## Inuzuka Clan
“Come on Sutemaru, let's sniff these guys out,” Aria says while petting the head of her ninja-dog who’s sniffing some left behind tents. “Are we sure he can find them? I mean, he’s not all that smart” Aria’s teammate Levi says while looking unamused at the ninja dog sniff through random objects. As Sutemaru begins to dig at the ground directly under him. “See he just wants to play. Dumb dog” Levi says as he begins to walk away annoyed the dog's antics. “Hey don’t be mean to him, He’s trying-” Aria begins before she is cut off by Sutemaru and starts scratching at Metal beneath the dirt. “You’ve gotta be kidding me…” Levi says while looking in complete disbelief. “Told you to give him a chance. He’s a good boy!”
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 1 excerpt.
While traveling with man's best friend, a ninken (or ninja dog). Exploring the countryside, training together and understanding one another and growing close enough to know what the other is thinking is the bond Inuzuka’s share with their Ning-Dog and one another.
### The Most Loyal
The Inuzuka Clan or Inuzuka Family is a family of shinobi in Konoha known for their use of ninja-dogs as fighting companions and are easily identified by the distinctive red fang markings on their cheeks. The members are given their own canine partner(s) when they reach a certain age. Thereafter, the shinobi and their dog(s) are practically inseparable. The shinobi and canine allies fight using Cooperation Ninjutsu, which takes advantage of their teamwork and their sharp claws and teeth. The clan members are also able to communicate with canines. The members of this clan, much like their canine partners, have greatly enhanced senses, especially their sense of smell.
### Inuzuka Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Dex, +1 Wis
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling, Survival
Beast Speak: You can speak to & understand creatures designated as Beasts.
Inuzuka Hijutsu: The Inuzuka Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Inuzuka Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
### Inuzuka Features
#### Four-Legs Technique
1st Level Clan Feature
Your clans unique fighting style has you fighting like a rabid beast with claws and fangs. Sharpened nails and teeth allows you to fight like a hunter, a predator, a Dog. While in combat, you can drop down on all fours and enter the Four-Legs Taijutsu stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits:
Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 2d4, and damage type becomes Slashing. This becomes 4d4 at 11th level.
You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for attacks and damage.
Your speed increased by +10, and you don’t spend extra movement when Wall or Water Walking.
You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.
#### Beast Master
1st Level Clan Feature
As per clan tradition, you were raised with a canine companion, bred by the Inuzuka clan known as a Nin-Dog. Your Nin-Dog has its own stats detailed as part of this clan but can be one of many breeds that determines its unique traits.
Your Nin-Dog is friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. In combat, it acts as part of your turn, but has its own reaction, which it can spend to cast Hijutsu you know with the [Tag-Team] keyword. You can command your Nin-Dog in one of the following ways:
Move. At no action cost to you, you can command your Nin-Dog to move its full movement.
Strike. As part of an attack made with your Attack action or a Jutsu you cast that makes attacks, you can forgo any number of attacks to command your Nin-Dog to use its Bite attack.
Synchronize. As part of casting a Jutsu with the Tag-Team keyword, your dog can spend a Jutsu slot casting the same jutsu, but using the Tag Team effect.
Hunt. As a Bonus action, you can command your Nin-Dog to perform any of its special abilities, Dash, Disengage, Hide, Help or perform a skill-based action in place of you while exploring or not in combat.
Your Nin-Dog has Jutsu slots like a summoned creature and regains them when he completes a rest of any type. When you are incapacitated or unconscious, your Nin-Dog can act on its own, and uses its turns to defend you and itself to the best of its abilities. If your Nin-Dog is reduced to 0 hit points, it makes Death saving throws like a player character would. If your Nin-Dog dies, over the course of a Full-Rest, while you are with the Inuzuka clan, you perform a secret ritual that provides you a similar Nin-Dog of the same breed, level and the same traits as your previous one.
Your Nin-Dog is treated as the same level as you and gains special traits as it grows in level with you. It starts small in size and grows to medium at 7th level and large at 15th. When you would gain the Ability score increase/Feat at levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 19, it also increases one of its ability modifiers and their associated saves by +1 of your choice up to a max of +6.
Beginning at character creation, you must first select your Dogs breed between the following list, and then select an additional trait from the Traits section at the end of this clan section. It gains one more trait at 7th and 15th levels.
Inuit. A breed known for its hunting skill. Gains proficiency in Survival and the Wild Sense trait.
Kugsha. A breed known for combat. Gains proficiency in Intimidation and the Ravage trait.
Tamaskan. A breed known for its ability to mold chakra. Gains proficiency in Chakra Control and the Paw-Signs trait.
Shiba. A breed known for its chameleon like fur. Gains proficiency in Stealth and the Silent Paw trait.
Akita. A breed known for its size and strength. Gains proficiency in Athletics and the Grit trait.
#### Savage Attacker
[BOX]
| #### Feral / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Rabid. You gain a +2 bonus to your AC and Dexterity saving throws. / Ferocious. You increase damage you deal by +1 damage die. If multiple damage die of different sizes are rolled, add one additional die of the largest size. / Hunting. You are always s aware of the location of creatures with less than full hit points so long as they are within 60 feet of you. / Calming. You exit Feral at the end of your next turn. |
[/BOX]
3rd Level Clan Feature
You and your Nin-Dog carry within them the savage fighting spirit of the Inuzuka. When you and your Nin-Dog are on opposite sides of a creatures, the first attack roll either of you make is at advantage, once per turn.
When either you or your Nin-Dog scores a critical hit, you become Feral.
Beginning at 11th level, when either you or your Nin-Dog falls below half of your maximum hit points, you become Feral for the next minute ignoring the Calming effect for the duration. Once you enter Feral in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.

#### Beast Human Clone
7th Level Clan Feature
When initiative is rolled, your Nin-Dog uses the advanced transformation technique, transforming to look exactly like you, with notable differences. While transformed, creatures cannot discern between either of you without Chakra Sight and your Nin-Dog gains the benefit of your Four-Legs Taijutsu stance and can become Feral when you do.
#### Beast Sense
11th Level Clan Feature
You have learned to imitate your Nin-Dogs sensory capabilities with your chakra. You gain a rank of Mastery in Perception, Insight, and Survival. Skill-based actions using those skills that take an action, now cost a Bonus action instead.
#### Two-Headed Wolf
15th Level Clan Feature
As a bonus action, you perform the Inuzuka Clans Secret Transformation Technique, fusing you and your dog, and transforming you both into a huge creature with 2 heads and combining your senses and strengths. You grow one size larger than your Nin-Dog up to a maximum size of Huge. You remain in this form for 1 minute. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.
While fused with your Nin-Dog, you use the Two-Headed Wolf stat block. When you fall to 0 hit points while in this state, you immediately end the fusion, separating back into two separate creatures. Your Nin-Dog has 1 hit point, and you have half of your maximum hit points.

### Nin-Dog Traits
#### Wild Sense
Your Nin-Dog can sniff out creatures even when they have covered their tracks. As a bonus action, the Nin-Dog raises its snout to the air and takes a single sniff. It becomes aware of all creatures within 60 feet of it and their current locations. Creatures that were previously Undetected drops down to being only Unseen. This increases to 120 feet at 7th level and 1 Mile at 15th level.
This does not identify a creature and does not reveal creatures submerged in water, underground, within buildings or using jutsu based effects to hide or mask themselves. Once they use this trait, they cannot do so again until 10 minutes pass.
#### Ravage
Your Nin-Dog becomes a four-legged feral beast, able to tear chunks out of wood or rock. Your Nin-Dogs Bite increases its damage die by 1 step. You can take this trait more than once increasing the die step each time, to a max size of d12.
Once per turn, as part of the Strike command, your Nin-Dog makes one additional Bite attack.
#### Paw-Signs
Your Nin-Dog weaves its paws like hand signs creating complex motions completely throwing you off. Select two Ninjutsu that you would normally qualify for of D-Rank. Your Nin-Dog learns it and you gain the Cast command. Your Nin-Dog continues its studies learning one additional jutsu at 7th and 15th levels.
Cast. As a bonus action, you command your Nin-Dog to cast a jutsu it knows.
You can take this trait more than once, increasing the rank of jutsu your Nin-Dog can learn by one grade, to a max rank of A-Rank.
#### Silent Paw
Your Nin-Dogs paw pads are soft, quiet and their nails make no clacking sound when they step. They gain a rank of mastery in Stealth. As part of the Hunt command, they can attempt to Hide while they are lightly obscured. On a success, they also gain the benefits of the Dash action and don’t lose the benefits being hidden when moving more than half their speed.
#### Grit
Your Nin-Dogs is built stoneface tough. With a body like a tailed beast, your Nin-Dog can truck through any harm that comes to it. Increase its hit points by an amount equal to twice its level. Whenever it gains a level thereafter, its hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit point.
Additionally, it gains proficiency in Constitution saving throws and Damage Reduction (DR) equal to its constitution ability modifier.
#### Savage
Your Nin-Dog lives and breathes violence. You often consider getting it a muzzle, just in case. Creatures that cast jutsu with the Hand sign (HS) component makes your Nin-Dog see red, allowing it to spend its reaction to move and then make a Bite attack against them before the effects of the triggering jutsu is applied.
You can take this trait more than once, increasing the number of attacks it makes as part of this reaction by +1, up to a max of 3 attacks.
#### Barker
Your Nin-Dogs bark is just are ferocious as its bite. Your Nin-Dog gains the Bark attack. It can use this Bark attack in place of its Bite.
Bark. Ranged Taijutsu Save: 15ft., one target. The affected target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it gains a rank of Demoralized.
#### Talker
Your Nin-Dog isn’t only man’s best friend. It can also talk!? Your Nin-Dog can speak in a language that everyone can understand. It gain proficiency in the Persuasion and Deception skills. It will never lie to you, but will always lie to others if it believes the truth will bring you harm in any way.
#### Skilled
Your Nin-Dog is very versatile. It gains proficiency in 4 skills of your choice.
You can take this trait more than once. When you do, select 4 more skills your Nin-Dog gains proficiency in. They also gain a rank of Mastery in all skills they had prior to gaining the 4 new skills.
#### Big Boy/Girl
Your Nin-Dogs is definitely getting three square meals. Increase your Nin-Dogs size by one category. If your Nin-Dog would grow in size on their own to a defined size, they instead grow to the next size category due to this trait. You also gain the Shrink Boy/Girl command.
Additionally, when your Nin-Dog attacks a creature smaller than it, it gains a rank of Mastery to its attack and damage rolls.
Shrink Boy/Girl. As an Action, you command your Nin-Dog to shrink down 1 size category. They can remain this smaller size indefinitely until commanded again to regain their larger size.

## Kurama Clan
“There has to be a way out!” the bandit screamed as he raced down the same hallway for the 20th time. “How did we end up here!? This was supposed to be an easy job.” The bandit screams as his voice echo’s infinitely. Elsewhere a young girl wearing a chunin vest sits in a tree eating ice cream as she watches the bandit run in circles screaming pointlessly. She giggles to herself before finishing her snack. She reaches into her side pouch drawing a single kunai and approaches them “I guess, I had my fun. Time to put an end to this.”
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 3 excerpt.
### Illusions as Real as Reality
The Kurama Clan is a clan of extremely skilled Genjutsu users. This talent in Genjutsu is due to the Kekkei Genkai that the clan possesses. However, once every few generations, a member of the clan will be born with such enormous skill in Genjutsu that their illusions causes the brain to make anything that happens to the victim within the Genjutsu physically real, allowing the clan member to potentially kill their opponents with Genjutsu.
### Kurama Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis or Cha, +1 Int
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Insight
Illusory Genius: You reduce downtime cost to learn Genjutsu you qualify for by an amount equal to their rank, to a minimum of 1. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)
Deep Sleep: Over the course of a long rest, your dreams are made manifest. Select one skill or Toolkit and gain proficiency in it until your next long rest. If you have proficiency already, you instead gain a rank of Mastery with that skill
Photographic Memory: You retain information, images and words better than anyone. Your mind is a lockbox. You can perfectly recall anything you’ve read, seen or heard within the last 3 months, without making a check.
### Kurama Features
#### Onijutsu
1st Level Clan Feature
Your Genjutsu are extensions of your subconsciousness, and your ability to control your dreams using your clans Kekkei Genkai give birth to a unique subset of Genjutsu molding, known as Onijutsu. The Kurama clans Onijutsu manifests in the form of Oni-Coils. You have a number of coils equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.
You can spend Oni-Coils on chosen Onijutsu. Each Onijutsu costs 1 or more Oni-Coils. If an Onijutsu costs more than 1 Oni-Coil it will specify its cost, otherwise, they cost 1 Oni-Coil. Each Onijutsu can be used once per turn, as part of casting a Genjutsu you know, unless otherwise specified. You can use up to 2 Onijutsu per casting. You regain spent Oni-Coils when you finish a rest. You gain 2 Onijutsu at character creation and can select one additional Onijutsu at 7th and 15th levels.
Infectious Genjutsu
When an affected creature, fails their saving throw or you score a hit with your Genjutsu attack, the target becomes a relay point for your Genjutsu. Until the beginning of your next turn, Once per turn, if the affected creature has an ally move within 10 feet of them, the moving creature must make a Saving throw against the effects of your Genjutsu, suffering its effects as if they were the original target.
Overwhelming Illusions
When a creature succeeds their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, until the end of their next turn, they increase the cost of jutsu they cast by an amount equal to the rank of the amplified jutsu. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +8, B-Rank: +12, A-Rank: +16, S-Rank: +20)
Punishing Illusions
If one of your targets succeeds on their save against the amplified Genjutsu, you manifest a secondary illusion with the original. The affected creature remakes their saving throw.
If they fail this remade save, they suffer the Genjutsu’s effects of a Success, but also become Confused.
Sensory Domination
A creature that fails their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, that have a special sense such as Blind Sight or Chakra Sight are instead Blinded for the duration of the jutsu. If the jutsu doesn’t have a duration, they remain blinded until the beginning of your next turn.
Subtle Illusion
The amplified Genjutsu can be cast without Hand Signs (HS) or Chakra Seals (CS). When cast this way, you must either make eye contact or make physical contact with the target as part of the jutsu’s casting.
The Pain Is Real
At the cost of 2 Oni-Coils, when you cast a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu that deals damage as an Action, you can convert it into a Genjutsu. The Jutsu cast loses its Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu keywords, gaining the Genjutsu and Tactile keywords.
Will Breaker
When an affected creature fails their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, their bodies ability to resist harm suffers as well. They suffer a -1 penalty to their next Strength or Dexterity saving throw. This increases to -2 at 11th level.
Versatile Authority
A creature making a saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu that has ranks of a Physical or Elemental condition cannot gain a jutsu based bonus to their saving throw.
#### Dream Walker
[BOX]
Dream Walker
Medium Illusory Construct
Armor Class 13 + your proficiency bonus
Hit Points 11 + Proficiency Bonus + your level.
Speed 30 ft.
|  | Mod | Save |  | Mod | Save |  | Mod | Save |
| STR | +0 | + | CON | +0 | + | WIS | +0 | + |
| DEX | +0 | + | INT | +0 | + | CHA | +0 | + |
Save Proficiencies All
Dream Walker Type
Dream Beast. +3 Str, Con. +2 Dex, Wis. Resistant to Acid, Bludgeoning and Earth damage. +20ft speed.
Dream Demon. +3 Str, Cha. +2 Con, Int. Resistant to Fire, Necrotic and Slashing damage. +20ft speed.
Dream Dragon. +3 Int, Con. +2 Dex, Cha. Resistant to Force, Lightning and Wind damage. 30ft Fly speed.
Dream Fey. +3 Wis, Con. +2 Dex, Cha. Resistant to Cold, Poison and Psychic damage. 30ft Fly speed.
Dream Spider. +3 Dex, Wis. +2 Str, Con. Resistant to Physical and Elemental Conditions. 60ft climb speed
Dream Walker Traits
Strong Dreams. Increase all modifiers by +1 at 7th level and again at 15th level.
Illusory Construct. This creature cannot physically interact with the environment and cannot be more than 60 feet away from their summoner before being dispelled. It can move through the spaces of other creatures as if they were difficult terrain. It reduces its hit points by 5 if it ends its turn inside an object where its summoner cannot see it. If an effect it uses requires a saving throw, it uses either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu save DC.
Attacks
Strike (Melee). Melee Genjutsu Attack: 5ft., one target. Highest Mod + Prof to hit, 1d8 + Mod psychic damage. This increases to 2d8 at 11th
Strike (Ranged). Ranged Genjutsu Attack: 30ft., one target. Highest Mod + Prof to hit, 1d6 + Mod psychic damage. This increases to 2d6 at 11th
Abilities
Beast Pounce. One creature within15 feet must make an Intelligence Saving throw, being knocked prone and Dazed on a failed save.
Demons Bargain. Once creature within 20 feet must make a Wisdom Saving throw, going Berserk on a failed save. Once this ability is used it cannot be used again until the end of your next turn.
Dragons Breath. All creatures in a 30-foot cone must make a Charisma saving throw, being Weakened on a failed save.
Fey Trickery. One creature within 60 feet must make an Intelligence saving throw, being Dazzled on a failed save.
Spiders Web. All creatures within a 10-foot cube, centering on a point you can see within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw, being Concussed on a failed save.
[/BOX]
1st Level Clan Feature
Whenever you awake from a rest, you bring something from your dreams with you, a Dream Walker. A Dream Walker is an illusory construct given life and form by your subconscious. You choose the type of Dream Walker from the following list: Dream Fey, Dream Beast, Dream Dragon, Dream Spider, Dream Demon.
Use the Dream Walker stat block found as part of this clan, and apply the specific Dream types traits. Your Dream Walker grows in strength alongside you, and can affect the waking world so long as you can prevent it from falling to 0 hit points. When it does, its dispelled, until you complete your next rest. Your Dream Walker regains all missing hit points when you complete a rest.
Alternatively, when you cast a Jutsu or use a feature that summons a chakra construct, or when you complete your rest while you have a jutsu on your known list that summons a chakra construct, you can spend 2 Oni-Coils to use that creatures stat block as your Dream Walker.
Your Dream Walker only obeys you and doesn’t acknowledge the existence of anyone else unless you command it to. It only obeys your commands. In combat, it acts on your turn. You can command your Dream Walker to do the following:
Move. At no action cost to you, you can command your Dream Walker to move its full movement.
Strike. As part of an attack made with your Attack action or a Jutsu you cast that makes attacks, you can forgo any number of attacks to command your Dream Walker to use its Strike attack.
Distort. As a bonus action, you can command your Dream Walker to use its associated ability. If an ability calls for a saving throw, you use either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu jutsu save DC.
Pass Through. Starting at 7th level, as part of casting a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you know, you can have your jutsu originate from your Dream Walker.
Inflict Harm. Starting at 7th level, as part of casting a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you know, you can have your Dream Walker perform the attacks and use their Strikes in place of [Unarmed] or [Weapon Damage].
#### Illusion Made Manifest
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your dreams give weight and form to the thoughts and ideals you wish to make real. When you complete a rest, you can select one weapon group and gain proficiency in those weapons. When you wield a weapon from that group, it takes on an ethereal, almost ghost like form.
Only you can wield this weapon and its damage type becomes Psychic. While wielding the weapon, you can choose to spend Oni-Coils to utilize one of the following abilities. If the affected creature is already making a save throw as a result of damage or to reduce damage, then on a failed save apply these abilities effects:
Memory Haze. As part of dealing [Weapon Damage] you can spend 1 Oni-Coil to force the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature becomes Confused as their more pressing thoughts become fleeting memories.
Stolen Thoughts. As part of dealing [Weapon Damage], you can spend 2 Oni-Coils to force the affected creature to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, you become aware of their most immediate goals, and they forget them for the next minute.
#### Déjà vu
[BOX]
| #### Well Rested / Will Amp / You ever slept so well; it boosted your capabilities? Well now you have. / Fresh Start. You gain temporary chakra points equal to your level. These temporary chakra points last until used or your next rest. / Quick Start. The next initiative roll you make is at advantage. / Loose Shoulders. The first instance of damage you deal is increased by +1 damage die. If multiple damage die of different sizes are rolled, add one additional die of the largest size. / Quick Reaction. The first reaction you take in combat does not consume your reaction for the round. You can use this effect once per application of this status. / No longer Rested. Once all of these benefits have been consumed or used, this status ends. |
[/BOX]
3rd Level Clan Feature
Some people say dreams are like prophecy, able to foretell an event before it happens. Yours are no different.
When you would need to make a contested check against an opponent’s Charisma or Wisdom based skill, you can make your check at advantage, because you’ve already seen this transpire in a dream you’ve had. Once you use this, you cannot do so again for 10 minutes, as dreams are often difficult to decipher or recall on demand.
#### Deep Sleep
7th Level Clan Feature
Your allies have never had a deep sleep like you, and thus, they have never been as well rested as you either. When you and your allies would complete a Long Rest together, you all become Well Rested.
#### Lucid Dreams
7th Level Clan Feature
When you summon your Dream Walker its form is more malleable. More surreal. You are able to adjust its form and tweak it to better fit what you originally dreamed it was. Select one of the following Lucid Dream modifications and apply it to your Dream Walker. You can change this modification when you complete a rest of any type.
Elemental
You dream that your Dream Walker was more of an elemental instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of a single nature release you have access to. If you do not have access to a nature release, you instead roll 1d6 and that is the nature release it is most like for the duration (1: Earth, 2: Wind, 3: Fire, 4: Water,  5: Lightning, 6: Reroll).
Depending on the nature release it embodies, select two jutsu you know of C-Rank or lower with the associated nature release keyword. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have 2 jutsu with the associated keyword, or you had to randomly select via the dice, they instead gain the chosen jutsu based on their nature release association.
Earth Release. Agonizing Thorn (D-Rank), Tectonic Palm (C-Rank)
Wind Release.  Slicing Wind Bullet (D-Rank), Great Breakthrough (C-Rank)
Fire Release. Phoenix Fire (D-Rank), Flame Armor (C-Rank)
Water Release. Tsunami Mallet (D-Rank), Hiding In Mist (C-Rank)
Lightning Release. Guiding Bolt (D-Rank), Lightning Rope
Warrior
You dream that your Dream Walker was more of a warrior instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of a warrior, samurai or even a shinobi. Select two Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you know of C-Rank or lower. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have a combination of two Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, your Dream Walker instead gains one of the following based on their type of your choice.
Brute. Leaf Uppercut (D-Rank), Beast (C-Rank)
Samurai.  Yosaku Cut (D-Rank), Disarming Riposte (C-Rank)
Ninja. Crippling Strike(D-Rank), Mikiri Counter (C-Rank)
Vegetative
You dream that your Dream Walker was more of an primal extract of nature instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of plants or fungi that exude substances used in Medicine. If you have access to Medical Release, you select the type of vegetable. If you do not have access to Medical Release, you instead roll 1d4 and that is the creature/damage type it is most like for the duration (1: Flowers (Poison), 2: Fungi (Necrotic), 3: Moss (Acid),  4: Reroll).
Depending on the plant type it embodies, select two jutsu you know of C-Rank or lower with the associated damage or effects most similar. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have 2 jutsu with the associated damage or effects, or you had to randomly select via the dice, they instead gain the chosen jutsu based on their plant type association.
Flowers. Poisonous Blast (D-Rank), Poison Mist (C-Rank)
Fungi.  Necrosis (D-Rank), Vampiric Touch (C-Rank)
Moss. Acid String (D-Rank), Acidic Bolt (C-Rank)
#### Mental Resistance
11th Level Clan Feature
Your mind and will is shielded by your subconscious. You gain a rank of mastery to Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.
#### Inner Self
15th Level Clan Feature
Your subconscious rises to the surface, becoming your true self. You’ve been training this piece of you unknowingly, until now. Your Dream Walker. As a bonus action, while you have a Dream Walker active, you fuse into them, assuming their form, and using their stat blocks ability scores, attacks, abilities and hit points. You retain your own weapon and skill proficiencies and jutsu knowledge, plus any it has that you don’t know. For the next minute, you retain this state. If your hit points fall to 0, you revert back to your normal form and your Dream Walker is dispelled. Once you transform in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest. Alternatively, you can spend 2 Oni-Coils to transform back into your Dream Walker form early.
## Namikaze Clan
A hot headed, blond shinobi stands at the beginning of the starting line. Other shinobi approach the starting line nervous that the blond shinobi is here at all. A start sound erupts as the adjacent shinobi all begin to race each other. The blond dashes forward with relative ease as he accelerates faster and faster. They cross the finish line. As everyone sits around tired and exhausted. He says “Good effort guys. Too bad I won twice already.” One of the other shinobi question what he means. To which he explains, the moment the race started he blinked passed the finish line, and caught back up with the other racers so they didn’t give up and so he could see who would come in second place, unfortunately he also came in second place.
—Shuria Nata
At Worlds End, Ch. 1 excerpt.
### Faster than the eye can see
The Namikaze Clan is a clan that doesn’t know its origins, but it’s assumed they hail from the land of Fire. Their most prominent member became its 4th Hokage. The Namikaze Clan doesn’t have a powerful family name, nor does it share a family compound or hold any high-ranking title. It is embodied by its ideal of speed and potential. The Namikaze clan has produced some of the fasted shinobi in the leaf, and the continuation of this tradition will move further into future.
### Namikaze Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex, +1 Int
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Chakra Control.
Swift Release Affinity: You begin with either Wind or Lightning Release affinity. (Pick one)
Swift Release Techniques: The Namikaze Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Namikaze Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
### Namikaze Features
#### Blood of the Swift
1st Level Clan Feature
The Namikaze are known for their incredible reflexes and agility. Due to your natural gift for speed, you develop a special fuinjutsu meant to seal bursts of chakra within you, that you can release for exponential boosts to your physicality. This special fuinjutsu is known as Speed Seals and are represented as D8’s. You have a number of Speed Seals equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.
You can spend Speed Seals on any feature or ability that calls for it. You regain spent seals when you finish a rest of any type. The first of such abilities you can spend Speed Seals on are your Blitz Arts, special abilities passed down from clansmen to clansmen. You begin with 2 such abilities. You gain an additional one at 7th and 15th levels.
Flash Dodge
As a reaction to taking damage, you can spend up to 2 Speed Seals, gaining +2 bonus to AC, until the beginning of your next turn, for each die spent. This bonus to AC is also applied against the triggering attack.
Flash Step
At the beginning of your turn, by spending 1 Speed Seal you gain the benefits of the Dash action. You also cannot have your speed reduced as a result of hostile effects for the duration.
Speed Amplification
At the beginning of your turn, you can spend 1 Speed Seal. When you do, you gain a +10-bonus speed and ignore difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. This increases to +20 at 7th level and +30 at 15th level.
Blitz Assault
Once per turn, as part of making an attack when you cast a jutsu, you can spend 2 Speed Seals to make one additional attack of the same type, dealing 2d8 damage on a hit and reapplying the jutsu’s non-damaging effect on a success, if any. This damage increases to 4d8 at 7th, and 6d8 at 15th level.
Blink of an Eye
At the beginning of your turn, by spending 2 Speed Seals, you can select a space within your movement speed range and teleport to the chosen location. All hostile creatures whose space is adjacent to the space you teleport to must make a Dexterity saving throw, suffering a -2 penalty to their AC until the beginning of your next turn on a failed save due to the suddenness of your appearance. If you were to make an attack against a creature with a penalized AC during the same turn you teleport, you can choose to spend 1 additional Speed Seal to teleport back to the original space you started your turn in.
Phase Dodge
As a reaction to making a Strength or Constitution saving throw, you can spend 2 Speed Seals. When you do, you make a Dexterity saving throw in place of the triggering save.
Like the Wind
Once per turn, when you deal wind or lightning damage to a creature, you can spend 1 Speed Seal, and select a different creature within 30 feet of you, and teleport into a space adjacent to them, and make one unarmed or weapon attack against them, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage], plus your spent Speed Seal.
Rushing Start
When you roll initiative, you can spend 1 Speed Seal, adding twice the result to your initiative.
Speed Burst
Once per turn, on your turn, you can spend 3 Speed Seals to gain an additional Action. This additional action lasts until the end of the current turn. Once you use this blitz art, increase the Speed Seal cost of this blitz art by +1, until you complete a long rest.
Speed Formula
As a bonus action, you can mark one weapon you are wielding with your Speed Seal. This mark lasts for the next hour or until spent. Marking a weapon doesn’t spend it.
As a bonus action on following turns, you can spend the marked weapons Speed Seal, teleporting to it, so long as its within 120 feet of you and is not destroyed/broken.
#### Interdiction Seal
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Namikaze are related to the Uzumaki through both blood and familial history. The Namikaze honors that by training its members to be specialist in Fuinjutsu as well as speed. Once per turn, when you deal damage with a weapon attack or a melee attack, you can spend 1 Speed Seal to mark a damaged creature with the spent seal. A specialized seal of your design grows over the impact point and there it remains for the next minute. While a creature is marked in this way, the seal provides the following benefits to you:
Marked. Trigger Interdiction Seal effects from Hijutsu you cast.
Triangulate. The first attack each turn against a marked creature has a +1 to the attacks critical threat range.
Interdiction. As a reaction, to a marked creature you can see casting a jutsu that requires Hand Signs (HS), you can detonate the Speed Seal forcing their chakra network to go out of control. The affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, having their jutsu Interrupted gaining 1 rank of Sealed on a failure. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level. Once your speed seal has detonated, the creature is no longer marked.
[BOX]
| #### Speed Sovereign / Reflex Amp / Your movements leaves steaks the same color as your hair. You leave after images in your wake. Others can barely comprehend what you have become. / Seal Reproduction. You regain 1 Speed Seal at the beginning of each of your turns for the duration. / Chain Blink. You can teleport to any creature marked with your Speed Seal, once per turn. If there are multiple creatures marked with your Speed Seal, you can teleport to them each, once per turn. / Spatial Sovereign. The Sealed condition cannot prevent you from teleporting. / Spatial Immunity. You cannot be teleported against your will by any means. |
[/BOX]
#### Swift Release Manifestation
7th Level Clan Feature
The Namikaze clan has a unique talent for manifesting Swift Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Lightning Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Swift Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Wind Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Lightning respectively.
Additionally, once per turn, at the beginning or end of that turn, you can spend 1 Speed Seal to teleport to a creature or object marked with your Speed Seal, so long as they are within 120 feet of you.
#### Tricksters Blink
11th Level Clan Feature
Your speed and reflexes have reached their peak. You are now where attacks go to be embarrassed. You gain the following special abilities you can use once per turn.
Redirecting Flashpoint. When you have two or more creatures marked with a Speed Seal and you see one of them making an attack or casting a jutsu, you can spend your reaction targeting two marked creatures. Both creatures teleport, switching their current position on the map. This teleport happens before the jutsu’s effect takes place. If this teleport would take the jutsu or attack out of its range, the attacker/caster must choose a new valid target. If no creature is in the attacks/jutsu’s range, then the attack misses and the jutsu is Interrupted. Both Seals then are dispelled on both creatures.
Blink Burst. When a hostile creature marked with your Speed Seal would deal damage to you or inflict a Physical or Elemental condition as a result of an attack or jutsu they cast, you can spend your reaction, dispel the targets Speed Seal and spend 1 additional Speed Seal.  When you do, make a Dexterity saving throw vs the triggering creatures attack result or their jutsu’s save DC. On a success, you avoid the attack or treat your success as if you succeeded their saving throw and they were forcing a Dexterity save. You also teleport into an adjacent space near them and can cast a Jutsu that requires an attack, has a casting time of 1 Action and only targets the triggering creature.
#### Sovereign of Speed
15th Level Clan Feature
You learn to vibrate your body accelerating yourself beyond normal shinobi limits. Infusing your cells themselves with the energy needed to ignore friction itself. As a bonus action, you can enter the Speed Sovereign state for the next minute. You can enter this state once per long rest.
## Namikaze Clan Jutsu
### D-Rank
#### Swift Release: Accelerate/Decelerate
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you see a creature within range take damage. Range: 60 feet Duration: Instant
Components: HS, M
Cost: 4 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile, Visual), Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.
Description: You focus your Chakra, accelerating or decelerating the impact of an attack or jutsu, lessening or multiplying its force.
Accelerate. The target takes 2d10 extra Wind or Lightning damage from the triggering instance of damage.
Decelerate. Reduce the damage dealt by the triggering instance of damage by 2d10.
Interdiction Seal. A creature marked with this seal that takes additional damage or has their damage reduced, must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the seal triggers, with chains shooting from it, connecting to the ground until the end of their next turn. For the duration, a creature that failed their saving throw cannot move more than 5 feet from their current space and take a -1 penalty to dexterity saving throws.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage dealt or reduced by 1d10.
#### Swift Release: Mirror Image Technique
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self Duration: 1 minute.
Components: HS, CM, M
Cost: 5 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual), Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.
Description: You utilize your Swift release, manifesting illusory duplicates of yourself maintained by your speed alone as three clones of yourself appear in your space.
For the Jutsu’s duration, the clones move with you and mimic your actions, shifting positions so it’s impossible to track which image is real. You can use your bonus action to dismiss the clones.
Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the jutsu's duration, roll a d8 for each of your remaining duplicates. If any of the d8’s are 4 or higher, one of the duplicates are hit instead of you, and the duplicate is dismissed. The duplicates otherwise ignore all other damage and effects. This jutsu ends when all duplicates are destroyed.
If the creature that targets you has True Sight, Tremor Sense, or Chakra Sight instead on a roll of 6 or higher, the duplicate is hit instead of you.
Interdiction Seal. When you attack a creature marked with this seal, your duplicates join in. You can dispel one clone you currently have active to grant yourself a d4 bonus to the attack result. Alternatively, creatures marked with this seal that deals damage to you as a result of an attack they make, reduce the number needed to roll on the d8 to make the attack hit the duplicate by 2.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, increase the number of duplicates you have by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of duplicates you have by +2.
#### Swift Release: Flicker
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you take damage. Range: Self
Duration: 1 round.
Components: HS, M
Cost: 5 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.
Description: When forced to avoid a hostile effect through sheer agility, evasiveness or speed, you don’t disappoint. You flicker in place so quickly that you make attacks and hostile effects phase through you.
Until the beginning of your next turn, the first time each turn that you take damage, including against the triggering instance of damage, roll a d4 gaining the benefit of the result.
If you roll a 1, you gain 4 damage reduction to that instance of damage. If you roll a 2, increase the DR gained by +2, and now applies to each instance of damage until the end of the turn. If you roll a 3, same as 2 but you have resistance instead. If you roll a 4, same as 3, but you gain immunity to the triggering instance of damage.
#### Swift Release: Air shattering Strike
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 30 feet Duration: Instant
Components: CM, M, W (Any, Optional)
Cost: 4 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.
Description: You move at the speed of intent, instantly strike out with it faster than the eye can see, at a creature within range, shattering the air like glass as you move.
Make a melee Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu) attack against a target you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes 4d10 Wind or Lightning damage if a ninjutsu attack or your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage] + 2d10 if a Taijutsu attack.
Interdiction Seal. When your attack lands, you prime the seal as it glows an ominous color of your choosing, if the affected creature willingly moves before the beginning of your next turn, the seal detonates with compressive force. The affected creature takes 3d10 force damage and must make a Constitution saving throw, on a failed save they are teleported into a space that can hold them as close as possible to another creature or object marked with your Speed Seal. If no other creature is marked in this way, they do not teleport.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d10 and you can make one additional attack against another creature within range.
### C-Rank

If used in combat, the duration of this jutsu becomes Concentration, up to 1 minute. For that duration the aura moves with you, centered on you and each creature of your choice, that begins its turn within your aura has its speed increased by +10 feet until beginning of your next turn.
If used during exploration or land travel, its duration becomes 1 hour and you and your team treat normal travel pace as Fast travel pace.

#### Swift Release: Thunder Flash
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: C-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self (30-foot line) Duration: Instant

Description: You move like a blur and rush forward with explosive power. As a part of casting this jutsu, you move to the furthest unoccupied space in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line from your current position. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks and you can move through another creatures space. Each creature you pass through during this movement must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 Wind or lightning damage on a failed save, and half as much on a successful one. If you used your Taijutsu save DC, they instead take your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage] + 3d6 on a failed save or half as much on a success.
Interdiction Seal. If your movement passes through a creature marked with a Speed Seal, you can move an additional 15 feet, but you can change direction after leaving their space. You must still move in a straight line when you change direction. You cannot affect a creature more than once if you somehow can pass through them a second time.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6.
### B-Rank
#### Swift Release: Spatial Step
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self  Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Components: HS, CM
Cost: 12 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.
Description: You draw a special fuinjutsu symbol onto yourself allowing yourself to slip into and out of a pocket dimension of your creation. At the end of each of your turns, roll a d8. On a roll of 5 or higher, you vanish from your current location, appearing in your pocket dimension.
At the start of your next turn, and when the jutsu ends, you return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space chosen at random.
While in your pocket dimension. You can only see shades of gray, and you can’t see further than 60 feet away from the space you vanished. While in this pocket dimension, you cannot interact with the material dimension in anyway. If you end concentration of this jutsu early while you are in this pocket dimension, you return to the material plane following this jutsu’s effect at the beginning of your following turn.
#### Swift Release: Spatial Wall
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 60 Feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Components: HS, M
Cost: 14 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release, Barrier
Description: You weave together a wall of shimmering, blocks of sealing symbols in the form of blocks on a solid surface within range. You can make a straight wall up to 30 feet long, 20-feet higher and 1 feet thick, or a cylindrical wall up to 20-feet high, 1 foot thick and 20 feet in diameter. This wall can be seen through as if looking through a foggy glass window.
This wall cannot be climbed, walked on and acts like a solid barrier that repels organic creatures.
Ranged Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu and Weapon attacks or Ninjutsu with a special shape that attempts to pass through the barrier or attempts to originate within the barrier is turned back on its caster, making its target the original caster, using the casters original attack vs their own AC. Genjutsu cast targeting a creature on the opposite side does not get redirected back to its original caster.
This barrier, while powerful, is extremely draining, the cost to maintain this jutsu, is its original cost to cast it.

Components: HS, CM

On a failed save, they become Slowed and Dazed.
While Slowed and/or Dazed in this way, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls as its speed and movement is being taken away and neither condition ends early, instead remaining applied for the duration of this jutsu.
A creature that succeeds on their saving throw ends both the Slowed and Dazed condition, until they remake their saving on their following turn for the duration of this jutsu.
Interdiction Seal. A creature with a Speed Seal, affected by this jutsu, suffers a -1 penalty to their saving throw each time they succeed for the duration. This penalty stacks up to 4 times.
## Nara Clan
Shinbi looked across the battlefield where multiple bodies lay either lifeless or almost there. Fireballs and Walls of Stone pepper the battlefield as the attacks have not stopped. She closed her eyes for a moment to envision the world in her mind’s eye. She saw the enemies begin to move towards the left flank to be stopped by her men trying to stave them off. This leads to more troops bursting through the defense set up in the center of the battlefield, her men would be powerless to stop it, she would be assaulted and the battle would be lost. She opens her eyes and begins to speak “The enemy knows we are wounded and weak, allow them to think that. They will be coming soon, it’s a trap we will set for them, let them come, Set explosive Traps along the way. We are making a tactical retreat.” Her men look confused but listen nonetheless. As they make their way out, the left flank is breached as they rush towards the retreating party, Shinbi makes a single hand seal as the explosives go off stopping them in their tracks and crippling their assault.
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 10 excerpt.
### Inconceivable foresight
The Nara Clan or Nara Family is one of the many clans of Konohagakure. They are known for tending deer and their ability to manipulate shadows through the use of Yin Release.
There are stories of men and women who can see battles before they happen, see victories and defeats before the first weapons are drawn and can route those victories or prevent those defeats all within the span of a moment. These men and women came together and over the years consolidated their knowledge and insight and became known as the Nara Clan. The Nara clan has a special relationship with the Akimichi and the Yamanaka clan. For several generations, members of these three families have formed "Ino–Shika–Cho" trios.
### Nara Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Wis
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Investigation, Insight
Nara Hijutsu: The Nara Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Nara Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
### Nara Features
#### Shadow Arts
1st Level Clan Feature
The Nara clan teaches you to think in silhouettes and the curvature of light. How to isolate a foe and get information out of them. How to use your shadow to strangle an army. But this takes focus, coordination and requires you to enter the Shadow Art stance.
You can enter your Shadow Art stance as a Bonus Action. This is treated as a Chakra stance for you. While in this stance you gain the following benefits:
Shadow Possession. As an Action, you can select a creature you can see within 40 feet of you, as your shadow snakes across the ground, connecting with their shadow. The affected creature must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest Jutsu save. On a failure, the target becomes Shadow Bound. A Shadow bound creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC at the end of each of their turns, ending this condition on a success.
Shadows Reach. The range of Shadow Possession increases by +20 feet at 7th level and 15th level.
Limited Shadow. You can only hold 1 creature at a time using Shadow Possession. This increases to 2 at 7th and 3 at 15th. You can select additional creatures when you spend your action to Shadow Possession as you gain the ability to hold more creatures, up to the number of creatures you can hold.
Distorted Shadow. You cannot use Shadow Possession if you cannot mold chakra, or maintain concentration on jutsu.
Time of Day. Your jutsu gain their associated time of day effect based on what your GM says most matches your environmental scenario; Bright or Dimly Lit
[BOX]
| Shadow Possession – Shadow Bound / [Physical] / A Shadow Bound creature is Restrained and Grappled in place. / This condition ends early if any of the following occurs: / A Shadow Bound creature is moved as a result of another creature or effect moving them. / The creature that bound you is incapacitated or cannot mold chakra. / The creature that bound you cannot see you. / You or the creature that bound you is covered by total darkness. / When you would make or remake your saving throw to end this effect, you do not roll at disadvantage. |
[/BOX]
#### Operational Contingencies
[BOX]
| #### Combat Coordinated / Will Amp / You move as a team, with your team. / Coordinated Start. As part of rolling initiative, you gain a rank of Mastery to your initiative. This becomes 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th level. / Team Coordination. You can select a willing allies creature to go in your place in initiative. This counts as their turn for initiative. If you take another Combat Coordinated creatures place in initiative, you must give your place in initiative to another Combat Coordinated creature. / Coordinated Support. If another Combat Coordinated creature is under the effect of a condition or hostile effect that requires an ability or skill check, or a saving throw, you can spend your reaction to make that check or saving throw for them using your statistics. |
[/BOX]
3rd Level Clan Feature
You don’t react. You knew what was going to happen hours ago, and you planned a contingency for it immediately afterwards.
At the beginning of each of your turns, you can spend your Bonus Action to establish a Contingency. A Contingency is combination of a Cause (Trigger) and an Effect (Result). This increases to two Contingencies as part of the same bonus action at 11th level.
When you do, select one Cause(trigger) and then one Effect(result), which form a single Contingency. A Contingency is prepared until the beginning of your next turn. If a Cause occurs within this duration, then the Effect is applied at the same time as the Cause occurring.
Cause
An allied creature is targeted by an attack.
[BOX]
| #### Diplomatic Coordination / Social Amp / You move as a team, with your team. / Coordinated Words. You gain a rank of Mastery to either Deception, Persuasion or Intimidation (pick one) for the remainder of this social encounter. This becomes 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th level. / Coordinated Experience. If your Background is related to or associated with the opposing creature, you gain advantage on Insight checks. |
[/BOX]
An allied creature fails a saving throws.
An allied creature gains a Physical Condition.
An allied creature gains a Mental Condition.
A hostile creature you can see casts a jutsu with a Hand Sign (HS) component.
A hostile creature that you can see, begins their turn concentrating on a jutsu.
A hostile creature you can see moves within 10 feet of an allied creature.
Effect
Grant an allied creature a rank of mastery to their AC, until the beginning of their next turn.
Grant an allied creature a rank of mastery to their saving throws, until the beginning of their next turn.
An allied creature can remake their saving throw for any effect currently applied to them.
An allied creature makes an opportunity attack against a hostile creature they can see within their range at no reaction cost.
An allied creature spends their reaction to move up to 10 feet without triggering attacks of opportunities. If this movement takes them out of range of an area effect, they are no longer a target and if they move out of range of a hostile creatures attack, the hostile creature must choose a new valid target.
An allied creature spends their reaction to cast a jutsu with a casting time of 1 Action against a hostile creature in its range.
#### Team Coordination
7th Level Clan Feature
Your team has come to depend on you and your clans strategic minds. You’ve brought it with you and plan on making sure your team has a tactical advantage in every scenario. When you roll initiative or begin a social encounter your allies begin coordinating around you.
All allies gain the Coordinated condition until initiative ends. There are two different variants of Coordinated, one focused on combat called Combat Coordination, the other for Social encounters called Diplomatic Coordination.
#### Shogi Board
11th Level Clan Feature
Every battlefield is a shogi board that only you can see. Every ally and adversary, a piece on the board. Every moment, a gesture to checkmate.
When you use Shadow Possession or cast a Nara Hijutsu that inflicts the Shadow Bound condition, while you have Contingencies established, you can dismiss one Contingency to command two of your allied to spend their reaction to Cast a jutsu with a casting time of 1 Action or use a clan feature they know, that costs an Action. When they do, they must target the same creature you do.
As part of this feature, you and your chosen allies determine the order of which effects are applied. (If the chosen allies cast the Human Boulder Hijutsu or uses the Mind Body Transfer clan feature or Mind Body Disturbance Hijutsu then they make their attacks with a rank of mastery and force the target creature to make their saving throw with a -2 penalty to their saving throw)
#### Mendokusē
15th Level Clan Feature
At this point in your career. You’ve seen it all. Your enemies strategies aren’t new or inventive. You haven’t struggled to find a solution in a long time and it’s become boring. What a drag, right?
You can set up 1 Contingency at the start of your turn, without spending a bonus action. If you do, you cannot spend a Bonus action to establish a Contingency.
You can use Shadow Possession as a Bonus action instead of an Action. If you do, you cannot use Shadow Possession as an Action.

## Sarutobi Clan
Altina stands in the center of the training field as her teammates circle her. “You sure we should be all attacking you simultaneously?” one asks while looking concerned as he gets into position. “Yeah, for the last time, I need to master this combination. Now do it!” Altina responds irritated. Her 2 allies sigh as they redirect their trajectory and assault her with two different jutsu from two opposing sides. She quickly leaps into the air dodging them both while weaving hand seals and firing multiple motes of Lightning at both her allies as she quickly weaves a second jutsu together firing jets of Water into the motes of Lightning as they combine and beam towards her training partners...
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 4 excerpt.
### Bound by A Code of Honor
The Sarutobi Clan is an influential clan from Konoha. It has produced several renowned members who have held positions of high authority, including the Third Hokage; whose son, Asuma, held membership in the Twelve Guardian Ninja, while his other children served directly under the Hokage along with their spouse as Anbu. All known members have also been devout observers of the Will of Fire. This clan has the strength and influence to tie other clans together and create long lasting bonds.
### Sarutobi Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Int, +1 Con
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Pick any two skills between: Ninshou, Martial Arts, Illusions
Advanced Nature Affinity: Select one Nature release between Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Lightning or Medical. You are now able to add jutsu with the corresponding Keyword to your jutsu list. (Suggestion: Fire Release)
The Will of Fire: You gain a Will of Fire when you complete a long rest if you didn’t already have one.
### Sarutobi Features
#### The Legacy of The Past
1st Level Clan Feature
As a Sarutobi, you have inherited the Will of Fire from your forefathers. You embody it more than most other clans in your given village. You’ve been taught that focus and determination is what makes a shinobi strong. This Will is pooled within you, available to be called upon at a moment’s notice. Starting from character creation, you have a number of Will equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.
You can spend Will on Legacy Techniques and other features that call for it. You regain spent Will when you complete a rest. You gain 2 Legacy Technique at character creation, and an additional one at 7th and 15th levels.
Kindled Will
By spending 1 Will you gain a rank of Mastery to your next d20 based roll. Beginning at 7th level, if you spend 3 Will, you can instead gain two ranks of Mastery. Beginning at 15th level, if you spend 5 Will you gain three ranks of Mastery.
Swift Reaction
Once per turn, by spending 3 Will you gain an additional reaction, which you lose at the end of the current turn if not used. For every additional use beyond the first, increase the Will cost by +1, until you complete a short rest.  You cannot have more than one additional reaction per round as a result of this technique.
Aggressive Response
Once per turn, by spending 2 Will you can spend your reaction to cast a jutsu or use a feature with a cost of 1 Action.
Determination
At the beginning of your turn where you need to make a Death saving throw. Before rolling, you can spend 2 Will. When you do, you immediately gain a success before rolling.
Inspiring Will
When an allied creature other than yourself would make a d20 Roll, you can spend 2 Will to grant them a rank of Mastery to their result. Beginning at 7th level, if you spend 4 Will, they can instead gain two ranks of Mastery. Beginning at 15th level, if you spend 6 Will, they gain three ranks of Mastery.
Enduring
When you or an allied creature fail a saving throw, you can spend 2 Will and a reaction to remake the saving throw.
Limit Break
As part of casting a jutsu you know with a casting time of 1 Action, you can spend 3 Will to cast the jutsu again, targeting a different creature as part of the same action at no additional chakra cost.
Second Wind
As a bonus action, you dig deep pulling out a reserve of energy and stamina from your ancestors. Spend any number of Will up to your remaining. For the first Will spent, you roll a die the same size as either your Hit or chakra die. You regain hit or chakra points based on the die rolled equal to the result + your constitution modifier. For every Will spent after the first, roll 1d6, adding it to the result. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. You cannot use this feature unless you are in combat.
#### Blessing of the Flame
1st Level Clan Feature
Sarutobi are trained and skilled in a variety of tools and weapons and you are no different. When you take a long rest, you can perform a family ritual, calling on the blessings of the will of fire to grant you the mastery needed to use these tools of war to maintain the fires of will.
Select one Weapon Group or one Weapon Property. All weapons part of the chosen group or that share the chosen property that you wield become Flame Blessed until you complete a long rest. Weapons that are Flame Blessed gain the following benefits:
You cannot be disarmed of Flame Blessed weapons unless you are incapacitated.
Weapon attacks with Flame Blessed weapons can use your Taijutsu, Ninjutsu or Genjutsu ability modifier.
You gain a rank of Mastery to [Weapon Damage] (or [Unarmed Damage] if a Flame Blessed weapon with the Unarmed property) that you deal.
#### Cross-Style
3rd Level Clan Feature
As a Sarutobi, you are a versatile Swiss army knife of skill and options. You are able to mix it up and use any form of combat you see fit to unlike all others.
This technique manifests itself into a unique stance known as Cross-Style. This stance is unique in that it counts as a Chakra, Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance all at once. You can enter your Cross-Style stance as a bonus action. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits.
Chakra Powered Strikes. Your unarmed damage die becomes 1d6. Your [Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] types becomes the damage type associated with the nature release you selected for Advanced Nature Affinity (Medical = Poison).
Unified Form. Once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu) as an Action, you can spend a number of Will based on the jutsu’s rank (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5) to cast a second jutsu of a different discipline but the same rank as part of the same action. The second jutsu must have the same casting time and neither jutsu can require concentration or benefit from cost reduction effects. Once you do, you cannot spend your Bonus action to cast a jutsu until the beginning of your next turn. You gain a benefit based on the order in which you cast the chosen jutsu:
Any > Ninjutsu: Affected creatures with ranks of a Physical, Elemental, or Sensory condition suffer a -1 to their saving throw against the Ninjutsu cast.
Any > Taijutsu: The initial jutsu cast gains the Combo keyword and when the Taijutsu deals damage, the affected creature is pushed 10 feet in a direction of your choice.
Any > Bukijutsu: The initial jutsu cast gains the Chain keyword and when the Bukijutsu deals damage, the affected creature has a -1 to their AC until the beginning of your next turn.
Any > Genjutsu: Select a willing allied creature within half your movement speed range. You each teleport and swap places with each other.
#### Ember’s Guardian
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your clan is one that has been charged with the protection of the wills of the people. The will of fire. This takes the form in ways of protecting your allies should they find themselves in dire straits.
Guardians Will. When an allied creature within 10 feet of you takes damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to swap spaces with them. The attack now hits you. As part of this attack dealing damage to you, you reduce the damage you take by an amount equal to your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage].
Bonded Resolve. When an allied creature would take damage while within 10 feet of you, you can spend your reaction to interpose and share some of the impact, shouldering the weight of your team. Reduce the damage your allied creature would take by half. You take damage equal to the reduced damage of the same type.
[BOX]
| #### Blazing / Battle Amp / Your Will Surges. / Kindling. At the beginning of each of your turns, you regain 1 Will. / Apotheosis. Reduce the Will cost for Unified Form by 1. / Blazing Limits. You gain a +1 to Weapon and Taijutsu attacks with Flame Blessed weapons. |
[/BOX]
#### Advanced Release Manifestation
7th Level Clan Feature
The Sarutobi clan has a unique talent for manifesting multiple different nature releases, focusing in on a core martial fighting technique or broadening their illusory skills. You have reached that decision point. Select one:
You gain another Nature release you didn’t select from your Advanced Nature Affinity clan trait.
Select a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu Expert stance, even if you don’t qualify. You gain the benefits of the chosen Expert stance while in your Cross-Style stance.
While in your Cross-Style stance, creatures that critically succeed a saving throw against a Genjutsu you cast, suffer the effects of a success if you spend 2 Will.
#### Inspiring Presence
7th Level Clan Feature
Even when all seems lost, and there doesn’t seem to be any more hope. You and your clans presence is more than enough to instill the thought that there is a way forward. Creatures of your choice that begin their turn within 10 feet of you, reduce ranks of Demoralized and Shaken they have by -1.
#### Rekindling Pulse
11th Level Clan Feature
An ally falls and you refuse to let them stay there. You keep their flame alive with but a glance and bellowing command to survive.
As an Action, all allied creatures you can see within 20 feet of you, who are Incapacitated, Stunned, Dying or Unconscious makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. You can spend any number of Will as part of this action. For every Will spent, all affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to this saving throw. On a successful save:
If they had 0 hit points, they immediately spend all remaining hit die, regaining the result and gain ranks of Exhaustion equal to half the spent hit die.
If they had hit points, they lose all of the listed conditions, and stand from prone.
Creatures cannot be affected by this feature more than once per long rest.
#### Will of Fire Incarnate
15th Level Clan Feature
You embody the will of fire unlike anyone else. Your clan has taught you what the will of fire means, but you practice and preach of it like a religion, primary or secondary.
As a bonus action, you can ignite the Will of Fire within you for the next minute. For the duration, you Will Blazes. Once you cause your Will to blaze, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.
## Senju Clan
The Genin stands on top of one of tallest tree’s just outside of the Leaf village. She claps her hands together focusing. The tree begins to shake, as it grows, slightly. She stops as she realized she was already higher than the canopy. She hears the voice of someone below her. “Hey! Tsunanami, you sure you’re not over doing it?” The Girl standing on the tree, falls to the ground, taking the snacks the other girl brought her. “No, I think I’m making progress. Just this morning, this tree was only to my ankle. Now Look at its Tallest tree in this part of the forest. Sooner or later. I’m going to make this the tallest tree in the world!”
—Yuki Hyūga
At Worlds End, Ch. 13 excerpt.
### The Leaf’s Patriarchs
The Senju Clan is a clan that hails proudly from the Land of Fire and is one of its founders. So deeply ingrained and influential, that three of the Leaf Villages Hokage have been Senju, bringing about a new era of prosperity for the leaf each time. Using Mokuton (or Wood release), a user is extremely versatile and able to control, restrict and even seal away an opponent’s Chakra. The power of Wood Release, and by extension the Senju are widely known, so much so that they were heralded as the strongest clan during the Warring states era.
### Senju Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Str
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Ninshou.
Wood Release Affinity: You begin with either Earth or Water Release Affinity. (Pick one)
Mokuton Release Techniques: The Senju Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Senju Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
### Senju Features
#### Built Different
1st Level Clan Feature
The Senju are known for their inhuman stamina and vitality. Increase your Hit Point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your hit point total by 2.
Additionally, this well of vitality coalesces within you as latent self-restoring energies. You have a well of these healing energies called Senju Cells, of which you have 2.
Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated, you can call upon this healing energy and spend 1 Senju Cell. When you do, roll 1d6 + your half your level, minimum 1. You regain hit points equal to the result. You regain spent Senju Cells when you complete a rest.
Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 4. Also, at the beginning of your turn, you can spend 1 Senju Cell to end any one Physical or Elemental condition you have.
Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 6. Also, if you begin your turn with 0 hit points, you can spend any number of Senju Cells to spend an equal number of Hit Die, regaining hit points equal to the result.
#### Mokuton Infusion
1st Level Clan Feature
While the blood of the Senju runs through you, the heritage of one burns brightest. You have access to the unique Mokuton Kekkei Genkai and it suffuses itself throughout your already varied forms of combat. This is represented by your Mokuton Infusion Chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this Chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.
You can enter the Mokuton Infusion stance as a bonus action, when you do, select one of its variants. You can swap between these variants by spending a bonus action on subsequent turns.
Will of the Buddha. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:
When you take the attack action while you wield a Combat Scroll you can choose to instead make Verdant Lash attacks. You can replace each attack you would make as part of the Attack action with a Verdant Lash attack.
Verdant Lash. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, lashing out with bramble strikes. On a hit, you deal the listed melee or ranged damage. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, you inflict 1 rank of Drained and push or pull them 10 feet closer or further from you. This increases to 15 feet, 2 ranks of Drained and this attack is treated as casting a D-Rank Hijutsu at 7th level. Increase the damage dealt by +1 damage die at 11th level. Starting at 15th level, increase the ranks of Drained inflicted to 3.
Melee: 1d10 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.
Ranged: 30 feet, 1d10 Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.
Fist of Hevajra. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:
Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes Cold, Earth or Chakra which you choose when you roll damage.
Your unarmed attacks can use your Hijutsu Flexibility trait to calculate its attack and damage rolls.
Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 weapon property as your strikes are followed by branching wood strikes. This increases to Reach 2 at 7th level.
#### Verdant Bloodline
[BOX]
| Mokuton Infusion – Drained / Max Ranks: 5, [Physical], [Mental] / A Drained creature takes 1d8 chakra damage at the start of each of their turns for each rank it has. / A Drained creature increases the chakra damage they take from hostile creatures attacks or jutsu by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level. / A Drained creature can spend an Action to make a DC 15 Constitution ability check to end this condition. |
[/BOX]
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your link to green isn’t an accident. Your chakra doesn’t just build, it grows, sprouts and reveals its beauty and strength. You can control wood and nature like its second nature. Once per turn as part of an attack made with the Attack action while in your Mokuton Infusion stance or when casting a Senju Hijutsu, you can use the New Growth ability.
New Growth. Select a point you can see on the ground within 60 feet of you as you manifest a 10-foot radius patch of almost sentient foliage such as roots, trunks or brambles. Creatures other than you that move through this affected area spends 4 feet for movement for every 1 feet they move as they try to maneuver through this terrain. This special terrain is named New Growth and lasts for 1 minute or until cleared as a result of a damaging effect crossing affected spaces.
#### Wood Release
7th Level Clan Feature
The Senju clan has a unique talent for manifesting Wood Release due to their close affinity to both Earth and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Wood Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Water release keywords, you can change the damage type to Earth or cold respectively.
Additionally, once per turn, as a Bonus action, by selecting one creature you can see within 30 feet of you that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or has ranks of Drained. You force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw, being pulled 20 feet closer or pushed 20 feet further away from you on a failed save.
#### Blood of the leaf
11th Level Clan Feature
The Senju clan has a unique talent for communication and negotiating hostile terms. While you are in communication with a non-allied creature, and they make a request of you. If you attempt to intimidate them in response, you gain 2 ranks of Mastery to the check.
#### Verdant Domain
15th Level Clan Feature
You are one with the wood. You are the commander of the green. All things in nature are part of your domain. Hostile creatures of your choice that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or are standing in an area under the effects of the New Growth special terrain has their chakra network impeded. When a hostile creature with an impeded chakra network casts a Jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) of a rank higher than the listed rank based on their classification, they gain ranks of Drained for every rank above the listed rank that they cast the triggering jutsu at.
Standard: D-Rank
Elite: C-Rank
Solo: B-Rank

## Senju Clan Mutation(s)
[BOX]
| #### CLAN MUTATIONS / Experimental Idea / Clan Mutations are an attempt to codify some of the great ideas that the community has had prior to and during this process. / My goal with this is to have these Mutations function similar to how Tasha’s Cauldron of Everything introduced optional class feature replacements. / How Mutations Work / Mutations are a simple concept. Mutations are feature replacements. If you choose a feature Mutation, you gain the select Mutation, and lose the mutated clan feature. Some features will be independent and allow you to only swap it with the normal version. Other features will require you switch it, along with multiple other features in order to function correctly. / Hey…. this is cool but not balanced! / I’m aware it isn’t as balanced or as well put together as the clan above. But the goal is to share an idea, and see if people are interested in it.  This pulls from some of the concepts that others have utilized. A link to the inspiring Clan that gave me the idea for this (Team 7 - Page 148) |
