#### Prime Nature Release
Clan Trait
Mutated Trait: Wood Release Affinity, Mokuton Release Techniques
Select one Nature release between Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Lightning or Medical. You are now able to add jutsu with the corresponding Keyword to your jutsu list. (Suggestion: Water Release)
At 1st, 3rd, 7th, 11th, and 15th levels, you can add 2 jutsu you qualify for with the chosen keyword.
If you take this mutation, you must also take any one 1st, 3rd, 11th and 15th level Senju mutation.
#### History of The Elite
1st Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Mokuton Infusion
Beginning at 1st level, you become a shinobi capable of fighting with an Uchiha with nothing more than grit, skill and a bit of clever tricks. You gain access to a selection of Elite Tactics. Select two when you gain this mutation. You gain another selection at 7th and 15th levels.
Unbreakable
Select an ability score. You gain a Rank of Mastery to saving throws with the chosen saving throw. You can select this Tactic a second time, repeating this tactics effects.
Energizing
Once per turn, as a Bonus action, you can passively activate the healing capabilities of a willing creature. A creature you touch rolls 1 hit die without spending it, regaining hit points equal to the result + their constitution modifier. This increases to 2 hit die at 7th and 3 hit die at 15th level. A creature can be healed in this way only twice per rest.
Alternatively, as a Bonus action, you can help cleans 1 rank of any Physical or Elemental condition a creature is suffering from by attempting the check associated with the condition. If no check is associated, make a DC 12 Constitution ability check, ending 1 rank of the associated condition. For every +2 over the DC, remove +1 additional rank. A creature can be healed in this way only twice per rest.
Unfaltering
Select two conditions from the following list. You gain resistance to the chosen conditions.  You can select this Tactic a second time, repeating this tactics effects;
Burned, Chilled, Corroded, Shocked, Envenomed, Bruised, Staggered, Bleed, Dazed, Shaken, Weakened, Concussed or Exhausted.
Rallying Figure
When you or an allied creature you can see fails a saving throw, you can spend your reaction forcing the target to remake their saving throw. If they succeed, you regain 1 Senju Cell.
Legacy of the Second
You can learn jutsu with the Water Keyword. Jutsu you cast with the Water keyword that inflicts a condition, can instead inflict an equal number of ranks of Drained.
Legacy of the Fifth
You can learn jutsu with the Medical Keyword. Jutsu you cast with the Medical keyword that inflicts a condition, can instead inflict an equal number of ranks of Drained.
#### Elite Bloodline
3rd Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Verdant Bloodline
You are both strong and wise. These qualities are so prevalent in you that they seem to be a bloodline quality. You have resistance to Physical and Elemental conditions.
Additionally, you gain +2 additional Senju Cells. You gain an additional +2 Senju Cells at 11th level.
#### The Strongest Bloodline
7th Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Wood Release
The Senju clan has a unique talent for manifesting their nature release with unmatched power. You can add your highest jutsu ability modifier to your Jutsu’s damage if you don’t already.
Additionally, once per rest, you can designate a different clan as your Rival Clan. When you encounter a hostile creature from your Rival Clan you gain a +1 to attacks made and your Jutsu Save DC against these creatures.
#### Quickened Regeneration
15th Level Clan Feature
The ability to rapidly recover has reached its peak within you. Once per turn, while in combat, when you would take damage from a hostile creature that wouldn’t reduce you to 0 hit points, you regain an amount of hit points equal to half your level.
Additionally, conditions with the [Persist] tag, now end after 1 minute has passed.
## Uchiha Clan
Vale sits holding her fallen ally in her arms. As the enemy surrounds her. “This is it, Uchiha. It’s over, there is no way to reconcile what you did. If you had just surrendered from the beginning, they would all be alive” the rogue shinobi says while placing his weapon on his shoulder looking down on her. Vale begins to look up at them, but something is different. Her eyes are red with additional tome in them. The rogue shinobi attack her but misses, she moves like she was a phantom, a ghost. She sees all of their movements before they even make them and will get vengeance for her fallen allies. She feels her weakness being the sole reason for their defeat and she will rectify it, if it's the last thing she does.
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 15 excerpt.
### The Curse of Hatred
The Uchiha clan is one of the four noble clans of Konohagakure, reputed to be one of the village's strongest because of their Sharingan and natural battle prowess. After helping found Konoha decades ago, the Uchiha grew increasingly isolated from the village's affairs, culminating in most of their deaths during the Uchiha clan downfall. After the 4th great ninja war, they began to find footing and regrow. There are quite a few Uchiha now in the present day, though not as many who are shinobi.
### Uchiha Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex or Int, +1 Wis
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Pick one between: Ninshou, Martial Arts, Illusions
Fire Release Affinity: You have Fire Release affinity.
Uchiha Techniques: The Uchiha Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Uchiha Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
### Uchiha Features
#### Advanced Adaptation
1st Level Clan Feature
Uchiha are known for their extreme adaptation on the battlefield. Able to see, comprehend, understand and react all in a hair’s breadth with or without a Sharingan. You can select 2 of the following adaptations. You can select another adaptation at 7th and 15th levels.
Amplified Defense
You are able to amplify your reaction speed, reacting more than others in short bursts. You gain an additional reaction. Once you use this adaptations bonus reaction, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. Beginning at 7th level, you can use this bonus reaction twice per 10 minutes. As usual you cannot take multiple reactions against the same trigger.
Amplified Flames
Uchiha hare often hailed as the Fire release specialists of the Land of Fire. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, that affects an area you can increase the size of the area by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 7th and +15 at 15th.
Amplified Retaliation
The Uchiha has a strong love for their allies and will punish anyone who would dare attempt to harm them. Once per turn, when a hostile creature within 15 feet of you makes an attack targeting you or an allied creature, you can spend your reaction to move up to half your movement, ending that movement within your weapons attack range and make an attack of opportunity against them. On a hit they must make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.
Agile Fist
The Uchiha clan are masters of a highly agile form of combat known as the Agile Fist. This stance is treated as both a Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance because of its ability to integrate both unarmed and weapon based martial options into the flow of combat.
You can enter the Agile Fist stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits.
Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 1d6 and the damage die of weapons you wield that are smaller than a d6, become d6.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for Unarmed and Weapon attack and damage
When you take damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to use half of your AC, as your DR vs the triggering damage. If you reduce the damage by half or more, you can use Great Assault as part of the same reaction.
As an Action you can perform the Great Assault attack.
Great Assault. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack (60 Feet), using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, striking fast enough to fluster your foes, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, you can make a number of attacks with this ability equal to the number of attacks you can make with the Attack action.
Shurikenjutsu
The Uchiha clan are often seen as unparalleled specialist of thrown weapons. Once per turn, when casting a jutsu that uses a weapon with the Ammunition property, they do not roll their ammunition dice. Additionally, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] with a weapon with the Thrown or Ammunition property, you can force them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.
#### Sharingan
3rd Level Clan Feature
[Dojutsu]
One of the Hidden Leaf Village’s 2 great dojutsu. The Sharingan is an eye of extreme potential and flexibility. You gain access to the Sharingan. When you enter initiative, you can activate your Sharingan which lasts until the end of combat. Your Sharingan grants some passive bonuses, but you also has evolutions that can elevate it into a tool that represents you. Alternatively, you can activate your Sharingan as a bonus action and remains active for 1 minute.
You begin with 1 Ocular Evolution which you can use while your Sharingan is active. You can use these abilities by spending Ocular Charges. You have a number of Ocular Charges equal to 1+ your proficiency bonus. You gain additional Ocular Evolutions at 7th, 11th and 15th levels. You regain all spent Ocular Charges when you complete a rest.
[BOX]
| #### Sharingan / Reflex Amp / Your Sharingan grants you the following bonuses; / Chakra Sight. You gain 30-Feet of Chakra Sight. This increases to 60-feet at 11th level. / Enemy Reading. You gain a rank of mastery to the following skill-based action; See Through Lies, Sense Motive, and Search. You can also use the aforementioned skill-actions as a bonus action. / Eye of Insight. When you take the Read the Enemy skill action, you gain a +4 bonus to the check. |
[/BOX]
Sharingan Dodge
You can perceive an attacks target before it would ever land. Once per turn, while you are not grappled or prone, when you take damage from an attack or make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, you can spend 2 Ocular Charges to gain a rank of mastery to your AC or saving throw until the start of your next turn. This bonus does not stack with itself. When you reach 7th level, you instead gain 2 ranks of mastery.
Beginning at 15th level, you can choose to instead spend 3 Ocular Charges to cause the triggering attack to miss or automatically succeed the triggering saving throw.
Rewrite History
You place your allies under a helpful visual spell. As a reaction to an allied creature failing a saving throw, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge, allowing them to reroll. If they still fail, you can spend 2 additional Ocular Charges to make them remake their saving throw again. If they fail still, you can spend +1 additional Ocular Charge forcing them to remake the saving throw.
Hypnotic Eye
Your Sharingan can impart minor illusions onto enemies. As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Ocular Charges you can target a creature you can see within 30 feet of you that isn’t blind, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save they become either Berserk, Charmed, or Confused for the next minute. An affected creature remakes this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success. On a success the target creature gains immunity to this evolution for the next 10 minutes.
Ocular Jutsu Augmentation
Your Sharingan grants you some inherent knowledge of how to better manipulate jutsu you cast. By spending 2 Ocular Charge as part of casting a Jutsu, you cast it without the Hand Sign (HS) or Chakra Molding (CM) components.
Sharingan Copy
The Sharingan is known as the copy wheel eye, capable of reading, translating and imprinting the process of how to use a jutsu or ability it saw onto your brain.
As a reaction to a creature, you can see casting a Jutsu with either the Hand Sign (HS) or Mobility (M) components, but doesn’t have the Hijutsu keyword, you can spend 3 Ocular Charges to imprint the jutsu cast into your mind. The imprinted jutsu must be no more than the highest rank jutsu known based on your level. If you imprint a jutsu that has a nature release that you do not have an affinity for, increase that jutsu’s cost by an amount based on its rank. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +6, B-Rank: +8, A-Rank: +10, S-Rank: +12).
This jutsu is added to a special list known as your Imprint List. Your Imprint List is similar to your known jutsu list in which you can cast jutsu from it as if it’s on your known jutsu list, but with some specific rules.
You cannot cast jutsu on your Imprint List unless your Sharingan is active.
You can have 2 imprinted jutsu on your Imprint List. This increases to 4 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level.
Sharingan: Genjutsu!
The Sharingan is a weapon so potent that enemies know to never look you in the eye, else you place a spell upon them.
When you gain this Evolution and when you complete a rest of any type, select 2 Genjutsu you qualify for, of a rank you can cast based on your level, that has a casting time of 1 Action or Bonus Action. The chosen jutsu become known as Memorized Illusions, which are imprinted upon your Sharingan. You can imprint the same Memorized Illusion twice. Each imprint is treated as its own slot. Once you cast a Memorized Illusion it is spent and is no longer imprinted until you complete a short or long rest.
As an Action on your turn, you can activate this evolution, spending 2 Ocular Charges to cast one of the imprinted jutsu from your Sharingan. The jutsu’s range becomes 30 feet and you must be able to maintain eye contact with them for its casting. Casting this jutsu does not reveal your location or break stealth.
Increase the number of Memorized Illusions you can have by +1 when you reach 7th and 11th level.
Genjutsu Counter
Your Sharingan grants you some inherent awareness of Genjutsu and even the ability to dispel them. Genjutsu, whose DC is equal to or less than your passive Illusion skill or your Genjutsu Save DC (Whichever is higher) are those that you become aware of. Genjutsu you are aware of radiate a misty haze. If a creature is under the effect of a Genjutsu you are aware of the radiate this haze. By spending a Bonus action, you can perform the Identify Genjutsu skill action on a Genjutsu you are aware of.
As an Action by spending 1 Ocular Charge or bonus action by spending 2 Ocular Charges, while you an allied or willing creature is under the effects of a Genjutsu, you can make an Ability check using your highest jutsu ability modifier, vs the DC of the Genjutsu affecting the target. On a success, you Dispel the afflicting Genjutsu.
If you are aware of the Genjutsu, you can instead make an Illusions check in place of an ability check.
#### Blood of the Fan
7th Level Clan Feature
Uchiha are well known in many shinobi circles as having stern, cool, and commanding presences. Their proximity to other capable shinobi makes it difficult to take control of a situation while an Uchiha is present.
When a non-allied creature attempts to make an Intimidation or Persuasion check against another creature while you are present, you can spend a reaction and impose disadvantage on their check. Once you use this feature you cannot do so again for 10 minutes or you succeed an Intimidation check, recharging it.
#### Fanning The Flame
11th Level Clan Feature
Uchiha’s affinity to fire release isn’t just associated with offensive fire release, but in how they move, fight and counter. Their passion burns bright, igniting the embers of ambition in all others. When you activate your Sharingan, you can select 2 of the listed abilities, gaining them for the duration of this combat. You can use your selected abilities, once per turn. You cannot use more than one of these abilities as part of the same trigger;
Blazing Set Up. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with an attack or jutsu you cast of B-Rank or lower, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your Bonus action to mark all affected creatures until the end of your next turn. The next time a marked creature takes damage from yourself or one of your allies that you can see, you can detonate the mark, dealing 3d6 fire damage to the marked creature.
After-Image Assault. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a hostile creature, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your reaction to force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, until the start of your next turn, attacks against you from the affected creature is at disadvantage. If the affected creature deals damage to you through this effect, you can choose to select a space within 10 feet of yourself, and teleport to that space as you try to create distance between yourself and the enemy.
Ricochet Technique. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or 1 Bonus action to select a second creature within 20-feet of the original target. Remake your attack roll, targeting the second creature. On a hit, you deal half damage to the second target but apply the original attacks effects to the second target as well.
Critical Refocus. Once per turn, when a creature critically fails their saving throw resisting a Genjutsu you cast, you regain 1 Ocular Charge, per creature that critically failed.
Commanding Gaze. Once per turn, in place of an attack granted by the Attack action, you can gaze into the eyes of a non-blinded enemy you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge and they make a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save, you can imprint one of the following subconscious commands into them. Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.
Command, Disarm. The affected creature, at the beginning or end of their turn, your choice, throws their weapon 30 + 5 times their strength of dexterity modifier in feet away from themselves in a direct of your choice.
Command, Retarget. When the affected creature targets a creature it can see, it must target a different creature it can see, even if that creature is its own ally.
Command, Telegraph. The affected creature telegraphs their next attack or jutsu unconsciously yelling out its name and its effects and who they are targeting and why. You and all allied creatures that can see and hear them gains the benefit of a successful Read the Enemy.
Command, Taunt. The affected creature gains disadvantage on attacks targeting creatures other than yourself. Additionally, creatures other than yourself treat the affected creatures save DC as -2 lower unless you are part of the area of effect or making the same saving throw from the same effect.
#### Crimson Sovereign
15th Level Clan Feature
You foresee victory in the movements of your enemies, even without the Sharingan.
As a bonus action, you can initiate your Crimson Aura, radiating a pulsing aura of chakra, radiating outwards from you in a 20-foot radius, centered on you. You can maintain this Crimson Aura for 1 minute, after which you cannot activate your aura until you complete a long rest.
While your aura is active you gain the following benefits;
Exploit Opening. Creatures that make attacks while in your aura, triggers attacks of opportunities from you. The first attack of opportunity you make against a creature, per round doesn’t consume your reaction.
Scan the Perimeter. Creatures that begin or end their turn within this radius, reveal themselves to you. You become aware of one statistic from a hostile creature between their AC, one saving throw bonus of your choice, or one special ability, attack or trait the creature has, that is unique to it.
Redirection. Once per turn, when a hostile creature you can see declares an attack against you while another hostile creature is within your aura, you can spend your reaction to force another hostile creature within your aura to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being forced to interpose the attack on a failed save.

When you do, you can make a Ninshou check vs the Jutsu Save DC of the barriers caster. If the Barrier doesn’t have a caster, then you instead make a Ninjutsu Ability Check using the Standard Jutsu Ability Check rules.
On a success, you or the jutsu you cast bypasses the barrier entirely until the end of the current turn.

Components: HS, CM, W (Any Thrown or Ammunition) Cost: 5 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Fire Release Description: You unleash a volley of shuriken, kunai or some other thrown or ranged weapon implements and ignite a blaze covering them with fire release chakra, increasing their destructive potential.
Select a creature you can see within range that your enflamed weapons will target and make a ranged Ninjutsu or Taijutsu attack, dealing [Weapon Damage] + 3d6 fire damage.
The affected creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, being Burned on a failed save.
Off-Guard. An off-guard creature that takes damage from this jutsu suffers a 10-foot penalty to their speed and if they don’t move before the end of their next turn, they take 3d6 fire damage at the end of their next turn.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage of this jutsu by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, the Off-Guard effect now applies a 15-foot penalty to a creatures speed.

Make two melee Taijutsu attacks against a creature you can see. The first attack deals your [Weapon Damage], and the second attack dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + 1d6.

Off-Guard. An off-guard creature that takes damage from this jutsu has the Off-Guard condition extended until the end of your next turn.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6 for each attack. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can make one additional melee Taijutsu attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] + [Unarmed Damage].

Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack against a target in range, dealing 4d6+4 fire damage on a hit and forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, being Burned on a failed save.
Off-Guard. An off-guard creature that takes damage from this jutsu is surrounded by flames. If they move more than 5 feet during their next turn, they take 3d6 fire damage.

### C-Rank:
#### Genjutsu: Deflect!
Classification: Hijutsu  Rank: C-Rank  Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you or another creature you can see fall under the effects of a Genjutsu. Range: 30 feet Duration: Instant
Components: CM Cost: 8 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Genjutsu, Visual Description: As part of the requirements of this jutsu, you must have the Sharingan active. You may immediately attempt to make a Standard Jutsu ability check using your Genjutsu Ability modifier vs the triggering Genjutsu.
On a success, you end the Genjutsu affecting you or another creature as it becomes Deflected. When you do you must select another targeting within range, that you can see and make eye contact with. The target creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Success: The target resists this jutsu’s effects.
Failure: Affected creatures falls under the effect of the Deflected Genjutsu as if you had cast it. They follow the original Failure effect of that Genjutsu.
Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the target follows the original Critical Failure effect of that Genjutsu. If that Genjutsu had no critical failure effect, they instead becomes Restrained for the Genjutsu’s original duration. #### Genjutsu: Red Star

Components: CM Cost: 9 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile), Unaware Description: You attempt to put a group of creatures under a strange and terrifying illusion of the sun turning red becoming an eldritch horror of your description.
Select a point you can see within range. All creatures in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on the point must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Success: Affected creatures are Off-Guard until the end of their next turn.
Failure: Affected creatures gains 2 rank of Shaken and must try to escape the sun. They must spend their reaction now (if able) and their movement on each of their turns to move to a space covered in Darkness. It will spend its movement on each turn to accomplish this. If the creature has a jutsu or ability that would generate Darkness or reasonably shield it from the sun, it will spend its actions to cast it to protect itself. A creature that begins its turn under any source of light takes 5d6 psychic damage. All affected creatures remake their save at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on them on a success.
Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the target instead takes 6d6 psychic damage and suffers a -1 penalty to their AC for the duration.

Select a point of a space your beam of fire passes through as the beam stops and detonates, filling a 20-foot radius, centered on this point of blazing flames. ## Uchiha Clan Mutation(s)
#### Divergent Techniques
3rd Level Clan Feature
Mutated Trait: Sharingan
You fail to manifest the clans Dojutsu. This absence was possible, but you expected this. Something inside warned you. And so, you trained until your technique and skill rivaled Uchiha with their Sharingan, even surpassing them in some areas. When you gain this feature mutation, you master two secret battle stances, taught to Uchiha incapable of awakening the Sharingan. The Flaming Spark chakra stance and the Blazing Fan Bukijutsu stance, of which you can benefit from both at the same time. If you have the Agile Fist adaptation, you can benefit from it, and either Flaming Spark or Blazing Fan, but never all three. As part of gaining this mutation, you also gain access to an Uchiha clan designed weapon a Gunbai Fan.
Flaming Spark. You build flaming chakra in your lungs until each word you speak is followed by spark of ember or whisps of smoke. You can enter this stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits;
As an Action, you can perform the Flame Flower attack. Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can make two attack with Flame Flower.
When you cast a Jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, you become Enflamed until the end of your next turn. While Enflamed, attacks you make that would deal fire damage gain a +1 bonus to their critical threat range.
Flame Flower. Make ranged Jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, spitting a ball of flame that deals 2d6+2 fire damage on a hit and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, increase the damage dealt by 1d6+1
Blazing Fan. You take hold of your clans weapon of choice, the Gunbai fan. While wielding a Gunbai Fan, you can enter this stance as a bonus action. While in this stance you gain the following benefits;
The Gunbai Fan gains 1 rank of the Blocking property.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can make two attacks with the Gunbai Fan, as part of the Attack action.
As an Action, you can perform the Fanned Wind attack.
As a reaction to taking damage from a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can perform the Uchiha Return.
Fanned Wind. You swipe your fan, creating a massive wave of force. All creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you must make a Strength saving throw, vs your highest jutsu save DC, taking [Weapon Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and being pushed back 20 feet on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, when you use this attack, you can choose to increase the size of the cone by 10-feet or the damage dealt by + [Weapon Damage].
Uchiha Return. You swipe your fan, initiating a Clash, using your highest skill between Ninshou, Martial Arts or Chakra Control.
If you take this mutation, you must also take the Heightened Battle Sense Uchiha mutation.
#### Heightened Battle Sense
11th Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Fanning The Flame
Your reliance on your own skill, technique and combat prowess, puts you above other Uchiha on the same level as you. Their reliance on their Sharingan’s are a liability you don’t share.
While you are in a combat stance, granted by your Clan, you gain a rank of Mastery to your AC, and your Dexterity saving throws.
Additionally, You gain 2 additional special attacks, each associated with stances gained from the Divergent Techniques mutation.
Flame Bloom. While in Flaming Spark stance, select a point you can see within 60 feet of you, as you release a brilliant bloom of crimson flame, filling a 20-foot radius sphere centered on this point, forcing all creatures in the affected area to make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, taking 6d6+6 fire damage, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn, and 1 rank of Burned on a failed save, or half damage on a successful one.
Uchiha Swipe. While in Fanned Wind stance, you slam your fan down, creating a focused blast of force. All creatures in a 5-foot wide, 60-foot-long line, are forced to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, your choice, vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they take three times your weapons damage, are pushed back 40-feet, and fall prone on a failed save or half as much damage and only pushed 5 feet on a successful one.
## Uzumaki Clan
Ketsuki stands in the middle of the arena, his rival standing opposite to him. “How are you still standing? I've closed so many of your Chakra points. Just fall over and give up already Ketsuki!” his rival cried out. Ketsuki, stumbling but resisting to fall over, begins to weave hand seals. “I don’t back down! You of all people should know that by now!” he screams as he finishes his hand seals and creates a wave of Fire from the ground as it rolls towards his rival, overcoming him and defeating him as the crowds from the chunin arena screams in excitement.
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 6 excerpt.
### Never Backing Down
The Uzumaki Clan was formerly a prominent clan in the whirlpool country. Since its destruction, most of its members have resided in Konoha. Despite its past demise, over 100 years after the Fourth Shinobi World War the clan is once again active and prominent in the land of Fire. Uzumaki's skill with Fuinjutsu earned them both respect and fear throughout the ninja world. Uzumaki naturally possess incredibly strong life-forces. As such, they have very long lifespans and likewise age slower.
### Uzumaki Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Cha
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Ninshou
Uzumaki Sealing Techniques: The Uzumaki have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Uzumaki Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Overwhelming Determination: Jutsu you create using the Creating a Jutsu rules (See Chapter 7: Adventuring & Missions, Learning/Creating A Jutsu) increases the maximum number of effects they can have by +1.
### Uzumaki Features
#### Wellspring of Chakra
1st Level Clan Feature
The Uzumaki’s are known for their unmatched stamina and chakra reserves. Increase your Chakra point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your chakra point total by 2.
Additionally, this reserve of chakra stabilizes within you as pockets of self-energizing stores of chakra. This reserve of Chakra can be call upon and is known as Spiral Cells, of which you have 2. Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated or have ranks of Sealed you can call on this energy and spend 1 Spiral Cell. When you do, you gain 4 Temporary Chakra points. You regain spent Spiral Cells when you complete a rest.
Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Spiral Cells you have to 4. Also, when you would take chakra damage or gain ranks of a Mental or Sensory condition you can spend 1 Spiral Cell to reduce the damage taken by an amount equal to your level or ranks of the condition gained to 0.
Beginning at 11th level, increase the Temporary Chakra points gained to 6.
Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Spiral Cells you have to 6.
#### Binding Chains
1st Level Clan Feature
The blood of the Uzumaki has crystalized and come to bear within you. You can manifest Chains of Binding. A special technique born of special fuinjutsu techniques inherent to your bloodline. These Chains of Binding manifest themselves as chakra-based chains of your description, manifesting themselves from your chakra core, but protruding from your body in a way you describe (from your back, your arms, belly, shoulders, etc.).
As a bonus action you can manifest these chains for 1 minute, by entering your Binding Chain chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.
When you enter this stance, you gain the following benefits;
You gain the Seal Break benefit from Uzumaki clan Hijutsu you cast.
When you take the attack action, you can choose to instead make either a Binding Chain or Striking Chain attack. These attacks use you’re your highest jutsu attack bonus.
Binding Chain. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack against a creature you can see, as your chains encircle them. On a hit, you deal half the listed damage and once per turn, make an affected creature make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being Sealed on a failure. Beginning at 7th level, you can increase the number of creatures you can target with this attack to 2. Beginning at 15th level, this increases to 3.
Striking Chain. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack against a creature you can see, as your chains strike out, dealing the listed melee or ranged damage on a hit. You can replace up to two attacks you would make as part of the Attack action with this attack. Beginning at 7th level, attacks against a Grappled or Prone creature is always at advantage. Beginning at 15th level, you can pick one physical damage type, in addition to chakra damage dealing both at the same time.
Melee: 1d8 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Bludgeoning, Piercing or Chakra damage. This increases to 2d8 + your Jutsu ability modifier at 11th level.
Ranged: 30 feet, 1d8 Bludgeoning, Piercing or Chakra damage. This increases to 2d8 at 11th level.
#### Swirling Seals
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your binding chains aren’t the only secret technique passed down through the Uzumaki clan. You also learn to prepare special sealing formulas known only to your clan. These formulas are places onto chakra seals, turning them into Spiral Tags. Spiral Tags are special tags that can apply to damage dealt with the Binding Chain clan feature, as part of casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu or even following its effect text.
You can use no more than one Spiral Tags per turn. You begin with 2 known Spiral Tags. You gain an additional one at 7th and 11th levels. A Spiral Tag that requires a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC. If you would use a Spiral Tag that requires a saving throw as part of a Hijutsu you cast that also forces a saving throw, you pick which saving throw to use, following both effects on a success or failure.
Bound Inscription. As part of damage dealt or a creature failing a saving throw you can affix a Spiral Tag to the affected creature for the next minute. Alternatively, as a Bonus action, you can affix it to a willing creature, object or surface, which lasts for 24 hours. While affixed, and you are within at least 1 mile of the Spiral Tag, you can sense and hear creatures within 15 feet of the affixed location, enough to target them as if you could see them. You can make Binding Chain attacks or cast Uzumaki Hijutsu, having them originate from the tags affixed location.
Barrier Reverse Technique. As part of damage dealt with an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, against a creature with ranks of Sealed, you can have the binding formula overwritten. Affected creatures with ranks of sealed must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the Sealed condition gains an additional effect for the next minute; A Sealed creature suffers a -1 penalty to their AC for every rank they have, but they lose one rank of sealed at the end of each of their turns.
Sealing Cage. As an Action, you can select one creature you can see, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw as they are enveloped by chains of binding, like a globe or orb. On a failed save, they are captured inside of the dome until the end of your next turn. While inside the globe they are under total cover, and blinded. They cannot be targeted or affected by hostile effects and cannot take hostile action. While within the dome they cannot mold chakra. By spending a Full-Turn Action, you can extend the duration until the end of your following turn. A creature trapped inside this dome can escape by spending their Action, making a Strength saving throw, shattering the dome on a success.
Draining Seals. As part of making an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, or casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu that deals damage, you can force the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened on a failed save. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.
Warding Seal. As a bonus action, you can mark a willing creature other than yourself, that you can see within 30 feet of you with a ward. A creature marked with this ward gains a rank of Mastery to their AC and a +1 bonus to their saving throws. While you have a creature marked in this way, this counts as concentrating on a jutsu of C-Rank.
Rebuking Seal. As part of making an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, or casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu that deals damage, you can force an affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, they gain a rank of Concussed on a failed save. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.
#### Gut Feeling
7th Level Clan Feature
Your clans instincts are legendary. So much so that this gut feeling is almost like a second bloodline trait. Your intuition sharpens your reactions and your read on people and your sense for traps.
While conscious, you cannot be surprised by hidden creatures. If one or more of your allies are surprised, you gain a rank of Mastery to your initiative, for each surprised allied creature.
Additionally, when a creature makes a Deception check against you, your GM treats your passive Insight as +5 higher.
If you would attempt the See through lies skill action, you make the check using either Constitution or Charisma. If you would beat the contested check by 5 or more, you gain a Will of Fire. You can gain a Will of Fire in this way, once per long rest.
#### Warding Network
11th Level Clan Feature
You sketch binding seals into the air, creating ninjutsu like effects without weaving a single hand sign.
Once per turn, as a bonus action or as part of casting an Jutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword, you can manifest a Spiral Ward at a point you can see within 60 feet of you. This ward looks like a piece of paper with a special sealing formula only possible via Uzumaki clan techniques. You can maintain up to 2 wards at once, and a creature can only ever benefit from one ward at a time, choosing which ward they want to benefit from if ever in 2 auras at once. You select which type of ward you want to apply from those listed at the end of this feature.
You count as maintaining concentration on a Ninjutsu of B-Rank, no matter how many wards you have active. Wards last until dispelled or you end concentration on them. Each ward emanates a 10-foot radius aura, centered on the point it occupies;
Aegis: All allied creatures in the affected area gain a rank of mastery to their AC.
Clarity: All allied creatures in the affected area gain a rank of mastery to their first saving throw they make per round.
Anchor: Hostile creatures that would teleport while within 1-mile of this anchor, must make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, teleporting into a space within the affected area on a failure.
#### Spiraling Chains
15th Level Clan Feature
You bind battlefields onto you. A living sigil of control or domination. The arena is yours to command.
As a Bonus Action, you can place a binding seal onto yourself, and the ground, at a point you can reach, which remains for the next minute. The sigil, releases a 120-foot radius aura centered on the point. The edges of the aura has binding chains at its perimeter.
For the duration, attacks made with the Binding Chain feature or jutsu you cast with the Fuinjutsu keyword, can target any creature within this radius, even if you cannot see them, so long as you are aware of them and they are within the radius, they can be targeted, even if behind full cover.
Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

## Uzumaki Clan Mutation(s)
#### Original Technique
Clan Trait
Mutated Trait: Uzumaki Sealing Techniques
Beginning at character creation, select one jutsu of B-Rank or lower that you qualify for, adding this jutsu to your known list, but with some key differences. This jutsu now becomes your Original Technique. A jutsu that is unique to you and you alone. This version is one that only you can utilize to its fullest potential.
Its cost is set as Special (An amount equal to its rank: D-Rank: 5, C-Rank: 9, B-Rank: 14, A-Rank: 20, S-Rank: 25)
Its base rank is set as Special (The Highest Rank you can cast, based on your level), and can only be cast at its base rank.
If it deals damage, reduce the amount of damage dice it has by an amount equal to its rank. As its rank grows based on your level (bullet point 2) return half the reduced damage dice rounded down for each rank. Once its base rank matches its original rank, it loses the damage dice penalty. (D-Rank: 0, C-Rank: -2, B-Rank: -4)
It gains the Hijutsu keyword.
Beginning at character creation, you can select 2 effects from the Jutsu Creation System (See Chapter 7: Adventuring & Missions, Learning/Creating A Jutsu), from the section that has a matching jutsu discipline as your select Jutsu (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu/Bukijutsu), and adding them to your chosen jutsu. You can select 1 additional effect at 7th and 15th levels.
You cannot select the same effect more than once.
You cannot select the following effects; Lasting, Upcast, Damage, Empowered Damage, Multiple Strikes, Damage Reduction, Augmentation, Unavoidable or Mind Control.
Work with your GM on how these modifications make this selected jutsu function in the narrative. GM’s have final say over if an effect is compatible with your selected Jutsu.
If you take this mutation, you must also take any one 1st, 3rd, 11th and 15th level Uzumaki mutation.
#### Spiral Power0
1st Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Binding Chains
The Blood of the Uzumaki Clan manifests within you, differently, not with sealing techniques, but with unyielding determination and willpower. Once per turn, when casting a Jutsu you know, you can select one of the following benefits;
Full Power. If the jutsu you cast would inflict ranks of a condition, you can spend 1 Spiral Cell, to increase the ranks of the inflicted condition by +1.
Controlled Power. If the jutsu cast requires concentration, you can spend 2 Spiral Cells to treat it as two different jutsu you are concentrating on, effects that would trigger once as part of casting from a class or clan feature, now trigger twice for this jutsu’s casting.
Energizing Power. As part of casting this jutsu, if a creature fails their saving throw by 5 or more, you regain 1 Spiral Cell.
Beginning at 7th level, you can apply two different effects. This increases to all listed effects at 15th level.
#### Stubborn
3rd Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Swirling Seals
Lacking the distinct Fuinjutsu mastery of the once famous Uzumaki Clan, you instead manifest an oppressive, dominant willpower to push through, and persevere through any situation. This manifests itself as additional Spiral Cells. You gain 2 additional Spiral Cells. This instead becomes 4 additional Spiral Cells at 11th level. You gain additional uses for these Spiral Cells meant to reinforce your fortitude. Once per turn, you can perform any of the following;
When you would make a saving throw or ability check to end a condition currently affecting you, you can spend 1 Spiral Cell to gain a rank of Mastery to that check or save.
When you would take damage, you can spend your reaction and 1 Spiral Cell to gain DR equal to your level against the triggering creature, until the beginning of your next turn.
#### Fundamental Technique
3rd Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Swirling Seals
Lacking the knowledge or access to the Fuinjutsu of the Uzumaki clan, you choose to instead focus on perfecting and mastering an established technique to make it more of your own.
Select one jutsu you know that is not your Original Technique. If you do not have the Original Technique mutation, you must select a Hijutsu you know instead. This jutsu, becomes known as your Fundamental Technique. Each time you cast your Fundamental Technique; you may select one of the following benefits it will gain as part of its casting. You can select one additional Jutsu at 7th and 15th levels.
Fundamental Stability. If the jutsu requires concentration, it gains the Stable keyword.
Fundamental Efficiency. If the jutsu requires concentration, it gains the Efficient keyword.
Fundamental Ability. This jutsu gains the Hijutsu keyword.
#### Tenacious Chakra
11th Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Warding Network
While you don’t possess the inherent sealing chains granted by your bloodline, you instead have the inherent ability to increase your resilience to Fuinjutsu.
You gain resistance to the Sealed and Compelled conditions. Additionally, you gain resistance to Chakra damage and effects that would increase the cost to cast jutsu, are halved.
#### Unbreakable Will
11th Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Warding Network
Your determination and chakra reserves are powerful enough to keep you standing, despite your body suffering grievous injury. When you would fall to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction or 2 Spiral Cells to instead be reduced to 1. Each time you would use this feature, you gain 1 rank of Weakened.
#### Resilience
15th Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Spiraling Chains
Your chakra suffuses you with strength, resilience, and raw strength. Allowing you the ability to resist falling when others would have long since done so.
You gain immunity to the negative effects of losing a Clash. Also, once per turn, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction to instead spend a number of Chakra dice, regaining the result as hit points. If this would cause you to have 1 or more hit points after the damage calculation, you regain the spent reaction.
#### Dattebayo
15th Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Spiraling Chains
You never know when to give up. You’re not even sure if you know what that means. Every challenge is something you rise to. Believe it.
When you roll a natural 20, on any d20 based roll, while in combat you regain 1 Spiral Cell. Additionally, when you would fail a d20 based roll, you can spend 2 Spiral Cells to remake the failed roll, gaining a rank of Mastery to the new result.
## Yamanaka Clan
A bandit walks into his group's main tent and demands to speak to their leader. The leader approaches him annoyed and confused “What is the meaning of this Dan?” the bandit leader demands. “I just got word from our scouts that the shinobi posted just past the hilltops are moving out. They are leaving! We need to act now boss.” he exclaims. The bandit leader looks shocked but takes his underling at his word. He commands his officers to get everyone up and moving now. If the shinobi are gone ow is the time to move through the hill pass. Dan bows and begins to make his way out of the tent. As he exits, he holds his head and almost collapses before catching himself and grumbling, “What happened?” About 400 Yards away hidden in the brush of a large tree, Leena begins to wake up looking at her 2 allies and raising a thumb of success. “They took the bait, hook line and sinker.” She says as her allies inform the awaiting ambush party.
—Tatsunami Aburame, The Long Road, Ch. 14 excerpt.
### Impossible to Pin Down
The Yamanaka Clan is a family of shinobi found in Konohagakure. They specialize in mind related techniques, and they own and run a flower shop in the village. They traditionally lead the Konoha Barrier Team. The members of this clan specialize in mind-related techniques which makes them experts at intelligence gathering, espionage and interrogation amongst other things. They have also displayed sensory abilities and their techniques include transferring their consciousness, reading minds and communicating telepathically. The Yamanaka clan has a special relationship with the Akimichi and Nara clan. For generations, members of these three families have formed an "Ino–Shika–Cho Trio", named after the first part of the names of the members.
### Yamanaka Traits
[BOX]
| Mind Body Transfer – Mental Overwrite / Max Ranks: 5, [Mental], [Sensory] / Pockets of the casters consciousness are overwriting yours. Your thoughts become hazy. Your movements sluggish and you begin to believe, not even your own. The strength of this jutsu depends on the mental strength of the target. Creatures lose 1 rank of Mental Overwrite at the end of each of their turns, unless they are Dominated. / Applies to Minions / With 1 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated (see effect), until dispelled. / Applies to Standards / With 3 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated for up to 1 hour. / This Dominated creature remakes their saves at the end of each of their turns, ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Elites / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated for up to 1 minute. / This Dominated creature remakes their saves at the end of each of their turns. ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Solo’s / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated until the end of their next turn. ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Player Characters / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated, remaking their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending it on a successful save. |
[/BOX]
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis or Int, +1 Cha
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Insight
Yamanaka Techniques: The Yamanaka Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Yamanaka Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.
Telepathic Comms: Once per long rest, select a number of willing creatures equal to 1+Proficienty bonus that you can reach during this rest. Until you all complete a long rest, you can telepathically communicate with one another, conveying your thoughts to one another at will, so long as you are within 1 mile of each other. If any of you are ever in a structure with chakra based or enhanced walls, you cannot communicate with that creature using this trait.
### Yamanaka Features
#### Mind Body Transfer
1st Level Clan Feature
The Yamanaka clan are known for their mind-altering abilities allowing them to inject their consciousness into bodies of their foes, taking their bodily autonomy away. But this takes focus, accuracy, the confidence that your team will be there to support you and above all, requires you to enter the Mind Disruption chakra stance. You can enter your Mind Disruption stance as a bonus action. While in this stance you gain the following benefits:
Mind Body Transfer. As an action, or in place of an attack you make as part of the Attack action or a Jutsu you cast, you can select a creature you can see within 60 feet of you and send a mental echo into them, as a beam. Constructs, inanimate objects, creatures not native to this world and creatures immune to the Compelled or Sealed conditions are immune to this feature.
Beam: You release a direct shot of your psionic frequency. Make a ranged attack using your highest jutsu modifier. On a hit, you deal 1d6 + modifier in psychic damage, and they gain 1 rank of Mental Overwrite. This increases to 2d6 and 2 ranks at 11th level.
Pulse: Beginning at 7th level, you can make an attack, pulsing waves of psionic intrusion, forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Mental Overwrite. This increases to 3 ranks at 15th level. This does not reveal you if you are hidden.
Wave: Beginning at 15th level, you can instead make an aura of psionic intrusion. All creatures of your choice within a radius, half the range of this feature, centering on you must make a Charisma saving throw, taking 5d6 psychic damage and inflicting 1 rank of Mental Overwrite on a failure.
#### Mental Recalibration
[BOX]
| #### Dominated / Extended Condition / A Dominated creature has their wills overwritten by the inflicting creature, known as the Dominator. The Dominator imposes the following effects on the Dominated and themselves. You can normally be a Dominator to one creature at a time, unless otherwise specified. / Dominator Effects / The Dominators body falls limp. Becoming Stunned, Blind, Deafened and incapacitated, for the duration of this status. / The Dominator takes over the body of the Dominated, meaning they now act in initiative, when the Dominated would act, speaks in their voice, dialect, languages and even has knowledge of their mannerisms. / The Dominator gains limited access to the Dominated statistics, becoming aware of their General and Clan traits, if any. / The Dominator retains access to their known jutsu while in the body of the Dominated. / The Dominator must maintain concentration on this status, as if it’s an S-Rank Genjutsu or Ninjutsu, that they do not spend chakra to maintain. / The Dominator uses their own attack bonuses and save DC when calculating them for the purpose of casting jutsu. / The Dominator can use any action, attack or special ability that doesn’t cost tenacity die or a special Clan or class specific resource, using their own attack bonuses or Save DC for calculation. / This status ends, if the Dominators original body takes damage. / Dominated Effects / The Dominated forgoes their turn to the Dominator. / The Dominated is aware of all things occurring while under this status. / The Dominated’s body is never a willing creature. / If this Dominated’s body takes damage, they remake their Charisma saving throw, ending this status on a success. / A Dominated creature, cannot be Dominated again for 24 hours. |
[/BOX]
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your experience with Yamanaka jutsu has reached the point where a creature you inflict with Mental Overwrite suffers alternating effects, not normally part of the Mind Body Transfer process. You can recalibrate the mind of your enemies. When you use Mind Body Transfer or a Yamanaka Hijutsu that inflicts Mental Overwrite, you can infuse one of these Recalibrations into the feature or jutsu cast. You begin with 2 different Recalibrations, gaining an additional one at 7th and 15th levels. You can only use one Recalibration as part of any trigger, jutsu or use of Mind Body Transfer.
Beginning at 11th level, you can choose to use 2 Recalibrations as part of any trigger, jutsu or use of Mind Body Transfer.
Un-armored Thoughts
As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you attempt to siphon the mental energy of an affected creature. They suffer a -2 penalty to their next saving throw before the beginning of your next turn and you can ask one question telepathically, as they must answer telepathically. The question must be in a format were answering Yes, No or I don’t Know are acceptable answers, and they must answer truthfully, using one of the 3 answer options available.
Mask of Many Minds
As part of Dominating a creature, you gain access to memories they’ve made over the past 48 hours.
Far Thought
As part of using Mind Body Transfer, increase its range by +30 feet. Beginning at 7th level, this recalibration can be applied to Yamanaka Hijutsu you cast. Beginning at 15th level, increase the range bonus this recalibration provides to +60 feet.
Stolen Might
As part of Dominating a creature, you gain access to any Taijutsu or Bukijutsu they know. If they would end the Dominating status, you retain knowledge of 2 of such jutsu of your choice. You can cast these jutsu, once each, before forgetting the stolen memories, within the next minute.
Stolen Technique
As part of Dominating a creature, you gain access to any Ninjutsu they know. If they would end the Dominating status, you retain knowledge of 2 of such jutsu of your choice. You can cast these jutsu, once each, before forgetting the stolen memories, within the next minute.
Stolen Dreams
As part of Dominating a creature, you gain access to any Genjutsu they know. If they would end the Dominating status, you retain knowledge of 2 of such jutsu of your choice. You can cast these jutsu, once each, before forgetting the stolen memories, within the next minute.
Stupefy - Coordination
As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you recalibrate its effects. Creatures with ranks of Mental Overwrite now suffer a -1 penalty to all melee or ranged attack and damage rolls for each rank they have.
Stupefy - Control
As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you recalibrate its effects. Creatures with ranks of Mental Overwrite increase the cost of jutsu they cast by +2 for each rank they have.
Stupefy - Concentration
As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you recalibrate its effects. Creatures with ranks of Mental Overwrite reduce the number of jutsu they can concentrate on by an amount equal to half the number of ranks they have.
Stupefy - Migraine
As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you recalibrate its effects. Creatures with ranks of Mental Overwrite take 1d8 psychic damage at the beginning of each of their turns for each rank they have.
Efficient Mind
As part of casting a Yamanaka Hijutsu, you can reduce its cost by an amount equal to its rank. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)
#### Shared Perception
7th Level Clan Feature
The Yamanaka clan is capable of sharing their thoughts as a result of their Telepathic Comms trait. But even that, isn’t always enough.
All creatures linked with your Telepathic Comms trait can spend 1 minute focusing on another willing creature linked with your Telepathic Comms trait. The focusing creature can now perceive through the target creatures senses, replacing them with your own. Creatures can only share in this perception for up to 1 hour, before needing a rest to share senses again.
#### Psionic Network
11th Level Clan Feature
Your mind generates a psionic pinging system, capable of mentally tracking the locations of anyone in or out of combat, so long as they are capable of sentient thought.
You gain a unique special sense, called Psionic Awareness, which only Yamanaka can ever manifest.
Psionic Awareness. You can perceive the presence and location of sentient thought. Creatures that are capable of complex thought like that of a human, sage beast, or other mentally capable creatures (GM has final say on which creatures qualify).
All creatures within 30 feet of you that qualify as being able to have complex thought, and are not incapacitate or unconscious are made aware to you.
Creatures that you’ve sensed before are familiar to you, and you can connect the sensation of sensing them to their name and face.
You are always aware of creatures with complex though within range.
Creatures with resistance to any Mental condition or conditions with the [Mental] tag, cannot be sensed with this sense.
This sense does not rely on sight, penetrating walls up to 1 feet thick, so as it’s not chakra based or reinforced.
This sense does not pinpoint their location, only their existence and relative distance from or direction from you.
By spending 1 minute focusing you can expand this range up to 120 feet.
If you spend 10 minutes focusing you can expand this range up to 1 mile.
If you spend 1 hour focusing, you can expand this range up to 100 miles.
When expanding the range of this send out to 1 mile or greater, to avoid overloading your mind, you must be looking for a creature familiar to you.
You can only maintain this expanded range up to 1 minute.
If the range is expanded to 1 mile or greater, you can maintain it for 1 minute, but only while stationary.
#### Deep Disruption
15th Level Clan Feature
Your mastery over invasive mental obstructions allow you to rewrite how an enemy responds to hostile intent.
You can now choose to use Mind Body Transfer as a Bonus action instead of an Action. If you do, you cannot use the Mind Body Transfer as an Action.
Additionally, while you are Dominating a creature, if they would succeed their saving throw to end the Dominated status, you can spend your reaction and reduce the ranks of Mental Overwrite by 1, and extend the duration by one additional round. A creature with 0 ranks of Mental Overwrite automatically ends the Dominated status.

# Land of Wind Clans
## Fūshin Clan
The man walked down the long winding road. The howling wind buffeting against him, each step seeming harder than the last. He finally manages to get to some cover a cave, and sighs in relief. He notices his clothes were shredded by the wind, and small cuts had begun to form over his body. The whole time he had been on this island there was a constant wind, and he had not been informed of this prior to starting his mission. No natural wind he could think of was this wide spread, this long-lasting, and this powerful. "This must be a jutsu," he thought to himself. Through the entrance of the cave, he saw a figure emerge. A kunoichi with a Land of Water headband and an air of confidence about her. He sees that her clothes are pristine, and immediately understands that she was the one who cast this jutsu. His screams were deafened by the roaring, insistent wind.
- Himitsu Yuki
The Longsword bearer, Ch. 13 excerpt.
### One Wind the Wind
The Fūshin Clan is a clan native to the Land of Water who are few in number, but make up for some of the most powerful wind users in the shinobi world. Seemingly blessed by the wind itself, this clan can devastate the battlefield with their techniques, that seem to tower over others, who are unfortunate enough to face them in battle.
### Fūshin Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Dex
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Ninshou
Passive Affinity: You have the Wind Release Affinity.
Fushin Techniques: The Fushin Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Fushin Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Wind Release Simplicity: Reduce the downtime cost to create or learn jutsu with the Wind Release keyword by half.

### Fūshin Features
#### Divine Winds
1st Level Clan Feature
The winds recognize you and your bloodline, giving you and your clansmen aid. You are able to call upon it as it aids you in combat. Thanks to this unique relationship with the winds, you can utilize your clans unique fighting style known as the Divine Wind fighting stance.
You can enter the Divine Wind chakra stance as a bonus action. When you do, you have access to two different forms within this stance. You can swap between these variants at the beginning of each of your tuns at no action cost. While in either variant stance, you float gently 1 feet off the ground and you cannot take falling damage if you fall no more than 50 feet.
Pressure Front. You compress air into invisible cyclones that spiral under you, shifting pressure around you, weaponizing air pressure as you gain the following benefits;
Each time you cast a jutsu with the Wind release keyword, you build 1 High Pressure. You can spend High Pressure on effects that call for it. You can retain up to 4 High Pressure at a time, and they last for 1 minute. This increases to 6 at 11th level. You cannot gain High Pressure as part of the same action used to spend it.
You can spend 1 High Pressure as part of casting a jutsu with the Wind release keyword to grant it the Swirl effect.
Your Hijutsu gain the Critical Success/Failure effects listed.
Razor Jet. You push wind though a small pin sized funnel of chakra that you maintain, creating highly lethal jets of slicing wind that can be as devastating or surgical as you desire. You gain the following benefits;
Each time you cast a jutsu with the Wind release keyword, you apply Low Pressure to one of the affected creatures. You can spend Low Pressure an affected creature has on them on effects that call for it and they last for 1 minute.
When you deal damage to a creature with Low Pressure, you can spend it to push them 10 feet into a direction of your choice, excluding vertically.
Jutsu you cast with the Wind Release keyword, that affect an area, can have its shape changed to either a Jet Needle or Cleave:

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |
[/BOX]
Jet Needle. 5-foot wide, 30-foot-long line. Creatures in this affected area suffer a -2 penalty to their saving throws. Increase the length of the line by +30 feet at 7th, 11th and 15th levels.
Cleave. Select two points you can see within 60 feet of you. Draw a line between these two points. All creatures within 5 feet of this line make their saving throw against the jutsu’s effects. On a failure, they gain +1 rank of Bleed.
#### Raging Tempests
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your wind has started to wander, almost gaining a mind of its own. It helps you, guide your movements, in ways that it doesn’t for others. You gain one Wind Whisper, which define how the wind aids you. You gain additional whispers at 7th and 15th levels.
Vortex Burst
Jutsu you cast with the Wind release keyword that affect an area or when you trigger the Swirl effect on jutsu you cast, you can increase the size of the jutsu cast or swirl triggered by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 11th level.
High Pressure. You can spend two High Pressure to grant yourself a fly speed equal to your move speed, until the end of your next turn.
Low Pressure. When a creature with Low Pressure fails their saving throw against a jutsu you cast, you can spend that pressure to slam them into the ground knocking them Prone and reducing their speed to 0 until the end of their next turn.
Blade Spiral
When you cast a Fushin Hijutsu as an Action that inflicts Bleed you can spend your bonus action, to trigger Swirl, even if the jutsu does not have it. When you do, all creature in Swirls affected area must also make the same saving throw as the original target if any. On a failure, all affected creatures gain +1 rank of Bleed.
High Pressure. You can spend one High Pressure to sharpen your weapon. Until the beginning of your next turn, your weapon deals an additional +1d6 wind damage. This increases to +2d6 at 11th level.
Low Pressure. When a creature with Low Pressure makes a melee attack against you, you can spend your reaction to spend that pressure, causing a burst of slicing wind, dealing 2d6 slashing or wind damage (your choice) to the triggering creature. This increases to 4d6 at 7th and 6d6 at 15th levels.
Storm wall
When you cast a Jutsu with the Wind Release keyword with the Barrier keyword, it is augmented, gaining 4 DR against incoming damage. This increases to 6 DR at 11th level. Also, when you cast a jutsu, you can dispel vapors, gases or fogs, if it is within 10 feet of you.
High Pressure. As part of casting a Jutsu with the Wind release keyword, you can spend 2 High Pressure to grant yourself a temporary shield of wind, with temporary hit points equal to twice your level, until the beginning of your next turn.

Low Pressure. When you deal damage to a creature with Low Pressure that are benefiting from a Barrier, you can spend that pressure to reduce the barrier hit points or DR (your choice), in half.
Whispering Breeze
When you cast a Genjutsu with the Auditory keyword, they also affect creatures that are Deafened. If the Genjutsu cast has the Inhale keyword, it also affects creatures that are holding their breaths or do not need to breathe.
High Pressure. When you cast a Fushin Hijutsu, that forces a saving throw, you can spend one High Pressure. When you do, on a failed save, the affected creature(s) are also Deafened and Dazed until the end of their next turn.
Low Pressure. When a creature with Low Pressure fails their saving throw against a Genjutsu you or an allied creature casts with the Auditory or Inhale keyword, you can spend that pressure to make them instead suffer the Critical Failure effect.
Rending Jetstream
When you cast a Fushin Hijutsu, you can as part of that casting, move up to 20 feet without triggering opportunity attacks, as the wind carries you to your destination.
High Pressure. You can spend up to two High Pressure to rend the defenses of a foe you deal Wind or Slashing damage to, reducing their DR by 2, for every pressure spent this way until the beginning of your next turn.
Low Pressure. When a creature with Low Pressure casts a Jutsu that requires Mobility (M), you can spend your reaction to spend the pressure, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, as they have their tendons slashed at, gaining 1 rank of Bleed and Shaken on a failed save.
#### Secrets of the Wind
7th Level Clan Feature
The wind does more that carry dust and leaves. For you and your clansmen, it ferries gossip, warnings, and secrets. By spending 10 minute of focus, for the next hour, you can whisper and creatures of your choice within 90 feet of you, that you can see, can hear you clearly and you can hear them, if they whisper, even if they are unaware you are listening. This feature is blocked by walls at least 1 inch thick and cannot affect creatures whom you lose sight of.
#### Forceful Gale Wind
11th Level Clan Feature
The speed of your assault is the speed of the wind. Everywhere at once. Capable of occurring without even moving. When casting a Jutsu with the Wind release keyword targeting a creature with Low Pressure, by spending 3 High Pressure and the marked creatures Low Pressure, your jutsu’s effects are applied before the effect the target creature attempts to utilize as a reaction, even if that jutsu has the Interrupt keyword.
#### Typhoon Release: Wind Scythe
15th Level Clan Feature
You’ve reached the pinnacle as your clansmen look to you for inspiration as you bring the full wrath of a raging typhoon into every battle. As a bonus action, you enter your Wind Scythe state, for the next minute, after which you cannot activate this battle state until you complete a long rest. While your Wind Scythe state is active you gain the following benefits:
You gain the benefit of both Pressure Front and Razor Jet while in your Divine Wind stance.
Jutsu you cast without the Wind Release keyword can gain the Swirl effect by spending 1 High Pressure.
Once per turn when you deal Slashing or Wind damage, by spending 1 High Pressure, you can inflict 1 rank of Bleed to all damaged creatures.
You can use either Jet Needle or Cleave as an Action. If you do they force Dexterity saving throws vs your highest jutsu save DC.
Jet Needle deals 8d6 Slashing or Wind damage on a failed saving throw or half as much on a success.
Cleave allows you to select three points, drawing a line from the first point to the second to the third and deals 6d6 Slashing or Wind damage and inflicts 2 ranks of Bleed on a failed save or half as much damage on a success.
