## Hanami Clan
I looked forward seeing the group of 30 men in front of me
and steeled my nerves. Shouting out to the group " What's
wrong, you afraid of a little kid?”
That got their attention. All at once they rushed in trying
to swarm me. Before I even got a chance to react a few even
managed to get a good hit on me.
I reacted swiftly. In one single fluid motion I threw my fist into the ground creating a massive shockwave knocking all my attackers backward and begun to heal my wounds. By the time the attack began again I was as good as ever. I may not be able to win this fight, but I will buy Hans and Chiyo all the time they need.
– Fujima Hanami                                                       The Long Road, Ch. 30 excerpt.
### Built for Combat
The Hanami Clan believes in perfecting one’s physical body, while also studying how to heal their and other’s wounds. The Hanami are known for their monstrous strength and blending medical jutsu into their combat style.
### Hanami Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str, +1 Wis or Int
Speed: 30 feet
Skill Proficiency: Marital Arts, Medicine
Tool Proficiency: Medicine Kit
Passive Affinity: You have the Medical Release Affinity.
Hanami Techniques: The Hanami Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Hanami Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Resilient Chakra Network: You have a rank of mastery to saving throws against gaining a rank of Sealed.
### Hanami Features
#### Medical Fist
1st Level Clan Feature
Your clans unique fighting style allows you to infuse chakra into your bones and layer the top layer of skin with a shell akin to the Chakra scalpel technique that can extend off of it like a flail, allowing your strike to pierce, slash and brutalize your opponent, known as the Medical Fist fighting stance.
As a Bonus action, you can enter your Medical Fist Taijutsu stance. While in this stance you gain the following benefits:
Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and can deal bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage, your choice when you roll for damage.
Your melee attacks gain the Reach property if it didn’t already. If it did, increase the ranks of Reach by +1. This increases to +2 at 7th and +3 at 15th levels.
You can use either the Monstrous Burst or the Healers Touch benefit from Hanami clan Hijutsu you cast. You cannot gain both benefits as part of the same casting.
You gain a rank of mastery to Athletics based checks.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
#### Hanami Boons/Banes
3rd Level Clan Feature
You learn to make different medicines that can heal or enhance combat capabilities or infuse into jutsu or, known as Hanami Boons/Banes. When you complete a short or long rest, you can select Boons or Banes each with a single use. You can create a number of Boons or Banes equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can prepare multiple copies of the same Boon or Bane. You can give a Boon to a willing creature at no action cost on the consuming creature turn, or on your turn, so long as they are within 5 feet of you. They must still consume it. Consuming a Boon costs 1 Bonus action. Banes have their infusion requirements listed in their text and use your highest jutsu save DC if it calls for a saving throw. Any unused Boons or Banes become inert, losing their potency when you complete a short or long rest.
A creature can only benefit from one Boon at a time. Consuming a Boon while benefiting from one, causing the oldest Boons effects to be dispelled.
Beginning at 7th level, you can make Fused Boons/Banes. When you do, select two different Boons or Banes. Fused Boons/Banes impart the benefit of both chosen Boons or Banes. Only you can consume a Fused Boon.
Beginning at 11th level, you no longer need to spend a Bonus action to consume a Boon and you can administer Boons to allied creatures at no action, on your turn as well.
Blessed Boon
By consuming this Boon, the affected creature becomes blessed with vitality that it never had before.  It gains a +1d4 bonus to their attacks, checks and saving throws, until the end of its next turn.
Boosting Boon
By consuming this Boon, the affected creature gains a +1 bonus to its critical threat range for melee attacks for the next minute. This increases to +2 at 11th level. If it scores a critical hit with an unarmed attack, add +1d12 to the damage dealt. This increases to 2d12 at 7th level.
Combo/Finisher Boon
By consuming this Boon, for the next minute when the affected creature casts Jutsu with the Medical or Inhale keyword, those jutsu gain the Combo keyword, as if they were a Taijutsu.
Alternatively, when the affected creature casts a Jutsu with the Combo keyword, if the next jutsu they cast has the Medical or Inhale keyword, it also gains the Finisher keyword, and increases the damage dealt by +2 damage die.
Lucky Boon
By consuming this Boon, the affected creatures next d20 roll before the beginning of their next turn, treats any roll below a 10, as a 10.
Restoring Boon
By consuming this Boon, the affected creature rolls two of its Hit Die and adds its constitution modifier to the result, regaining hit points equal to the results. This increases to three hit die at 7th and four hit die at 15th level.
Swift Boon
By consuming this Boon, the affected creature gains a +10 bonus to its movement speed and can ignore difficult terrain for the next minute. This increases to a +15 bonus to speed at 7th level and +20 at 15th level.
Warding Boon
By consuming this Boon, the affected creature gains resistance to one damage type of its choice, for 1 minute. This becomes two damage types of its choice at 11th level.
Dispelling Bane
As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, any creature that fails their save has one jutsu they are currently concentrating on of the same rank or lower dispelled.
Dispirited Bane
As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane and any creature that fails their save, becomes Confused for the next minute. If the chosen jutsu allows the affected creature to remake their saving throw, they end this effect on a success. If the chosen jutsu does not allow a resave, then the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.
Fragile Bane
As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane. On a failed save, for the next minute, the Bruised condition gains the Max Ranks: 5 tag, allow it to be applied up to 5 times. A creature with more than 1 rank of Bruised increases the bonus damage they take by +4, for each rank they have beyond the first.
Hindering Bane
As part of casting a jutsu with the Medical or Inhaled keyword that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane and any creature that fails their save, you can select either Strength, Intelligence or Wisdom. For the next minute, the affected creature gains a d4 penalty to attacks or saves with the chosen ability. If the chosen jutsu allows the affected creature to remake their saving throw, they end this effect on a success. If the chosen jutsu does not allow a resave, then the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.
Sluggish Bane
As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane and any creature that fails their save, becomes Slow. If the chosen jutsu allows the affected creature to remake their saving throw, they end this effect on a success. If the chosen jutsu does not allow a resave, then the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.
Weakening Bane
As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, any creature that fails their save gains one rank of Weakened for the next minute. At the end of the affected creatures turn, they make a Constitution saving throw, on a failure, they gain an additional rank of Weakened for the duration. If they succeed this save three times, they end this effect and remove all ranks of Weakened gained by this bane.
Gambling Bane
As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, any creature that fails their save rolls a d6. On a roll of 1, they lose their next action. On a roll of 2-4, they lose their bonus action. On a roll of 5 or 6, they suffer no effect.
#### Empowered Medicine
7th Level Clan Feature
Your clans methodical skill and technique with medicine, enables you to utilize the First Aid Kit in ways other medics simply cannot. First Aid Kit’s you have can now have their effects applied over the course of 10 minutes, instead of a short or long rest, can affect creatures twice per rest, and for you, no long have use limits, can be used with no fear of running out of materials. Additionally, First Aid Kits you have count as a Medicine Kits for the purpose of using the Medical Check Up ability.
#### Hardened Body & Mind
11th Level Clan Feature
You have trained your body and mind to resist the wills of others through use of medical techniques and martial practice. When you are forced to make a saving throw to resist a Physical or Mental condition as a result of a hostile creature, you can choose to make the saving throw using the higher ability based on your Hijutsu Flexibility clan trait (Strength or Intelligence saving throw)
Additionally, Banes can now be infused into any Jutsu you cast with the Medical or Inhaled keywords that you cast.
#### Overloaded Medicine
15th Level Clan Feature
You have perfected the specialized Medicines your clan is known for. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Medical Keyword that heals a creatures hit points, cleanses conditions, or deal damage, you select one allied creature within 30 feet of you with ranks of a Physical, Mental or Sensory condition. You reduce one conditions rank by 1. A creature who has its condition removed as a result of this feature, gains immunity to that condition until the end of your next turn.
Alternatively, once per turn, when you deal damage with a Jutsu with the Combo or Finisher keyword, you weaken their resilience to afflictions. They make their next saving throw to resist a Physical, Mental or Sensory condition at disadvantage.

## Jiton Clan
The Genin from the sand stands with his arms crossed, watching, unimpressed with the showing of his rival during the chunin exams. “I thought you showed more promise than this Judo” The Sand Genin states. His rival on one knee, stands up dusting himself off before weaving handsigns and conjuring a massive amount of Chakra creating a dense ball of wind. “Yeah, I thought I did too. Let’s not disappoint these people. They came to see a show Gura, Let’s give them one.” Judo responds as he creates a powerful blast of Air, that Gura, the Sand Genin smirks and responds with a drilling construct of Dust and Sand.
—Himari Hyūga

### A Magnetic personality
The Jiton Clan is a clan that hails proudly from the Land of Wind. Every Kazekage has held this Nature Release and it have brough about an era of prosperity and peace within the Land of Wind. Using Jiton, or Magnet release, a user is usually seen as an extremely oppressive opponent able to fight without lifting a finger a lot of time due to this clan using their Jutsu almost entirely through Chakra control with only a few of their techniques requiring the chakra focusing of hand signs to enable.
### Jiton Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Cha
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Ninshou, Survival.
Magnet Release Affinity: You begin with either Earth or Wind Release Affinity. (Pick one)
Magnet Release Techniques: The Jiton Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Jiton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.
Magnetic Sense: You can sense the presence and exact location of exposed and concealed metal within 30 feet of you, so long as it is at least 1 Bulk in size. You can determine the space and elevation of each metallic object, creature or structure within range, even if you cannot see it. Creatures carrying no metal of the appropriate size or are not made of metal are invisible to this sense. This special sense cannot penetrate barriers or obstructions greater than 1 feet thick.
### Jiton Features
#### Dust Veil
1st Level Clan Feature
You are capable of manipulating magnetically charged dust particles. These dust particles can be of a material of your choice, each offering special properties based on your choice. Select one particle type. This cannot be changed later. You can release or recall your Dust Veil from a container you carry or from the environment, based on the make-up of the particles as a Bonus action, entering your Dust Veil Chakra stance.
While released you gain the benefits of one of your chosen particle types. If you fall unconscious, or take lightning damage, the Dust Veil stance is dispelled.
Select one of the following particle types at character creation. You gain an additional upgrade at 7th and 15th levels. You can select the same particle type additional times, further magnifying your control over them which is signified by the Potency I and Potency II additional effects listed with each particle type. Alternatively, you can select a different Particle type, gaining the base version when you reach 7th or 15th levels.
Dust Veil abilities use your highest jutsu save DC, for effects that call for it.
Carbon
You can manipulate particles of black carbon packed with potential energy. While your Dust Veil is active, As an action you can select a point you can see no more than 60 feet away and fill a 20-foot cube centered on this point with a highly corrosive cloud of carbon. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a wind of moderate speed disperses it. All creatures that begin their turn in this cloud must make a Constitution saving throw being Envenomed on a failure. This cloud itself is counted as having 2 ranks of Volatile.
Potency I: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with a Jiton Clan Hijutsu, they become Volatile.
Potency II: When you spend your action to generate a cloud, you can select two points you can see, and the affected areas becomes heavily obscured and difficult terrain. Creatures that fail their saving throw within the cloud becomes Blinded until the end of their following turns.
Gold
You can manipulate particles of gold dust, dense and heavy. While your Dust Veil is active, once per turn, As a Bonus action you release a wave of heavy weighted gold particles in a 20-Foot Cone originating from you, forcing all creatures in range of your choice to make a Strength saving throw, being Grappled in place until the end of their turns on a failure.
Potency I: Once per turn, When a creature fails a saving throw against a Jiton Clan Hijutsu you cast, they become Heavy until the beginning of your next turn.
Potency II: When you spend your action to generate a wave, it increases in size to a 40-Foot Cone, and creatures who fail their saving throw also become Heavy and Slowed until the end of their following turns.
Iron

On a failure, if they have ranks of Bleed already, they suffer the effects of the Bleed condition as if it was the beginning of their turn.

If you could coat your particles in a different poison, the previous poison becomes inert.

Potency II: As a Bonus action, you can manifest constructs made entirely of sand. When you complete a rest, select one jutsu from the following list. You can cast the chosen jutsu as part of this Bonus Action, as if you were casting it at A-Rank, at no chakra cost. If the jutsu would allow you to summon more than one creature as part of its casting, you can summon no more than two of those creatures. Once you use this effect, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.

#### Magnetic Tagging
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your ability to subtly magnify objects, structures and creatures have grown to the point where you can manipulate those magnified, in subtle ways.
At the beginning of each of your turns, and once per turn when you cast a Jiton Hijutsu, you accumulate a Magnetic Charge, of which you can have up to 4 at any given time. These Magnetic Charges last for 1 minute. Once per turn, you can spend your Magnetic Charges to manipulate objects, structures and creatures in certain ways. If your Magnetic Tag requires a saving throw, it uses your highest jutsu save DC.
Magnetic Pulse. When a metallic weapon is used as part of an attack while within range, you can spend 1 tag, to impose a 1d4 penalty to the attack result. This increases to 1d6 at 11th level.
Magnetic Shield. When a metallic weapon is used as part of an attack while within range, you can spend 1 tag, to reduce the damage die size of the weapon by 1 step. If the weapons damage rolls multiple dice, you instead reduce the number of dice rolled by 1. Reduce the damage die size by one additional step at 7th and 15th levels. If the weapons damage die is a d4 and cannot be reduced any further, they instead treat their dice result as 1.
Magnetic Snatch. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 tag to attempt to snatch a weapon held by an unwilling creature in range. They must make a Strength saving throw, having their weapon taken from them and pulled to you, on a failed save. Increase the number of creatures you can target by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.
Magnetic Vectors. When a metallic weapon is used as part of a ranged attack while within range, you can spend 2 tags and your reaction to redirect the attack to another creature within range. Make a jutsu attack, using your highest bonus against the new target. On a hit, apply the attacks original effect to the new target.
Magnetic Puppetry. As an Action, select a creature you can see wielding a metallic weapon and spend 3 tags to force them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, you control the weapon they are wielding, as it seemingly comes to life in their hands as it strikes out against a creature within 5 feet of them. The creature that failed their save must make an attack against the closest creature to them of your choice, dealing their attacks damage + 2d8. Increase the bonus damage by +1d8 and the number of creatures you can target by +1 at 7th, 11th and 15th levels.
#### Magnet Release Manifestation
7th Level Clan Feature
The Jiton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Magnet Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Earth Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Magnet Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Wind Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Earth respectively.
Also, as an Action, you use your chosen dust particle and create a semisolid platform in the shape of a 5-foot radius circular disc, which floats 2 feet above the ground, and has a 40-foot fly speed. This platform can hold up to 4 creature, or no more than 500 lbs. in weight. This platform lasts for 10 minutes. Beginning at 15th level the size of this platform increase to be a 10-foot radius disc and now hold up to 8 creatures or 1000lbs. in weight.
While you are riding the platform, you can forgo your movement speed and use the platforms movement speed in place of your own.
#### Swirling Currents
11th Level Clan Feature
Your magnetic field constantly slows objects used against you, based on your focus. When you complete a short or long rest, you grant yourself resistance to two of the following damage types from melee and ranged attacks, until you complete a short rest; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, earth or wind.
#### Magnetic Surge
15th Level Clan Feature
Your Chakra magnetizes everything, allowing you to not be caught off guard and even strike from unconventional locations. Increase the number of Magnetic Charges you can have to 6.
Additionally, you can extend your radius of dominion, by entering a Magnetic Surge state as a Bonus action, which lasts for 1 minute. While in this Magnetic Surge state, you emanate a 40-foot radius of dominion, centered on you, that moves with you. You gain the following benefits for the duration. Once you exit this state, you cannot use it again until you complete a rest;
Jiton Clan Hijutsu you cast or Dust Veil abilities you use, can originate from any space you can see within your radius of dominion.
Creatures of your choice within your radius of dominion that you can see treat the area as difficult terrain.
Once per turn, when you force a creature to move against their will, you can increase the distance moved by +10 feet.
You regain 2 Magnetic Charges at the beginning of your turns, instead of 1.

If you score a critical hit with an attack made with this jutsu, you refund the chakra cost associated with the attack.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can target the same creature with one additional attack if you make extra attacks with this jutsu’s effect. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the damage by 1d10 of each damage type. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can choose to instead choose up to 4 creatures, and make a single attack, comparing the result against each of their AC. You can spend the additional chakra to make additional attacks, targeting all previously targeting creatures up to three additional times.

If you are selecting a space then the space is damaged beyond repair, destroying the ground. If the surface is not at least 5 feet thick, then the ground collapses into whatever lies below, and the structure falls to the next surface landing and occupying a 15-feet wide, 20-feet tall cube like space. All creatures within 40-feet of the structure when it lands, must make a Strength saving throw, if they are wielding a metallic weapon. On a failed save, the weapon is drawn to the structure and merged into it for the duration. If a creature hit by this jutsu’s attack fails their strength saving throw to retain their weapon they are also Restrained by being under the structure. A restrained creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, escaping from under the structure on a success.
The Structure remains solid and does not fall apart for the duration. Weapons merged into the structure fall harmlessly into a space that can hold it when this jutsu ends.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d10, and the number of structures/attacks you can make by +1.

## Konjiki Clan
"I blinked once, then twice before realizing that I was still alive to blink and not buried miles below the surface. That’s when I heard it; Izumi was taking in short heavy breaths that sounded almost like she was wheezing. She had summoned an unbelievable amount of steel to stop the cavern from collapsing and saved us all. I started to let out my gratitude when she collapsed onto the ground. Sensei walked up to her and lifted her onto his back saying that he was proud to have such a strong student"
-Kamira Kaguya The Long Road, Ch. 24 excerpt
### Tempered Will
The Konjiki is a clan from the village hidden in stones, a small village in the country between the lands of wind and earth, this clan is known for both their mercenary works in those great nations and their special affinity to the materialization of Yin and Earth chakra known as “Steel Release”.
### Konjiki Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Con
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Crafting, Ninshou
Steel Release: You begin with the Earth Release Affinity.
Konjiki Techniques: The Konjiki Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Konjiki Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Liquid Metal: As a Bonus action, you can conjure one weapon (or a stack if they have the ammunition trait) with a bulk of 2. This weapon shares any weapon seals found on weapons you currently have that it qualifies for but dissolves if another weapon is conjured this way.
### Konjiki Features
#### Alomancy
1st Level Clan Feature
Your clans Kekkei Genkai grants you unparallel control over the physical makeup of metals you infuse your chakra into, even able to liquify them to make it easier to reshape. Your clan has fostered a plethora of ways to utilize this Alomancy, which are represented as Liquid Metal Ingots, of which, you have an amount equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.
You can spend these Ingots to fuel your Alomancy. You begin with 1 Alomancy Technique of your choice. You gain an additional Alomancy Technique at 7th and 15th levels. If an Alomancy forces a saving throw, or requires an attack use your highest jutsu attack or saving throw to resolve its effect. You regain spent ingots when you complete a short rest.
Iron Bulwark
As a Reaction, to an allied creature within 30 feet of you taking damage you can spend 1 Ingot to project a metallic shield, intercepting damage, acting as a barrier for them. The barrier projected has hit points equal to 2d6 + 6 and DR equal to your highest ability modifier. Its hit points increase by +1d6 at 7th, and 15th levels. This barrier lasts until the beginning of your next turn.
[BOX]
| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |
[/BOX]
Steel Reinforcement
As a Bonus action, you can select one willing creature within 30 feet of you wearing armor or wielding a weapon, and wrap them in your metallic chakra, spending 2 Ingots. When you do, for the next minute their armor or weapons bulk is increased by either +2, +4 or +6, your choice. The chosen bulk increase also provides some benefits for the duration.
Bulk +2. The target gains the Fortified property and a +2 bonus to their Armor Bonus.
Bulk +4. Same as Bulk +2 & a +2 bonus to their Constitution Saving throws.
Bulk +6. Same as Bulk +2 and a +2 bonus to their Strength and Constitution Saving throws.
Metallic Thorns
As a Bonus action, by spending 1 ingot, you can select a point you can see within 30 feet of you, and fill a 10-foot cube with liquid metal that form into spike when a creature of your choice steps onto the space, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 piercing damage, gaining 2 ranks of Bleed and reducing their remaining movement by 15 on a failure, or half damage on a successful save. This trapped area lasts for 1 minute and can trigger once per turn.
This damage increases by 1d6 at 7th and 15th levels and the ranks of Bleed increases by +1 at 11th level.
Metallic Step
As a reaction, to seeing an allied creature other than yourself, within 60 feet of you be forced to make a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, by spending 1 ingot, you can form some of the metal on their person, into something that can pull them, dragging them up to 20-feet into a space closer to you, in a straight line without triggering opportunity attacks. If this movement would pull them out of the triggering effects range, they make their saving throw at advantage, otherwise, they gain a +2 bonus to their saving throw.
Superheavy Metals
As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu, you can spend up to four Ingots to magnify its weight, making it barrel through any defense. When you do, if the affected creature is Bruised, they suffer the effect of Bruised once additional time for each ingot spent.
Supersharp
As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu, you can spend up to two Ingots to magnify the piercing capabilities of the strike, gaining 4 Pierce for every ingot spent this way.
Metallic Fan
As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu that targets a single creature, you can spend one Ingot to magnify the striking range of the attack. All creatures within 5-Feet of the original target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the attacks original damage on a failure or no damage on a success. If this attack is a critical hit, all creatures making their saving throw make their save at disadvantage.
#### Metallurgy
3rd Level Clan Feature
Members of the Konjiki clan are able to utilize the malleability of their chakra, infusing it into metal, bending and twisting it into a liquid-like substance, capable of reclaiming a solid shape at the Konjiki’s pleasure. At the conclusion of a Short or long rest, the Konjiki can choose to create a Metallurgy Armor or coat a weapon they wield in Metallurgy itself, that lasts until they complete their next rest.
If a weapon, they select a single weapon they have in their possession to become coated in Metallurgy. If the weapon chosen has the Ammunition trait, treat the ammunition die as a d12 that can never be reduced in size by an effect that would call for it. The weapon gains a unique Konjiki weapon property from the following list.
Beginning at 11th level, you can create one of each an Armor and weapon.
Geometric Makeup. The Weapon grants you with a solid offense and defense with its dense structure, gaining the Fortified and Blocking 1 traits.
Counter weight. The weapon cannot be disarmed from you and gains the thrown (20/40) and Return keywords.
Shearing Edge. Once per turn, on a hit, you may reduce an affected creatures AC by 1, or their DR by 2, until the beginning of your next turn.
[BOX]
| #### Mercury Foundry / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / You generate +1 Ingot at the beginning of each of your turns. / You DR is set at 12. If your DR is instead higher than 12, increase your DR by +2. / At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain 8 Temporary hit points. / Weapons made by your Liquid Metal trait, or under the effects of your Metallurgy clan feature, count as any weapon group, for the purposes of casting Bukijutsu. / Armor made by Metallurgy can gain a second trait. |
[/BOX]
Rebounding Line. Once per turn, if your attack using this weapon (Weapon attack or Taijutsu attack) result would be 5 or higher than the targets AC, the next attack targeting you before the beginning of your next turn is made at disadvantage.
If armor, select one Armor from the following: Reinforced Cloth, Shinobi Combat Jacket or Jonin Armor. The armor can be in any design of your choice, has a Bulk of 1 and gains a Konjiki unique armor property from the following list:
Anchored Greaves. You have Advantage on saves to resist being moved against your will. On a successful save against such an effect, you gain 1 Liquid Metal Ingot.
Elemental Deflection Plates. Select one elemental damage type (Earth, Wind, Fire, Cold, Lightning or Acid). You have resistance to the given damage type until you are hit by a critical hit or create another weapon or armor with this feature.
Expanding Plates. All other creatures within 5 feet of you gain a +2 bonus to their AC.
Smart Armor. While wearing this armor, you can use Intelligence, in place of Dexterity for armor class calculation and 60 feet of tremor sense.
Kinetic Raiment. Once per turn, when you move at least 10 feet on your turn, you gain a bonus to the damage you deal equal to twice your Reinforced value. When you use this effect, you gain 1 Liquid Metal Ingot.
#### Bromine Keys
7th Level Clan Feature
You take liquid metal and insert it into an open lock of a sealed or locked contraption. By spending 1 minute, you can perform the Pick Locks activity as if you have a Security Kit. When you do, reduce the DC by 10 as your try to reconfigure the locks internals to fit any key shape you are thinking. On a successful check, the lock is unlatched and any other key that would normally unlock the lock can no longer do so. Any key you have can now unlock or lock the lock as if it was the original key.
#### Heavy Metal
11th Level Clan Feature
You learn to infuse some of your metallic chakra into your earth release jutsu, reinforcing their molecular structure, making them harder, stronger, and more durable.
When you cast a Jutsu with the Earth Release keyword that summons a creature, structure, or barrier with hit points, it becomes suffused with your metallic chakra, enhancing it further. Increase the hit points it has at creation, by an amount equal to your level or you can increase the DR it has at creation for the duration of its existence by an amount equal to your highest ability modifier.
#### Liquid Mercury Foundry
15th Level Clan Feature
Konjiki’s ultimate form of Metallurgy, infusing liquid metal into your skin, granting you metal like resilience, but also the ability to manifest any tool needed to accomplish any task at hand.
As a Bonus action, you enter your Mercury Foundry state, coating yourself in liquid metal for the next minute. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a short rest.

A Genin dashes through a thick brush of trees trying to escape an ambush. She weaves hand seals and Fires forth a white-hot sphere of flame towards the brush in front of her, completely burning way the brush in front of him without even a hint of smoke or soot. As they move through the forest chasing her, they arrive to an opening in the forest. Seeing their target, they move in to attack, but she responds by conjuring a large, single sphere of Scorch flame and engulf all of her enemies, turning them into mummified carcasses.
—Soren Uzumaki
At Worlds End, Ch. 2 excerpt.
### Too Hot to Touch
The Shakuton Clan is a clan that hails proudly from the Land of Wind. This clan has an extreme affinity for Fire & Wind Release able to create flames as hot as a small sun that can burn away all moisture on impact. This clan has a famed history in the Land of Wind, but after one of its famed members were killed in an ambush, they scattered joining other villages to avoid the potential of a clan massacre.
### Shakuton Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Wis
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Survival, Ninshou.
Scorch Release Affinity: You begin with either Wind or Fire Release Affinity. (Pick one)
Scorch Release Techniques: The Shakuton Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: The Shakuton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
Blazing Heat Regulation: Shakuton Clansmen and creatures within 5 feet of them are immune to hostile cold environments and do not need to make checks or saving throws to resist effects caused by extreme cold temperatures.
### Shakuton Features
#### Heating Up
1st Level Clan Feature
Your chakra is hotter, more dangerous, and more lethal than any other user of fire release, not because you are inherently stronger, no. It’s because you can directly infuse and feed your flames with wind release, constantly increasing the potency and heat of your flames until they emulate that of a small sun, reacting to the fuel you feed it. Beginning at 1st level, each time you cast a Shakuton Clan Hijutsu or a jutsu with the Fire or Wind Release keyword, you build heat, increasing your temperature to the extreme. This is represented as Scorch Charges of which, you can gain 1, once per turn when you cast the qualifying jutsu. You can maintain up to 2 Scorch Charges at a time and they are dispelled after 1 minute. You cannot gain Scorch Charges the same turn you spend them as a result of casting a jutsu. While you have Scorch Charges you are in your Scorching Heat state.
When you reach 3rd, 7th, 11th and 15th levels, increase the maximum Scorch Charges you can maintain by +2.
#### Desiccated Heat
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your flames go beyond just burning. They can boil, dehydrate, evaporate and even melt without leaving so much as a burn mark. But you can control it. Make it far less about burning, and more versatile in nature, based on your needs in the moment, by spending your Scorch Charges. If an ability requires a saving throw or makes an attack, use your highest jutsu ability modifier/saving throw DC. Select two abilities. You gain an additional 2 options at 11th level.
Scorching Aura
As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to generate a zone of intense heat for all creatures within 20-feet of you. This zone of intense heat is not only uncomfortable, but also detrimental. Creatures other than you within the zone cannot regain hit points while within the zone. If a creature would regain hit points while within the affected area, they instead take Fire damage equal to the amount of hit points they would regain. This fire damage is treated as if you dealt the damage to them.
This zone lasts until the end of your next turn, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to extend this auras duration by 1 round.
Blazing Aura
As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to generate a zone of blazing heat for all creatures within 20-feet of you. This zone of heat is painful to be within for all creatures, excluding you. Creatures other than you that begin their turn within the zone or enter the zone for the first time on a turn must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Immolation. Increase the damage this aura deals by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels and the ranks of Immolation inflicted by +1 at 11th level.
This zone lasts until the end of your next turn, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to extend this auras duration by 1 round.
Dehydrating Aura

On a successful check, the condition ends. |

As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to generate a zone of intense and evaporating heat for all creatures within 20-feet of you. This zone of heat is difficult to be within for all creatures, excluding you. Creatures other than you that begin their turn within the zone or enter the zone for the first time on a turn must make a Wisdom saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened on a failed save. Increase the ranks of Weakened inflicted by +1 at 11th level.
This zone lasts until the end of your next turn, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to extend this auras duration by 1 round.
Instigating Blaze
When an allied creature within 60 feet of you, excluding yourself, casts a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu that doesn’t have both the Wind and Fire Release keywords, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to overheat it, granting the jutsu both keywords and the following bonuses:
Their Jutsu’s damage increases by +2 Damage die, but this additional damage is fire damage.
Their Jutsu reduces the affected creatures Temporary Hit points to 0, before calculating the damage dealt.
Swirling heat
When you or an allied creature within 60 feet of you triggers the Swirl effect on a Jutsu with the Wind Release keyword, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge turning the swirling wind into a blazing twister. Increase the radius of the Swirl to a 10-foot radius on the affected creature and all creatures in the area instead gain 1 rank of Immolation.
Searing Knuckle
As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, coat your hands or feet in scorching flames that only harms what you touch for the next minute. Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 2d6, deals fire damage, and if you score a critical hit while dealing [Unarmed Damage], the target gains 1 rank of Immolation.
Additionally, as an Action, by placing your hand against plant matter or something metallic, that is no larger than a 1-foot cube, you are able to reduce it to ash or a molten puddle by flash frying it.
Searing Edge
As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to coat either your own or an allied creatures weapon in a super-heated layer of scorching flames for the next minute. The affected weapons [Weapon Damage] becomes 1d12, deals fire damage, and if you score a critical hit while dealing [Weapon Damage], the target gains 1 rank of Immolation.
Heat Mirage
As an Action, you release pent up heat, creating a hazy wave of heat that creates optical illusion making it hard to adequately select a target. All creatures in a 30-Foot Cone originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw, gaining 2 ranks of Dazzled on a failure.
Creatures with ranks of Immolation that make this saving throw, do so suffering a -1 penalty to their saving throws for each rank of Immolation it has.

#### Scorch Release
7th Level Clan Feature
The Shakuton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Scorch Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Fire release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Scorch Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Fire or Wind Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Fire respectively.
Additionally, As an action, you can evaporate all exposed sources of water or ice, no larger than a 10-foot cube that you can touch, boiling them into steam in an instant.
#### Evaporating Barrier
11th Level Clan Feature
The Shakuton clan has the ability to destroy moisture on a molecular level. If you would clash with a jutsu by spending 1 Scorch Charge, the opposing creature, makes their check with a -4 penalty to their result. If you succeed the clash check, the opposing creature also gains ranks of Weakened based on the rank of the Jutsu you originally cast. (D-Rank: 1 Rank, C-Rank: 2 Ranks, B-Rank: 3 Ranks, A-Rank: 4 Ranks, S-Rank: 5 Ranks.)
If the opposing creature clashed with a jutsu with the Water or Wind Release keywords, then as part of this feature, you make your check at advantage and apply an equal number of ranks of Immolation as Weakened on a successful clash.
#### Scorching Dominion
15th Level Clan Feature
You have reached the peak of the Shakuton clans ability to generate heat and fire. You gain the following abilities;
You can generate Scorch Charges up to twice per turn now.
You are always in your Scorching Heat state, even without Scorch Charges.
While a creature is within 20 feet of you with the Immolation or Burned condition, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to increase or decrease the ranks of that condition by 1. Once you do this, you cannot do it again until the end of your next turn.
Once per turn, while a creature is within 20 feet of you with the Chilled condition, you can reduce the ranks of Chilled they have by 2, by spending 1 Scorch Charge.

# Land of Water Clans
## Genwa Clan
"Remind me why I'm bringing you along again?" An Iburi Shinobi states to his partner as they approach a large steel door barricaded with advanced technology. "Sir! Because my skills can get us into the enemy fortress! Sir!" The nervous partner stands upright, sending a small wave of sweat at the Iburi. "Right... Well listen let's hurry on up before we get caught-" In an instant, a chain of smoke explosions appears from far behind the pair, as a myriad of Sand Shinobi emerge. "Ah great. Hidden Sand." The Iburi laces a chained hand scythe with smoke. "Listen man, hurry up and get us in. Wind natures are kind of a problem for me." The Hidden Sand quickly marches towards the two in a loud charge, before a sudden blue flash blinds all, and the Hidden Sand lie incapacitated in a sea of spectral blue swords. The Iburi turns towards his partner, confused. "W-Well...You said that these guys would be trouble for you…Sir!" The Iburi pauses then grins. "Hey kid what's your name?" "Sir! Yugene Genwa! Sir!" The Iburi pats Yugene on the shoulder. "Yugene. I think we're going to be great together."
- Delsan Iburi                                                          The Long Road, Ch. 30 excerpt.
### Dimension Walkers
Tag: Homebrew, Blasteroid
Formally hailing from the Hidden Rain, members of this clan commonly share an affinity with Lightning, and occasionally, they can manifest something greater. A powerful nature release transformation known as Data Release, which possesses a unique affinity for technology. The Genwa formally worked with the Akatsuki to gather information during the rule of Hanzo of the Salamander. However, after his defeat and the rise of Pain, the Genwa were forced into hiding, eventually splitting from the Rain and scattering themselves among other lands.
### Genwa Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Dex Speed: 30 feet. Skill Proficiencies: Ninshou, Sleight of Hand
Tool Proficiencies: Hacker Kit, Security Kit  Extra Language: Machine-Speak. You can translate electronic signals transmitted between machines so long as you are in physical contact with either the sending or receiving machine.  Passive Affinity: You have the Lightning Release Affinity.
Data Release Techniques: The Genwa Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Genwa Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
Radio Tower: You always count as possessing a Radio Link communication tool which doesn’t require a device and instead you can hear and respond to radio transmissions with no tools or equipment. Also, radio-based communication will always work as you function as a radio tower for tools and equipment within 1 mile of you, even if no radio transmissions is possible. Signals originating from you cannot be intercepted or traced using ninja tools.
### Genwa Features
#### Stable Frequency
1st Level Clan Feature
The Genwa clan specializes in utilizing the information that electrical signals transmit, acting as information gatherers as the shinobi world utilizes more modern technology such as radio, Ninja-Net or computers. You’ve learned two different forms which enable you to manifest this information in a destructive way. Your Uplink and Downlink stances. These are separate stances, and you can spend a Bonus action to enter or switch to one of these stances.
Uplink. You have electrical energy radiating off of you, that glows in a neon color your choice. While in this Chakra stance you gain the following benefits;
You can utilize the Angel Link effect of your Hijutsu.
Genwa Hijutsu you cast can originate from any space or creature that is currently Signal Boosted.
When you take the attack action, while in this stance, you can replace attacks made with this action with a Radiant Beam attack.
Radiant Beam. Make ranged Jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you firing a blast of light like energy formed from your lightning release. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + your jutsu modifier in lightning damage. If you roll an 8 on the damage die of this attack, you or an allied creature within 30 feet of the target becomes Signal Boosted until the end of your next turn. Increase the range of this attack to 60 feet at 7th level and the damage you deal to 2d8 + your jutsu bonus at 15th level. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks with this attack, instead of one.
Downlink. You manifest a neon weapon formed of light, that glows in a color your choice. While in this Bukijutsu stance you gain the following benefits;
You can utilize the Demon Link effect of your Hijutsu.
Genwa Hijutsu you cast that affects a creature with ranks of Shocked converts 1 rank of the affected creatures Shocked condition into the Firewalled condition.
Melee weapons you wield that you are proficient in become wreathed in a neon light, infusing them with your unique nature release variant. When you take the attack action using this weapon, you can replace the attacks made with a Radiant Saber attack.
Radiant Saber. Make melee Jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 5 feet of you, as you strike with a beam of light like energy formed from your lightning release. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon Damage] as lightning damage depending on your weapons damage dice, the affected creature becomes Firewalled until the end of your next turn. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks instead of one when you take the Attack action. Beginning at 15th level, increase critical threat range of these attacks by +1.
d4: On a roll of 3 or 4
d6: On a roll of 5 or 6
d8: On a roll of 7 or 8
d10: On a roll of 9 or 10
d12: On a roll of 11 or 12
#### Data Channels
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Genwa clan specializes tapping into electronic frequencies, such as radio and even data cables from more modern technology such as computers. These are known as data channels. Information networks that the Genwa utilize to become information centers all their own. The Genwa are able to pick up residual packets of information from these data channels, helping to improve their abilities and treating them like free lessons to utilize. When you complete a Long Rest, select a Data Channel from the following and learn their secrets, gaining their listed benefits until you complete your next rest. Beginning at 7th level you can select two channels the benefit from at once. Beginning at 15th level you can switch chosen channels on a short rest.
Hidden Cloud Channel
You have stolen information, tactics and techniques from careless hidden Cloud shinobi that gloat of their impregnable defenses.
When you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, gain a rank of Mastery against jutsu with a nature release keyword, until the start of your next turn.
Once per turn, when you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn. This increases to +2 at 11th level.
Jutsu you cast with the Sensory keyword that you benefit from gain the following effect; For the duration, you become aware if another Sensory effect is within 60 feet of you (or the range of the cast Sensory jutsu, whichever is greater)
Hidden Leaf Channel
You have stolen information from the Hidden Leaf elite on their extreme training regimen and how they and their ability to utilize fire release techniques to guarantee success in battle.
Genwa Jutsu you cast that deal damage, gains a +1 bonus to the damage they deal equal to the number of dice they roll, up to a maximum of +10.
Once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu, one allied creature within 30 feet of you gains a d4 bonus to their next saving throw or check. A creature cannot benefit from this effect more than once every minute. This increases to a d6 at 11th level.
Jutsu you cast with the Sensory keyword that you benefit from gain the following effect; For the duration, you become invisible to Camera’s, sensors and electronic detection devices.
Hidden Mist Channel
You have stolen information from the Hidden Mist elite on utilizing extreme environments to supplement conserving chakra.
Genwa Jutsu you cast have their cost reduced by 1, if you are within the area of effect of; or have been affected by; a jutsu with the lightning release keyword. This cost reduction becomes 2 if you are within 30 feet of a Shocked, Signal Boosted or Firewalled creature.
Once per turn, while you are obscured by the effect of a jutsu you or an allied creature cast, if you move into a space that is not obscured by the jutsu’s effect, you can spend a bonus action to extend it, having the new replicated effect center on you, until the beginning of your next turn.
Jutsu you cast that creates structures or obscurement causes you to be treated as if you are heavily obscured to special senses that rely on sight until the beginning of your next turn.
Hidden Rain Channel
You have stolen information, training methods and infiltration technique from boisterous hidden Rain shinobi that speak highly of their skill and ability.
Genwa Hijutsu you cast count as not having either the HS or CS component, not both. If a jutsu has both, you can pick one at the time of casting.
While concentrating on a jutsu with the lightning release keyword, when you begin your turn, you can spend all of your movement, to select a space you can see within 60 feet of you, that can hold you, and teleport into that space. If you have spent your movement or have less movement available than your maximum, you cannot teleport in this way.
Jutsu you cast with the Sensory keyword increase their affected area by +15 feet. This increases to +30 at 11th level.
Hidden Sand Channel
You have stolen information, and methods to combat and survive hostile environments from cautious hidden Sand shinobi that speak highly of their techniques.
When you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, select a point that you can see within 30 feet of you. You generate a 20-foot radius of protection, granting all creatures within the given area a rank of mastery to checks or saves made to resist hostile environments, or jutsu based effects that affect an area.
At the beginning of each of your turns, while concentrating on a jutsu with the lightning release keyword, you gain bonus DR, equal to your highest ability modifier against the first instance of damage you take before the beginning of your next turn. If you are concentrating on two or more jutsu with the lightning release keyword, you instead gain bonus DR equal to twice your highest ability modifier.
When you cast a jutsu that affects an area and can be concentrated on, you can give the chosen jutsu the Sensory keyword. When you do, for the jutsu’s duration, you gain Tremor sense in the affected area.
Hidden Stone Channel
You have stolen information, and methods to utilize jutsu based constructs in combat, and fortify their positions like a boulder or mountain from confident Stone shinobi that speak highly of their techniques.
When you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, that summons a construct, it gains additional hit points equal to the rank its summoned. (D-Rank: +10, C-Rank: +15, B-Rank:  +20, A-Rank: +25, S-Rank: +30).
Once per turn, if you are Signal Boosted or a hostile creature is Shocked or Firewalled and are within 30 feet of you, you can dispel the select effect (all ranks if shocked) to gain an additional reaction, which can only be used to cast a jutsu with the lightning release keyword that summons a construct of D-Rank. This becomes C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level.
Constructs you summon with the lightning release keyword gains the Sensory keyword. Constructs with the Sensory keyword gain 60-Feet of vision, and shares that vision with you.
