## Hoshigaki Clan
Alistair stares down the man in Red. Drawing his Odachi to confront him. He moves in swinging it with ruthless tenacity. He stabs the blade into the ground after his first attack weaving handsigns and conjuring a massive wave of Water that turns into Sharks before they collide with their target. When the dust settles, Alistair looks for his enemy who seems to have been completely blow away by his assault. “Oh…Well…Looks like I went a tad bit overboard for training, hehe.”
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 13 excerpt.
### The Tailless Beast
The Hoshigaki Clan is a clan that hails from the Land of Water and is famous for all the wrong reasons. Every prominent member of their clan has betrayed their home village in more than one way. But this does not brand them all as traitors, instead it has caused a vast majority of them to branch out and move to other villages to break the stigma of their history.
### Hoshigaki Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Str
Speed: 30 feet
Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling, Nature
Weapon Proficiencies: Power Weapon Group & Weapons with the Heavy Property
Dark Vision: You have Darkvision up to 30 feet.
Passive Affinity: You have Water Release Affinity.
Amphibious: You can breathe air and Water.
Deep Speech: You can communicate with fish and other aquatic life.
Aquatic Adaptation: You have a Swimming and Water walking speed equal to your walking speed.
### Hoshigaki Features
#### Deep Sea Predator
1st Level Clan Feature
As a Hoshigaki, your physical features are unique and different from everyone around you. Your clan is known for aqua blue skin, recessed eyes, gill like features on your face or neck, and the unique ability to breath in water as easily as breathing air. But this is surface level. When peering deeper, you will find that all Hoshigaki carry features of these deep-sea predators of different degrees. Select two Predator Traits. You gain an additional selection at 7th and 15th levels.
Apex Gaze
When an enemy look into your eyes, they see an Apex predator. A beast of a person who doesn’t see them as an equal, but as prey. You can take the Demoralize skill action as a Bonus action, and you can attempt it on creatures any number of times instead of once per hour.
Beginning at 7th level, increase the ranks of Demoralized you inflict by +1. Beginning at 15th level, when you take the Demoralize skill action, you can instead target all creatures you can see within 20 feet of you.
Beast of the Sea
Your stamina is unmatched. Increase your Hit points and Chakra points by an amount equal to your level.
Commander of the Deep
You learn a modified version of the Summoning Technique Ninjutsu, with a contract with the Shark tribe. The Shark tribe you are contracted with are a bit more versatile than other shark tribes. When you summon these sharks, they are summoned in a large bubble of Water that they use for land travel, using half their swimming speed to traverse the land.
Shark Skinned
Your skin is rough, slightly scaled, tougher and more resilient to damage. While you are not wearing Heavy Armor, you have Bonus DR equal to your constitution modifier. Beginning at 11th level, when a creature would deal damage to you with a melee attack, they take slashing damage, equal to your Constitution modifier.
Tide Locked
Your close affinity with water release chakra, makes your innate control over it uniquely suited to deal with extremely aggressive foes. Once per turn, when you deal cold damage to a creature as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword, you can select one of the affected creatures to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, you can choose to have either their speed reduced by 10 until the end of their next turn (This reduction becomes 20 at 7th and 30 at 15th level), or increase chakra damage they take by +2 until the beginning of your next turn. (This damage bonus increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.)
Tiger Sharks Maw
Your teeth are sharp, serrated and can tear through flesh with ease. Losing teeth for you is a minor inconvenience since you regrow teeth like people regrow nails. You gain a special Bite Attack, which you can use in place of an attack made with your attack action.
Bite. Make a melee jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see or sense. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + your jutsu ability modifier in piercing damage. This attack has a +1 bonus to its critical threat range. Beginning at 7th level, creatures who take damage from your bite must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Grappled by you. Beginning at 15th level, creatures that fail their saving throw also gain 1 rank of Bleed.
Prey Sense
Your senses are tuned to grant you awareness to those close enough to be considered a victim to your assault. You gain 10 feet of blindsight.
Beginning at 7th level, increase your blindsight to 20 feet, and it doubles while submerged in water.
Beginning at 15th level, increase your blindsight to 30 feet.
#### Ravenous Chakra
[BOX]
| #### Apex Predator / Battle Amp / You embody the power of the Apex of the sea. / Ocean Bond. When Water Walking or swimming, double your movement speed. / Cold Blooded. Creatures with the following conditions, increase the damage they take from you by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th levels (Bleed, Concussed, Dazed, Demoralized, Grappled, Restrained or Shaken) / Ravenous Aura. [Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] you deal can trigger your Ravenous Chakra clan feature, as if it were a C-Rank Jutsu. You cannot gain temporary chakra using Ravenous Chakra this way. / Limitless Blue. Jutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword gain their additional effects as if near a sufficient source of Water. / Efficient Recovery. Once per turn, increase Temporary Hit points gained from allied or self-sourced effects by +4. This increases to +6 at 7th level and +8 at 15th level. |
[/BOX]
1st Level Clan Feature
As a Hoshigaki, your body yearns to consume the Chakra of others. The stronger your enemies, the stronger you can become, using their energy to fuel you. Beginning at 1st level, once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu with a nature release keyword, you deal additional chakra damage to the affected creatures equal to the rank of the jutsu cast; D-Rank: 2d6, C-Rank: 3d6, B-Rank: 4d6,  A-Rank: 5d6, S-Rank: 6d6.
When you reach 7th level, when you deal chakra damage as a result of this feature, you gain temporary chakra equal to the number of dice rolled.
Beginning at 15th level, if your jutsu would clash with an opposing creatures jutsu, you treat the opposing jutsu as if it’s one rank lower for the purposes of the clash check. If you win this clash, you double the chakra damage dice rolled as part of this feature.
#### Apex Berserker
3rd Level Clan Feature
You’ve learned to tap into your bestial heritage, becoming more shark like in your physical features, turning you into more of a monster than a man.
As a bonus action, you transform, enter your Apex Predator state. This form has you take on a shark like form, growing large gills, large wing link fins from your shoulders, and web between your fingers. You can remain in this state for 1 minute. Once you enter this state, if you enter it again before completing a long rest, you gain 1 rank of exhaustion.
Beginning at 11th level, you can enter this state once per rest before gaining ranks of exhaustion.
#### Predatory Surges
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your bloodline can only take you so far in this world. You begin to learn how to utilize your brutish physicality in ways unique to your clan known as Predator Surges. Predator Surges are special techniques that you can utilize as part of combat to infuse your onslaught with Hoshigaki power. Unlike other clans that learn and can never adapt, your clan utilizes an instinctual form of combat similar to a Shark, allowing you to learn the useful techniques and forget the ones that aren’t useful. When you complete a long rest, select two Predator Surges from the following list. You can use one surge as part of any trigger. If a Surge requires a saving throw, use your highest jutsu saving throw to determine the surges DC.
Predators Terrain
Trigger: As part of casting a Jutsu
When you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword that affects an area, you can use this surge to cause the affected area to become difficult terrain for the next minute for all creatures, excluding yourself and up to 3 creatures of your choice.
Creatures that attempt to move through this area can spend 10 chakra to ignore this difficult terrain effect until the end of their turn.
Predators Drag
Trigger: As part of making a melee attack
When you score a hit with a melee attack, you can use this surge to suddenly bite down, or grab an enemy in such a way that you have them held down. The affected creature becomes Grappled and you immediately can move up to twice your full speed pulling them along with you. While grappled in this way the affected creature cannot take reactions.  Once you’ve finished this movement, you end the grapple on the affected creature.
Predators Clarity
Trigger: As part of taking damage
When you take damage from a creature, you can use this surge to mark the triggering creature until the end of your next turn. When you do, you become aware of them if they are invisible or are hidden from you.
Predators Rend
Trigger: As part of making a melee attack
When you deal damage as a result of a melee attack, you deliver it via your sharpened teeth, which allows you to rend your opponent’s defenses, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you reduce their DR by 2 for the next minute. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
Predators Crash
Trigger: As part of casting a Jutsu
When you cast a jutsu with the Water release keyword that affects a creature protected by a Barrier, you can use this Surge to destabilize the barrier, causing half of the damage you deal to also affect creatures protected by the barrier.
Predators Feeding
Trigger: As part of taking damage
When you take damage from a creature as a result of a melee attack you can use this Surge to spend your reaction, to take the Attack action, targeting the triggering creature with attacks made as a result.
#### Abyssal Wayfinder
7th Level Clan Feature
Your close affinity with the seas, oceans and lakes grant you and instinctual knowledge about the seas that others would spend lifetimes trying to match. While observing a body of water you can predict the weather, tides and visibility while traversing this water by making a Nature check vs a DC 5.
Additionally, while you are swimming, allies within 20 feet of you that attempt to follow you, can spend their Actions on their turns to swim behind you, following your swim trail, always ending keeping up with you and never being lost no matter how murky or dark the water is.
Finally, by spending 10 minutes submerged in a body of water, you can remove 1 rank of exhaustion as the waves gentle wash away your fatigue. You can do this once per rest.
#### Ichthyic Armorer
7th Level Clan Feature
The Weapons you wield while well-crafted have always been missing something. Something that makes it feel yours. By spending 1 Downtime, you are able to perform a Hoshigaki ritual, hunting down different aquatic life and using their remains to enhance the weapons you utilize in combat. Select two of the following weapon grafts, which you use to enhance your weapon with, granting it their listed effects. A weapon can never have more than 2 grafts at a time, and you can only have a single weapon grafted at once. Any new grafts you place on a weapon with them, causes the previous ones to be dispelled.
Raking Dermis (Shark Skin). This weapon gains Pierce 2, and it can deal either slashing or piercing damage.
Wing Guard (Manta). This weapon gains Blocking 1, if it didn’t already. You can now, as a reaction to taking damage, use this weapon to parry some incoming damage, reducing the damage you take by an amount equal to its [Weapon Damage].
Sawtooth (Sawfish). Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon damage] to a creature with temporary hit or chakra points, you reduce them to 0, before applying damage.
Scale Plate (Coelacanth). This weapon gains the Fortified armor property.
Tiger Pattern (Tiger Shark). On your turn, if you hit two or more creatures, you gain +2 DR for each creature hit, until the beginning of your next turn.
Marlin Imprint (Marlin). Attacks with this weapon while underwater gain 2 ranks of Mastery.
Angler Lure (Anglerfish). As a Bonus action, you can force a creature in range to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they gain 1 rank of Shaken and they have disadvantage on attacks targeting creatures other than you until the end of their next turn.
#### Abyssal Bulwark
11th Level Clan Feature
You are clad in flesh hardened by the pressures of the deep and perseverance. You gain resistance to Chakra and Cold Damage. Also, when you are hit with a Critical Hit, you gain a Will of Fire.
Additionally, while in your Apex Predator state, you gain immunity to Cold Damage, and you have advantage on saving throws made to resist the Bleed, Dazed and Stunned conditions.
#### King of the Deep
15th Level Clan Feature
In battle you are the king of the oceanic waves and your inherent ability to control water shines through with this pinnacle of your Hoshigaki bloodline. As an Action, all sources of water within 120 feet of you collects around you and creates a massive maelstrom with you in the center. All sources of water within range, that occupy no more than 8 spaces are dispelled. If a source of water occupies more than 8 spaces, you only draw water from it as the body of water is too large to drain entirely.
For the next minute, you conjure a 30-foot radius spinning column of darkened water, centered on you, that moves with you with the following properties. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest;
Creatures in this waters area are submerged.
The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures.
Allies creatures can swim with no obstruction.
Ranged attacks made by hostile creatures into or through the maelstrom have disadvantage.
Hostile creatures that end their turn inside take 4d6 cold damage as if from a Ninjutsu you cast with the water release keyword.
While inside your maelstrom, your melee attacks gain the Reach 2 property if they didn’t already, and on a hit, affected creatures are pulled 5 feet closer to you.
Jutsu with the fire release keyword that would be cast while inside the maelstrom has its fire damage reduced by 4 damage die.
When a hostile creature inside the maelstrom cast a jutsu, its cost is increased by +8, and its damage is reduced by 2 damage die. You gain temporary chakra equal to the rank of the jutsu cast (D-Rank: 2, C-Rank: 3, B-Rank: 4, A-Rank: 5, S-Rank: 6.)
## Hozuki Clan
The Rogue from the badlands, sits waiting patiently, hunting his prey. He takes a jug of Water from his pouch and begins to drink from is carefully, not wasting a single drop. After finishing, he reaches behind himself and grabs a large Odachi with one hand, as his arm expands showing a massive increase in strength. He leaps from his hiding place bring the blade down on his mark.
—Hato Hyoshi
At Worlds End, Ch. 17 excerpt.
### Demons Second coming
The Hozuki Clan is a relatively small clan that hails from the Land of Water. While the clan itself is small, it has had prominent members, whom have attained the rank of 7 Swordsmen and garnered a notoriety of being excellent swordsman and even better assassins. The Hozuki clan has a unique trait, allowing them to turn their body into a liquid form passively. Though due to this extreme affinity with the Water Release affinity, they have lost the ability to access the Lightning Release Affinity, in its entirety.
### Hozuki Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str, +1 Int
Speed: 30 feet
Skill Proficiencies: Martial Arts, Chakra Control.
Water Release Affinity: You begin with the Water Release affinity.
Swimming Speed: You have a swimming speed equal to your land speed.
Liquid Biology: You can breathe air and Water.
Altered Water: Earth Release no longer has an elemental advantage to jutsu you cast with the Water release keyword. Lightning Release now has an elemental advantage against jutsu you cast with the water release keyword.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Hozuki Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Hozuki Techniques: The Hozuki Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
### Hozuki Features
#### Hydration
1st Level Clan Feature
The Hozuki clan are widely known across Kirigakure as an elite shinobi clan, often in the running for Mizukage and often having members occupy a position on the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist due to its unique Kekkei Genkai, allowing them to liquefy their bodies at will, becoming living water. This can be achieved by expending their bodies natural Hydration. You have a pool of Hydration equal to 1 + your highest ability modifier. You regain spent Hydration when: you complete a long rest, take damage from a jutsu with the Water Release keyword, begin your turn with at least half your body submerged in a body of water, or when you cast a jutsu with the Water release keyword and gain the benefit of a sufficient source of water. Once per turn, when you take lightning damage, you lose 2 Hydration.
You can spend Hydration to fuel your Kekkei Genkai’s Liquification Techniques.
Capillary Infiltration. By spending 2 Hydration on your turn, until the end of the current turn, you can squeeze through opening as small as 1 inch and gain immunity to the Grapple and Restrained conditions as your physical form becomes liquid.
Hydrofication. As part of casting a Hozuki Hijutsu, you can spend 1 Hydration to use the Hijutsu’s Hydrofication effect.
Liquid Evasion. As a reaction to taking bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, cold or earth damage, you can spend 1 Hydration to shift the impacted body part into liquid, gaining resistance to the triggering damage, and slushing away as a puddle, moving up to 10 feet before reforming. This movement doesn’t trigger opportunity attacks. If the triggering damage is cold, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to the triggering jutsu’s rank in place of taking damage (D-Rank: 5, C-Rank: 10, B-Rank: 15, A-Rank: 20, S-Rank: 25).
Liquid Impact. If a hostile creature would score a critical hit against you, you can spend 3 Hydration to turn the critical hit into a normal one.
Water Pistol. By spending 2 Hydration on your turn, for the next minute, you when you take the Attack Action, you can make one Water Bullet attack. This increases to 2 attacks at 7th level and 3 attacks at 15th level. The action taken to use the Water Bullet attack counts as casting a Hozuki Hijutsu, with the Ninjutsu and Water release keywords at the highest rank you can cast.
Water Bullet. Make a ranged jutsu attack against a creature you can see within 30 feet, using your highest jutsu ability modifier. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + ability modifier in bludgeoning, piercing or cold damage. Beginning at 7th level this attack has 6 Pierce. Beginning at 11th level, this attacks damage increases to 2d8. Beginning at 15th level this attack has 12 Pierce.
Water Muscles. When you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage], you can spend 1 Hydration to increase the damage you deal with the chosen damage calculation by +2 until the end of your next turn. This increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.
#### Mistborn Infiltrator
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Hozuki clan excel in infiltration and information gathering through positioning a clever use of the clans liquid body techniques. Select two of the listed Liquid Infiltration techniques that you learn, to aid you to break into places or gather information at a more efficient level than others. You gain an additional selection at 11th level.
Vapor Shroud
As a bonus action, you exhale a thin halo of mist that clings to you for the next minute. While shrouded in this way, yourself an allied creatures that begin their turns within 10 feet of you gain a rank of mastery to Stealth checks and a +10 bonus to your speed. This increases to two ranks at 7th. Suffering the hostile effects of a jutsu with the Wind or Lightning Release keyword ends this effect early. Once this effect is used, you cannot do so again until they complete a short rest.
Hydrophonic Sense
While you are in contact with a source of liquid such as puddles, flooded halls, sewers, you gain tremor sense based on that liquid up to 1 mile away. In addition, conversations had near the body of water can be heard by you. You can only focus on one location at a time and thus cannot perceive all conversations had near a body of water.
Rain Traversal
You leave no tracks or scent when moving through rain, mist or standing water. Creatures attempting to track you through while you are experiencing any of the aforementioned environmental situations, increase the DC to do so by +10.
Mist Voice
You can communicate with creatures that are in contact with the same body of water as you, within 120 feet of you. You can exchange simple messages no longer than 10 words through small bubbles containing your voice, quiet enough to only be heard by the intended creature.
Dampen Reverb
As a bonus action, you can create a 10-foot radius bubble of water, centered on you. This bubble of water lasts for 10 minute or a hostile creature passes through the radius of the bubble. Sound cannot escape the inside of the bubble, nor penetrate to the inside of the bubble. Once used cannot be used again until you complete a short rest.
#### Follow the Current
7th Level Clan Feature
The Hozuki clans ability to shift their physical forms to and from water, also grants them an immensely unique ability. The ability to infuse themselves with water and traverse it almost instantly.
By spending a Bonus action, while at least half of your body is submerged in a body of water, you can select a space within that body of water no further than 120 feet away and teleport to this space. Once you teleport in this way, you cannot do so again for at least 10 minutes.
#### Blood As Thick As Oil
11th Level Clan Feature
[BOX]
| #### Mirage Regent / Battle Amp / Your body becomes thin and almost frail as you spread most of the water in your body into a mist of your absolute control. / Mist Mirage. You radiate a cloud of mist, filling a 30-foot radius, centered on you, that moves with you. Hostile creatures treat the affected area as difficult terrain and you are heavily obscured against hostile creatures until said creature is within 10 feet of you. / Where are You Looking?. The first time per turn when a creature attacks you, you can roll a d12. On a roll of 11 or less, their attack misses as it strikes a mirage. Once a creature misses in this way, reduce the roll needed to miss by 1 (10 or less > 9 or less > 8 or less, etc.). / Everywhere and No where. Attacks you make and jutsu you cast can originate from anywhere within your mist. |
[/BOX]
The Hozuki clan while wildly recognized for their ability to transform into water, you have found that with a little focus you can shift your body into substance more akin to oil. As a result, Hijutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword now have an elemental advantage against jutsu with the Earth release keyword. In addition, Hijutsu you cast that deals damage, treats structures and constructs with hit points as if the structure and construct is vulnerable to its damage.
#### Heir of the Mist
15th Level Clan Feature
You have become the pinnacle of what a Hozuki clansmen strives to be. You have reached an apex that others only dare to dream of. But you don’t walk this path alone, you draw inspiration from your forefathers.
First, Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Water Release keyword that costs chakra, you can spend 2 Hydration to gain temporary hit points equal to the rank of the jutsu cast. These temporary hit points last until the beginning of your next turn (D-Rank: 5, C-Rank: 10, B-Rank: 15, A-Rank: 20, S-Rank: 25).
Finally, when you complete a long rest, select one of the following Tidal States, of which you gain their listed effects until you complete your next long rest, after which you can choose to swap or keep your same Tidal State. You can enter your chosen state for 1 minute, by taking a bonus action and spending 4 Hydration. Once you enter a state you cannot reenter it until you complete a rest.
Tidal Gains
You enter your Tidal Gains state, focusing an absurd amount of Water into your muscles causing them to expand and become similar to that of a body building strong man. Once you exist this state you cannot enter it again until you complete a short rest.
Mirage Regent
You enter your Mirage Regent state, allowing you to spread the water your body is formed from into a large are, creating a mist of your design.
[BOX]
| #### Tidal Gains / Battle Amp / You embolden your physical strength to new heights, enlarging your muscles and reinforcing your brutal physique. / Colossus. Your size increases to Lear, melee weapon and unarmed attacks you make gain the Reach 1 Property, if they didn’t already. You make Athletics checks at advantage. / Muscular Overdrive. You gain the benefits of the Water Muscles Liquification techniques for the duration, at no Hydration cost. / Water Canons. Increase Cold damage you deal as a result of casting a jutsu with the Water Release keyword by +1 die. / Hydro Armor. You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing. Slashing, cold and fire damage. / Water Pressure. Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a large or smaller creature, you can force them to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Weakened and are knocked Prone |
[/BOX]

Kamira ejects a bone from her shoulder creating a saber. She’s wounded, weakened, and outgunned. Standing against her Jonin teacher who has fallen prey to a Genjutsu. Her teammates downed by the overwhelming power of their Sensei, she thinks to herself “I need to survive to save them and stop sensei.” She draws a second sword made of bone from her ribcage. The Long Road, Ch. 16 excerpt.
### Savage Battle Instincts
The Kaguya Clan was previously an extinct clan known for their savage battle tactics. There are stories of Kaguya who loved war so much, they would enter battles and conflicts to show off their fighting prowess. The ability to manipulate their own bone structure creating weapons gives them amazing fighting skills.
### Kaguya Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Dex, +1 Con Speed: 35 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Martial Arts
Hijutsu Flexibility: Kaguya Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Strength as its casting ability score.
Shikotsumyaku Dance: The Kaguya Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Bone Weapons: As a Bonus action, you can conjure one melee weapon with a bulk of 2 or up to two melee weapons with a bulk of 1. These weapon shares any weapon seals found on weapons you currently have that it qualifies for. They become brittle and break if another bone weapon is conjured.
### Kaguya Features
#### Shikotsumyaku Stance
1st Level Clan Feature
The Shikotsumyaku Stance is the primary fighting style for the Kaguya clan which trains their young ruthlessly to utilize their unique physiology. While in this Bukijutsu stance you gain the following benefits.
You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength weapon attacks with a Bone Weapon.
Hostile creatures that cast a jutsu with the Hand sign (HS) component within your weapons range trigger attacks of opportunity from you.
When a weapon or Taijutsu attack, using a Bone weapon is 5 or higher than the targets AC, or you roll a natural 20, you gain a rank of Battle Lust.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
#### Calcified Structure
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Kaguya clan were known for their alien and almost foreign bone and body structure, making it exceedingly difficult to truly know how any Kaguya functioned as they were all unique and different in their own way. You can select the special mutations you have compared to another Kaguya. Select one Defining Anatomy from the following list. You can select one additional option at 7th and 15th levels.
Ossuary Crown
Your skull while human shaped, is designed markedly different. Harder, more resilient, and can quickly repair itself. You have a rank of Mastery on saving throws to resist effects that would inflict the Concussed, Confused or Dazed conditions.
Marrow Overflow
Your bones are thicker and produces excess marrow that floods your muscles providing abundant nutrients. You gain a rank of Mastery to Athletics or Acrobatics based skill checks.
Additionally, at the conclusion of a short rest, you regain additional hit points equal to your level.
Lamellar Lattice
Your ribcage is instead in a weblike shape with joints formed of tendons, allowing for your chest to expand or compress more than normal ribcages allow. You gain a rank of Mastery on saving throws to resist effects that would inflict the Bruised, Staggered, or Shaken conditions.
Femur Springs
Your legs are structured with the intent to emulate biological springs, to allow for more kinetic movement. Increase your speed by +10.
Additionally, your jump distance is increased by +10 feet and your jump height is increased by +5 feet.
Ulna  Aegis
Your forearm bones are fused into one solid spongey structure that can harden on command forming a dense and protective shield for the Kaguya. While you can see an attacker, you gain a +2 DR bonus against them. This increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.
Also, once per long rest, when you are critically hit you can treat it as a normal hit.
Skeletal Reinforcement
Your entire skeleton is structured in such a way it can only be described as modular, allowing for much swifter healing processes. The first time each turn that you regain hit points as a result of a jutsu, increase the hit points gained by an amount equal to your level.
#### Ivory Fragments
7th Level Clan Feature
You learn to leave behind fragments of your bone as caltrops. While traveling, creatures automatically succeed tracking attempts, but their travel speed is reduced in half. These bone caltrops can also serve as a trail, helping you prevent getting lost in foreign or hostile terrain.
Additionally, when climbing you leave bone handholds and footholds behind. You gain a climbing speed equal to your movement speed. Allies using your holds suffer no penalties to checks or movement.
Finally, you can form a total number of bone slivers equal to your Constitution modifier once per Rest. These can be placed on creatures, objects, or surfaces. For 10 minutes after being placed, each sliver functions as Sealing Art: Chakra Mark at D-Rank.
#### Desire for Battle
11th Level Clan Feature
The desire for combat is baked into your blood and at this point, you can call upon it at will. When you roll initiative for combat, you can roll 1d4. You gain ranks of Battle Lust equal to the result.
Additionally, when a creature deals damage to you they become Battle Marked by you until the end of your next turn. Attacks made against a Battle Marked creature cannot be made at disadvantage.
#### Dance of the Pale Tyrant
15th Level Clan Feature
Pale spurs bloom and fold as you move, a pale white gale sketching your perfect dance of death. You enter the clans ultimate performance stance. You can assume this enhanced battle stance for one minute, after which you require a rest before you can use it again. For the duration you gain the following benefits:
Tyrants Lust. You can gain Battle Lust once per turn when you take damage or deal damage with a Bone Weapon to a creature with a Physical condition.
Ivory Judgement. When you take the Attack Action or make an attack of opportunity and make a weapon attack using a Bone Weapon, increase the number of attacks made by +1.
Counter Dance. Hostile creatures that cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component within your weapons range trigger attacks of opportunity from you.

## Vesper Clan
Drese awaits perched on a corner of the Victorian era building in Lordan City, in the Land of Moons. A large scar across his shoulder, he waits impatiently, while biting his lips in frustration. “Those bastards won’t get away.” He mutters to himself before he sees his target, dart from inside of a building, making a mad dash into the nearby alleyway.
Drese follows closely by leaping and making a small clicking sound, like that of a bat, tracking him via echolocation along. The man makes multiple turns, but is quickly cut off by Drese who quickly descends upside down with his crimson red scarf dangling below him. “You thought you could sell that poison in our village, then just get to go home like nothing happened. Fat chance.” Drese barks while touching down to the ground slowly.  The man laughs “You think I’m the first boy? No, I won’t be last either. Look to smooth things over, how about I donate some ryo to your village you could use it.”
Drese snickers before smiling with two large fangs protruding from where his K9’s should be. “Nah, I don’t need it. I’m bout to have a meal in a minute anyway.” Drese says. “Do you know how much you could buy with what I’m offering!? I could feed all of you shinobi, what more could you want” the man barks back. Drese’s eyes flickers red “To eat the rich.” Drese says before dashing forward.
-Otsohi Suzumaru
Shinobi Historia, Ch. 12 excerpt
### Nocturnal Hunters
Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Schmeelo
The Vesper Clan is a clan that originally hails from the Land of Moons, but has since migrated to the Land of Water. Their origins trace back to a Sage know for his association with the Bat tribe. The Clan is often associated with bat like traits and features. Red eyes, darker skin, more pointed ears, and fanglike teeth and a preference to the night over the day.
### Vesper Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Cha, +1 Str or Dex
Speed: 35 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Stealth
Nocturnal Sight: Vesper Clansmen have 60 feet of Darkvision.
Nocturnal Movement: While in dim light or darkness, a Vesper Clansmen’s movement cannot provoke attacks of opportunity.
Nocturnal-Speak: You can speak to and understand Rats, Bats, Snakes, Wolves and Predator Birds.
[BOX]
| Crimson Hemorrhage – Claws of Night / Max Ranks: 5, [Physical] / Once per turn, a creature with Crimson Hemorrhage takes 1d6 necrotic damage for each rank it has, when it makes a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw. / A creature with Crimson Hemorrhage that takes Unarmed or Weapon damage from a hostile creature, heals the attacking creatures hit points by 2. / At the end of a creature with Crimson Hemorrhage’s turn, if it have ranks of Bleed, it lose those ranks of Bleed and gain an equal number of ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage. This does not occur if it have 5 ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage. |
[/BOX]
[BOX]
| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |
[/BOX]
### Vesper Features
#### Claws of Night
1st Level Clan Feature
One of the Vesper Clans defining physical traits are their nails, black as midnight and able to be sharpened to rival the edge of a Kunai. The Clan has developed a special combat style utilizing their claws, or their claws in conjunction with a weapon from the Blade weapon group. While in combat you can sharpen and elongate your claws and enter your Claws of Night Taijutsu stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits:
Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 1d8 and your [Unarmed Damage] type becomes Slashing.
Once per turn, when inflicting the Bruised condition, you can change it to be 1 rank of Bleed instead.
Once per turn, if you deal [Weapon Damage], with a weapon from the Blade weapon group that doesn’t have the Two-Handed property or [Unarmed Damage], you can force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save, gaining a rank of Crimson Hemorrhage on a failure.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
#### Echo of Night
1st Level Clan Feature
The Vesper clan has many special traits due to their unique heritage, but the one thing that separates them from the pack is their unique association with sound-based techniques. They are able to emulate bats with terrifying accuracy, attuning to the world by both sound and shadows.
Echolocation. By spending 1 Bonus action, for the next minute, you have 30 feet of blindsight that functions only while you can hear and it is suppressed if you are Deafened or under an effect that muffles sound. You also have a rank of Mastery to Perception checks that rely on sound.
Pinging. As a bonus action, you emit a soft click: choosing a point you can see within 30 feet. All creatures within 10 feet of that point are Pinged until the start of your next turn. Attacks you make against Pinged creatures cannot be made at disadvantage. The range of this ping increases to 45 feet at 7th level and 60 feet at 15th level.
Sonar Reprisal. Creatures Pinged by you, triggers attacks of opportunities for allied creatures within range of your Echolocation if they are invisible or unseen by them.
#### Vampyric Physique
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Vesper clans unique physical physique places them into a category all their own with their physical strength. They dominate other shinobi with feats of physical strength and agility that seems, simply inhuman. You gain two of these options and another of your choice at 7th and 15th levels.
Anchored Steps
Creatures or effects that would attempt to move you against your will make their checks to do so at disadvantage. You also make saving throws or checks to resist being moved at advantage.
Dominating Stability
Creatures struggle to challenge you physically. You gain a rank of mastery to Strength Saving throws.
Dinner Bell
Combat for you feels like a chance to feed on the failure of your foes. When initiative is rolled, you can spend your Reaction. If you do, you gain a rank of Mastery to all d20 based rolls you make before the end of your next turn.
Gravestone Dragging
You are physically superior to most other shinobi of a similar stature to you. Increase your Bulk by +5. Additionally, when attempting to move while grappling a creature, moving does not count as difficult terrain for you.
Inhuman Stamina
Your physical stamina cannot be compared. Checks and saving throws made to resist gaining ranks of Exhaustion are made at advantage. Additionally, if you spend an Action to Dash, you can spend your Bonus Action during the same turn to Dash again.
Launching Throw
Objects, items or tools that allow you to throw them, have an increased range of +20 feet. Additionally, you gain a rank of Mastery to Shove attempts. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th and three ranks at 15th level.
Vaulted Limbs
When chakra movement techniques aren’t available, the old fashion way is more than doable for you. You gain a Climbing speed equal to your movement speed. Additionally, reduce the number of fall damage dice rolled by an amount equal to half your level.
#### Mesmeric Sonance
3rd Level Clan Feature
The clans close association with the Bat sage tribe isn’t just skin deep. Its become a near symbiotic relationship, so much so that the clan has learned ways to utilize sound and turn your enemies vision against themselves. You learn either the Hypnotic Voice or Hypnotic Gaze ability. Beginning at 11th level, you gain the ability, you didn’t select at 3rd level.
[BOX]
| #### Hypnotic Gaze: GM Notes / This feature is left open ended to facilitate Roleplay or even tactical Combat moments. This does leave open opportunities for some disruptive players to attempt to force scenarios or actions on an NPC such as “Kill yourself” or other detestable commands. It is suggested to completely rule against these scenarios and even punish the character within the narrative for attempting it. As always the GM is final rules arbiter for open ended effects and abilities such as these. |
[/BOX]
Hypnotic Voice. As an action, you release a screech like sound wave, that overwhelms the senses of all creatures of your choice within a 20-foot cone originating from you, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. This ability counts as a Genjutsu of a rank equal to the highest rank you can cast, but uses your highest jutsu saving throw DC. Increase the size of this cone +20 feet at 11th level.

Critical Success: The affected creature is able to resist this abilities effects.
Success: The Affected creature becomes Confused until the end of their next turn.
Failure: Affected creatures become Confused and Dazed.
Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creatures are also Slowed.
Hypnotic Gaze. As an action, you stare into the eyes of a single creature you can see within 30 feet of you, release your compelling chakra into them, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw. This ability counts as a Genjutsu of a rank equal to the highest rank you can cast, that you must maintain concentration on, but uses your highest jutsu saving throw DC. A creature that fails or Critically fails cannot suffer its failure or critical failure effects again, until you complete a rest.
Critical Success: The affected creature is able to resist this abilities effects.
Success: The Affected creature becomes Charmed until the end of their next turn.
Failure: Affected creatures become Charmed and while charmed must spend its Movement and Actions for the next minute obeying one command you give it, that must be done as part of this ability. Once the command is complete, the Charmed condition ends on them.
Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creature remains charmed, obeying following orders that you give as a Bonus action on your turns for the next minute. Creatures compelled in this way that take damage, can remake their saving throws once per turn.
#### Nocturnal Dominion
7th Level Clan Feature
Using the secret techniques of the Vesper clan, you are able to wrestle control of the Shadows upon the battlefield, and twist them into aspects of fear and extensions of yourself.
When you complete a rest, you may select two of the listed abilities, being able to utilize them until you complete your next rest. These abilities use your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus, if they require an attack or saving throw.
Umbral Domain
As an Action, select a point you can see within 60 feet of you. A 30-foot radius zone of shadows manifest for the next minute. Spaces within this zone is treated as Chakra based darkness and difficult terrain. You can see normally in this affected area and its area is not difficult terrain for you. When a hostile creature begins its turn in the affected area, they must make a Wisdom saving throw. This ability counts as a C-Rank Genjutsu, with the Visual and Tactile keywords. Its damage increases by 1d8 at 11th and 15th levels.
Success: Affected creature takes half of 4d8 psychic damage.
Failure: Affected creature takes 4d8 psychic damage and gains 1 rank of Demoralized.
Critical Failure: Affected creature takes 6d8 psychic damage and gains 2 rank of Demoralized.
Dread Weave
Once per turn, when you cast a Genjutsu with the Visual or Auditory keywords, you can layer abject terror into it. A creature that fails their saving throw, gains 1 rank of Shaken. Creatures that critically fail their saving throw gains 1 rank of Shaken and become Berserked.

Terror-Borne Constructs
When you summon a Creature as a result of a Genjutsu you cast or summon a creature with the Illusory Construct trait, it gains the following benefits, while they remain summoned;
They gain additional Hit points equal to 5 + your level.
The first time they deal damage each turn, increase the damage they deal by +2. This increases to +4 at 11th level.
Mist Step
As a bonus action, while not in direct sunlight, you transform into a swirl of mist and teleport into a space you can see that can hold you, up to 40 feet away. Increase the distance you can teleport in this way by +20 feet at 11th level.
Once you teleport using this feature, you cannot do so again, until you cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu of C-Rank or higher that costs chakra.
Vapor Reprieve
When you take damage, you can spend your reaction to transform a portion of the damaged area into mist softening the impact. When you do, you reduce the damage taken by 2 damage dice. This increases to 3 damage dice at 15th level.
Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again, until you cast a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu of C-Rank or higher that costs chakra.
#### Umbral Transmutation
7th Level Clan Feature
Using the secret technique of the Vesper, you are able to transform into a bat-wreathed terror, longer hair, completely red eyes, fur covers your torso, shins and forearms and your ears grow into points. As a bonus action, for the next minute, you enter your Umbral Monarch state. Once you enter this state, you cannot do so again until you complete a Long Rest. If you enter this state again before completing a long rest, you gain 1 rank of exhaustion.
#### Nocturnal Discussions
11th Level Clan Feature
Both halves of your clan yells out to you during tense social discussion. One half asks for patience, to follow the teachings of the Bat-Sage and to show humility. The other side demands swift action, and to overwhelm with societal force. Each a compelling option, both with their own upsides and down. When you enter a social encounter, you can decide to either; Be Patient, Impatient, or neither.
If you choose to be Patient, you cannot gain jutsu or feature based bonuses for the current social encounter. But in exchange for your patience, you gain a Will of Night, which lasts until spent and you can only have one of at any given time. When used grants you two ranks of mastery to all Wisdom and Charisma based skill-based checks for 1 minute.
If you choose to be Impatient, you gain a rank of Mastery to one skill of your choice until the conclusion of this social encounter. But in exchange for your impatience, if you fail 2 or more checks during this encounter, you and your team have the Social Attitude of the creature you were interacting with, reduce by 2 ranks.
#### Nocturnal Supremacy
15th Level Clan Feature
You’ve become the perfect symbol for the Vespers. A lodestar to aspire to become. A myth among the living and a legend for those not yet born. But this perfection isn’t absolute. You must make a choice. When you reach this level, choose between Dominion and Requiem. An Ultimatum in choice for which part of your clan you wish to represent. Once you make this choice, you can only change it by completing a ritual to do so, which can be done as part of a Full-Rest.
Dominion
You embody the shadows and fear, and the ability to compel at will.
When you roll initiative, you begin to radiate a small aura of shadows around yourself as the range of your blind sight from the Echolocation ability is increased to 40 feet.
Additionally, If you would ever teleport into a space that is dimly lit or in darkness that is adjacent to a creature that is Berserked, Charmed, Confused, Demoralized or Shaken, you can, as part of the same action used to teleport, force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, select one creature they can see that is in initiative. They must spend their movement, action and bonus action to harm the select creature. When they have dealt damage to the target creature 3 times, this effect ends on them. A creature that passes their save by 5 or more, becomes immune to this effect until you complete a rest.
[BOX]
| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |
[/BOX]
Requiem
You embody the concept whispered about in your clan, the Apex Vampyr. A predator and stalker of the night that feeds on crimson ichor to sustain themselves.
When you roll initiative, your claws become crimson red and grow in length. While in the Claws of Night stance, or while in your Umbral Monarch state, you gain a +15 bonus to your movement speed and when you take the Attack action, can make one additional attack as part of that Action.
Also, creatures with ranks of Bleed or Crimson Hemorrhage, grant you a +1 bonus to your unarmed attacks or weapon attacks critical threat range.
Additionally, as a Bonus Action, creatures with ranks of Bleed or Crimson Hemorrhage within 30 feet of you have their blood siphoned from them, as they lose all ranks of the listed conditions. For every rank of the listed conditions removed, you regain 1d6 hit points or gain 6 Temporary hit points, your choice.
## Yamada Clan
“When the blade finds the seam between extended muscle, sinew, and bone...anybody — no matter how sturdy — can be cleaved. No matter how unconventional the opponent may be the principles behind decapacitation still hold. Know the body's framework, and weave into the openings. Such is the way of Yamada Asaemon…”
—Yamada Asaemon Sagiri, Jigokuraku
### Single-Swing Style
Tag: Setting Agnostic, Creator: KadenUchiha
The Yamada are sword testers and executioners. Some time ago, a fraction of their clan broke rank, and crossed the sea, landing on the shores of the Land of Water. They retained their original work as executioners for the Daimyo, and some even officially joining the Shinobi Military. As part of their training, they spend a great deal of time deepening their understanding of the human body, it is not uncommon to find a Yamada working in the morgue dissecting corpses to better understand the ways to slice a human. When performing executions, the Yamada clan's doctrine is that the condemned should not feel any pain or emotions coming from their swords and that they must try to hone their skills to perform an ideal cut.
### Yamada Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Cha, +1 Str or Dex
Speed: 30 feet
Skill Proficiency: Martial Arts, Medicine
Tool Proficiency: Medicine Kit
Weapon Proficiency: Tanto, Broadsword, Katana, Odachi & Chokuto.
Single-Swing Practitioner: The Yamada Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Yamada Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
Anatomical Studies: The Yamada clans skill in medicine, allows them to use their knowledge on physical anatomy to foretell an enemies actions. They can use Medicine, in place of Illusions, Martial Arts or Ninshou to take the Read the Enemy action.

### Yamada Features
#### Tameshi Itto-ryu
1st Level Clan Feature
Drawing your weapon is a show that peaceful options have been exhausted. With your weapon drawn you steady yourself and settle into an almost motionless stance, giving each foe that stands against you a verdict of guilt and execution. While in this stance, if you are wielding a weapon listed under your Weapon Proficiency trait, it becomes known as your Executioners Instrument. While in this Bukijutsu stance, you gain the following benefits:
You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength weapon attacks with Executioners Instrument weapons.
Yamada clan Hijutsu you cast with your Executioners Instrument can use the Ideal Cut ability listed. Beginning at 7th level, you cast can use the Tao ability listed. If you use the Tao ability, you cannot use the Ideal Cut ability, and vice versa.
When you take the Attack action with an Executioners Instrument, you can use the Empty Blade attack.
Empty Blade: You can forgo all additional attacks beyond the first one as part of this Attack Action. When you do, roll a number of d6’s equal to the forgone attacks, plus 1 if the affected creature is Severed. If you roll a 5 or 6 with a d6, you can deal additional damage equal to your [Weapon Damage], which is not multiplied as part of a critical hit.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
#### Asaemon Disciplines
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Yamada clan have strict training regimens enforcing their clansmen to be proficient in more than just the blade. They must also be skilled in a variety of other things to help them find some semblance of balance within themselves. You can select two of the listed disciplines to gain proficiency in. You gain another discipline at 7th and 15th levels. You use your highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC for effects that call for a saving throw.
Anatomist
You gain a rank of Mastery to Survival. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a Bruised creature. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead they gain the Severed condition.
Blind Blade
While you can hear and mold chakra, You gain 10 feet of Blindsight. This increases to 15 feet at 7th level and 20 feet at 15th level. Attacks you make within your blindsight range cannot be made at disadvantage.
Carpenter
You gain a rank of Mastery to Crafting. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] to a Construct or Structure, and you use the 3rd bullet point effect of your Tameshi Itto-Ryu stance, you can roll 2 additional d6’s.
Edge Sharpening
You methodically sharpen every tool you find yourself in possession of. Over the course of a short rest, you take your Executioners Instrument and one weapon from each willing allied creature and work to sharpen or balance them. At the conclusion of your rest, the first time you roll initiative, all of your sharpened weapons come to fruition. Until the conclusion of this combat, you gain a rank of Mastery to your [Weapon Damage]. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.
Once you sharpen weapons in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete another rest.
Interrogator
You gain a rank of Mastery to Intimidation. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
When you take the Demoralize skill action, the opposing creature does not make an opposing check, but instead you make your check vs the opposing creatures Wisdom DC.
Additionally, by beating the target creatures Wisdom DC by 10 or more, if they are a Standard or Minion classed adversary, they drop their weapons, if any and must flee until the end of their next turn.
Judge
You gain a rank of Mastery on saving throws vs gaining the Charmed, Confused, Demoralized and Dazed conditions. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.
Lawyer
You gain a rank of Mastery to Investigation. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a creature with at least one rank of Confused or Dazed. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead gain the Severed condition.
Politician
You gain a rank of Mastery to Deception. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
When you take the Create Diversion skill action, you may, as part of that action, make one Weapon attack against one target creature you can reach. On a successful check, you can instead make two weapon attacks.
Surgeon
You gain a rank of Mastery to Medicine. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level. Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a creature with at least one rank of Bleed. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead they gain the Severed condition.
#### Assessment of Tao
7th Level Clan Feature
The secrets of Tao are found in a scroll in the Yamada clans storerooms. Manipulating Yin and Yang Chakra allows one to tap into a special form of energy called Tao. You’ve become able to sense the latent Tao within others. By Spending 1 minute focusing, for the next 10 minutes, creatures of your level and lower within 120 feet of you, that can mold Chakra or aren’t suppressing their chakra, reveal their presence to you. This does not reveal their location, only that they are within your sensory range and granting you immunity to being Surprised and hidden creatures cannot make attacks at advantage against you. Once you use this special sense, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.
#### Tao Attunement
11th Level Clan Feature
It is said that while Chakra was a creation of Shinobi, by Shinobi. Tao is much older and far more primordial in nature. The source of everything in existence, be it living or non-living. Most creatures go their entire lives never knowing Tao or how their lives are shaped by it. But the Yamada have learned to harness it after a botched mission under their homelands shogun. The Yamada now teach and train its more senior members in the ways of Tao, attuning them to one of five base Tao Principles, but unlike others, you have the unique ability to hold any affinity through meditation.
Select one of five Tao attributes gaining its benefits. You can switch this attunement when you complete a short rest.
Wood
When you regain or heal another creatures hit points, increase the amount by half your level, once per creature, per rest.
Additionally, when there are 2 or more hostile creatures within your Executioners Instrument’s range, if you take the Empty Blade attack against one of them, compare your attack result against the AC of up to 2 of them, treating each as if they were the original target.
Fire
You gain 2 ranks of Mastery to your initiative.
Once per turn, when you take the Dash or Disengage actions, you can make an Empty Blade attack with your Executioners Instrument as part of the action taken as if you were forgoing 2 attacks.
Earth
You gain advantage on checks and saves made to resist being moved or knocked prone.
Once per turn, you can forgo one attack granted by the Attack action to guard yourself, reducing the next instance of damage by an amount equal to your [Weapon Damage], before the beginning of your next turn.
Metal
When you roll a d6 as a result of the Empty Blade attack, you can trigger its effect on a 4, 5 or 6.
If you would miss your Empty Blade attack you can spend your Bonus Action to remake the attack.
Water
When a creature attempts to dash, disengage, grapple, disarm, shove or forcefully move you, while they are within your Executioners Instrument range, you can make one weapon attack against them.
Once per turn, when a creature within 30 feet of you attempts to attack an allied creature that is also, within 30 feet of you, you can spend your reaction to move up to your speed, ending it adjacent to your ally and attempting to parry the blow by rolling your [Weapon Damage] die and adding half the result to your allies AC. If the attacking creature misses, you deal your [Weapon Damage] to them.
#### The Middle Path
15th Level Clan Feature
As you reach the pinnacle of the Yamada clan, you have found that the absolutes they taught were merely limitations you’ve grown beyond.
By spending your Bonus Action as part of casting a Hijutsu you can use both your Ideal Cut and Tao abilities.
Once per turn, when making an Empty Blade attack, reduce the value needed to trigger its effect by 1.

If a creature would be Severed again, they instead gain +1 rank of Shaken. Creatures without the listed anatomy are immune to that result. If a creature regains hit points, would cleanse a condition or spends an Action to make a DC 15 Medicine check, this condition ends. You may increase the DC by +2 for every rank of Shaken a creature has. / Hand/Arm. The affected creature cannot make HS or wield a weapon. / Eyes. The affected creature becomes Blinded. / Back/Wings/Tail. The Affected creature loses its flying or swim speed if any. They also lose concentration of all jutsu they are concentrating on and cannot concentrate on more than 1 jutsu at a time. / Foot/Leg. The affected creature cannot cast jutsu with a Mobility (M) component, and their speed is reduced by half. / Torso/Abdomen. The affected creature reduces the damage they deal by 10. / Neck/Head. The affected creature is Staggered, and remains Staggered for this conditions duration. |

## Yuki Clan
A masked shinobi stalks a group of spies. The spies get pretty far into the country before they settle in for a rest. While resting the spies sense that something is off before they attempt to perform evasive maneuvers. Ice erupts from the ground creating ground spikes, skewing a few of the intruding spies. It doesn’t take long before the masked shinobi confronts the panicking group. “You have wronged the village hidden in the Mist. You have stolen more than a fair share of village secrets and by order of lady Mizukage, you have been sentenced to death.” The words come out cold, and unfeeling. Sharp and dry at the same time. The shinobi realizes the risk in dealing with a Member of the Yuki Clan, but they know that if they do nothing, it’s already over. So, they draw their weapons and move in to confront this foe. The Yuki behind the mask smirks before all falls below subzero in the immediate area.
—Tatsunami Aburame, The Long Road, Ch. 16 excerpt.
### Cold to the Bone
The Yuki Clan is a family of shinobi found in the Land of Water. They were almost wiped out due to a massive Kekkei Genkai revolt held in the country. Many died, and because of this their bloodline splintered. They no longer share a common family name, and are generally known as a family that in combat are nigh unbeatable.
### Yuki Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex or Int, +1 Int or Cha (Int cannot be chosen as the +1 ASI, if it was chosen for the +2 ASI.)
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Stealth
Ice Release Affinity: You begin with either Wind or Water Release Affinity. (Pick one)
Ice Release Techniques: The Yuki Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Yuki Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Cold Adjustment: Yuki Clansmen are immune to hostile cold environments and do not need to make checks or saving throws to resist effects caused by extreme cold temperatures.
Slick Movement: Yuki Clansmen ignores difficult terrain and effects that would impede movement caused by jutsu with the Wind or Water Release keywords.
### Yuki Features
#### The Looking Glass
1st Level Clan Feature
You are capable of manipulating water and wind release chakra, and fusing them together to create mirror like glass constructs that reflect you, and only you within them. As a Bonus action, you can select an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you that is along the ground. Within this space, you conjure a mirror pane that is 6 feet tall, 3 feet wide, and 2 inches thick. This mirror projects only your reflection and is known as your Ice Mirrors.
An Ice Mirror has 10 Hit Points, 20 AC, Resistance to Piercing, Slashing, Cold and Wind Damage, and vulnerable to fire damage and lasts for up to 1 minute. You can maintain up to 2 Ice Mirrors at once, creating an additional Ice Mirrors beyond the limit melts the oldest one. The number of Ice Mirrors you can maintain increases by +1 at 7th, 11th and 15th levels.
While you have at least one Ice Mirrors active, you gain the following abilities;
Join Reflection. By spending 5 feet of movement, while adjacent to an Ice Mirror, you can infuse yourself into it. While infused in this way, you occupy the same space as the glass and your reflection is shown on all active Ice Mirrors. While occupying an Ice Mirror, you can spend 5 feet of movement to exit the Ice Mirror you are occupying, moving into a space that can hold you within 5 feet. If the mirrors HP is reduced to 0 while you are occupying it, remaining damage is applied to you and you exit the destroyed mirror, occupying the space it previously occupied.
Attacking Reflections. When you infuse into a Ice Mirror, while at least one other Ice Mirrors is active, you can make a Stealth check with a rank of Mastery. On a success, gain the benefits of a successful Hide action as creatures cannot tell which mirror you are currently occupying until a creature succeeds a Search.
Mirrors Protection. If you are occupying a glass, all attacks targeting you, instead target the Ice Mirrors. While infused into a glass, you have immunity to the Grappled, Restrained and Prone conditions and cannot be moved against your will, except by teleportation.
Reflective Movement. By spending 10 feet of movement, while occupying a Ice Mirrors, you can teleport into another Ice Mirrors within 30 feet of the current Ice Mirrors you are occupying.
Mirrored Strike. While occupying a Ice Mirrors, when you make a ranged attack, this does not end your successful stealth benefit, if any.
#### Bloody Mist Legacy
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your clans previous near extinction has taught all of the clans survivors one major lesson. To never outshine your masters. The Clan has learned to adapt from its bloody legacy. Its clansmen adapt to their surroundings more, but never commit and always be ready to pack up and move to survive, if necessary.
When you gain this feature, select 1 path. You can switch this paths by spending a Bonus Action. Though, as a quirk of your clans need to never try the same thing twice too soon to avoid suspicion, you cannot select paths you previously selected, until you spend at least 10 minutes outside of combat.
If an ability requires a saving throw or attack, use your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus.
Refraction
Double Pane: When you create an Ice Mirror, you instead create 2, instead of 1 and your mirrors have immunity to Poison Damage.
Truth in Passing: You gain a rank of Mastery to Investigation. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you take the Study action, you can complete it as an Action, instead of 1 minute.
Frostbane: When you inflict the Frostbite condition on a creature within 10 feet of an Ice Mirror, you can force the affected creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are dragged into the Ice Mirrors, and then expelled from another active Ice Mirrors, falling prone into a space within 5 feet of the Ice Mirrors they were expelled from.
Hoarfrost
Frosted Glass: While occupying an Ice Mirror, all Ice Mirrors, emit a mist, filling a 10-foot radius around them. Allied creatures standing within this mist gain the benefit of Mirrors Protection.
Ominous Reflections: You gain a rank of Mastery to Chakra Control. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you take the Suppress Chakra action, you can select an active Ice Mirrors. That Ice Mirrors now emits chakra, making it look like you are occupying it, even if you aren’t.
Brine Prison: When you inflict the Frostbite condition on a creature, that creature releases a pulse of frozen air, freezing the ground around them, making it slippery. The affected creature turns a 10-foot radius, centered on them into difficult terrain for the next minute. You have immunity to this difficult terrain and if an effect that deals fire damage would occur or overlap with the affected area, the difficult terrain is dispelled.
Glacial Movement
Glacial Jump: Once per turn, when you use Reflective Movement to teleport to an Ice Mirror, it costs you no movement. Additionally, You can use the effects of Mirrored Strike, to make melee attacks, against creatures up to 15 feet away from your Ice Mirrors as if they were within your melee attacks range.
Hostile Terrain: You gain a rank of Mastery to Initiative. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you create difficult terrain with a Hijutsu you cast or feature you use, hostile creatures take 5 cold damage for each space they pass through and allied creatures are immune to the effects of the difficult terrain.
Rime Line: When you move, you leave behind a layer of rime on the surface you are moving on and all adjacent surfaces. This rime melts at the beginning of your next turn.
Black Ice Mirror
Black Iron Reflection: Your Ice Mirrors gains 5 DR against damage it isn’t Immune, Resistant or Vulnerable to.
Frost Courier: You gain a rank of Mastery to Athletics. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. Allied creatures that take damage while within 10 feet of an Ice Mirrors, can spend their reaction to fall back into the Ice Mirrors, and teleporting into a space within 5 feet of another Ice Mirrors as if they jumped into one and exited from another.
Black Frost: When a hostile creature destroys an Ice Mirrors you are occupying, the mirror explodes, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, becoming Frost Bitten on a failure.
Shiver-Weave
Invisible Threads: When you teleport between Ice Mirrors, using Reflective Movement, you can draw a line between the mirrors you teleported between, that only you can see, that lasts until the beginning of your next turn. If a hostile creature moves through this invisible line, you can spend your Reaction, to teleport to a previously occupied mirror and perform a number of attacks equal to the number of active Ice Mirrors against the triggering creature, dealing 2d6 + Modifier in cold damage, for each successful attack, and forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, having their speed reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn, on a failure.
Hail Burst: You gain a rank of Mastery to Stealth. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. As part of casting a Yuki Hijutsu, you can release a cloud of snowy hail from your body filling a 15-foot cube, originating from you. This cloud totally obscures creatures within and on opposite sides of it, but vanishes at the beginning of your next turn.
Frost Splinter: When a creature destroys an Ice Mirror, you can spend your Reaction, to teleport to another active Ice Mirrors. You still take any damage that would be inflicted.
Frost bound Shield
Bulwark: Ice Mirrors that you summon gains additional hit points equal to your level.
Stalwart: You gain a rank of Mastery to Strength and Dexterity saving throws while occupying an Ice Mirror. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. Additionally, Ice Mirrors you summon are resistant to damage that affects an area.
Black Frost: When you inflict the Frostbite condition, all of your active Ice Mirrors regain 5 hit point.

7th Level Clan Feature
The Yuki clan has a unique talent for manifesting Ice Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Ice Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Wind or Water release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Cold respectively.
Your skills with Ice Mirrors you create has become far more prominent, garnering you the following benefits;
Ice Mirrors that you occupy can use its own AC or your AC, whichever is higher.
While not in combat, you can allow allied creatures to teleport through your Ice Mirrors through to another Ice Mirrors.
When you summon an Ice Mirror, you can have it suspended in the air, no higher than 10 feet off the ground.
#### Sanctum of Ice
11th Level Clan Feature
You were born of the snow and ice. It comforts you, and you find some solace in its inclusion in the environment around you. When you begin your turn within 30 feet of a creature with ranks of Chilled or Frostbite, you can reduce that creatures rank of the listed condition by up to 5. When you do, you regain hit points equal to 10 times the ranks removed.
Additionally, when you would end your turn with ranks of an Elemental condition, while another creature has ranks of Chilled or Frostbite, you can reduce that creatures rank of the listed condition by up to 5. When you do, you reduce the ranks of the Elemental condition you have by an equal amount.
Once you use either effect you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.
#### Demonic Mirror Master
15th Level Clan Feature
You are what the Yuki clan has worked so hard to achieve. You have become the culmination of decades of training and technique.
As a bonus Action, on your turn, you enter a state of perfection, like that of an unmalting snowflake, called the Demonic Ice Prism (or Prism, for short), that lasts for 1 minute. Once you exit this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a rest. While in this state you gain the following benefits;
Select up to 8 Spaces you can see within 60 feet of you, that is unoccupied. You summon an Ice Mirror in each chosen space. You then immediately occupy the closest Ice Mirrors to you, teleporting into its space. Ice Mirrors created this way do not count against the limit of Ice Mirrors you can create.
Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, you can switch which paths from the Bloody Mist Legacy clan feature you benefit from. Switching paths in this way does not prevent you from switching back for the duration.
When you cast the Ice Daggers Hijutsu, compare the attack result vs the AC of all creatures of your choice within 15 feet of an active Ice Mirrors.
