# Land of Earth Clans
## Bakuton Clan
“We are in way over our heads!” Senko says. “Don’t you dare give up on me!” her red haired Uzumaki friend responds. They find themselves in a rather dangerous situation. The building is collapsing in around them, their enemies have escaped, and they have a downed ally, while they are also all wounded. “You have to use it Senko!” the Uzumaki screams. “What!? No! I haven’t mastered it yet, what if the blow back~” she begins, but is caught off guard by her friend’s tearful pleas. “Fine! Stand back. I’m about to blow us out of here!!!”
—Tye Tiken
At Worlds End, Ch. 3 excerpt.
### An Explosive Personality
The Bakuton Clan is a clan without a clear family name, but one with a fearsome history and purpose. Members of this clan can be found in villages, across the country, and are used to great effect in different military institutions. The Bakuton Family line is one of power, and absolute authority. These shinobi are known to control a battlefield through force alone, and very few can say they would stand a chance against one in a head-to-head match.
### Bakuton Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Int
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, and your choice between Ninshou or Martial Arts.
Explosion Release Affinity: You begin with either Earth or Lightning Release Affinity. (Pick one)
Explosive Techniques: The Bakuton Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Bakuton Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Branch Family: The Bakuton are split between two different branches, the [Artistic Branch] and the [Reckless Branch]. The artistic branch are artisans who also happen to be demolitionist. The reckless branch acts as demolitionists who happen to be brawlers. Select which branch your character is a part of. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later.
### Bakuton Features
#### Artistic Cataclysm
1st Level Clan Feature, [Artistic Branch]
You are born with 3 mouths. The one on your face, and one on each hand. These additional mouths have the ability to infuse explosive chakra into any substance they can lick or chew. This is represented by a unique for of combat that only you can reasonably utilize, your Artistic Cataclysm Chakra stance.
As a bonus action, you can enter this Artistic Cataclysm chakra stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;
Clay constructs you command all act as part of the same Bonus action spent to command them. You can command each Clay Construct separately.
When you take the attack action or cast a Bakuton Clan Hijutsu that requires an attack, you can choose to replace any number of attacks made with the action with a Clay Bombings attack. Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack feature, when you take the Attack action while in this stance, you can attack twice with your Clay Bombing attack, instead of once
Clay Bombings. Make a ranged jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, dealing 1d12 force damage on a hit. If you roll a 12 on the damage die of this attack, you can add 1 additional damage die to the result as the attack is far more explosive.
Beginning at 7th level, increase the damage of this attack to 2d12 and Barriers, structures and constructs treat this attacks damage as if they were vulnerable to it.
#### Ballistic Knuckle
1st Level Clan Feature, [Reckless Branch]
When you would get into scraps as a child the one thing everyone could agree on, was that you had hands…explosive ones. This is represented by a unique form of combat that only you could reasonably utilize, your Ballistic Knuckle Taijutsu stance.
As a Bonus action, you can enter this Ballistic Knuckle Taijutsu stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits:
Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 2d8, damage type becomes force, and no longer adds your ability modifier to the damage dealt.
Your unarmed attacks gain the Deadly 1 weapon property. This increases to Deadly 2 at 7th level and Deadly 3 at 15th level.
You gain resistance to damage you would take as a result of your own clan features.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack feature, you can attack twice while in this stance, instead of once.
#### Priming Cataclysm
3rd Level Clan Feature
You don’t set traps. You schedule surprises. You learn to manufacture compact chakra charges that detonate at your command. Once per turn, when you deal [Unarmed Damage], damage as a result of Clay Bombings, or damage as a result of a Bakuton clan Hijutsu you can Prime all damaged creatures. Alternatively, as a bonus action you can Prime an object or structure you touch. Primes last for 1 minute or until detonated. You can maintain up to 4 Primes at any given moment, and a creature can be Primed more than once.
While Primes are active, you can spend your Action, Bonus Action or Reaction, on your turn to detonate all Primes. When a Prime detonates an explosion filling a 5-foot radius centered on the affected creature or object goes off. Primes on a structure explode with a radius originating from the place the Prime was set. This radius is increased in size for every Prime a creature, object or structure has by +5 feet.
All creatures in the area of an explosion, must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, taking 2d6 force damage for every Prime detonate on that same target or half as much on a success. If a creature would be caught in multiple overlapping explosions, it is only affected by one of them, which you choose.
Your Prime detonations scale with you. At 7th level, the number of Primes you can have active at once increases by +1. At 11th level, increase the damage of your Primes to 3d6.  At 15th level the number of Primes you can have active at once increases by +1.
#### Artistic Payloads
7th Level Clan Feature, [Artistic Branch]
Your charges are like a composition of a beautiful symphony, an amazing sculpture, a once in a lifetime painting. Detonating them bring forth the beauty within that others just don’t understand. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Explosion Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Earth Release keywords, you can change the damage type to force.
You learn three Payloads, and choose which two you have prepared after each rest. Unless a payload says otherwise, affected creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 2 more Payloads at 11th level and can prepare three to use after each rest.
When you detonate Primed creatures, objects and structures you can select one Payload infusing their effect into the detonation itself. Only one detonation will have the Payload effect.
A1 Scatter burst
Scatter Burst. The detonation forces all creatures who failed their saving throw to be thrown 30-feet into a direction of your choice excluding airborne and falling prone. You can choose which direction each creature is thrown individually.
A2 Smoke Petals
Smoke Petals. The detonation creates a 20-foot radius of smoke that heavily obscures vision. This smoke lasts until the end of your next turn. Creatures who fail their saving throw gain 1 rank of Concussed and Dazzled.
A3 Seismic Quake
Seismic Quake. The detonation shatters the ground making the affected area difficult terrain. Creatures that fail their saving throw are Slowed until the end of their next turn from the shock of the explosion
A4 Fractal Adhesive
Fractal Adhesive. The detonation creates a splash of sticky mud like adhesive that binds to everything. Creatures that fail their saving throw are Restrained in place by the adhesive until the end of their next turn.
A5 Cluster Gallery
Cluster Gallery. The detonation creates 4 mini charges which each land on a point of your choice within 20-feet of the triggering explosions affected area. Each mini charge then explodes in a 5-foot radius forcing creatures in each new zone to make their saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Concussed and being knocked Prone on a failed save. A creature can be affected by up to 2 mini charge at a time, but only make a saving throw once to determine if you suffer the mini charges effect twice.
#### Reckless Payloads
7th Level Clan Feature, [Reckless Branch]
You detonate your charges while in point blank range. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Explosion Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Earth Release keywords, you can change the damage type to force.
You learn three Payloads, and choose which two you have prepared after each rest. Unless a payload says otherwise, affected creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 2 more Payloads at 11th level and can prepare three to use after each rest. You are immune to your own Payload effects.
You can detonate a single Primed creature instead of all creatures by dealing [Unarmed Damage] to them and these payloads can change the shape of the affected area.
When you detonate Primed creatures, objects and structures you can select one Payload infusing their effect into the detonation itself. Only one detonation will have the Payload effect.
B1 Knuckle Burst
Knuckle Burst. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 30-foot cone originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw gain 1 rank of Shaken.
B2 Armor Crack
Armor Crack. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 60-foot line originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw reduce their AC by 2 until the end of your next turn.
B3 Flash bang
Flash Bang. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 20-foot cube originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw are Blinded until the end of their next turn.
B4 Ear Ringer
Ear Ringer. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 30-foot cone originating from you. Creature who fail their saving throw are Deafened and gain 2 ranks of Concussed.
B5 Barrier Buster
Barrier Buster. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 60-foot-long line originating from you. Creature who fail their saving throw have effects they are benefiting from as a result of a jutsu with the Barrier keyword dispelled, before damage is calculated.
#### Controlled Demolition
11th Level Clan Feature
You’ve blown up enough things to know how to not blow up everything. While you are not in combat, you can spend 10 minutes placing and tuning a Prime to Breach a surface or structure within your reach.
Breach. You blow a 5-foot-wide hole through up to 5 feet of material, even if chakra reinforced.
[BOX]
| #### Cataclysm Knuckle / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Blast Zone. You are immune to the harmful effects of your Primes, Bakuton Hijutsu and Clan features. / Black Powder Pressure. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature and Prime them, they are marked twice instead of once. / Detonation Momentum. You gain a bonus to your attack critical threat range when attacking a Primed creature. This bonus is equal to the number of Primes they have active on them. |
[/BOX]
Additionally, you can ensure negotiations, while hostile, go your way. As part of making an Intimidation or Persuasion check against a non-combat ready creature, you can pretend to set a visible charge, Priming yourself or another creature, object or structure within 10-feet of you. On a successful check, the target becomes extremely compliant for the next minute, answering the next question as truthfully as possible, delaying sounding alarms and even escorting you somewhere to avoid blowing up with you. A creature will attempt to defend themselves if they take damage or realize the Prime was fake. To realize a Prime is fake a creature makes a perception check vs your highest jutsu save DC.
#### Explosive Art!
15th Level Clan Feature, [Artistic Branch]
You become a walking magazine of explosive potential. As a Bonus action, you can enter the Grand Detonator state for the next minute. Once you enter this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a long rest.
[BOX]
| #### Grand Detonator / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Expanded Limit. You can have up to 8 Primes active at once. / If Looks Could Kill. Once per turn, you can detonate a single Primed creature without spending an action on your turn. / Lethal Charge. You can infuse up to 3 different Payloads into a detonation. / Terrain Buster. All detonations can create difficult terrain in the affected area. |
[/BOX]
#### Bombfist Brawler
15th Level Clan Feature, [Reckless Branch]
You become a walking warhead capable of releasing explosive bombs with each strike. As a Bonus action, you can enter the Cataclysm Knuckle state for the next minute. Once you enter this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a long rest.

Components: HS, CM Cost: 3 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release, Barrier Description: You create a small explosion from the palm of your hand, timed to deflect incoming damage, capable of bounding ranged attacks back. Reduce the triggering damage by 4d6.
If the triggering damage was the result of a ranged attack from a creature you can see, you deflect some of it back. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu) attack targeting the attacking creature. On a hit, you deal 2d6 force damage.

## Futton Clan
“And you think we are just gonna hand over the client?” Diane asks her assailants who are surrounding her traveling party. “You seem to think you have the leeway to respond to my demands with a question little girl?” The Black-haired Bandit says with a condescending scowl. “That’s Genin, to you, whoever you are. But I think you better move, before I get mad, your people end up burned and boiled” She responds with an aggravated look in her eye. The bandits attack her for her statements. She inhales and exhales a gas of boiling hot steam, that creates a stream of screams from her would be assailants that slowly, but surely, goes silent.
—Lyo Hataka
At Worlds End, Ch. 2 excerpt.
### A Corrosive Breath
The Futton Clan is a clan without a clear family name, but one with a deadly history and purpose. Members of this clan can be found in villages across the country, and are used to great effect in different military institutions. The Futton Family line is one that has a clear influence in Kirigakure (The Land of Water), even having one of its descendants as the Mizukage at one point in time. This clan uses its acidic Jutsu to melt the competition.
### Futton Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int or Str, +1 Con
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Martial Arts, and your choice between Ninshou or Athletics.
Boil Release Affinity: You begin with either Water or Fire Release Affinity. (Pick one)
Corrosive Techniques: The Futton Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s). They do not need both Nature Release’s to use their Clan jutsu.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Futton Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Constitution as its casting ability score.
Branch Family: The Futton are split between two different branches, the [Corrosive Branch] and the [Broil Branch]. The corrosive branch are fighters who specialize in using the acidic vapors of Boil release to dissolve anything in their path. The broil branch are fighters who boil the chakra in their own body to build pressure for explosive martial arts. Select which branch your character is a part of. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later.
### Futton Features
#### Corrosive Kisses
1st Level Clan Feature, [Corrosive Branch]
The teachings of this side of the clan focuses on manipulating the corrosive and acidity of your water release chakra, using your fire release a global dial to determine how lethal the aura you emit can be. You learn to expel this acidic mist from your person at will, temporarily filling a small space, laying waste to anything in your way. You gain the following abilities.
Solid Fog. As an action, you expel a cloud of acidic mist from your person melting anything made of matter. When you do, select the shape of this mist when used. All creatures in the affected area must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 1d12 acid damage and one of the following effects of your choosing, or half as much damage on a success. This damage is increased by 1d12 at 7th and 15th levels.
Inflict 1 rank of Corroded or Deteriorate (your choice). This is counted as a Ninjutsu of the highest rank you can cast. This increases by +1 rank at 7th and 15th levels where applicable.
Line: 25-Foot Long, 5 foot wide. Increase in length by +10 feet at 7th and 15th levels.
Cone: 15-Foot Cone. Increase in size by +5 feet at 7th and 15th levels.
Sphere: Select a point you can see within 30 feet, and fill a 10-foot radius sphere, centered on this point. Increase in size by +5 feet at 7th and 15th levels.
#### Broiling Rampart
1st Level Clan Feature, [Broil Branch]
The Broil Branch has a penchant for heavy strikes and stalwart defenses, having a strong desire for close range fights, by boiling ones chakra, until a mist forms within, building pressure for each strike like a steam engine.  While in this Taijutsu stance you gain the following benefits.
You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for unarmed and weapon attacks.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
Build Pressure. You can build Pressure, with each strike, or movement. Once per turn, you can gain 1 Pressure when you Dash, Disengage, or cast a Jutsu with the Fire or Water release keywords. You can maintain up to 3 Pressure. You can spend this Pressure on the following. Abilities that would force a saving throw or make an attack uses your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus. Each of the listed abilities cost 1 Pressure.
Boil Knuckle. On your turn, when your attack result is 5 or higher than the targets AC, you force them to make a Constitution saving throw, being Dazed on a failure.
Jet Dash. You release a halo of steam from your body that propels you like a steam engine. On your turn, increase your speed by +20, and, you release boiling steam at the end of the current turn, forcing adjacent creatures to you to make a Constitution saving throw, becoming Corroded or Scalded on a failure. This ability counts as a Taijutsu of the highest rank you can cast.
Vent Strike. Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage], you can increase the damage you deal by +2, until the end of the current turn. This increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.

Melting Heat. Once per turn, as part of casting a jutsu that would inflict the Burned condition, you can infuse it with an acidic additive. Replacing all ranks of Burn inflicted with ranks of Scald. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Caustic Aura. As a bonus action, you boil your chakra, and begin to emit a haze of steam around you. While the Steam is active, you reduce the damage you take from bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from weapons by an amount equal to half your level, as you corrode and dull their impact on you.
Great Wall Dissolution. Once per turn, as part of dealing [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a construct, object or structure you wash over it with corrosive chakra. The target must make Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, it loses all resistances it has, and gains a vulnerability to Acid damage, and one other damage type of your choice, until the end of your next turn. #### Alchemical Fog
7th Level Clan Feature, [Corrosive Branch]
Nothing stands long when facing you. Even the densest defenses melt like butter to a hot knife when you engage. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Boil Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Water or Fire Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Acid.
You also learn to further harden and solidify your Solid Fog. When you use your Solid Fog, it now persists until the beginning of your next turn. You also learn two alchemical mixtures which allows you to transmute your boil mixture into. Unless an acid says otherwise, affected creatures must make savings throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 1 more acids at 11th level.
Curtain of Rain

Perchloric Barrier

Clear Lungs

When they do, they can select one of the physical conditions they have and remove all ranks of it. A creature can only remove conditions in this way once, every 10 minutes.
Flower Boil

Geometric Aerosol

11th Level Clan Feature
Your presence is a constant reminder to your foes, that lies are to be punished. Those that try, can feel the heat when they do.

When the select creature makes a Charisma check vs you or your allies, you can spend your reaction to turn up the heat, imposing a 1d4 penalty to their check. You can use this feature twice per social encounter.
#### Perfect Solution
15th Level Clan Feature, [Corrosive Branch]
You radiate a corrosive aura so potent, creatures within your vicinity can sense their defenses failing them as a result of your very presence.
While in combat, hostile creatures that end their turn within 15 feet of you, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your Highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, their AC is reduced by 1, for the next minute. A creature that passes this saving throw by 10 or more gains immunity to it until you complete a rest.

#### Catastrophic Vent
15th Level Clan Feature, [Broil Branch]
You can release stored pressure, in a single violent purge, pushing you and your body into a state of extreme Torque.
When you enter Torque, you gain the following additional benefits for the duration;
You gain +4 DR.
You gain 2 ranks of Mastery to Athletics and Acrobatics checks.
Hijutsu you cast that requires concentration, gains the Stable and Efficient keywords.
You gain immunity to the Dazed and Staggered conditions.

## Shí Hóu Clan
"At long last!" the humble monk traveling west on his journey to collect the divine sutras sang out. Following behind, a slightly annoyed, but still playful Shinobi Son Wu. "Hey old man, how much further do we have to go?" Cried out the Ninja. "Not too much further! Only another 1000 miles!" Wu angrily followed, but loyal to the mission. Unbeknownst to him, the mission papers the monk holds are forged. The monk had gotten away with this dozens of times before, but this time, Son was the victim of this tall tale. With Sons other teammates, they faced eighty-one trials during their quest. For his service and strength, Son Wu was awarded a single apple as laid out in the rewards portion of the forged mission documents...”
- Tales of the Gallant, Chapter 2
### Taoist Spirit
Tag: Setting Agnostic, Creator: StruggledKiller
The Shi Hou are a peaceful clan hailing from a small village in the Land of Earth. From birth, members of this clan are exceptionally strong, manifesting an unusual Kekkei Genkai, a monkey-like tail. The Shi Hou tend to keep to themselves, however, time and time again during Great Shinobi wars they lend their strength. They believe themselves descendants of the first Human Sage, who trained under the Primate Tribe.
### Shí Hóu Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Str or Dex
Speed: 35 feet
Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics, Deception.
Weapon Proficiencies: Polearm Weapon Group
Shi Hou Agility: You have a climbing speed, equal to your walking speed.
Monkey Tail: From birth, Shi Hou clansmen are born with an additional appendage, similar to that of a monkeys tail, covered in a furlike hair that matches their natural hair color. It can be used as an additional limb for holding small items with 1 Bulk, and it provides additional balance, granting clansmen 1 rank in Mastery for Acrobatics.

### Shí Hóu Features
#### Inner Chi
1st Level Clan Feature
The Shi Hou clansmen have their bodies permeate with a unique secondary chakra source called Inner Chi. This Inner Chi can be utilized to great effects, using more basic jutsu but at an advanced level far before others would be capable.
You begin with a number of Inner Chi equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can spend this Inner Chi on any feature that calls for it. The first of which are Simple Transformations. You regain spent Inner Chi when you complete a rest of any type.
By spending 1 Inner Chi, you can tap into your ancestors playful and whimsical legacy, allowing you to partially transform into other animals to empower your martial prowess. You can send Inner Chi in this way when a Transformations trigger dictates. Select 2 Simple Transformations at character creation. You gain an additional selection Simple Transformation at 7th and 15th levels. If a transformation would call for an attack or saving throw, you use your highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC for its calculation.
Bear
When you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a creature, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature is knocked off balance. You increase the damage you deal by +1 damage die and the next attack targeting them that isn’t from you, has advantage.
Bull
When you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a creature on the same turn which you moved at least 10 or more feet, prior to the damage roll, you can force them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Shaken and thrown 30 feet into a direction of your choice. If they are thrown upward, you can cast a jutsu with the Finisher keyword, as if you cast a jutsu with the Combo keyword.
Squid
When you are Grappled or Restrained by a hostile creature, you can immediately attempt an Acrobatics or Deception check the hostile creatures lowest jutsu save DC. On a success, you end the Grapple or Restrain condition on yourself.
Hawk
As part of casting a Jutsu, until the beginning of your next turn, you gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed. Additionally, you ignore effects that would force you to spend additional movement to move through a space, such as difficult terrain.
If a Hostile creature would reduce your speed as a result of a jutsu they cast, you can also use this Transformation to gain additional speed equal to the speed you lost until the end of your next turn.
Bat
As a Bonus action, you can perform a Search skill action. When you do, you gain 15 feet of Blind Sight until the end of the current turn and gain a rank of Mastery to the check.
Rabbit
As a Bonus Action, you can double your Jump distance, reduce fall damage you would take to 0, if its less than 120 feet, and Jutsu you cast against creatures that are flying, gain advantage on their attacks against them.
#### Ruyi Jingu Bang
1st Level Clan Feature
The Shi Hou Clan can utilize tools of war as an extension of their own spirit, infusing their Inner Chi into a weapon, manipulating its form. You can choose one weapon in your possession from the Polearm weapon group, infusing your chi into it, until it becomes Spirit Bonded to you. You can have up to two Spirit Bonded weapons at a time. You can change the weapon you are Spirit Bonded to at the conclusion of a Full-Rest. A weapon you are Spirit Bonded with gains the Reach 1 weapon property if it doesn’t have the Reach property already.
While in combat, while you have a Spirit Bonded weapon, you can do the following, each of which lasts for 1 minute;
Shi Zhou Suo. As a bonus action you can alter your Spirit Bonded weapon, shrinking its size, granting it the Hidden and Light weapon property and removing the Two-Handed and Heavy properties as well as reducing its bulk to 0. Reduce its damage die size by 1 step. You cannot use Fāyù while using this ability.
Zengzhang. As a bonus action, you can alter your Spirit Bonded weapon, increasing its length. Increase its Reach property by +1. Beginning at 7th level increase Reach gained by +2. Beginning at 15th level, increase the Reach gained by +3.
Fāyù. You can spend an Action to massively increase its weight. The Weapon gains the Heavy and Critical 2 weapon properties. You cannot use Shi Zhou Suo while using this ability.
Hui. As an Object interaction, if you are using Shi Zhou Suo or Fāyù, you dispel their effects.

#### Deceptive Strikes
3rd Level Clan Feature
Shi Hou clansmen are touted as experts of whimsical combat deception, striking from unpredictable angles or even completely feinting mid combo. As part of an attack made with the Attack Action, you can attempt one of the following;
Deceptive Combat.  Perform the Create Diversion skill-based action. You can choose to use your attack result as the result for your check. On a success, the affected creature falls under the effects of the Create Diversion skill action and the next allied creature that targets them for an attack adds 1d4 to their attacks result. A creature can only suffer this effect once every other round.
Confusing Technique. Once per turn, force the target creature to make an Intelligence saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain the Confused and Concussed conditions. A creature can only suffer this effect once every other round.
#### Monkey See, Monkey Do
3rd Level Clan Feature
You can commit a person’s voice, behavior and mannerisms to memory. By spending 1 Inner Chi, you can cast either the Transform Genjutsu or the Advanced Transformation Ninjutsu at no action cost.
While transformed into another creature using either jutsu, when you would attempt a Lie, Impersonate or Make an Impression/Request skill-based action, you gain a rank of Mastery to the check. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level, and three ranks of Mastery at 15th level.
#### Advanced Transformations
7th Level Clan Feature
With experience and finesse, you’ve not only gained access to new forms, but you can maintain these transformations for an extended period of time. This type of transformation is called Partial Transformation. Select 2 Partial Transformations, which you can access. By spending 2 Inner Chi and a Bonus Action, you transform part of your body into the listed animal for up to 1 minute. You can select an additional 2 Partial Transformations at 15th level.

#### Golden Strands
7th Level Clan Feature
The strands of hair on a Shi Hou’s head and body carry the spirit of their powerful ancestry, allowing them to be expended for a multitude of uses.
By spending 1 Inner Chi, you can as a Bonus Action, pluck a strand of your hair, and transform it into any non-consumable item with a Bulk of 3 or less, with a quality no higher than Greater. If you create an item with charges, it has a single charge. Items summoned this way exist and persist for no longer than 1 minute.
#### Primal Vanity
11th Level Clan Feature
The Shi Hou clan are often seen as very self-reliant. So instead of reaching a hand out for others to let them down, they instead look inward and ask themselves to do more.
As an Action, by spending 2 Inner Chi, you can summon up to four Clones as if you cast the Shadow Clone Technique Ninjutsu at A-Rank. Clones summoned this way have a number of additional hit points and temporary hit points, equal to your level. These clones regain temporary hit points equal to your level, at the beginning of each of your turns.
#### Nirvana
15th Level Clan Feature
You can unleash all of your Inner Chi, wrapping it around your body like a cloak of chakra, entering a state of focus. Once per long rest, at the beginning of your turn, you can spend 4 Inner Chi. When you do, for the next minute, you enter a state of Nirvana.
## Yoton Clan
A Chunin male is training in the desert tundra’s, of the land of Earth. The Jonin Exams are quickly approaching and he wants to be absolutely sure he is prepared. He has some of his allies stand ready to assist him in this endeavor. One of his allies draws their Tetsubo and begins to attack with reckless abandon. The Chunin quickly weaves hand seals before conjuring a wall of earth blocking his Tetsubo assault. His second sparring partner responds by conjuring a jolt of Lightning that the Chunin responds to in kind by conjuring a mote of magma and firing it to clash with the Lightning.
—Vale Uchiha
At Worlds End, Ch. 21 excerpt.
### Blood of the Earth
The Yoton Clan is a clan that hails from the land of Earth. A Clan without a clear family name, but one which has produced many of prominent shinobi. This clan has an extreme affinity for Earth and Fire Release, mixing them, and creating the ability to conjure and use Lava as both an offensive and Defensive force. Their power is well respected, with one of their members being chosen as a jinchūriki for the Four-Tails.
### Yoton Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Con
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Nature, Survival
Lava Release Affinity: You begin with either Earth or Fire Release Affinity. (Pick one)
Lava Techniques: The Yoton clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s). They do not need both nature releases to use their clan jutsu.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Futton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Constitution as its casting ability score.
Thermal Acclimation: You have advantage on checks made to resist extreme heat environments.
Thermal Attunement: You can sense sources of heat such as fire, lava, or any substance whose heat could burn. You become aware of them and can track them down to their location within 120 feet of you, even through walls up to 1 foot thick.
[BOX]
| #### Molten Terrain / Special Terrain / Molten Terrain. Creatures attempting to move through a space marked as Molten terrain, every foot of movement in that space costs 1 extra foot. This effect is cumulative with difficult terrain and other special terrains. |
[/BOX]
### Yoton Features
#### Magma Domain
1st Level Clan Feature
The Yoton clan are a varied and truly unique clan within the land of Earth. Often mistaken for 4 different clans, due to the variety of techniques available to them. You are able to utilize one of the many variants of Lava release. Select one Magma Variant. This cannot be changed later. Hijutsu you cast or maintain use your Magma Variant’ listed abilities. You can select another variant at 7th and 15th levels. If you select a Variant you already previously selected, you gain its listed Intensity I ability. You gain their Intensity II ability if you select the same variant a 3rd time. Magma Variant abilities use your highest jutsu save DC for effects that call for it.
Regardless of the Magma Variant you have, they all have the following ability;
Molten Terrain. As a Bonus Action you can select a point you can see no more than 60 feet away and make a 10-foot cube, centered on this point becomes Molten Terrain. You can only have 1 active Molten Terrain at once. This increases to 2 at 11th level. Molten Terrain, lasts for 1 minute. Placing more Molten Terrain, than you can maintain dispels the oldest Molten Terrain, currently active.
Onyx
You can reshape the environment into one where you have the advantage. Once per turn, as part of casting a Hijutsu, or as a Bonus action, you can select a point you can see within 30 feet of you, as a shard of Onyx erupts from the point, radiating your molten chakra for the next minute. You can only have 1 Onyx shard active at a time. Conjuring more than you can currently maintain, dispels the oldest shard All creatures within 10 feet of this shard of onyx make saving throws against effects that reduce their speed, Grapple, Restrain or knock them Prone at disadvantage. Increase the number of Onyx you can have active by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.
Intensity I: Onyx that you conjure also become Earthen Artifacts. Additionally, hostile creatures that cast a Barrier within your Onyx’s aura has its cost increased by +8.
Intensity II: While you have two or more Onyx shards active, and standing in the aura generated by both at the same time, you gain resistance to the first instance of damage you take each turn.
Quicklime
[BOX]
| Molten / [Elemental] / A Molten creature is coated in molten rock and fire, setting them up for cataclysmic elemental reactions. Once a creature takes one of the listed elemental damage types this condition applies the listed effect. / This condition ends at the end of the affected creature’s next turn unless otherwise specified. / A Molten creature that takes earth damage, has the molten matter on them harden, reducing their speed by half and they cannot cast jutsu with the M (mobility) component until the end of their next turn. / A Molten creature that takes wind damage, has the molten matter on them burst, spreading to all creatures within 10 feet of them, applying the Burned condition. This condition then immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes fire damage has the molten material heat up radiating extreme heat, applying 2 ranks of the Burned condition. This condition then immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes cold damage has their body become brittle, becoming vulnerable to the next instance of Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage they take. If they take Bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage before the end of their next turn, this condition immediately ends. / A Molten creature that takes lightning damage has lightning arc to all creatures within 10 feet of them, applying the Shocked condition. This condition then immediately ends. / Creatures that are immune to Fire and Earth damage is immune to this condition. |
[/BOX]
You can reshape the environment into one where hostile creatures can’t move freely. Molten Terrain you conjure increase their size by +5 feet and the number of Molten Terrains you can maintain by +1. Increase the size of your Molten Terrain by an additional +5 at 7th and 15th levels.
Intensity I: Hostile creatures that that would attempt to leave your Molten Terrain, must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they cannot move into a space unaffected by your Molten Terrain until the end of the current turn.
Intensity II: Hostile creatures that cast a jutsu with the HS (Hand Sign) component while under the effects of a Hijutsu you cast, must first make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, their jutsu casting is Interrupted.
Volcanic
You can reshape the environment into one where wading through it is actively detrimental. When a creature first enters your Molten Terrain they make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they become Molten.
Intensity I: If you cast a jutsu with the Earth or Fire release keywords that affect an area, and their effect area crossed your Molten Terrain, the area they affect increases in size by +10 feet.
Intensity II: When you create Molten Terrain as a Bonus Action, increase its size by +10 feet. Additionally, creatures within 5 feet of the selected point makes the next saving throw they make vs a jutsu with the Fire or Earth release keywords at disadvantage, before the beginning of your next turn.
Rubber
You can reshape the environment into one where it protects you and your allies. Jutsu you cast with the Fire or Earth release keywords, with a range of Self, that provides you temporary hit points, DR, or summons a Barrier, for you, gin a range of 30 feet and can be cast targeting a willing allied creature, applying its effect to the select creature as if they cast it. Additionally, Earthen Artifacts, within your Molten Terrain, that don’t have listed hit points, gain 20 hit points
Intensity I: Allied creatures within your Molten Terrain, have resistance to Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing and lightning damage. Additionally, by spending 4 of an Earthen Artifacts hit points that is within your Molten Terrain, you gain grant one allied creature, also within your Molten Terrain, one additional resistance that lasts until the beginning of your next turn.
Intensity II: If you have an active Earthen Artifact that has its own hit points, allied creatures within your Molten Terrain that take damage, can have up to half of the damage they take, transferred to the Earthen Artifact. If the damage they would transfer to the Earthen Artifact would exceed its current hit points, any remaining transferred damage goes back to the original ally.

#### Scorched Foundation
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your ability to superheat the environment around you in a variety of ways, modulating your Molten Terrain, in a variety of ways, causing it to have a variety of effects based on your choices, first of which is granting allied creatures immunity to the harmful effects of your Molten Terrain. Select three of the following Foundations. When you create Molten Terrain, you can choose two of your selected foundations, applying their effects to the Molten Terrain. You can select an additional foundations at 7th and 15th levels. If a foundation calls for a saving throw, use your highest jutsu save DC. If you have two or more foundations that require a saving throw, pick one saving throw between the two. If the affected creature fails, they suffer the effects of both.
Buoyant
The magma becomes semi-fluid, but supportive. Allied creatures that begin their turns on this terrain gain a +15 bonus to their speed, advantage on saving throws to resist being forcefully moved or knocked Prone and hostile creatures cannot take attacks of opportunity against their movement.
Dense
Structures and Barriers summoned/conjured as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Earth or Fire release keywords on this terrain gain 4 DR. This increases to 8 DR at 7th and 12 DR at 15th level.
Obscuring
Blazing heat shimmer distorts perception. This terrain is treated as lightly obscured for creatures not standing on it. Beginning at 11th level, hostile creatures cannot target creatures with attacks standing on this terrain, unless they are also within the area of the terrain.
Reactive Heat
Once per turn, hostile creatures that take Acid, Earth or Fire damage while on this terrain, causes the terrain to erupt with volatile energy, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain a rank of Burn.
Rubbery
Allied creatures that take damage while standing on this terrain have some of the harm they suffer shared with the terrain. They take 4 less damage. This increases to 8 damage at 7th level and 12 damage at 15th level.

You gain the following benefits for the duration; / You gain a +2 Bonus to your AC. / When you create a Molten Terrain, as a result of the Magma Domain feature, you can creature 2 Molten Terrains simultaneously. / Hostile creatures that deal damage to you as a result of a melee attack, takes 10 fire damage. / Difficult terrain you create using jutsu with the Earth Release keyword can be treated as Molten Terrain. / When you inflict ranks of Burned as a result of a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, you can instead inflict the Molten condition. |
[/BOX]
Scalding
Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain take 1d6 fire damage. This increases to 3d6 at 7th level and 5d6 at 15th level.
Shifting
The terrain becomes a siphon, draining energy, stamina and heat. Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they make concentration checks at disadvantage and increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.
Sticky
Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, their speed is reduced by 15 feet and they cannot take the Dash, Disengage or Dodge actions until the end of their next turns.
Toxic
Once per turn, hostile creatures that take Wind, Poison or Necrotic damage while on this terrain, causes the terrain to erupt with volatile energy, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain a rank of Envenomed.
#### Lava Release Manifestation
7th Level Clan Feature
The Yoton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Lava Release due to their close affinity to both Fire and Earth Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Lava Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Fire Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Earth or Fire respectively.
Also, when encountering a seal or barrier, formed of a jutsu or effect meant to impede someone from progressing forward or through it, you can spend 10 minutes pouring your Magma release chakra into it, causing it to crack, and splinter until you destroy it at the end of the duration. You can only destroy seals or barriers in this way or a Rank equal to the highest rank jutsu your class allows for your level. For barriers and seals of a higher rank, you can make an ability check using your highest jutsu modifier, vs the Standard Jutsu DC of the target barrier or seal.

#### Lava Chakra Mode
11th Level Clan Feature
The Yoton clan has had a secret technique for generations. For most Yoton, this becomes their ultimate expression of combat genius. But for you, it is simply a stepping stone for what comes next. But this stepping stone isn’t small nor minor. This is the ultimate for the clan. You learn to excrete magma chakra from your very pores, coating yourself in lava, until it forms armor. Both protecting and enhancing you.
As a Bonus action, you can enter your Lava Chakra Mode for the next minute. Once you enter this state, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.
Alternatively, by standing within two overlapping Molten Terrain’s while in combat, you can spend a Bonus action, dispelling both and entering Lava Chakra Mode. You can only enter Lava Chakra mode in this way, once per long rest.
#### World Forge
15th Level Clan Feature
You have dominion over your own reality. Your own domain. Your own world. You have gone beyond what other Yoton’s have found to be the peak. You have gone beyond that. You have found your zenith.
As an Action, you create a massive aura of raw magma chakra that radiates out from you in a 40-foot radius for the next minute, centered on you as you become a Forge of change. For the duration, this aura has the following benefits;
All terrain within this radius becomes Molten Terrain.
You can apply up to 4 Foundations at once to your Molten Terrain.
At the beginning of each creature with the Molten conditions turn, you gain 10 Temporary hit points.

Description: You punch the ground and conjure an eruption of lava and magma, enough to fill a 45-foot cube originating from you. All creatures in range, must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 3d10 Fire and 3d10 Earth damage and are Molten until the end of your next turn and Bruised on a failed save. Creatures who succeed, take half damage and no further effects. Creatures in range repeat this saving throw at the beginning of each of your turns.
Additionally, the affected area becomes Molten Terrain for the duration.
If this jutsu is cast while you are in your Lava Chakra Mode state, it can be cast as a Bonus Action.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, damage by 1d10 for each damage type, and the cube size by 5 feet.

# Land of Lightning Clan
## Chinoike Clan
"You're going to tell me everything you know or else!" The Mist captain yells at a wounded farmer, pointing a sword at his neck. The farmer appears to be in a trance. Beneath their feet lie the bodies of warriors who tried fighting off the mist shinobi. The farmer gives no answer. "Ugh! This guy is useless! Tonima, use your genjutsu to figure out where those Anbu went!" "On it boss!" Tonima moves towards the old man and weaves the signs to enter his mind. Near instantaneously, Tonima is surrounded by a pool of red water and is greeted by a pair of ominous black and red eyes in the sky. He recoils in horror in a pool of sweat. Before the captain and the other squad can ask what is wrong, a voice can be heard in the distance. "You mist shinobi really are all brawn no brain." A man walks from behind the trees and faces towards the Mist. As the Mist began exclaiming as the mysterious figure, the man calmly responds. "The residents of this village died a long time ago." The eyes of the man turn black with an ominous red as the corpses and the wounded villager begin rapidly producing a black, cancerous growth from their bodies. In a flash, the bodies erupt, turning the Mist to ash."                                                                                     -Kikushi Uchiha
The Long Road, Ch. 30 excerpt.
### Blood Architects
The Chinoike is a clan that was active in the land of lightning then exiled to the valley of hell in the land of hot water which then led to peace for generations until a civil war broke out and many of the Chinoike clan died. In the present day, only a few Chinoike remain, scattered throughout the world.
### Chinoike Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis or Int, +1 Dex
Speed: You base walking speed is 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Medicine
Blood Release Affinity: You begin with the Water release or Medical release affinity (Pick one).
Chinoike Techniques: The Chinoike have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Chinoike Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
[BOX]
| #### Ketsuryugan / Will Amp / Your Ketsuryugan grants you the following bonuses; / Crimson Sight. You gain 30-Feet of Blood Sight, a unique special sense, that allows you to perceive creatures that have iron in their Blood (Humans, Animals etc.), even if they are invisible. This special sense does not penetrate walls or barriers. This increases to 60-feet at 11th level. / Blood As A Resource. If you or another creature has ranks of Bleed within 30 feet of you when you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword, you can consume 1 rank of Bleed to gain the benefit of a sufficient source of water, where applicable. / Lifeforce Casting. When you cast a Chinoike Hijutsu, you can spend 2 Crimson Charges to use its Blood Detonation effect. |
[/BOX]
### Chinoike Features
#### Ketsuryugan
1st Level Clan Feature
[Dojutsu]
One of the Hidden Cloud villages noble Dojutsu. The Ketsuryugan is an eye of fearsome power and potent illusory skill. You gain access to the Ketsuryugan. You may, as a bonus action, activate this Dojutsu, which remains active for up to 1o minutes at a time, after which, you require at least 10 minutes of non-use before you can activate it again.
Your Ketsuryugan grants some passive bonuses, but also adapts to your unique fighting style via special techniques known as Crimson Evocations. You begin with 2 such Crimson Evocations that you can only use while your Ketsuryugan is active. You can only use these abilities by spending Crimson Charges. You have a number of Crimson Charges equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You gain additional Crimson Evocations at 7th and 15th level. You regain all spent Crimson Charges when you complete a rest.
Bloody Resilience
Internal or biological attacks are far less effective against someone who can control their own blood. By spending 1 Crimson Charge, at the beginning of your turn, for the next minute, you gain resistance to Acid, Poison and Necrotic damage and effects that would inflict the Bleed or Envenomed conditions.
Beginning at 7th level, you can instead select one willing allied creature within 30 feet of you and spend 1 Crimson Charge, granting them the effects of this evocation for the next minute. You can only affect up to two creatures, including yourself, at once. Using this on an additional creatures ends the oldest active effect.
Beginning at 15th level, when you or a creature within 30 feet of you has ranks of Bleed, you can spend 1 Crimson Charge, to reduce the ranks of Bleed the select creature has to 0. Then you roll 1d8 for every rank removed, gaining temporary hit points equal to the result.
Cold Blooded
Water release jutsu you cast is infused with your blood, turning it crimson red. Each time you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword; you can spend 1 Crimson Charge. When you do, its damage type becomes Necrotic and affected creatures with ranks of Bleed suffers a penalty to their saving throws against the cast jutsu, equal to the ranks of Bleed they have.
Beginning at 11th level, creatures that fail their saving throw vs a Hijutsu you cast, has their circulatory network infiltrated by spending 2 Crimson Charges, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are Stunned until the end of their next turn. A creature Stunned in this way cannot be affected by this feature moving forward until you complete a rest.
Circulatory Supercharge
You can supercharge the circulation of blood in yourself or allied creatures by infusing your chakra into their circulatory system. As an Action, by spending 2 Crimson Charges, you release a pulse of chakra in a 20-foot radius, centered on you, affecting all willing allied creatures of your choice within range. Affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to their AC, a +20 bonus to their speed, and gain the Surge special action until the beginning of your next turn.
Surge. You can use this special on your turn to take the Dash or Disengage actions or make one Unarmed or Weapon attack.
Beginning at 7th level, all affected creatures also gain a rank of Mastery to their attacks for the same duration.
Beginning at 15th level, creature can use the Surge special action to fulfil a feature, jutsu or ability that requires an Action to use. If they do, they gain 2 ranks of Exhaustion.
Life Force Drain
Water and Medical release jutsu you cast no longer relies on your blood to amplify it alone. You can instead siphon the lifeforce of enemies it affects. When you cast a Jutsu with the Water or Medical release keywords, you can spend your Bonus Action and 1 Crimson Charge to mold any excess chakra to drain the life from enemies. When you do, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level and affected creatures must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. If your jutsu already forces a saving throw, then this effect also applies on a failure. On a failure they take Chakra damage equal to the amount of temporary hit points you gain, and you gain temporary chakra equal to the result.
Beginning at 11th level, you learn to drain the chakra from barriers, reappropriating their strength for your own uses. When you use this feature and the target creature is protected by a Barrier with hit points, you can spend 1 additional Crimson Charge, to reduce its hit points by an amount equal to your level. When you do, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level, instead of only your level.
Mental Acuity Boost
You learn to safely increase the flow of blood to the Brain, to increase the targets ability to think and react mentally. When you or an allied creature within 30 feet of you would fail a saving throw, you can spend 2 Crimson Charges, to boost the brain processing power of the affected creature. When you do, they gain a rank of Mastery to their saves result and can move up to half of their speed away from the source of whatever harmed them.
Beginning at 7th level, this increases to two ranks of Mastery to the failed save and if they take psychic damage, they gain temporary hit points equal to half the psychic damage took for the next minute.
Beginning at 15th level, if the failed save would inflict ranks of a Mental condition, you can spend 1 additional Crimson Charge, to reduce the ranks of each Mental condition gained by 2.
Sanguine Illusions
You learn to channel Genjutsu through blood just as well as you can through the eyes. When you cast a Genjutsu with the Visual sensory keyword, you can spend 1 Crimson Charge as part of that casting, to change that sensory keyword to Inhale. When you do, the saving throw instead becomes Constitution and on a failure, they also gain 1 rank of Bleed, as blood begin to leak from their eyes, ears, nose or mouth.
Beginning at 11th level, when a creature fails their saving throw vs a Genjutsu you cast with the Inhale keyword, for the duration of that Genjutsu, each time they cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, they must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Bleed on a failure.
Illusory Pain Receptor
You learn to amplify every sensation an enemy feels from long lasting damage. As a Bonus action, select one creature you can see within 60 feet of you, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, for the next minute, damage they take as the result of a Condition they have, is increased by +2, for each rank they have. This increases to +4 at 15th level.
#### Crimson Weaponry
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Chinoike clan are one of the original noble clans tied to the Daimyo of the land of lightning, known for their unique ability to manipulate iron rich liquids, such as blood, their techniques are often infused with the Land of Lightnings philosophy of martial skill. When initiative is rolled, you can create a small incision on yourself, deep enough to draw blood, but otherwise harmless.
If you do, you can select one weapon from the Blade, Thrown, or Flail weapon groups and conjure this weapon, formed entirely of your blood. This weapon gains the Critical and Blood Bound weapon properties and you become proficient in it for the remainder of initiative. If the weapon has the ammunition property, and it cannot be reduced in size, below a d8.
The Blood Bound Weapon property is a unique property unique to weapons formed with this feature.
Blood Bound. Weapons with this property can be used to make weapon attacks using the ability modifier as chosen by your Hijutsu Flexibility clan trait and you cannot be disarmed of this weapon. Other creatures attempting to wield this weapon has it dissolve into a pool of blood. This weapon can be used in place of a Combat Scroll to qualify for a Chakra Stance and if you cast a Bukijutsu with this weapon of C-Rank or lower, you can use either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu ability modifier, once per turn.
#### Crimson Release Manifestation
7th Level Clan Feature
The Chinoike clan has a unique talent for manifesting their Blood manipulation and Ketsuryugan bloodline limit, which grants them a close affinity with both Water and Medical Release. You gain the second release you didn’t select from Blood Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Water or Medical release keywords, you can change the damage type to necrotic.
Also, you’ve learned to isolate toxins and foreign substances within blood. By spending 1 minute focusing on a creature that is Envenomed, suffering from a disease or infected with some special substance or virus, you can extract it from them, ending whatever hostile or negative effects they could be suffering from as a result.
#### Crimson Pact
11th Level Clan Feature
[BOX]
| #### Crimson Pact / Fortitude Amp / You are under a bond of blood. You gain the following benefits; / Bonded Ally. You can sense the direction of the other creature with the matching Crimson Pact so long as they are within 10 miles of you. You also become aware if they are dead, without chakra or have Physical conditions. / Blood of my Blood. While within 60 feet of your matching Crimson Pact, if either of you regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu’s casting, the other creature gains temporary hit points equal to the result of Hit points gained, which last for 1 minute. / Bonded Lifeforce. If you fall to 0 hit points, your matching Crimson Pact can reduce their maximum hit points by 20 until you both complete a long rest. If they do, you instead fall to 20 hit points. |
[/BOX]
By leaving traces of your chakra within the blood of your allies, you can form a bond of blood with them known as a Crimson Pact. This Crimson Pact is represented as a special marking on the bonded creature of either of your designs, in a place where blood flows strongest (chest, wrist, neck, back, etc.). You can perform this ritual over the course of a Long Rest with a willing creature you can reach. You can only have one creature actively Bonded at a time.
While bonded both you and the allied creature gain the Crimson Pact status. If either creature willingly dismisses the bond, dies, or is the target of an effect that can dispel a Jutsu of B-Rank or lower, this effect ends on them.
#### Crimson Architect
15th Level Clan Feature
[BOX]
| #### Crimson Pact / Fortitude Amp / You are under a bond of blood. You gain the following benefits; / Bonded Ally. You can sense the direction of the other creature with the matching Crimson Pact so long as they are within 10 miles of you. You also become aware if they are dead, without chakra or have Physical conditions. / Blood of my Blood. While within 60 feet of your matching Crimson Pact, if either of you regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu’s casting, the other creature gains temporary hit points equal to the result of Hit points gained, which last for 1 minute. / Bonded Lifeforce. If you fall to 0 hit points, your matching Crimson Pact can reduce their maximum hit points by 20 until you both complete a long rest. If they do, you instead fall to 20 hit points. |
[/BOX]
You shower the battlefield in your ichor, baptizing everything in blood. While you have your Ketsuryugan active, you can, spend 1 action to build your Crimson Domain. You can use this feature once per long rest.
When you do, you radiate chakra and blood droplets a 40-foot radius, centered on you, for the next minute. For the duration you gain the following;
Creatures with ranks of Bleed that are in the radius, that would regain hit points, instead regains half of the listed amount. You gain the remaining half.
Creatures with ranks of Bleed that begin their turn in this radius must move at least 30 feet, fully circulating their own blood, or they lose their Reaction until the beginning of their next turn.
When an allied creature gains hit points or temporary hit points, you can select one other allied or willing creature and they gain half of the hit points or temporary hit points gained.
When a creature with 2 or more ranks of Bleed would move into a space not within your domain, you can spend your Reaction, to reduce their remaining speed to 0, and then they must move 15 feet closer to you.

Classification: Hijutsu

Blinding Bubble. Select one creature within 60 feet of you that you can see and direct the bubble towards them, as it pops in their face, getting blood in their eye. The target creature must make a Constitution saving throw, being Blinded on a failure until the end of their next turn.
Drowning Bubble. Select one creature within 60 feet of you that you can see and direct the bubble towards them, as it surrounds their head, drowning them in blood. The target creature must make a Constitution saving throw, being Dazed and falling Prone on a failure as the bubble then pops.
Slime Bubble. Select one point you can see within 60 feet of you that you can see as you direct the bubble to this point as it then pops, releasing slimy blood that traps creatures within 5 feet of the chosen point, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, their speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.

Drift Bubble. You encircle yourself with your Blood Bubble and begin to float like a bubble in the wind. You gain a 60-foot fly speed, that lasts until the end of your next turn. If you take damage before the end of your next turn, the bubble pops and you lose this flying speed.
Shield Bubble. This jutsu can be cast a Reaction, to yourself or an allied creature within 10 feet taking damage. When you do, the target creature gains 20 + 4d6 temporary hit points until the beginning of your next turn.

### Let there be light
Tag: Setting Agnostic, Creator: Artemys, Mr. Hey
Members of the Keton clan have the unique Plasma release. A powerful combination of Fire and Lightning that grants both devastating and bright shows of power. The clans special release is often called Light release by onlookers and in general social circles. The Keton clan formally works as the Land of Lightnings Storm guard, similar to the Land of Fires Military Police Force, acting as the Cloud villages internal force for law and order.
### Keton Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Cha
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Performance, Chakra Control
Plasma Release Affinity: You begin with either Fire or Lightning Release Affinity. (Pick One)
Plasma Techniques: The Keton Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Keton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.
Enlightening Grasp: The Keton clan has the ability to produce light in any object you touch. As a bonus action, you can place your palm on an object no larger than 5 feet in any dimension. For the next 10 minutes, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. If the object is completely covered in something opaque, the light is blocked. An object cannot be enhanced in this way more than once every hour due to the stress this chakra places on them. You can dismiss the light from as many objects you have affected with this feature at no action.
### Keton Features
#### Stargazer
1st Level Clan Feature
The Keton clan is known as the guiding light within the Land of Lightning. Its north star. The clan achieves this by harnessing the power of Plasma, also known as Stellar Light. You embody this by placing your beacons of light around a battlefield and becoming your teams North Star.
While in combat, once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, you can select a point you can see within 30 feet of you and manifest Starlight, at a chosen point for up to 1 minute. This Starlight is a floating construct of plasma formed of your chakra that sheds a bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
You can maintain up to 4 Starlight’s at once and they are dispelled when combat ends, you spend a Bonus action to dismiss them or you end your movement further than 120 feet away from them. If you create an additional Starlight beyond what you can maintain, the oldest Starlight is dispelled. Effects that can dispel jutsu of the highest rank you can cast, based on your character level can dispel Starlight’s you place. Increase the number of Starlight you can maintain by +1 at 7th and 15th levels. Increase the range you can place a Starlight to 60 feet at 11th level.
While you have Starlight active, you can choose to spend a Bonus action to enter your Solar Flare chakra stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;
Keton Hijutsu you cast that makes a ranged attack, or ranged attacks you make with the Plasma Burst attack, can originate from one of your active Starlight’s.
When you take the Attack action while in this stance, you can replace attacks made with this action with either a Stellar Knuckle or Plasma Burst attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks with either of these attacks, instead of one.
Stellar Knuckle. Make a melee attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus as the limb you strike with is imbued with Plasma energy. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + your jutsu ability modifier in fire damage.
Plasma Burst. Make a ranged attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet as you fire a bolt of plasma like chakra at a creature. On a hit you deal 1d12 fire damage.
#### Stellar Convergence
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Keton clan is not just able to wield light, they become it. They are able to illuminate and obliterate anything in their path to victory. You learn to harness this willpower and fighting spirit, in the form of Stellar Charges, releasing it as precise bursts of plasma.
You have a number of Stellar Charges equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You begin combat with 0 Stellar Charges, and you cannot gain them outside of combat. You can gain 1 Stellar Charges per trigger, per turn, from the following;
When you deal damage to a hostile creature.
When you take damage from a hostile creature.
When you begin your turn and maintain concentration on a Keton Hijutsu.
You provide a bonus to an allied creatures attack or damage rolls.
You can spend Stellar Charges, on Constellations, of which you begin with 2. You gain an additional Constellation at 7th and 15th level. Constellations that force a saving throw or make an attack, use your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus for its calculation.
Sazanami – The Ripple
Your light radiates like ripples in the sky, supercharging a Starlight in range. As a bonus action, by spending 2 Stellar Charges you can select one Starlight you have active, as it becomes supercharged and flashes a blinding unstable white light. All creatures within 10 feet of this Starlight must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Dazzled and becomes a Convergence for the next minute.
Beginning at 7th level, you can select two different Starlight’s as this abilities point of origin. Beginning at 15th level, creatures that fail, gain 2 ranks of Dazzled.
Urashima – The Fisherman
You can direct the radiance of your starlight’s towards an ally, marking them as your bait for the next fish caught in your trap. As a bonus action, by spending 1 Stellar Charges you can select one allied creature within 60 feet of you. Until the beginning of your next turn, that ally begins glowing with a soft plasma like light and can reroll one attack roll or check they make, taking the new result. If a hostile creature makes a melee attack against the chosen ally, all Starlight’s within 60 feet can trigger at your discretion. If you let them, you can spend your reaction, and all Starlight’s fire a Plasma Burst, at the triggering creature. Make an attack for each triggering Starlight.
Beginning at 7th level, the select ally gains a +2 bonus to their AC and their next saving throw for the duration. Beginning at 15th level, You can target two allies with this feature, instead of one. You also gain an additional Reaction, which you can only use to trigger this features Starlight attacks.
Kagayaki – The Glittering
The light you manifest begins to glitter as you bend it around an ally, guiding them to victory. As a bonus action, by spending 2 Stellar Charge you can select one allied creature within 60 feet of you. That ally can move up to their speed, and then can spend their Reaction to cast a Jutsu of their choice. If the jutsu forces a saving throw, on a failure against a hostile creature, on a failure the hostile creature becomes a Convergence for the next minute. If the jutsu does not force a saving throw but still affects a hostile creature, then the hostile creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they become a Convergence for the next minute.
Beginning at 7th level, the select ally creature can instead choose to spend 10 feet of their movement to teleport into a space closest to one of your Starlight’s. Beginning at 15th level, if you instead spend 3 Stellar Charges, to activate this Constellation it no longer costs a Bonus action, if you do, you cannot use this feature again the same turn.
Tokaichi – The Market
You bend a field of plasma around a hostile creature, attempting to escape from your radiance. As part of casting a Keton Hijutsu, you can reshape the jutsu’s range of effect by spending 2 Stellar Charges. Select one of the following shapes, all of which now originates from a Starlight of your choice, allowing your jutsu to now begin from unconventional locations. The new shape now forces all creatures in range make a Dexterity saving throw, suffering the effects of your chosen jutsu on a failure, or half damage (if any) on a success.
20-Foot Cube.
10-Foot Radius, that goes around corners.
30-Foot long, 5 foot wide, line.
30-foot cone.
Beginning at 7th level, you can place a Starlight as part of this Constellation. If you do, this effect originates from that new Starlight. Beginning at 15th level, if a creature making their saving throw is a Convergence, they make their saving throw at disadvantage, and doesn’t end the Convergence condition as normal.
Mikogami – The Shrine Maiden
You scatter your Plasma energy into a diffuse haze of light and interference, obscuring your allies from hostile perception. As a reaction to an allied creature taking damage from an attack, you can spend 2 Stellar Charges, to spread this blinding light between your ally and the triggering creature. Roll 1d6, reducing the triggering attack total by the result, potentially causing the attack to miss. If the triggering attack is part of a jutsu with multiple attacks, all subsequent attacks that are part of the jutsu takes a 1d4 penalty to their attack results.
Beginning at 7th level, If the result on the d6 is a 6, then the attacking creature becomes a Convergence for the next minute. Beginning at 15th level, the subsequent attacks now roll a d6 penalty, instead of a d4.

You compress and release built up stellar energy into bursts of power. When you take the Attack action and make a Stellar Knuckle or Plasma Burst attack or cast a Keton Hijutsu that deals damage, you can spend 1 Stellar Charge to magnify their power. Increase the damage you deal with them by +2, until the end of the current turn. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.
Aphelion – The Mirror
You channel compressed Plasma into a shield of light, protecting yourself or an allied creature from fatal harm. Increase the temporary hit points gained to 5d6 at 7th level and 7d6 at 15th level.

#### Plasma Release Manifestation
7th Level Clan Feature
The Keton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Plasma Release due to their close affinity to both Fire and Lightning Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Plasma Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Fire or Lightning release keywords, you can change the damage type to Fire or Lightning respectively.
Additionally, you exemplify your clans principles and status as a guiding light. The North star for your team. When socializing with creatures native to the Land of Lightning or with knowledge of your clans station in the Cloud village, you gain a 2 ranks of Mastery to all social checks made against them as you are able to lead the conversation with no fear of it falling apart.
#### Plasma Fission/Fusion
11th Level Clan Feature
You have learned to modify your Starlight’s to becomes beacons of your victory. Your Starlight’s now have two new states they can be in either Starlight Fission or Starlight Fusion. At the beginning of your turn, instead of creating a new Starlight, you can choose to select a currently active Starlight to enter either its Fission or Fusion state. Either form
Starlight Fission. Your Starlight becomes an unstable mass of energy, that bubbles and looks to be going nuclear until the beginning of your next turn, after which, it explodes. All hostile creatures that begin their turn within 20 feet of the chosen Starlight are hit with a wave of chakra fueled radiation, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain Convergence, and either 3 ranks of Dazzled, Weakened, or Concussed. At the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Starlight explodes, filling a 20-foot radius, forcing all creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire or lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Starlight Fusion. You select two active Starlight’s, as they are attracted to one another, and begin to fuse, becoming a super mote until the beginning of your next turn. Select a new point within 120 feet of you, where both Starlight’s converge upon. This new Fused Starlight, glows bright light in a 40-foot radius, and dim light for an additional 40 feet. Effects that originate from this Fused Starlight gain a rank of Mastery to its attack result, and a +1 bonus to its Save DC. You can increase this bonus to 2 ranks of Mastery and a +2 bonus by fusing one additional active Starlight.
#### Event Horizon
15th Level Clan Feature
You have become not just the guiding light, but instead the gold standard within your clan. Your control, power and skill with Plasma release is unmatched. You have found a way to make your body act as a focal point similar to that of actual stars. By spending a Bonus Action, 4 Stellar Charges, and consuming up to 4 Starlight’s your body becomes wreathed in superheated plasma chakra as you reach an Event Horizon only dreamed of. You remain in this Event Horizon state for up to 1 minute. Each Starlight consumed is dispelled. Once you exit this state you cannot reenter it until you complete a long rest.
