## Ranton Clan
A Jonin wearing the Cloud Villages vest, being confronted by an adversarial village as he’s been caught alone without any allies to back him up. He tries to make a move to escape, but he is quickly stopped by more enemies around him. “You think it was smart to go out alone huh?” the enemy shinobi speaks rather directly and aggressively. The Jonin grits his teeth, before he quickly weaves hand seals. The adversarial shinobi leaps back scattering in random directions saying “Can’t Fire in unorthodox directions now can Y~”. They are quickly cut off by beams of bending Lightning that tears through them all.
—Ren Nara
At Worlds End, Ch. 7 excerpt.
### Laser Focused
The Ranton Clan is a clan that hails proudly from the Land of Lightning. Known to work closely with the Raikage, but not limited to that one country. Their bloodline has spread widely throughout the continent, they are for sure reliable allies, and even greater enemies. When given a task, they are usually focused to a fault, on accomplishing a goal.
### Ranton Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex, +1 int
Speed: 35 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Nature, (Athletics or Chakra Control, pick one).
Storm Release Affinity: You begin with either Water or Lightning Release affinity. (Pick one)
Storm Techniques: The Ranton Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s). They do not need both Nature Release’s to use their Clan jutsu.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Ranton Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Branch Family: The Ranton are split between two different branches, the [Storm Branch] and the [Reezaa Branch]. The storm branch are warrior who enhance their physical body with lightning release, in the form of a chakra cloak reinforcing their durability and strength. The Reezaa branch is capable of creating flexible beams of energy that can curve and shift direction. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later
### Ranton Features
#### Gale Style
1st Level Clan Feature, [Reezaa Branch]
Lightning is many things, if not predicable. But your job is to make the lightning unpredictable. You know how to shift the consistency of lightning into that of water, allowing you to bend beams of energy around corners. This is represented by a unique for of combat that your branch of the clan can utilize, your Laser Circus Chakra stance.
As a bonus action, you can enter this Laser Circus chakra stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;
When you take the attack action or cast a Ranton Clan Hijutsu that requires an attack, you can choose to replace any number of attacks made with the action with a Laser Circus attack. Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack feature, when you take the Attack action while in this stance, you can attack twice with your Laser Circus attack, instead of once. Beginning at 15th level, you can attack three times instead of twice.
Laser Circus. Make a ranged jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, dealing 1d10 lightning damage on a hit. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, the target creature is marked as a Refraction Point.
#### Storm Incarnate
1st Level Clan Feature, [Storm Branch]
The legacy of the Raikage flows through your veins. You may be a decedent or student, but it flows through you the same. Others use Lightning as a weapon, you have learned to use it as your shield, and sword. This is represented by a unique battle form where you augment yourself in a coat of lightning, your Storm Force state.
When you enter initiative, you can activate your Storm Force state, which has two variants, the Spear and Shield forms, which lasts until the end of combat. You choose which form you enter at the beginning of combat, and can switch your chosen form as a Bonus action on your turn.
While in your Storm Force state, you build Voltage, a special resource that is stored as an electrical force within your body that you can convert into combat momentum. You begin each combat with 0 Voltage, and can build up to 4 Voltage. This increases to 5 at 7th and 6 at 15th levels. You can gain 1 Voltage per trigger, per turn, if you; Take damage from a hostile creature, deal lightning damage to a hostile creature or succeed on a saving throw vs a hostile effect. You can spend this Voltage when an effect calls for it.
Spear Form
Your attacks become the ultimate spear, able to penetrate any defense and overwhelm anyone that dares to try and clash with you. Your unarmed and weapon attacks can deal Lightning damage. Melee attacks you make as a result of Hijutsu you cast gain a +1 bonus to their attack rolls and a +2 bonus to their damage rolls. Beginning at 7th level, this expands to your Unarmed and Weapon attacks that deal Lightning damage as well. Beginning at 15th level, the bonus to attacks increases to +2 and the bonus to damage becomes +4.
Shield Form
Your lightning acts as the ultimate shield, covering your entire body, protecting you like a suit of armor. You gain resistance to Lightning damage, and temporary hit points equal to 4 times your current Voltage, at the beginning of each of your turns.
If you cast a jutsu with the Lightning or Water release keywords, on the turn you gain temporary hit points, you can gain additional temporary hit points equal to your current Voltage. This is in addition to the temporary hit points gained by this feature, up to twice per turn.
#### Gale Circuit
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Reezaa Branch]
Your precision with Storm release is amplified by your attention to detail. You have learned to bend, split and amplify your lightning release in ways that defy conventional geometry. This is represented as Circuits, of which you can select 2 from the following list. You gain 1 additional Circuit at 7th and 15th levels.
Rapid Fire
While in Laser Circus stance, if you take the Attack Action to make Laser Circus attacks, you can also spend your Bonus action, to make 1 additional Laser Circus attack. This increases to two attacks at 7th level and three attacks at 15th level.
[BOX]
| Refraction Point / [Elemental] / A creature marked as a Refraction Point has been saturated with Storm Release chakra, and their body acts as a Prism for the Laser Circus technique. / When a creature marked as a Refraction Point takes damage from a ranged attack as a result of a Ranton Hijutsu or a Laser Circus attack, the attack is refracted. The nearest creature within 30 feet of the Refraction Point, that is hostile to the Ranton that inflicted this condition becomes a target, immediately taking half the damage the Refraction Point took. This condition then immediately ends. / If a creature marked as a Refraction Point takes damage as a result of another creature that is marked as a Refraction Point, the next nearest creature takes damage equal to half the damage the original target took. This effect can only occur up to 4 times per turn. / The original Refraction Point, can never be affected by this chaining effect. / Creatures immune to both Lightning and Cold damage are immune to this condition. |
[/BOX]
Prismatic Split
When you score a hit with a Laser Circus attack against a creature marked as a Refraction Point, the creature affected by the Refraction Point damage chain is also marked as Refraction Point’s for the next minute.
Cold Snap
Once per turn, when you deal cold damage to a creature as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Water release keyword, you can spread water particles surrounding them until the end of your next turn. If you target this creature with a Laser Circus, the first missed attack can be remade as you refract the laser off of the scattered water particles.
Beginning at 7th level, if the water release jutsu cast deals damage and can inflict an Elemental condition, you can choose to instead mark the affected creature as a Refraction Point for the next minute, even if they pass their saving throw.
Static Arc
Once per turn, when you deal lightning damage to a creature, you can spend your Bonus action to release an arc of electricity targeting one creature you can see within 20 feet of the original target, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain the Shocked condition and are marked as a Refraction Point for the next minute.
Cascade
Once per turn, when you deal both Cold and Lightning damage to a creature, you can crystalize the charged lightning in the air around them. Until the end of your next turn, if that creature willingly moves more than 5 feet, or casts a jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, they take three times your Laser Circus attacks damage and must make a Constitution saving throw, being Stunned, until the end of their current turn on a failure.
Prismatic Overloads
As you strike the same creatures with Laser Circus attacks, they become charged with your electrical energy before it surges out in shockwave.
Once per turn at the conclusion of Laser Circus attacks as a result of your Action and Bonus action, count the number of successful attacks and inflict any one effect based on those successful attacks. If an effect forces a saving throw, use your highest jutsu save DC.
2+ Attacks: Once per turn, an affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, energy overloads, causing them to be Dazed and Weakened.
3+ Attacks: Once per turn, an affected creature becomes the center of a shape of your choice (20-foot radius, 30-foot cone, 60-foot long, 5-foot-wide line) The chosen shape erupts from them forcing all creatures in this new area to make a Dexterity saving throw, inflicting the Bruised and Slowed condition on a failure.
5+ Attacks: Once per turn, an affected creature is overwhelmed by the number of concurrent hits, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, being Stunned on a failure.
#### Storm Circuit
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Storm Branch]
Your connection to black lightning has deepened beyond the surface level Storm Force, your foes have come to know you for. You have learned to push your Storm Force state into specialized expressions, spending Voltage on different effects. Abilities that force saving throws use your highest jutsu save DC. This is represented as Circuits, of which you can select 2 from the following list. You gain 1 additional Circuit at 7th and 15th levels.
Black Thunder
Once per turn, on your turn, you can spend 1 Voltage. When you do, reduce your remaining speed by 10, and then select a space you can see within 30 feet of you, teleporting into the chosen space as a flash of lightning. Until the beginning of your next turn, the first attack made against you by a creature within 10 feet of the space you teleported to is made at disadvantage.
Beginning at 7th level, if you make a melee attack immediately after teleporting in this way, you make that first melee attack at advantage.
Grounded
While in your Storm Force state, by spending up to 4 Voltage, until the end of the current turn, ranged attacks that deal lightning or cold damage, that target an allied creature within 60 feet of you, can be rerouted to you, forcing the attack to instead be treated as if you were the original target.
Additionally, until the end of the current turn, you gain immunity to the Shocked and Chilled conditions and temporary hit points equal to 4 times the number of Voltage spent until the end of the current turn. This is in addition to any gained by the Shield Form.
Spear of Heaven
While you are in Spear Form, once per turn, as part of dealing damage with a melee Ninjutsu or Taijutsu attack that deals Lightning damage, you can spend 3 Voltage. If you do, you release a spike of electrical energy from your strike, forcing the target to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take an additional 2d6 lightning damage and are also Dazed, or half as much on a success. Beginning at 7th level, increase the bonus damage to 4d6 and the target is also Staggered. Beginning at 15th level, increase the bonus damage to 6d6 and lightning damage you deal as part of the triggering attack and this Circuit ignores resistance and treat immunity as resistance.
Shield of Thunder
While you are in Shield Form, once per turn, when you take damage as the result of an attack, you can spend your Reaction and 2 Voltage. When you do, you erect barriers of lightning in front of you, granting it 2d6 plus your level in hit points. This barrier lasts until the end of the current turn.
Beginning at 11th level, this barrier gains immunity to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
Storm Drain
As a Bonus action, by spending 2 Voltage, you can create a field of dominance around you, consuming all ranks of Shocked from all creatures within 30 feet of you. For every rank of Shocked consumed in this way, roll 1d4. You gain temporary chakra equal to the result, until the end of your next turn.
Beginning at 7th level, if a hostile creature in range is under the effect of a jutsu with the Lightning Release keyword, that is granting then a bonus or positive benefit, they must make a Constitution saving throw, having that effect dispelled on a failure.
Beginning at 15th level, if a hostile creature in range, is under the effect of a jutsu with a nature release keyword, they must make the Constitution saving throw.
Beast of Lightning
When you summon a creature as a result of a Jutsu you cast with the Lightning or Water Release keyword, by spending 2 Voltage as part of casting the triggering jutsu they surge with power, as they become pitch black and radiate with energy. For the summoned creatures duration, they gain additional hit points equal to your level, and +1 AC. This increases to +2 AC and Resistance to Earth and Fire damage at 7th level and +3 AC and Immunity to Elemental conditions at 15th level.
#### Storm Release Manifestation - Reezaa
7th Level Clan Feature, [Reezaa Branch]
The Ranton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Storm Release due to their close affinity to both Lightning and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Storm Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Cold or Lightning release keywords, you can change the damage type to Water or Lightning respectively.
Additionally, when you enter initiative, you can activate the Storm Force state, you can enter this Storm Force state, but you can only access the Spear Form which lasts until the end of combat. This version of the Spear Form does not gain the 7th or 15th level benefits for the feature.
#### Storm Release Manifestation - Storm
7th Level Clan Feature, [Storm Branch]
The Ranton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Storm Release due to their close affinity to both Lightning and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Storm Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Cold or Lightning release keywords, you can change the damage type to Cold or Lightning respectively.
Additionally, when you take the attack action or cast a Ranton Clan Hijutsu that requires an attack, you can choose to replace any number of attacks made with the action with a Laser Circus attack.
Laser Circus. Make a ranged jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, dealing 1d10 lightning damage on a hit. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, the target creature is marked as a Refraction Point.
#### Static Network
11th Level Clan Feature
You learn to weave invisible threads of storm release chakra between yourself and your allies, establishing an invisible communication network.
At the completion of a long rest, you and up to 5 allied creatures gain special chakra made communication devices infused into each creatures chakra network until your next long rest. Each creature with this network, can transmit things they say and hear to other creatures on this network so long as they are within 1 mile of them.
Additionally, while linked if any one creature would be Surprised, all other members are not surprised if part of the same initiative.
#### Eye of the Storm
15th Level Clan Feature
The most dangerous storms are the ones that form suddenly with no warning. You have learned to suppress the visible expression of your Storm Release entirely, spreading it across the battlefield, as you create a network of electrical nodes that only you can fully perceive.
As a Bonus action, you can activate this invisible network as you begin to control a 60-foot radius centered on you, for the next minute. This field moves with you and cannot be detected unless a creature has Chakra sense or Chakra sight. You can use this feature once per long rest.
For the duration you gain the following benefits:
Storm Awareness. You know the location of every creature within this radius, regardless of concealment, invisibility or darkness. Even if you cannot see them, these creatures can always be targeted with your Laser Circus attack even if behind Cover.
Interference Field. Hostile creatures in the affected area must make a Constitution saving throw at the beginning of their turns vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure If they cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu that does not have the Lightning or Water release keywords, that jutsu’s cost is increased by +4 until the beginning of their next turn.
Grounded Surge. Hostile creatures that are Shocked or Chilled on your turn, suffer a -2 penalty to their saving throws against Ranton Hijutsu you cast.

# Land of Sound Clans
## Jūgo Clan
Daisuke casually walked through the forest without much concern. 'A beast is giving us trouble'? This job should be easy. Reaching a creak, he looks around at the peaceful environment. A twig snaps behind him. Turning around and drawing his kunai, he plunges it into the unseen threat. A human man with dull brown hair stares at him. Before he can apologize, Daisuke watches the human turn grey and grow up to 7ft tall. A lone whimper is heard as the creature mutters out "I only wanted to enjoy the peaceful river with him...".
—Lyo Hataka
At Worlds End, Ch. 19 excerpt.
### Monstrous oppressors
The Jugo clan does not hold many members due to their unique power and often, far more unique personalities. Those that find themselves gifted with this ability often lose themselves to madness and turn into raging monsters on the battlefield. Able to call on durability and health at a simple beckon call, these shinobi should not be taken lightly
### Jūgo Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str, +1 Con
Speed: 35 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Chakra Control.
Extra Language: Bird-Speak, you can understand and speak to birds and other avians.
Raw Chakra Techniques: The Jugo Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Jugo Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
### Jūgo Features
#### Nature Energy
1st Level Clan Feature
Your body stores Nature Energy, a raw and volatile force of energy that you accumulate involuntarily when in the heat of combat. You have a maximum of 1 + your proficiency bonus Nature Energy. When you complete a long rest, you reset your Nature energy to 0. You cannot accumulate Nature Energy outside of combat, but it does persist from encounter to encounter. You gain 1 Nature Energy per trigger, per turn, from the following:
You deal damage to a hostile creature.
You take damage from a hostile creature.
You begin your turn within 10 feet of a hostile creature.
You can spend this accumulated Nature Energy on the following during combat. You can activate one Expenditure per turn.
Amplify. Jugo Clan Hijutsu you cast gains its Amplified effect by spending the listed Nature Energy.
Heal. As an Action, you can spend up to 4 Nature Energy. When you do, select one allied creature other than yourself that you can touch. That creature regains 1d6 hit points for every Nature Energy spent. Beginning at 11th level, increase the number of Nature Energy you can spend to 6.
#### Flesh Crafting
1st Level Clan Feature
As Nature Energy accumulates in your body, it physically manifest by hardening your skin, extending your reach and radiating outward as an oppressive pressure that hostile creatures can feel just by being near you. You gain passive benefits based on your current Nature Energy level (This will be abbreviated to NE in the associated effects). This occurs automatically and doesn’t require any action on your part.
Nature Shell – 2+ NE: Your skin hardens and grays throughout. You gain bonus DR equal to half your level, minimum 1 while not wearing Medium or Heavy Armor.
Predator’s Grasp – 4+ NE: Your limbs elongate subtly. Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 property and adds +2 bonus to the damage dealt.
Natures Endurance – 6+ NE: Your body recycles Nature energy faster than ever making it exceedingly difficult to hold you down. You gain a rank of Mastery to two of the following Saving throws; Strength, Dexterity or Constitution, your choice when you first gain access to this bonus. You can change your selection when you complete a long rest.
Tyrants Presence – 8+ NE: Nature Energy radiates from your body like heat from an engine. Hostile creatures that begin their turn within 10 feet of you, must make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu Save DC losing their Reaction on a failure, until the beginning of their next turn.
King of Savagery – 10 NE: You grow in size by 1 size category and you regain Hit points equal to your level at the beginning of each of your turns.
If at any point during your turn, you have reached the maximum Nature Energy you can maintain, it overwhelms you causing you to become Manic.
#### Feral Instincts
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your connection to Nature Energy deepens beyond just raw accumulation. You have learned to shape, direct and in some cases even tame it. This is represented as Instincts, of which, you have 2 from the following list. You gain 1 additional Instinct at 7th and 15th level.
Feral Assistance
As a reaction to an allied creature casting a Jutsu within 30 feet of you, excluding yourself, you can spend up to 6 Nature Energy. For every Nature Energy spent, reduce the cost of the jutsu they cast by 1.
Feral Axe
While you have 1 or more Nature Energy, your arm enlarges and your bones shift to create a massive Axe like appendage. For the duration, your Unarmed damage die becomes a d10, deals slashing damage, and each successful unarmed attack, reduces the targets DR by 2, until the end of your next turn.
Feral Bloodlust
Your Nature Energy causes your lust for violence to be magnified. While Manic, you can cause critical strikes more often. By spending 2 Nature Energy, if you make an attack and score a hit, you can roll two d20’s. If either of these die results are a 20, you treat your attack as a critical hit.
Feral Consumption
As an Action, you can begin to use your Nature Energy to siphon chakra from your foes. By spending 3 Nature Energy, all creatures you can see in a 15-foot cube, up to 30 feet away from you, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 2d6 Chakra damage and gain the Sealed condition or half as much damage on a success. This increases to 4d6 at 7th level and 6d6 chakra damage at 15th level.
Beginning at 11th level, by choosing to instead spend 4 Nature Energy, you can use this ability as a Bonus action instead of an Action.
Feral Denial
You know how to limit your Nature Energy intake. Select one trigger which grants you Nature Energy and suppress it. You can no longer gain Nature Energy in this way. You can change this choice once per long rest.
Feral Endurance
While you have Natures Endurance, you can now choose between Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom and Charisma.
Feral Force
While Manic, you become fundamentally impossible to stop. You gain immunity to the Grappled and Prone conditions as a result of a hostile creatures jutsu.  Additionally, while within 10 feet of your Priority target, you can make opportunity attacks against them as a result of moving, or casting a Jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) or Mobility (M) components.
Feral Grasp
While you have the Predator’s Grasp benefit, your body adjusts more dramatically, as your bones elongate and soften allowing you to strike with extended limbs. Reach property increases by +1 and you gain a rank of Mastery to Athletic Checks to Grapple.
Feral Hunger
You expand ways to gain more Nature Energy beyond your limits. Select one trigger which grants you Nature Energy. You now gain 2 Nature Energy when it triggers.
Feral Leap
Once per turn, when you take damage from a creature you can see, you can spend 2 Nature Energy, growing booster jets on your back, and move up to 30 feet in a straight line towards the triggering creature. If you end this movement within 5 feet of the triggering creature, they trigger an attack of opportunity from you.
Feral Morningstar
While you have 3 or more Nature Energy, your arm enlarges and your bones shift to create a massive mace like appendage. For the duration, your Unarmed damage die becomes a d10, deals piercing damage, and each successful unarmed attack, forces the target to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, gaining the Bruised condition until the end of your next turn.
Feral Purge
While Manic, you can spend your Bonus Action to violently expel excess Nature Energy. All creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they take 2d8 force damage and are knocked Prone. This increases to 4d8 at 7th level and 6d8 at 15th level. Regardless of a success or failure, roll 1d4, reducing your Nature Energy by the result.
Feral Bursts
Your Nature Energy when fired from you become all the more potent, refined and efficient. Hijutsu you cast that makes ranged attacks can increase the number of attacks they make by +1. This bonus attack must be against a different creature in range.
Additionally, Hijutsu you cast that affects an area in the shape of a Line or Cone that forces a saving throw, cannot be made at advantage.
Feral Roar
While you have 5 or more Nature Energy, you can spend your Bonus action to spend 2 Nature Energy to release a raw burst of concentrated Nature Energy in the form of a terrifying roar. All creatures within 20 feet of your must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, affected creatures are pushed back 10 feet, and gain 2 ranks of Demoralized.
Feral Senses
While you have 5 or more Nature Energy, your Nature Energy grants you preternatural senses beyond human limits. You gain 15 feet of Tremor sense, and creatures cannot gain Advantage on attacks against you.
Feral Shell
While you have the Nature Shell benefit, your skin also produces splintered spike that attempt to stab into creatures. Creatures that make melee attacks against you, take piercing damage equal to half of your level, for each attack, regardless if they hit or miss. This damage ignores Damage Reduction (DR) and resistance.
Feral Suppression
You work overtime to limit your Manic episodes. If you would become Manic, you can begin to Concentrate, as if concentrating on a Jutsu of B-Rank. While Concentrating, you cannot gain the Manic condition.
#### Nature’s Voice
[BOX]
| Flesh Crafting – Manic / [Physical], [Mental] / A creature can only become Manic if they are of the Jugo Clan and have reached the maximum amount of Nature Energy, they can maintain. While Manic, you gain the following penalty and benefits: / Penalty / While Manic, you suffer the effects of the Berserk condition as if you yourself are your own compeller. / Benefits / A Manic creature gains a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This increases to +2, if attacking a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn. / A Manic creature that scores a critical hit, adds 2d12 force damage to the result. This increases by 1d12 at 7th and 15th levels. / A Manic creature can make one additional weapon or Unarmed attack when they take the Attack Action. / A Manic creatures speed increases by +10 feet. They gain an additional +10 speed when moving towards a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn. / A Manic creature spends 4 feet of movement for every 1 feet they spend moving away from a valid hostile creature while not also moving towards another valid hostile creature. / This condition ends when you would reach 0 Nature Energy. |
[/BOX]
7th Level Clan Feature
Your attunement to Nature Energy extends beyond your own body and into your surroundings while not in combat, using it to communicate with beasts of the land and even the land itself. You gain the Animal Speak language.
Animal Speak. you can understand and speak to all land-based animals.
Also, by spending 10 minutes focusing, you attune to your surroundings and for the next hour, you can extract information from natural terrain and animals you communicate with. You gain 2 ranks of Mastery to all Charisma checks made against them for the duration.
Additionally, for the duration, you can learn the following about an area you can see:
You learn the movement patterns of creatures that have passed through within the last 24 hours, learning their size, the number of them and their direction.
If Chakra has be used in your general area within the last 24 hours and the approximate location it was used.
The location of water sources, natural shelter such as caves or underbrush’s.
If a creature of your size or larger is hiding within 120 feet of you. This does not reveal their location, just their presence.
Once you attune yourself, you cannot do so again until you complete a short rest.
#### The Hunter
11th Level Clan Feature
You have learned to harness your Manic state into one that can be focused and targeted. In the moments before losing yourself to your mania, you can focus on a single target, instead of lashing out wildly. Once per short rest, when you become Manic, you can select one creature you can see as your Marked Prey. This creature becomes your Priority Target while Manic and cannot be changed. While this creature is marked in this way, you must maintain concentration on them, as if concentrating on an S-Rank jutsu. This mark lasts until the target is reduced to 0 hit points or you lose concentration.
Also, this focus has unlocked additional ways to spend your Nature Energy. You gain the following additional expenditures:
Savage Intimidation. As a Bonus action, by spending 2 Nature Energy, select your Priority Target, if they are within 60 feet of you. You release an alluring pulse of nature energy, attempting to trick their bodies instincts, forcing them to move closer. They must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they must spend their Reaction, and then move up to their movement speed towards you. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity from creatures other than yourself.
Rejuvenating Siphon. When a hostile creature scores a critical hit against you, you can spend 4 Nature Energy, to select up to 4 of the highest rolled damage dice by the hostile creature. Those dice are removed from their damage result and you gain hit points equal to twice the result of the rolled dice.
Natures Verdict. If you score a critical hit against your Priority Target, while Manic, as a result of an Action you took, you can spend 6 Nature Energy. If you do, you gain an additional action which you can use to repeat the same action used to score the critical hit.
#### Cascading Mania
15th Level Clan Feature
You have transcended the boundary between shinobi and feral beast entirely. The Manic condition is no longer something you suffer from. It’s something you utilize and command. Not only that, but due to your Nature Energy, when you become Manic, you are no longer alone.
Once per turn, at the start of your turn, you can choose to become Manic voluntarily ignoring the Nature Energy requirements. Becoming Manic this way costs 2 Nature Energy at the beginning of each of your turns to maintain. If you cannot pay this cost, the condition ends and you become Dazed and Staggered as the sudden mental whiplash takes time to recover from.
Additionally, when you become Manic, you can spend your Reaction to release a pulse of concentrated Nature Energy outward, saturating the bodies of your allies with raw primal forces. Select up to two willing allied creatures you can see within 30 feet. Each selected ally becomes Manic and treat any creature currently marked as your Priority Target as their Priority Target as well. Both allies occupies one of your concentration slots as if concentrating on an A-Rank jutsu.
Your allies mania ends if you lose concentration on them, the priority targets hit points are reduced to 0, or they are incapacitated.
## Jugo Clan Jutsu
### D-Rank
#### Misplaced Misfire
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: Special
Range: Self
Duration: Instant
Components: M, CM
Cost: 5 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Taijutsu
Description: After missing an unarmed attack, you quickly fix your mistakes, using a jet on one of your legs or arms to quickly propel an attack forward. Make one unarmed attack against the original target. You can only cast this jutsu once per turn.
If you have the Feral Axe or Feral Morningstar instinct, this remade attack is made at advantage.
Amplify: By spending 2 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, due to how unpredictable this follow up attack is, if the target is benefiting from a Jutsu based effect that grants them a Bonus to their AC or DR, this jutsu’s attacks ignore those bonuses.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, increase the number of times you can use this jutsu per turn by +1.
#### Lotus Cannon
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: 60 Feet
Duration: Instant
Components: CM
Cost: 5 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu
Description: Using nature energy, you transform one of your arms into a jet booster like appendage that collects your Nature Energy, before you fire a beam of raw nature chakra. Make a ranged ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack against a creature you can see in range dealing 3d10 force damage and forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, being Bruised on a failure.
Amplify: By spending 2 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, its range instead becomes a 30-foot cone originating from you. Compare your attack results vs the AC of all creatures in range, dealing damage to each creature on a hit.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d10. If cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the range of the jutsu to 90 feet, and if Amplified increase the Natural Energy cost to 4 and the size of the cone to 45 feet. If cast at S-Rank, if Amplified, when you score a critical hit with this jutsu, the affected creatures must make a Constitution saving throw, being Stunned on a failure.
#### Savage Overhand
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Touch
Duration: Instant
Components: CM, M
Cost: 4 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu
Description: You increase the size and volume of your hands before interlocking your fingers and slamming down with enough force to collapse the ground and surrounding terrain. Make a melee taijutsu (or ninjutsu) attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + 2d12 force damage and forcing the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw, being knocked Prone on a failure.
If you have the Feral Axe or Feral Morningstar instinct, if you score a critical hit with this attack, the affected creature is also Staggered.
Amplify: By spending 2 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, you activate chakra thrusters on your elbow, slamming your target into the ground, bouncing them like a ball, and then following it up with a heavy swipe, throwing them 30-feet in a direction of your choice, excluding upwards. A creature thrown this way makes their saving throw to resist being Prone at disadvantage
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
#### Sage Energy Transfiguration
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 Minute
Components: CM
Cost: 5 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu
Description: Instead of temporarily transforming your limbs when striking, you transfigure them temporarily maintaining their form. Select which ligaments you want to transform, between your arms or legs. Casting this jutsu while currently benefiting from it dispels any previous instance of it.
Monstrous Arms: Your arms grow in size, and transforms into a monstrous form resembling arms with jet like ports protruding from your elbow. While in this form, your Unarmed damage die is increased by + 1d8 force damage.
Jet Legs: Your legs grow in size and transforms into a monstrous form resembling legs with jet like ports on your ankles. While in this form, your speed is increased by +15, your jump height is increased by +20 feet, and creatures make attacks of opportunities against you at disadvantage.
Amplify: By spending 3 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, if you select Monstrous Arms, your Unarmed attacks gain the Deadly 2 quality. If you select Jet Legs, when you cast a Taijutsu, increase its range by +10 feet as you can perform short burst movements before applying its effects.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, when you cast this jutsu, you can gain the benefit of both forms.
### C-Rank
#### Hellfire Jets
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: Special
Range: Self
Duration: 1 Round
Components: CM, M
Cost: 6 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu
Description: As part of moving, you may cast this jutsu, forming jets at your back. Until the beginning of your next turn, your speed increases by 20ft and you gain a flight speed equal to your speed.
For the duration, you may choose to float up to 1 foot off the ground, being immune to difficult terrain and any special terrain you encounter.
Amplify: By spending 2 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, and then 1 Nature Energy at the beginning of each of your turns, you can extend this jutsu’s duration by 1 round.
#### Tyrants Piston Press
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: Special
Range: Special
Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM
Cost: 9 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu
Description: When striking enemies with a melee attack you can quickly release a jet of Nature Energy from the back of your striking limb like a piston, giving the strike an amplified effect.
On a hit of a melee attack, you can cast this just, increasing the attacks impact, dealing an additional 4d8 force damage and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, being Dazed on a failure.
If you have the Feral Axe or Feral Morningstar instinct, this damage ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance.
Amplify: By spending 4 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, you activate chakra thrusters on your elbow, moving across the battle field and attempting to drag your target with you. If the affected creature fails their saving throw, they become Grappled by you and you can move up to your movement speed in a direction of your choice, pulling them with you.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and damage by 1d8.
#### Cellular Regeneration: Absorption
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Touch
Duration: Instant
Components: CM, M
Cost: 9 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Medical
Description: You reach out and attempt to destabilize the cellular structure of your foe, while also trying to absorb these destabilized cells through your Nature Energy. Target creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Weakened, and you regain 5d6 hit points.
Amplify: By spending 3 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, you magnify the power of this ability, allowing you to also drain the targets Chakra. On a failure, the target take chakra damage equal the hit points you regained and you gain temporary chakra points equal to half your level.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank above C-Rank you cast this jutsu, increase the cost by 3 and the amount of hit points regained by 1d6. If this just is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Weakened inflicted by +1.
#### Natures Surge
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: Instant
Components: CM, M
Cost: 7 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu
Description: You reach up and feel the Nature energy in the surrounding area and by forcing your body to accept it, you forcibly gain 3 Nature Energy. Nature Energy gained this way, allows you to go above your maximum amount of Nature Energy you can normally hold. If this excess Nature Energy isn’t spent before the end of the current turn, it is lost.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank above C-Rank you cast this jutsu, increase the cost by 3 and the amount of Nature Energy gained by +2.
### B-Rank
#### Full Sage: Nature Transfiguration
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: B-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 Minute
Components: HS, CM
Cost: 14 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Stable
Description: Hardening raw chakra over your body, your body grows thick scales, your skin grays, your eyes become black and golden, you grow large spines on your back. Your strength and endurance is magnified, and you become a tyrant on the battlefield. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:
AC increases by +2.
Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
Jugo Clan Hijutsu you cast with a casting time of Special, reduce the Nature Energy cost of their Amplify effects, by half, min 1.
If you benefiting from the Nature Endurance bonus you have advantage on Strength and Constitution Saving Throws.
If you have the Feral Endurance instinct, hostile creatures cannot reduce your DR or ignore any Resistance you have or treat any immunity you have as resistance.
Amplify: By spending 6 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, you can remove concentration from this jutsu, and its duration becomes 1 minute.
### A-Rank
#### Lotus Nonself Connected Cannons
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: A-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Full Turn Action
Range: Self (90-foot Line)
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 Minute
Components: HS, CM, M
Cost: Special (21 Chakra)
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Clash
Description: Resting both your arms together, you transform them into a single, large chakra cannon.
The cannon shoots a beam in a 10-foot wide, 90-foot-long line that forces all creatures in its range to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, affected creatures reduces their Temporary Hit Points to 0, reduce their DR by 2 for the next minute and then take 7d10 force damage. On a success, they instead first reduce their current Temporary Hit Points by half and then take half of the listed damage.
After the initial casting, you are able to choose to maintain the cannon. If you do, you gain the following effects for the duration:
Your Speed is set to 0.
You gain a bonus 10 DR. You cannot be moved against your will, knocked Prone or Stunned.
As an Action on your turn, you may choose to fire the beam again. Draw a line originating from you as if you cast it again, this line does not need to be in the same direction as when you first cast this jutsu. You force all creatures in range to make their saving throws as normal. This beam penetrates environmental structures that aren’t made as a result of a Jutsu, ignoring their Hit Points and Resistances, if any.
At the start of each of your turns, you may choose to end this jutsu and de-form the cannon. You do not always have to fire the cannon each turn.
You only need to pay the concentration cost of this jutsu, when you refire the beam.
Amplify: By spending 5 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, its range becomes Self (60-foot cone).
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the range by 10 feet, and the damage by 1d10.
## Jugo Clan Mutation(s)

| #### Jugo Clan Mutations / A Berserker Experience / Some Jugo Clan Mutations are meant to help further allow players to embody a true Berserker gameplay style, and all the risks associated with it. This will possibly result in player vs player encounters, in the middle of an already hectic combat scenario. In this case, do not use PvP rules. / A Controlled Experience / Some Jugo Clan Mutations will be meant to allow a player to completely avoid the Mania mechanic. But in exchange, the clan will be a bit weaker, and you as a player will end up giving up a few options within the clan. |

You find yourself often unable to control your Nature Energy intake. When you gain Nature Energy, increase the amount gained by +1.
If you take this Trait, you must take Feral Abandon Mutated Feature.

#### Full Sage: Undiluted Rage
11th Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: N/A, this mutation does not replace another feature.

#### Tempered Beast
[BOX]
| Tempered Beast – Primal Focus / [Physical], [Mental] / A creature can only experience Primal Focus if they are of the Jugo Clan and have reached the maximum amount of Nature Energy, they can maintain. While experiencing Primal Focus, you gain the following penalty and benefits: / Benefits / A creature experiencing Primal Focus gains a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. / A creature experiencing Primal Focus speed increases by +10 feet. / A creature experiencing Primal Focus gains advantage on Wisdom saving throws. / This condition ends when you would end your turn with less than half of your maximum Nature Energy. |
[/BOX]
1st Level Clan Feature
Mutated Feature: Flesh Crafter
As Nature Energy accumulates in your body, it physically manifest by hardening your skin, extending your reach and radiating outward as an oppressive pressure that hostile creatures can feel just by being near you. You gain passive benefits based on your current Nature Energy level (This will be abbreviated to NE in the associated effects). This occurs automatically and doesn’t require any action on your part.
Nature Shell – 2+ NE: Your skin hardens and grays throughout. You gain bonus DR equal to half your level, minimum 1 while not wearing Medium or Heavy Armor.
Predator’s Grasp – 4+ NE: Your limbs elongate subtly. Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 property and adds +2 bonus to the damage dealt.
Natures Endurance – 6+ NE: Your body recycles Nature energy faster than ever making it exceedingly difficult to hold you down. You gain a rank of Mastery to two of the following Saving throws; Strength, Dexterity or Constitution, your choice when you first gain access to this bonus. You can change your selection when you complete a long rest.
If at any point during your turn, you have reached the maximum Nature Energy you can maintain, it overwhelms you causing you enter a state of Primal Focus.  Features you have that reference Mania, also count for Primal Focus.
## Kashu Clan
"What the hell do you think you're looking at?! Unless you want your eye ball plucked out and your eye sockets filled with roaches and sown shut, I'd suggest looking elsewhere!" Those were the vulgar remarks shouted at me by a child no older than 11 years. Her mother didn't even bat an eye. There is something deeply wrong with the members of this clan.
- Saikusu Uchiha
At Worlds End, Ch. 19 excerpt.
### If Music be the Song of Death
The Kashu Clan are a clan of foul mouthed, aggressive, masters of genjutsu. The clan has contracts with unknown evils from different realms to preform malicious jutsu and summoning horrid creatures. Not much is known about the clan other than their clear affiliation with the land of sound and their superior auditory genjutsu.
### Kashu Traits
Tag: Canon Inspired, Creator: StruggledKing
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Wis
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Survival
Illusory Genius: You reduce downtime cost to learn Genjutsu you qualify for by an amount equal to their rank, to a minimum of 1. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)
Hijutsu Flexibility: Kashu Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
Kashu Sound Techniques: The Kashu Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Bound Instruments: Select one Simple Weapon or a Weapon you are proficient in. You use techniques taught by your clan to reengineer it to double as a Shinobi Instrument. A special weapon usable only by your clan that doubles as a musical instrument.
Branch Family: The Kashu are split between three different branches, the [Harmonic Branch], the [Symphonic Branch] and the [Mnemonic Branch]. The Harmonic branch are bards and composers who utilize shinobi tools disguised as instruments such as bladed flutes or poisoned harmonicas, and infuse Genjutsu into their songs. The Symphonic branch are tinkerers that infuse shinobi tech into their instruments, turning them into sound-based weapons, such as tuning gauntlets or ultrasonic Boom whackers, focusing on a more martial centric fighting style. The Mnemonic branch specialize in traps and tricks and prefers wire-based instruments such as guitars, violins and lutes, whose wires can be used to set said traps. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later
### Kashu Features
#### Conductors Throne
1st Level Clan Feature, [Harmonic Branch]
This branch of Kashu, tend to think of themselves as puppeteers, composers or even conductors of battle. This doesn’t come from Hubris, no. Instead, this comes from one of the clans core secret techniques. A special summoned creature, known as the Doki. Unlike other summoned creatures, the Doki are bound not by an elaborate contract, but instead, to the melodies you play and they are summoned the same way. Your Shinobi Instrument is their leash, and you use the music it produces to command them.
You gain access to one of three Doki’s. The Bandaged, The Claw, or the Club. You gain access to one of the remaining Doki’s at 7th and 15th levels. When initiative is rolled, you can choose to roll your initiative at disadvantage. If you do, you summon all of your Doki’s as part of rolling initiative otherwise, you can summon them one at a time as a Bonus action. They are summoned into a space that can hold them within 30 feet of you. Your Doki’s act as a bonus action on your turn, commanding all active Doki’s at once as part of the same bonus action. Your Doki’s remain until dismissed, they are reduced to 0 hit points or you are incapacitated, at which point they are dispelled. Once dismissed or defeated, a Doki cannot be resummoned until you spend at least 10 minutes meditating outside of combat.
Beginning at 11th level, you can command one Doki to at no action cost, on your turn. The remaining Doki can be commanded to move, but not use any ability, jutsu or attack it has, if commanded this way.
#### Resonance Crown
1st Level Clan Feature, [Symphonic Branch]
This branch of Kashu, focus more on the technological side of their craft, modifying their Shinobi Instrument in ways to augment their combat capabilities. This branch focuses on putting pressure on your foes through brutal close or mid-range combat. Your Shinobi Instrument enables you to fight far above your weight class.
Rather than a combat stance, when initiative is rolled, you tune your Shinobi Instrument to build Resonance. Resonance is represented as vibrational buildup your Shinobi Instrument has accumulated from your attacks.  You begin combat with 0 Resonance, and can gain 1 Resonance, per turn, when you make an attack with your Shinobi Instrument or a Taijutsu (or Bukijutsu) while wielding your Shinobi Instrument. Your Shinobi Instrument can store up to 4 Resonance. You can only gain Resonance in combat. Resonance last for 1 minute or until your release a Menacing Melody or Combat ends. You begin with 3 such Melodies. If a Melody requires a saving throw it uses your highest jutsu save DC.
Vertigo Strike. Once per turn, when you deal damage with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 1 Resonance, to force the target creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Disorientation.
Frenetic Frequency. When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a Melee attack while you are wielding your Shinobi Instrument, you can, as a reaction spend 2 Resonance, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they take 2d8 psychic damage, and gain 2 ranks of Concussed. This increases by +2d8 at 7th and 15th levels.
Overtone Burst. Once per turn, when you deal damage as a result of a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you cast with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 2 Resonance to either reduce the targets DR by 4 or remove one of the following resistances (Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Earth, Lighting, Psychic, or Force), until the end of your next turn.
#### Bell Witch
1st Level Clan Feature, [Mnemonic Branch]
This branch of Kashu, focus more on the ancient art of traps and acoustics to overwhelm their enemies senses. Your Shinobi Instrument enables you to fight without your enemies even realizing they are at a disadvantage.
When facing you a trap is always waiting to be sprung. You use your Shinobi Instrument to set up a network of bells and sonic strings that turn the battlefield into your own killing choir.
Once per turn, while in combat, at the beginning of each of your turns you can place a Bell Wire at and point you can see within 30 feet. A Bell Wire is an invisible tripwire of sonic chakra that occupies a 10-foot radius centered on this chosen point. You can maintain up to 6 Bell Wires at a time. A Bell Wire is triggered when a hostile creatures moves through the radius. Placing additional Bell Wires beyond your maximum dismisses the oldest one.
When a creature triggers a Bell Wire, you can spend your reaction to cast any Kashu Hijutsu with the Auditory keyword targeting the triggering creature and dispel the placed Bell Wire. The jutsu originates from the triggered Bell Wire location. You do not need line of sight to the triggering creature. You are always aware if a hostile creature would trigger your Bell Wire.
#### Harmonic Songs
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Harmonic Branch]
You have developed an album of songs meant to bring ruin to your foes, but victory to you and your allies. These songs are known as your Harmonies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Harmonies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.
If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.
Pull The Strings
Once per turn, when a Kashu clan Hijutsu you cast would affect a creature with ranks of a Mental Condition, on a failure, they become overwhelmed with a strong drive to approach the source of your song, even if detrimental. They spend their reaction to move up to their speed towards you. This movement can trigger attacks of opportunity.
Binding Melody
Doki you control gain the Binding Melody ability.
Binding Melody. While mute, this Doki begins to jump, bounce and move in a rhythmic fashion. All hostile creatures within 10 feet of the Doki must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they suffer the curse of Binding, gaining 1 rank of Sealed, and being unable to target creatures other this Doki until the end of their next turn. Ranks of Sealed increases by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.
Rhythmic Repeat
Once per turn, when a creature with ranks of Disorientation takes damage from a source other than you or a Doki you control, you deal an additional 1d6 psychic damage to them, per rank of Disorientation, as their ear drums vibrates violently in response. This is treated as conditional damage.
Echo Chamber
When you cast a Kashu clan Hijutsu, you can have it originate from up to two active Doki you have instead of yourself. If you do, creatures can only be affected by one instance of the chosen jutsu at once.
Aggressive Tempo
When you cast a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, if an allied creature is in the jutsu’s range, they become immune to its hostile effects, and also gain a +10 bonus to their speed, and a +2 bonus to damage they deal as a result of jutsu they cast until the end of their next turn. Their bonus to speed increases to +20 at 7th and +30 at 15th levels. And their bonus to damage increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th levels.
Underworlds Melody
As an Action, you release a regenerative song, healing all Doki within 15 feet of you by 4d6 hit points. This increases to 6d6 at 7th and 8d6 at 15th levels. Doki can only be affected by this song, twice per combat.
Demonic Chorus
Kashu Genjutsu you cast, increase their damage by +2 for every active Doki you have as their overlapping demonic resonance amplifies your illusory output.
Harmonious Bridge
Once per turn, when a Doki scores a hit on a creature, you can immediately command it or another Doki to use their Revolt of the Demon World attack against the same creature.
#### Symphonic Songs
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Symphonic Branch]
You have developed an album of songs meant to raise your tempo and stop the flow of your enemies. These songs are known as your Symphonies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Symphonies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.
If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.
Staccato Burst
Once per turn, when you spend Resonance, you can choose to release the stored vibrational energy in a sudden burst. All hostile creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 1d6 psychic damage for each Resonance spent.
Dissonant Chord
You gain the Dissonant Chord Melody that you can spend Resonance on.
Dissonant Chord. Once per turn, when you score a hit and deal either [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 1 Resonance to force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose concentration on 1 random jutsu they are concentrating on.
Subsonic Pressure
Once per turn, when you use the Overturn Burst Melody, if the target has ranks of Disorientation, the DR penalty or Resistance suppression lasts until they have no ranks of Disorientation.
Overtuned Frequency.
As a Bonus action, you concentrate on over tuning your Shinobi Instrument. Your Shinobi Instrument can hold up to 8 Resonance, and you can gain up to 2 Resonance per trigger, per turn, but you must concentrate on doing so as if you are concentrating on an A-Rank Genjutsu.
Sonic Cannon
You tweak your Shinobi Instrument, to allow you to release blasts of sound and wind, gaining the Sonic Cannon and Sonic Cannon Burst attacks.
When you take the Attack action, you can replace any number of attack you make with a Sonic Cannon attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, beginning at 7th level, you can make two Sonic Cannon attacks instead of one.
Sonic Cannon. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet. On a hit, you deal 1d12 force damage. If you roll a 10 or higher on the damage die, the target gains 1 rank of Disorientation. This attack counts as using your Shinobi Instrument for features that call for it.
Sonic Cannon Burst. As an Action, you spend all remaining Resonance, releasing it as an overwhelming shockwave, forcing all creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 1d12 force damage for every Resonance spent, or half as much damage on a successful save.
Piercing Tone
[Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] you deal with your Shinobi Instrument ignores resistance and treats Immunity as resistance while you have at least 4 Resonance.
Resonant Disruption
Your Shinobi Instrument acts as a passive shield against sound. When you would make a saving throw to resist the effects of a Genjutsu cast against you with the Auditory keyword, your Shinobi Instrument automatically spends 1 Resonance, to grant you advantage on this save.
Additionally, if you succeed, you treat your success as if you critically succeeded instead, if possible.
Subsonic Grip
You gain the Subsonic Grip Melody that you can spend Resonance on.
Subsonic Grip. Once per turn, when you deal damage with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 2 Resonance, to force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you vibrate the fluid in their joints until movement becomes agonizing. They become Restrained in place until the end of their next turn.
#### Mnemonic Songs
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Mnemonic Branch]
You have developed an album of songs meant to bring ruin to your foes, but victory to you and your allies. These songs are known as your Mnemodies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Mnemodies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.
If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.
Haunting Notes
You gain the Haunting Note attack. Also, when a creature triggers one of your Bell Wires, you can choose to instead make a Haunting Note attack at no additional action, instead of spending your Reaction.
When you take the Attack action, you can replace any number of attack you make with a Haunting Note attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, beginning at 7th level, you can make two Haunting Note attacks instead of one.
Haunting Note. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you or an active Bell Wire. On a hit, you deal 1d8 psychic damage. If a target already has at least 1 rank of Disorientation, they must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they gain ranks of Dazzled equal to their ranks of Disorientation.
Multi-Traps
You can place 2 Bell Wires as a Bonus action on your turn. They must be in different locations and their areas cannot overlap.
Hair Trigger
Bell Wires you place, now trigger on any movement through their space, including forced movement.
I Planned For This
When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a melee attack, you can spend your reaction to dispel an active Bell Wire. If you do, Select one Kashu Clan Hijutsu you know of D-Rank that forces a saving throw and cast it as part of this reaction, at no chakra cost targeting them.
The rank of jutsu you can cast increases to C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level.
Taut String
Once per turn, when a creature within 30 feet of a Bell Wire casts a jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) component, you can spend your reaction to Dispel that Bell Wire. When you do, the triggering creature must make a Wisdom saving throw as they begin to hear music from all directions. On a failure, they become Confused for the next minute. A creature Confused in this way remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the Confused condition on a success.
Cruel Reverb
When a creature triggers a Bell Wire, you can choose to instead have the triggering creature make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they become Berserk for the next minute. A creature that is Berserk in this way ends this condition the first time they deal damage to a creature they previously considered an ally.
Patient Trap
You can now place Bell Wires outside of combat. Bell Wires placed in this way persist for up to 24 hours before fading.
Bell Wires placed this way are always delayed and do not trigger automatically. They always alert you to a creature crossing its affected area. If combat would begin and a creature is standing in your Bell Wires affected area, they automatically trigger, forcing them to make their Initiative roll at disadvantage, and you can use your triggered Bell Wires effects as part of initiative being rolled. You can maintain up to 4 Bell Wires outside of combat.
Lingering Bell
When a Bell Wire is triggered, you can choose to instead mark them as a Lingering Bell. A creature marked as a Lingering Bell remains marked for up to 1 minute. You can spend your Bonus action on your turn or Reaction on other creatures turn to detonate a Lingering Bell. Once detonated, all creatures within 20-feet of a Lingering Bell must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they become Slowed and gain 1 rank of Concussed.
Increase the ranks of Concussed by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.
#### Sirens Voice
[BOX]
| Disoriented / Max Ranks: 5, [Mental], [Sensory] / A Disoriented creature suffers the effects of their equilibrium and sense of balance being impeded. / A Disoriented creature suffers a -1 penalty to attack rolls for each rank they have. / A creature with 3 or more ranks of Disoriented must spend its Bonus Action at the beginning of its turn to target one creature it can see. The target creature is the only creature they can target with attacks, jutsu or effects that requires them to select a creature to harm. / A creature with 5 or more ranks of Disoriented cannot make attacks as they cannot reliably target creatures. / Creatures that are immune to psychic damage or the Dazzled condition is immune to this condition. / A Disoriented creature can spend an Action to make a DC 15 Wisdom ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |
[/BOX]
7th Level Clan Feature
The Kashu clan's mastery of sound extends beyond the battlefield. By performing on your Shinobi Instrument for at least 10 minutes, creatures that can hear you, you weave a subtle emotional undercurrent into your music. For the next 24 hours, the first time you or an allied creature socially interacts with a creature that heard your song, the initiating creature gains a +4 bonus to any Charisma based check made. If you or an allied creature attempts a Charisma Skill based action during this time against a creature that heard your song, they make any contested check or saving throw to resist or otherwise at disadvantage. Once a creature is affected by your song in this way, they become immune to its effects until they complete a Full-Rest.
Additionally, as part of this performance, if you are inside a building, you saturate the area with lingering frequencies. You learn the exact structural layout of the building you occupy within a 120-foot radius, penetrating through walls, and barriers that aren’t chakra enhanced. This does not reveal creatures, only the structural layout, possibly revealing hidden rooms or trap doors.
#### Killing Frequency
11th Level Clan Feature
The Kashu clan's most technically demanding technique is not a jutsu. It is a piece of music. A sustained composition played at a frequency so precisely calibrated to a living creature's biological and chakra resonance that it turns their own body into a weapon against them.
As an Action, you can begin to play your Shinobi Instrument, creating your Killing Frequency. Your Killing Frequency is a sustained state that lasts for up to 1 minute. Your Killing Frequency fills a radius based on the source you choose for its duration;
30-foot radius centered on you, and moves with you.
20-foot radius centered on one of your Doki. You can switch which Doki the Killing Frequency is centered on at the beginning of each of your turns.
10-foot radius centered on all active Bell Wires.
While your Killing Frequency is up, you gain the following abilities: Effects that trigger when a hostile creature performs an action such as cast a jutsu or move can only be used once per turn. They cannot all be used at the same time and once an effect has been used it cannot be used until the next creatures turn. Once you activate your Killing Frequency feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.
Embedded Frequency. Twice per turn, hostile creatures that cast a Jutsu with the Hand Seal (HS) or Mobility (M) components within your Killing Frequency, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain a rank of Disoriented.
Chakra Interference. Once per turn, when a hostile creature attempts to cast a jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component within your Killing Frequency, they must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they increase the cost of the jutsu cast by +8.
Sonic Pulse. Once per turn, when a hostile creature with ranks of Disoriented moves more than 10 feet within your Killing Frequency on their turn, they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they take 2d6 psychic damage, for each rank of Disoriented they have.
Discordant Broadcast. Once per turn, when a hostile creature begins their turn maintaining concentrating on a jutsu or effect within your Killing Frequency they must make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they must choose to either triple their concentration chakra cost (if any) or lose concentration.
#### Opus
15th Level Clan Feature
Every great composer eventually transcends the boundaries of their chosen instrument and sound. The Kashu clans mastery of sound does not end at the edge of their Branches techniques. It only expands and grows, hungrily consuming the methods of their sister branches. Select one of your sister branches. You gain access to that branches 1st and 3rd level features and can now learn jutsu with the associated branch keywords with the following limitations:
Harmonic Branch: You gain one Doki of your choice. You can summon it following the rules of the Conductors Throne clan feature. You can command it, once per turn as at no action cost. Your Doki acts on your turn. You also gain 2 Harmonies from the Harmonic Songs clan feature. These two Harmonies are always prepared for you.
Symphonic Branch: Your Shinobi Instrument can begin to store up to 2 Resonance, and can use all three Melodies in the same way that the Resonance Crown clan feature dictates. You also gain 2 Harmonies from the Symphonic Songs clan feature. These two Symphonies are always prepared for you.
Mnemonic Branch: You learn to place Bell Wires following the rules of the Bell Witch clan feature. You can maintain up to 3 Bell Wires simultaneously and place one per turn at the start of your turn as described in the Bell Witch clan feature. You also gain 2 Mnemodies from the Mnemonic Songs clan feature. These two Mnemodies are always prepared for you.

Keyword: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Auditory, Unaware), Medical
Description: You play a song through your Shinobi Instrument at the detriment of your foes. While many can hear your song, only one is the true target. Select one creature in range as their psyche is repeatedly attacked. Make 2 ranged Genjutsu (or ninjutsu) attacks against them. On a hit, you deal 2d6 psychic damage and force them to make a Charisma saving throw.
Success: The target suffers no additional effects.
Failure: The target gains 1 rank of Disoriented and the next non-d20 based roll they make has a d4 penalty.
Critical Failure: Same effects as a failure, but the target gains 2 ranks of Disoriented.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.

Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action

Components: CM, W (Shinobi Instrument)

While charmed by this jutsu, the creature cannot hear anything besides the music being made by the genjutsu.
Success: No effects, and this jutsu ends on the target.
Failure: The creature is Charmed and Restrained, enraptured by the music. The target may remake this saving throw to end this jutsu’s effects at the end of each of their turns. This jutsu’s effects end immediately if the take damage or are knocked prone.
Critical Failure: Same effects a failure, but the target is also Incapacitated for the duration.

Select a creature in range, the target must make a Charisma saving throw, on a failed save, for the duration, whenever they are asked a question, they must answer truthfully, otherwise they take 5d8 psychic damage and become Confused for the duration.
A creature under the effects of this Genjutsu remakes their saving throw each time they respond to a question. If the creature answers truthfully, they make the save at advantage. If they lie or refuse to answer, they instead make the save at disadvantage.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.

Description: When you see a creature attempt to cast a jutsu and weave hand seals, you release a sound wave in response attempting to disturb them. Target creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Critical Success: The target suffers no additional effects.
Success: The target gains 1 rank of Disoriented.
Failure: The target gains 2 ranks of Disoriented and have the triggering jutsu’s casting fails.
Critical Failure: Same effects as a failure, but the target cannot cast the triggering jutsu for the next minute as their thoughts become hazy when thinking of it. They can clear their haze by spending an Action to still their thoughts.

Critical Success: The target suffers no additional effects.
Success: The target gains 1 rank of Disoriented.
Failure: The target gains 2 ranks of Disoriented and if the affected creature takes psychic or force damage before the end of your next turn, the vibration energy detonates, dealing 5d8 force or psychic damage (your choice).
Critical Failure: Same effects as a failure, but each time the affected creature begins concentrating on a jutsu before this jutsu’s effect ends, then this jutsu has a duration of 1 minute, and each time they maintain concentration on the chosen jutsu at the beginning of their turns, they take 5d8 psychic damage.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
#### Demonic Instrument: Doki Bomb

You play a melody forcing your Doki to realize that they are weapons of relative destruction. Select one active Doki. They spend their movement moving as close to a hostile creature as possible.  At the end of their movement, if a hostile creature is within range, they can make an attack, targeting them using one of their available attacks. After the attack, your Doki self-destructs, blowing themselves up. All creatures within 20-feet of the Doki when it explodes make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 4d12 force damage.
As part of them detonating, you can spend your Reaction to resummon this Doki.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.

If the Doki (Club) scores a hit, the target creature takes damage as if they were hit by Club twice and must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are knocked Prone and have their speed reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.

If your Barrier would have hit points remaining, all creatures within 10 feet of you feel the backlash, and they must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking psychic or force damage, equal to the barriers original hit points.
