## Shoton Clan
A Chunin female is trapped behind enemy lines as the opposing force of mercenaries led by a prominent rogue ninja are advancing towards her position. “Damnit, we need help! Where is Genkai!?” she exclaims as a fireball erupts at her location. She barely avoids it as her back is badly burned. The rogue shinobi approaches her with a katana hanging over his shoulder with a smug grin. “Any last word scum, Before I send your head back to the Tsuchikage in a bag?” He says confidently as he raises his sword ready to deliver the final blow. “Yeah, I got one” a voice exclaims from the tree’s. “You need to know how to treat a lady” the voice continues before the rogue ninja begins to see his forces slowly become overtaken by blue crystalline constructs as they are frozen in time inside the beautiful crystal.
—Himari Hyūga
The Never-Ending Wars, Ch. 11 excerpt.
### Diamonds in the Rough
The Shoton Clan is a clan that hails from the land of Sound. A Clan without a clear family name, but one which has produced many of prominent shinobi. This clan has an extreme affinity for earth release allowing them to convert any matter into crystals with enough chakra control. They have been known to serve the Otokage at some point in history, but its members have long since spread and assimilated into different villages and formed a multitude of different family names, becoming most prominent in the land of earth most recently.
### Shoton Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Cha
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Nature, Survival
Passive Affinity: You begin with Earth Release Affinity
Crystal Release: The Shoton Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Shoton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.
Crystallization: As a Bonus action, you can conjure one melee or ranged weapon with a bulk of 2 or up to two melee weapons with a bulk of 1 that you are proficient in. These weapon shares any weapon seals found on weapons you currently have that it qualifies for. These weapons are known as Crystal Weapons.
### Shoton Features
#### Crystal Form
1st Level Clan Feature
The Shoton Clan is one known for its ability to manifest crystal release. The Clan is often closely associated with an iconic member, Guren who was a notable and powerful member that worked for Orochimaru. But the bloodline is vaster than that. Shoton Clansmen are able to express two distinct forms of combat. You can embody one, the other or both as the battle demands.
When you enter initiative, you can access one of two different forms; either the Crystal Weapon Dance or Crystal Aura Form. You remain in either of these forms until the end of combat and can switch your chosen form as a Bonus action on your turn.
While using either form, your crystals are hardened by your will, granting it the ability to both shield and reinforce allies and yourself in combat. This is represented as its Hardness, of which it has an amount equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.
Regardless of the form you choose, when you cast a Jutsu that summons a Construct, structure or Barrier you can spend 1 Hardness as part of its casting. When you do, that jutsu gains the Earth Release keyword and is treated as if summoned by a Shoton Hijutsu for that casting.
You can regain spent Hardness by casting Shoton Hijutsu or completing a long rest. You regain an amount of Hardness equal to the rank of the Jutsu cast (D-Rank: 1 Hardness, C-Rank: 2 Hardness, B-Rank: 3 Hardness, A-Rank: 4 Hardness, S-Rank: 5 Hardness.)
Crystal Weapon Dance
While wielding a Crystal Weapon and in this combat form, your weapon can deal Earth damage or its normal damage, which you choose when you roll damage. In addition, it gains two special weapon properties; Prismatic Edge and Crystalline Structure.
Prismatic Edge. Once per turn, per creature, when you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] with your Crystal Weapon, you can spend 1 Hardness to force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they become Bruised or Weakened, your choice.
Crystalline Structure. As part of casting a Shoton Clan Hijutsu or Ninjutsu with the Earth Release keyword that summons a creature, you can spend 2 Hardness to infuse the summoned creature with your Crystal Weapon, causing it to gain additional DR equal to half your level against the first damage they take, each round. While your weapon is infused into this creature, you cannot use it. You can defuse your weapon from the creature at the beginning of your turn.
Crystal Aura
You conjure a shard of crystal infused with your will that bonds to you in a visible place of your choice. This crystal radiates a 10-foot radius aura, centered on you. The size of this aura increases by +5 feet at 7th and 15th levels.
When creatures within your crystals aura take damage, you can spend your Reaction and up to 2 Hardness per creature damaged to shield them from harm. For each Hardness spent on a creature, remove the highest rolled damage die from the damage total affecting that creatures, working from the highest to lowest value. Increase the number of Hardness you can spend per creature to 4 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level.
#### Crystals, Gems and Jewels
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your Crystals are not a ubiquitous and monolithic resource. The Shoton devised a network of carefully structured shapes of chakra-based mock-molecules to express different properties in the crystals you use depending on the needs of the moment.
When you complete a long rest, select up to 2 Crystal Types from following list. This increases to 3 at 7th level and 4 at 15th level. These cannot be changed until you complete your next long rest. Depending on our Crystal Form, each Crystal Type provides a bonus to the Crystal Form you are in. While you have multiple Crystal Types at a given time, you can only benefit from one at a time, switching the Crystal Type you want to benefit from at the beginning of each of your turns. Crystal Aura effects only apply to creatures within the Crystal Aura’s radius.
If a Crystal Type calls for an attack roll or saving throw it uses your highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC.
Amethyst Ward
Crystal Weapon Dance. Summoned creatures infused with your Crystal Weapon, gain temporary hit points equal to the rank they were summoned at, at the beginning of each of your turns. (D-Rank: 4 Temporary hit points, C-Rank: 8 Temporary hit points, B-Rank: 12 Temporary hit points, A-Rank: 16 Temporary hit points, S-Rank: 20 Temporary hit points)
Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a rank of Mastery to resist Mental conditions. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.
Emerald Lattice
Crystal Weapon Dance. You gain a rank of Mastery to maintain concentration on Shoton Clan Hijutsu. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level. Beginning at 15th level, if you would fail concentration on a Shoton Clan Hijutsu, you can spend 2 Hardness, to instead maintain Concentration.
Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a rank of Mastery to maintain concentration on Jutsu they cast. Beginning at 7th level, you can spend 1 Hardness to add 1d6 to their Concentration or Clash check. Beginning at 15th level, if an allied creature other than yourself loses concentration on a Jutsu, you can spend 2 Hardness for each jutsu they are concentrating on, to allow them to maintain concentration on said jutsu, for every 2 Hardness spent.
Jade Verdancy
Crystal Weapon Dance. Once per turn, each time you cast a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu using a Crystal Weapon, you regain hit points equal to your unarmed or weapon damage die result. Beginning at 7th level, this increases to twice per turn, and three times per turn at 15th level.
Crystal Aura. Once per turn, allied creatures that regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu with the Medical keyword, regain +4 additional hit points. This increases to +6 at 7th level and +8 at 15th level.
Onyx Shell
Crystal Weapon Dance. Once per turn, when you take damage, you can spend your reaction to shield yourself with Obsidian crystals. When you do, roll your [Weapons Damage] + 1d6, reducing the damage taken by the result. Increase the damage reduced by +2d6 at 7th and 15th level. If you reduce the triggering damage to 0 as a result of this reaction, you force all hostile creatures within 10 feet of you to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the result of your roll as Earth damage on a failure or half as much on a success as shards of obsidian pepper them in retaliation.
Crystal Aura. If you spend Hardness on an allied creature other than yourself, increase the Hardness benefit as if you spend +1 additional Hardness. This bonus increases by an additional +1 at 11th level. You do not spend additional hardness this way.
Quartz Veil
Crystal Weapon Dance. Your Crystal Weapon gains +1 ranks of the Blocking weapon feature. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a +1 bonus to their AC. This increases to +2 at 7th level and +3 at 15th level.
Ruby Blaze
Crystal Weapon Dance. Your Crystal Weapon gains a rank of Mastery to the damage it deals. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a +2 bonus to [Weapon Damage] and [Unarmed Damage] they deal. This increases to +4 at 11th level.
Sapphire Tide
Crystal Weapon Dance. Your Crystal Weapon gains +1 ranks of the Critical weapon feature. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a +1 bonus to the critical threat range of jutsu they cast. This increases to +2 at 7th level and +3 at 15th level.
Topaz Surge
Crystal Weapon Dance. When you score a critical hit with your Crystal Weapon, you regain 4 Hardness. Beginning at 7th level, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a hostile creature under the effect of a Jutsu you cast with the Earth release keyword, you regain 2 Hardness. Beginning at 15th level, you can regain 1 Hardness each time you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a hostile creature with an Elemental condition.
Crystal Aura. When an allied creature other than yourself scores a critical hit, you regain 4 Hardness. Beginning at 7th level, once per turn, when an allied creature other than yourself begins their turn and maintains concentration on a jutsu they cast, you regain 2 Hardness. Beginning at 15th level, once per turn, when an allied creature other than yourself casts a jutsu while in your radius, you regain 1 Hardness.
#### Crown Jewels
7th Level Clan Feature
The Shoton clan is no stranger to fools coming to them and begging for rare or expensive gems. They have experienced it enough to know that wealth is always a tool for a shinobi to exploit.
By spending 10 minutes, working with your crystal release, you can conjure one ornate or expensive looking crystalline regalia (A Crown, a brooch, signet ring, scepter, or any other object of apparent status or value.) This regalia seen in passing appears as the genuine article and cannot be discerned as fake or fabricated without a steady eye or chakra-based means such as Chakra sight or sensing. The regalia persists for 24 hours before it dissolves into a sand like material. You can have one regalia at a time. If you create another one while one is active, the previous regalia dissolves into sand.
While you or another creature is wearing or wielding your crystalline regalia, creatures that aren’t familiar with them, that are influenced by wealth, status, nobility, institutional authority or a social hierarchy, treat the wearer as being of higher standing, often of high or noble like status. Creatures of high authority are unaffected by the regalia’s effects. The wearer gains the following benefits against such creatures;
The first time the wearer makes a request of them, the wearer can make a Persuasion or intimidation check at advantage. The target creature must make a Wisdom saving throw vs the result. On a failure they attempt to complete the regalia wearers request.
Can access areas often restricted or reserved for people of higher station or authority, such as forcing audiences with officials, bypassing checkpoints or claiming ownership of resources or valuables temporarily until exposed as a fraud.
When a creature that values wealth or status first sees the regalia’s wearer, they must make a Wisdom saving throw against your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they are preoccupied with the regalia’s status for the next minute. They will not begin the social interaction with them, with hostile intentions.
#### Crystal Symbiosis
11th Level Clan Feature
You’ve reached a point where your ability to juggle different crystal effects becomes second nature. You can now benefit from two different Crystal Types from the Crystals, Gems and Jewels clan feature.
In addition to this, you have learned to crystalize any creature you summon as a result of a jutsu. As part of casting a Jutsu that summons a creature that has a nature release keyword or using a class feature that summons a construct of your creation, you can crystalize them, granting them the Crystal Body trait based on one of the Crystal Types. You do not have to be using a Crystal Type to grant a summoned creature that Crystal Type.
Crystal Body (Amethyst). This creature always takes half damage from effects that affect an area.
Crystal Body (Emerald). If the jutsu used to summon this creature requires Concentration, that jutsu gains the Stable and Efficient keywords.
Crystal Body (Jade). This creature can spend its Action to release a pulse of rejuvenating energy, healing all allied creatures 2d6 + its summoners level, in hit points.
Crystal Body (Onyx). This creature interposes all attacks against allied creatures within 10 feet of it.
Crystal Body (Quartz). This creatures AC is increased by +2, and an additional +1 for every rank above its base rank it is summed at.
Crystal Body (Ruby). This creature increases its attacks damage die rolled by 1 step.
Crystal Body (Sapphire). Once per turn, If this creatures attack result is 5 or higher than its targets AC, treat that attack as a critical hit
Crystal Body (Topaz). When this creature uses a Recharge ability, its summoner regains 4 Hardness.
#### Crystal Ascension
15th Level Clan Feature
The ultimate expression of the beauty and power of crystal release. You not only create crystals; you infuse yourself with them.
As a Bonus action, while within 10 feet of a creature you summoned as a result of a class feature or a Jutsu you cast with the Earth release keyword, you can spend 4 Hardness, to fuse into them, becoming a single entity. When you do, you immediately begin to occupy their space as you are treated as a single creature. Record your hit points prior to fusing, this becomes your Original Hit Point Value. In your fused state, regardless of the hit points the creature or you had originally, your new fused state has 120 Hit points. You use the summoned creatures size and physical statistics (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution) while retaining your own mental statistics (Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma) as well as all of your own speed, class features, clan features, and access to only your Shoton Clan Hijutsu. You can use the summoned creatures attacks and abilities as well as any granted to it as a result of a Shoton Clan feature or Hijutsu as well as the following bonuses.
You benefit from both Crystal Weapon Dance and Crystal Aura at the same time while fused.
Your Crystal Aura radius is increased by +10 feet, while fused.
You can remain in this fused state for 1 minute, your fused hit points are reduced to 0, or you spend an Action to end the fused state. When the fused state ends, you cannot enter it again until you complete a long rest, you appear in the nearest space that can hold you, and the creature you fused with is dispelled. If the fusion ended as a result of your hit points falling to 0, any remaining damage from the triggering instance of damage, is applied to you and your Original Hit Point Value.

## Jinzo Clan
“Look at ‘em. Doesn’t he remind you of someone?”, the Bandit King asks his advisors as he stands, raising his hands in feigned confusion, in reference to the pale skinned boy tied to a chair and wounded from the interrogation techniques employed. “I think if you surrender now, you will have a chance at redemption mister.” The captured shinobi speaks, with a voice that would scream both ignorance and meekness. “Oh, really now boy? And what if I choose to not surrender? Whose gonna punish me ‘eh?” the Bandit King retorts with an obvious condemnation in his voice. “Ah well, at least we can’t be reprimanded for not giving them the option.” The boy responds speaking aloud. “What do you mean we!?” the Bandit responds, before the lights go out. A flash of light and the pale skinned boy with a sinister smile would be the last thing the Bandit King see’s before that same boy walks out of the Bandit camp, with his snake in tow and his team looking on in abject horror.
—Lyo Hataka
The Long Road, Ch. 9 excerpt.
### Designed Existence
The Jinzo are named as such because they are a small pseudo family of people, not related by blood, but by design. Biologically designed individuals created either by a rogue scientist, or by sanctioned village action. Their current defining trait is that the members of this clan are a rough mix of decedents of both successful and failed artificial duplicates of the legendary Sanin, Jiraiya and Orochimaru, while others have been recently created and released or lost to the wild, with their own fates as their guide. While this is not an official family name or structured clan, most villages designate such individuals using Jinzo as their surname due to most of them not having an actual family name to refer to.
### Jinzo Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Int, +1 Any, except Str or Int.
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Perception, Survival.
Extra Language: Bio-Speak, you understand Mutants and other artificially created beings that either have no language, or have developed their own makeshift language, being able to communicate with these creatures telepathically, while within 10 feet of them.
Passive Affinity: You begin with either Fire, Water or Lightning Release Affinity (Pick one).
Synthetic Techniques: The Jinzo Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Jinzo Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
Branch Family: The Jinzo are split between two different branches, the [Shin Branch] and the [Bio Branch], also known amongst village elites as the Synthetic Human: Jiraiya or Orochimaru strains. The [Shin Branch] are members who were not born, but instead made. People who were given consciousness at their current stage in life, with no inherent memories beyond those they suddenly woke up with. The [Bio Branch] are members who were artificially born from a single strand of genetic data, with the inherent goal of evolving and surpassing the source of their DNA. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later.
### Jinzo Features
#### Bio-Bonded Pet
1st Level Clan Feature
Every Jinzo carries within their biology, the capacity to generate a Bio-Bound Pet. A living extension of their own synthetic/artificial makeup. An entity grown of their own Biomass, bound to them on a biological level. At character creation, select either Bio-Snake or Bio-Toad, as your Bio-Pet. Your branch inherently leans towards one Bio-Pet, but you can choose either one. This choice cannot be changed later and helps define how you interact with both combat and exploration.
Your Bio-Pet is friendly to you and your allies, but only responds to your commands but can be no more than 120 feet away from you at any given time, being dismissed if you are ever outside of this range. In combat it acts as part of your turn, but has its own reaction. You can command your Bio-Pet in the following ways.
Move. At no action cost to you, you can command your Bio-Pet to move its full movement.
Strike. As part of an attack made with your Attack action or a Jutsu you cast that makes attacks, you can command your Bio-Pet to use either its Bite or Tongue Lash attack.
Synchronize. As a Bonus action, you can command your Bio-Pet to perform any of its special abilities, Dash, Disengage, Hide, Help or perform a skill-based action in place of you while exploring or not in combat.
When you are incapacitated or unconscious, your Bio-Pet cannot act on its own. If your Bio-Pet is reduced to 0 hit points, it immediately dies, and over the course of a Long Rest, you perform a secret ritual resummoning your Bio-Pet using your bio-mass as its base.
Your Bio-Pet is treated as the same level as you and gains special traits as it grows in level. When you would gain the Ability score increase/Feat class feature at levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 19, it also increases two of its ability modifiers and their associated saves by +1 of your choice up to a max of +5.
You must select your Bio-Pets type between the Bio-Amphibian and the Bio-Serpent. This also determines which Hijutsu you have access to.
Bio-Amphibian. A Bio-Pet designed for combination tactics and Combat synergy and aggression, linked to the [Shin Branch]
Bio-Serpent. A Bio-Pet designed for trickery, subterfuge, traps and tempo control, linked to the [Bio Branch]
#### Soft Physique
1st Level Clan Feature, [Bio Branch]
Your body isn’t bound by the same limitations as another human. Because you aren’t just human. You are more. The Genetic data woven into your biology grants you instinctive mastery over your own biomass and physical structure in the form of your Soft Physique Technique.
When initiative is rolled you can activate this technique for the duration of combat. Alternatively, you can activate this state as a Bonus action. While active you gain the following benefits:
Reach Extension. Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 property. This increases by +1 at 7th and 15th levels. This increased reach also extends to Taijutsu you cast, when you attempt the Grapple Skill action, or even when exploring the environment and attempting to grab, reach or interact with something within range that you can see.
Instinctual Coil. You can use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by the Hijutsu Flexibility clan trait when using the Grapple skill action.
Dragging Wrap. You can move your full movement speed while maintaining a Grapple. Also, you can push or pull a creature Grappled by you up to your full reach distance by spending 5 feet of your own movement, once per turn, without ending the grapple, as long as the creature remains within your reach at the end of the movement.
Coiling Pull. You can carry or grapple up to two creatures of your own size category or smaller, simultaneously, one in each arm.
#### Engineered Predator
1st Level Clan Feature, [Shin Branch]
You one day awoke the way you are. Conscious of yourself, your abilities and your potential, but not of your destiny. That you make yourself. This power is expressed through your skilled use of your Bio-Pet and special Fuinjutsu seals that amplify your technique. You gain the Shin-Pet and Shin-Seal abilities, but can only utilize one of these at a time.
When you enter initiative, you can begin to focus on either your Shin-Pet or Shin-Seal combat focus, which lasts until the end of combat. Alternatively, you can spend a Bonus action to enter one of these focuses outside of combat. You can switch your chosen focus as a Bonus action on your turn.
Shin-Pet
Your Bio-Pet isn’t designed just for combat, but also for penetration, getting into places and on targets without being detected. Your Bio-Pet gains the following abilities.
Extended Range.  Your Bio-Pet can be up to 1 mile away from you without consequence. While further than 120 feet away from you, it cannot receive commands to Strike or Synchronize, but can follow the Move command.
Telepathic Link. Your Bio-Pet can communicate with you telepathically unless there is a chakra-based obstruction or barrier between you both. While telepathically communicating with you, your Bio-Pet conveys all that it can see and hear, within 60 feet of it.
Latch. Your Bio-Pet gains the Latch attack.
Latch. This attack can only be made while the pet is unseen or Hidden. Make a Melee Weapon Attack: 5ft., one target. Dex+ Prof to hit. On a hit, the bio-Pet becomes Latched. While latched, the Bio-Pet is attached to the target is moves with them automatically. You always know its exact location and attacks you make against a Latched creature ignores the benefits of cover or Invisibility, except full cover and cannot be made at disadvantage. A Latched creature can only detect the Bio-pet if they have Chakra Sensing or Chakra Sight or succeed on a perception check vs the Bio-Pets Stealth DC. If the Bio-Pet is detected, the Latched creature can spend a Bonus action to remove it, ending the Latched effect. If you switch Focus while your Bio-Pet is Latched they remain latched.
Shin-Seal
Your body naturally is attuned to a special Fuinjutsu signature that is unique to you or maybe your creator. A sign of your engineered origin. These seals are only visible to you, appearing as a pattern of your design.
You can apply a Shin-Seal to a creature when you successfully score a hit with an Attack you make, or as a Bonus action when you touch a structure or object.
You can mark a number of creatures, objects or structures equal to your proficiency bonus at a time and the Shin-Seal lasts for 1 minute or until spent by an effect that triggers them, such as Jinzo Hijutsu you cast. You always know which creatures or objects are currently marked by a Shin-Seal.
Creatures marked with your Shin-Seal remain marked even if you are not using this focus.,
#### Biological Evolution
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Bio Branch]
Your synthetic biology had hidden potential that is now being realized as you grow older and stronger. Things sealed away within your DNA that you can now access. Select 2 Biovolutions from the following list. You gain 1 additional Biovolution at 7th and 15th levels. Effects that force a saving throw or make an attack use your highest jutsu attack bonus or Save DC.
Constricting Coil
A creature Grappled by you, takes your [Unarmed Damage] at the start of each of their turns. This increases to twice your [Unarmed Damage] at 7th level and three times your [Unarmed Damage] at 15th level.
Alternatively, you can choose to forgo the damage of this Biovolution to instead force them to make a Strength saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened on a failure, as their body is compressed beyond their tolerance point. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th level and 3 ranks at 15th level.
Bio-Matter Strike
Your synthetic biology has unlocked a secondary gland that coats your extended limbs in a compound of your design when active. Once per turn, when you hit a creature and deal [Unarmed Damage] while Soft Physique is active, you can force them to make either a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, Pick one.
Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure, the affected creature gains 1 rank of Doused. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level
Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the affected creature gains the Stupor condition. At 11th level, if you score a critical hit with an unarmed attack, you instead inflict the Stupor condition without a saving throw.
Regenerative Tissue
Your cells have unlocked a rapid response healing protocol. Once per initiative, when you take damage that would reduce you below half your maximum it points, your body springs into action, rapidly regenerating 2d6 + Half your level in hit points at the end of the turn you took the damage.
Cellular Redistribution
Your body can redistribute impact across various points of your skeletal structure. When you take damage, you can spend your Reaction, to reduce the triggering damage by 2d8. You then immediately move up to 10 feet into a direction of your choice without provoking opportunity attacks as your body repurposes the kinetic energy. Beginning at 7th level, increase the damage reduction by 1d8, and an additional 1d8 at 15th level.
DNA Resonance
Your genetic makeup is malleable, and shift and reconstitute itself to aid another. As a Bonus action, by touching a willing creature within your reach, you channel biomass into them. The target creature removes 1 rank of any Physical or Sensory condition they have while also regaining 1d6 + your level in hit points. You can use this effect once per creature, per rest. Beginning at 7th level, you can also remove 1 rank of a Mental condition, and increase the hit points regained by +1d6. Beginning at 15th level, increase the number of times you can use this on a creature to twice per rest.
Biomass Augment
You learn to push your Biomass into your Bio-Pet temporarily expanding their physical capabilities beyond their base design. As a Bonus action, while your Bio-Pet is within 10 feet of you, you can both command and augment them until the end of your turn. While augmented your Bio-Pet gains the following:
Their size increases by 1 stage.
Their movement speed increases by +15 feet.
They gain a rank of Mastery to their attack rolls.
They increase the damage they deal with their Bite and Tongue Lash attacks by +1 damage die. This increases to +2 damage dies at 11th level.
Beginning at 7th level, this transformation lasts for up to 1 minute, but requires concentration as if concentrating on a B-Rank jutsu and they gain temporary hit points equal to your level for the duration. Beginning at 15th level, their size increases by 2 stages, and they gain DR equal to half your level.
Suppressive Grip
You can suppress chakra within a foe just by touching them. While a creature is Grappled by you, at the beginning of each of their turns, you can choose to make them make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 3d6 chakra damage, and gain 1 rank of Sealed for the duration of the grapple. The damage increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels. Beginning at 11th level, the ranks of Sealed increases to 2. A Grappled creature that has a ranks of Sealed due to this effect, loses the ranks of Sealed gained by this effect, when they are no longer Grappled by you.
Symbiotic Restorative
Your shared biology, allows your Bio-Pet to share in the benefits of restorative actions. When you would regain hit points, as a result of an item, jutsu or feature, if your Bio-Pet is within 10 feet of you, they regain half the hit points you gained as well.
#### Synthetic Awakening
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Shin Branch]
The knowledge stored within you synthetic body is not set in stone or static. It grows, branches and expresses itself as you accumulate more experience, represented as new things you begin to remember you can do. Select 2 Synthwakenings from the following list. You gain 1 additional Synthwakening at 7th and 15th levels. Effects that force a saving throw or make an attack use your highest jutsu attack bonus or Save DC.
Chakra Conduit
Your Bio-Pet develops Jutsu slots like a summoned creature, gaining its Constitution Modifier + half your level in slots, regaining spent slots when you complete a short or long rest and you gain the Cast command. When you gain this Synthwakening, they can select 2 D-Rank Jutsu with a nature release keyword that you have access to without the Fuinjutsu, Clone, or Kinjutsu keywords adding it to their jutsu list. Jutsu it casts uses its own ability modifiers, but your proficiency bonus to calculate their Attack bonuses and Save DCs.
Beginning at 7th level, they can select 2 C-Rank jutsu with the same restrictions. Beginning at 15th level, they can select 2 B-Rank jutsu with the same restrictions.
Cast. As a bonus action, you command your Bio-Pet to cast a jutsu it knows
Predatory Instincts
Your Bio-Pet has developed an aggressive response to threats against you. Your Bio-Pet gains the Multiattack and Camouflage abilities, both of which you can use as part of the Synchronize command.
Multiattack. This Bio-Pet can make two attacks using Tongue Lash, Oil Spit, or Bite.
Camouflage. This Bio-Pet becomes Invisible until it attacks, is touched, or 1 minute has passed. While invisible the Bio-Pet has a Rank of Mastery to its Latch attacks and increases its Stealth DC by +5. Beginning at 11th level, the Bio-Pet can maintain invisibility even after making a Latch attack.
Elemental Augmentations
Your synthetic physique carries with it special ways to infuse jutsu you cast. Once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu with the associated nature release keyword, you can use its listed effects. If the Jutsu cast has more than one nature release keyword, pick one of the listed effects.
Fire Release. If the Jutsu cast affects an area the shape of a Cube, sphere, cylinder or radius, increase the size of the affected area by +5 feet.
Water Release. If the jutsu cast doesn’t inflict an Elemental condition, you can force all affected creatures to make a Dexterity saving throw, gaining the Doused condition on a failure. If the jutsu cast does inflict a save, then on a failure they gain 1 rank of Doused. Beginning at 7th level, if the jutsu inflicts an Elemental condition, then it also inflicts 1 rank of Doused on a failure. Beginning at 11th level, increase the ranks of Doused inflicted by +1.
Lightning Release. If use the Jutsu’s Overcharge effect, it forces the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining Stupor on a failure. If the jutsu cast forces a saving throw, then if the target fails the original save, they gain the Stupor condition.
Synthetic Seal
Your Shin-Seals have developed a secondary property to them. While you have an active Shin-Seal, so long as it is within 60 feet of you, you can dispel that Shin-Seal as part of casting a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu that affects an area in the shape of a Sphere, Cube, radius or cylinder.
When you do, the jutsu becomes centered on the creature, structure or object that was marked with the Shin-Seal.
Layered Seal
Your Shin-Seals can now be stacked and layered onto creatures forming a more oppressive mark. A creature can now have up to 5 Shin-Seals on them at any given time. When a creature with Shin-Seals on them casts a Jutsu that you can see, you can spend your reaction to dispel all Shin-Seals on them. For every Shin-Seal dispelled this way, they increase the cost of the jutsu cast by +6.
Punishing Seal
Your Shin-Seals now interact with the Oil/Neurotoxin your Bio-Pet uses. When a creature with ranks of Doused or Stupor has a Shin-Seal, they suffer the listed effect based on the condition applied.
Doused. The affected creature cannot mold chakra appropriately without consequence. At the beginning of their turn when they maintain concentration on a Jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they increase the cost to maintain concentration by +6 for every rank of Doused they have.
Stupor. The affected creature has its nervous system under constant attack and stress. When they cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure their speed is reduced by half, and they must spend 5 feet of movement for every Attack they make until the end of the current turn. If they cannot spend the require movement, they cannot make the associated attack.
Installed Foresight
Your synthetic biology includes a predictive combat module that processes threat data faster than conscious thought. You cannot be Surprised, and once per turn, when a creature you can see makes an attack against you, you can spend your reaction to impose disadvantage on the triggering attack as your body moves before you even realize what is happening.
Beginning at 7th level, if the triggering attack misses, you can as part of the same Reaction cast a D-Rank Jinzo Hijutsu targeting the triggering creature at no chakra cost. This increases to C-Rank at 15th level
Latched Seal
Your Bio-Pet doesn’t just hold on, it also marks the latched creature so long as it is Latched.
Also, while a creature is both Latched by your Bio Pet, and marked with a Shin-Seal, the first time they would make a saving throw against a Jinzo clan Hijutsu you cast that affects an area, they cannot benefit from advantage or Jutsu based bonuses on this saving throw.
#### Synthetic Battle Aura
[BOX]
| #### Synthetic Chakra Mode / Battle Amp / Your chakra engine roars to life allowing you to emulate the power of Senjutsu. You have the following base benefits: / Synthetic Surge. You gain a +1 bonus to Unarmed Attacks, or Attacks made as a result of Jinzo Hijutsu. This increases to +2 at 15th level. / Accelerated Biology. Your movement speed increases by +20 feet, and you gain immunity to the Slowed condition and cannot have your speed reduced by hostile effects / Then you gain benefits based on which Branch you hail from; / Bio Branch / Unleashed Physique. Your Soft Physique feature is enhanced by providing an additional +1 rank of Reach. / Shedding Response. When you take damage that would reduce you to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction to end your Synthetic Chakra Mode and roll 6d6.Your hit points fall to 0 but you remain conscious, and at the end of the current turn, you regain the result of the roll dice as hit points. / Shin Branch / Overclock. You can benefit from both Shin-Pet and Shin-Seal at the same time, and once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, you can select one creature within 60 feet of you, marking them with a Shin-Seal. / Anchor Latch. While your Bio-Pet is Latched to a creature, that creature cannot teleport, lose their fly speed if any and cannot benefit from effects that would increase their movement speed. / Finally, you gain benefits based on which Bio-Pet you have beginning at 15th level. / Bio-Amphibian / Oil Field. Yor Bio-Amphibians oil glands go into overdrive. All hostile creatures that begins or ends their turn within 5 feet of the Bio-Pet, gains 1 rank of Doused. / Bio-Serpent / Chakra Serpent Projection. Your Bio-Serpent merges into your form, being manifested as a chakra construct connected to your lashing aura. It is always connected to you and can no longer be targeted for attacks or hostile effects. It can now only reach and affect creatures no more than 30 feet from you. It retains all of its abilities, and attacks. For the duration, you gain the Chakra Serpent Special Action. / Chakra Serpent. Once per turn, on your turn, you can spend this action to command your Bio-Serpent, in place of a Bonus action. |
[/BOX]
7th Level Clan Feature
Your synthetic biology was never designed to replicate a human. You were always meant to both surpass your replicant, and become your own person. Deep within your engineer chakra network lies a dormant chakra engine that roars to life when you will it.
As a bonus action, you can activate your Synthetic Battle Aura for the next minute. When you do, your skin glows or has cybernetic patterns trace over it. Your hair glows or begins to grow in a wild pattern. Your eyes shift or begins to erupt in a pale like flame, and your begin to release enough chakra until it becomes visible to the naked eye. Once you use this state, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.
#### Ghost Protocol
11th Level Clan Feature
Your Bio-Pet was not exclusively designed for combat. It was designed to help you surpass the original. It can go where you can’t, see what you cannot and hear what is out of reach. By spending 10 minutes in contact with your Bio-Pet, you can activate their Ghost Protocol for the next 24 hours. While active, your Bio-Pet can move at an accelerated rate, gaining +90 feet movement speed and can telepathically communicate with you. Also, while hidden they become Invisible, and is unable to be seen or sensed with Chakra sight or Chakra sensing, but in exchange they cannot receive the Strike, Synchronize or any commands gained as a result of either the Biological Evolution or Synthetic Awakening clan features.
The Bio-Pet becomes able to exist up to 10 miles away, sharing its vision and hearing with you and being able to still receive basic commands such as move and Latch (They can take the Latch command even if your Branch did not originally gain the Latch Command). The first time you would roll initiative in an area the Bio-Pet has explored using this feature within the next 24 hours, you roll at advantage. By spending 1 minute the Bio-Pet can draw a summoning seal, filling a 10-foot cube on the ground and then summon you and all willing creatures touching you to the summoning seal, filling spaces you each can occupy within 5 feet of the Bio-Pet with you being summoned in the Bio-Pets space. If there isn’t enough room to hold all creatures summoned this way, then you and randomly chosen creatures are summoned until no space within 5 feet of the Bio-Pet is available to be summoned in. Once you are summoned this way, the Bio-Pet cannot summon you again until you complete a Full Rest.
If the Bio-Pet is harmed in any way while this feature is active, this feature ends and that instance of the Bio-Pet dissolves. If the Bio-Pet is still Latched to a creature when the feature ends, if they are outside of its normal range it can persist away from you, it dispels itself before being resummoning itself within 10 feet of you.
#### I’ve Become, Me
15th Level Clan Feature
You are no longer a work in progress. An experiment or a mistake. You are yourself, no longer a copy of someone else. Your synthetic biology has developed the ability to analyze and integrate biological data from creatures you’ve come into contact with. Once per combat when your Bio-Pet deals damage to a non-construct hostile creature with its Bite or Tongue Lash attack, it steals some of the targets Bio-data. Select one of the following benefits, which you maintain until the end of combat.
Adaptive Resilience. You gain a random resistance the target creature has.
Adaptive Senses. You gain a random special sense such as Tremor sense, Blindsight, Darkvision or Chakra sight.
Adaptive Physiology. You gain one random saving throw proficiency from the target creature that you don’t have proficiency in.

| Stupor / [Physical], [Sensory] / A creature suffering Stupor has been injected with a synthetic hallucinogenic that assaults their brains ability to process information. / A creature with Stupor suffers a -2 penalty to all Strength and Dexterity based rolls. / A creature with Stupor has all ranks of Mastery suppressed. / A creature immune to the Envenomed condition is immune to this condition. / A creature with Stupor can spend an Action, to make a DC 20 Constitution or Intelligence ability check to end this affliction. |
[/BOX]
[BOX]
| Doused / Max Ranks: 5, [Elemental], [Physical] / A Doused creature is covered in a toads belly oil, usually very flammable…oh no. / A Doused creature that takes Fire or Lightning damage takes 1d6 fire damage for each rank of Doused they have. Remove all ranks of Doused after this conditional damage is applied. / A Doused creature that takes Cold damage has its speed reduced by 10 feet for each rank of Doused they have and they cannot gain a bonus to speed, until the end of their next turn. Slithering Ambush. Once per turn, when a hostile creature makes an attack against the Bio-Serpents summoner, the Bio-Serpent can make a Bite attack, at no action cost, against the attacking creature.
Battle Fatigue. The Bio Serpent has abilities that have charges. They regain these charges when a new initiative is rolled.
Attacks

Constrict. The Bio-Serpent grows in length and size, before wrapping itself around a creature it can see within 5 feet of it, restricting its movements. The target creature must make a Strength saving throw, being Grappled. Grappled creature can spend its action to attempt to escape as normal.
Shed Skin (7th level, 2/Charges). When the Bio-Serpent takes damage, it can shed its outer layer of skin as a reaction, reducing the triggering damage by half as its discarded scales take the brunt of the impact.
Serpent Coil (15th level, 1/Charges). When the Bio-Serpent Successfully grapples a creature, it can make 3 Bite attacks against them. If two of the three attacks are successful, the target creature is Stunned until the end of the current turn.

Bio-Amphibian Traits
Spy. The Bio Amphibian is a master at stealth and infiltration. It gains a rank of Mastery at Stealth. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.
Battle Fatigue. The Bio Amphibian has abilities that have charges. They regain these charges when a new initiative is rolled.
Attacks
Tongue Lash. Melee Weapon Attack: 15ft., one target. Str+ Prof to hit,  1d6+Strength Mod bludgeoning damage and the target is moved 5-feet along the ground, into a space that can hold it.
Oil Spit. Ranged Attack: 30 feet, one target. Dex (or Int) + to hit. The target gains 1 rank of Doused being coated in toad oil. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.
Sticky Ground (7th level, 2/Charges). The Bio-Amphibian secretes oil from its body, across the ground filling a 10-foot radius around itself. The area becomes difficult terrain and if a jutsu that can trigger the Doused condition affects the area or a creature within the area, all creatures within the area, suffer the effects of the Doused condition.
Oil Burst (15th level, 1/Charges). When the Bio-Amphibian takes damage, it can spend its reaction to detonate its oil reserves, even if that damage reduced it to 0 hit points. All creatures within 15 feet of the Bio-Amphibian must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 fire damage, and gaining the maximum ranks of Doused. On a success they take half damage and no further effects.

## Jinzo Clan Jutsu
### D-Rank
#### Synthetic Art: Bio-Electric Shock
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: 30 Feet
Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM
Cost: 4 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Lightning Release
Description: You generate a discharge of lightning from your body, which takes any shape of your description before deciding on a target to strike as quick as lightning.
Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack against a creature in range. On a hit, you deal 3d10 Lightning damage and force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they are Dazed. If this attack is made targeting a Grappled or Chilled creature, they suffer a -1 penalty to their saving throw.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, the impact of this jutsu can send a creature into Stupor on a failed save, instead of Daze, at your choice.
#### Synthetic Art: Flaming Impact
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Self (15-Foot cube)
Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM, M
Cost: 4 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fire Release
Description: You synthetically ignite a part of your body before striking with it, creating a large explosion with enough force to leave whoever was in your path charred from the heat.
You strike forward and detonate the flame, filling a 15-foot cube originating from you. All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw taking your [Unarmed Damage] + 3d6 fire damage on a failure.
If an affected creature is Grappled by you or an allied creature, after the save result, you can make one unarmed attack against the target creature.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage of the jutsu and unarmed attack by 1d6 fire damage. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, on a failure affected creatures are Staggered.
#### Synthetic Art: Suppression Seal
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: 60 Feet
Duration: Concentration, Up to 1 minute
Components: HS, CM, CS
Cost: 5 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Earth Release, Lightning Release, Fuinjutsu, Shin Branch
Description: You conjure 4 stone pillars that occupy a space they appear in. Select a point you can see in range, then select 4 spaces within a 30-foot radius not occupied by a creature, structure or construct, where your special stone pillar will be summoned. Finally, select one pillar and draw a straight line from it, to another pillar, repeating this process until each pillar connects to one another from this line. All creatures within the area of the newly drawn enclosure are trapped within a special suppressing seal as jolts of lightning arcs following the line drawn from each pillar to the next. All enclosed creatures must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they cannot cast Jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component of the same rank or lower as this jutsu until the end of your next turn. Each affected creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of your turns.
Each Stone pillar has an AC equal to your Ninjutsu save DC, and 25 Hit Points. Each time a Pillar is destroyed, you must redraw the line reconnecting each pillar to one another. If there are ever 2 or fewer Stone pillars remaining, this jutsu ends early.
Shin-Seal: If an affected creature has a Shin Seal, you can dispel it. If you do, they make their saving throw with a -2 penalty and on a failure, they also gain the Shocked condition.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the hit points of the Pillars by +10. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of Pillars you summon by +2. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of Pillars you summon by +2.
#### Synthetic Art: Hidden Shadow Burial
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Instant
Components: M
Cost: 5 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bio Branch
Description: You burrow your arms underground, as they snake their way through the ground before rising up out of the ground to grab an opponent by their ankles, dragging their legs into the ground, immobilizing them. The target creature must make a Dexterity saving th row. On a failure, they are Restrained in place until the end of their next turn.
If a creature is Restrained in this way, you can select one allied creature, excluding yourself, allowing them to spend their Reaction to cast a Jutsu that makes an attack, with a casting time of 1 Action or take the Attack Action, targeting the Restrained creature.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the range of this jutsu by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can select yourself to spend your reaction to cast a qualifying jutsu targeting the affected creature. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, the Restrained creature must spend their Action to end the Restrained condition as their entire lower half is drug underground.
#### Synthetic Art: Oil Bullets
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: 60 Feet
Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM
Cost: 4 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Bio Amphibian
Description: Emulating the ability of your Bio-Pet, you are able to convert your chakra into a sticky oil, and spit it in bullet like bursts. Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack, against a creature you can see in range, dealing 4d6 cold damage and forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid being covered in the oil. On a failure, they gain a rank of Doused, and their speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Doused by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can change the shape of the oil burst into a Self (30-Foot cone), originating from you. If you do, then forgo the attack, and all creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the jutsu’s damage and conditions and effects on a failure. On a success, the affected creatures only take half damage. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Doused by +1.
#### Synthetic Art: Armor-Eater
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: D-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM, W (Any Armor)
Cost: 4 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Water Release, Bio Serpent
Description: Emulating the ability of your Bio-Pet to constrict a foe, you aim to have your armor do that for you. You melt some linking pieces of the armor you are wearing, creating a black liquid you can freely manipulate, that dart out and attempt to trap your foe. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, their mobility is greatly hindered, as their speed is reduced by 20 feet. If a creatures speed is reduced below half the maximum, the liquid metal is able to seep into open parts of their body poisoning them, as they enter a Stupor until the end of your next turn.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, creatures that fail their saving throw have the liquid metal begin to harm their armor as it liquifies some of their armor temporarily, reducing their AC and DR by 2, until the end of your next turn. This penalty increases by 1 for every rank above C-Rank this jutsu is cast.
### C-Rank
#### Synthetic Art: Adaptive Biology
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Components: CM
Cost: Special (9 Chakra)
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Stable
Description: Your bodies biology rapidly reconfigures into a more defensive state, allowing you to resist harmful effects and even shrug off very damaging assaults.
When this jutsu is cast, select one Damage type or condition you’ve experienced this initiative. For the duration you gain resistance to the chosen damage or condition.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is Cast at A-Rank, you can instead select any combination of Damage types or conditions you’ve experience, up to two, gaining resistance to them for the duration.
#### Synthetic Art: False Smog Technique
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when a hostile creature you can see moves within 10 feet of you.
Range: Self (10-foot radius)
Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM
Cost: 9 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile), Shin Branch
Description: When a creature moves close enough, you are able to trigger your trap, releasing a thick smog of smoke from your body, forming a smokescreen that both masks you and your allies movements, but also is harmful to breathe. You spew a thick cloud of dense black smoke that forms as a 10-foot radius cloud centered on you, that lasts until the end of your next turn, forcing the triggering creature to make a Constitution saving throw.
Critical Success: No further effect
Success: Affected creature becomes Dazzled and treats the smoke as light obscurement until the end of the current turn
Failure: Affected creatures gains 2 ranks of Dazzled until the end of the current turn, and treats the smoke as light obscurement for its duration.
Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the smoke causes them to enter a Stupor for its duration.
Shin-Seal: If an affected creature has a Shin Seal, you can dispel it. If you do, on a failure, they are also Blinded until the end of their next turn.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the size of the smoke cloud and the range in which a creature needs to be to cast this jutsu by +5 feet.
#### Synthetic Art: Syphoning Biology
Classification: Hijutsu
Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take on any turn you are currently Grappling a creature
Range: Special
Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM
Cost: 9 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Bio Branch
Description: This jutsu can only be cast while you have a creature Grappled. You begin to forcefully siphon the targets will and strength from them, for yourself.
All creatures currently grappled by you must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d6 chakra damage and gain a rank of Weakened for the next minute or half as much on a success. A creature weakened by this jutsu, remakes this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the condition on a success.
You gain temporary hit points equal to the result of highest die rolled as part of this jutsu’s chakra damage and increase the next instance of damage you deal by +4, for every rank of Weakened inflicted by this jutsu.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6, and the ranks of Weakened inflicted by +1.

On a failure, they are crushed under your Pet, taking 3d12 bludgeoning damage being knocked Prone and Bruised on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

## Tsuchigumo Clan
Lendio waits hiding in the darkness of the trees. His target walking unaware he is being stalked. Lendio jumps into action, weaving a web, capturing them almost instantly.
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 4 excerpt.
### Arachnophobia
The Tsuchigumo Clan is a small clan from the land of Rice, which finds its home in the Sound Village. But ever since the destruction of the Sound Village, they have scattered and are known to work closely with the Grass and Leaf Villages respectively. They are known for their odd genetic makeup allowing them to create webs, and biological matter that acts like Chakra resistant armor.
### Tsuchigumo Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex, +1 Wis
Speed: 30 feet
Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics, Perception
Weapon Proficiencies: You are proficient with Short bow’s and Longbows.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Tsuchigumo Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Spider Climb: When Wall Walking, you do not spend additional movement during movement and you do not make saving throws or checks to resist being pushed or pulled at disadvantage.
Web Weapons: As a Bonus action, you can conjure one ranged weapon with a bulk of up to 3 or up to two melee weapons with a bulk of 1. These weapon shares any weapon seals found on weapons you currently have that it qualifies for. They become brittle and break if another web weapon is conjured. If a ranged weapon has the Ammunition trait, you never need to roll for it as you make ammunition as part of each attack made.
Spider Techniques: The Tsuchigumo Clan have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Third Eye: All clansmen have a third visual organ, located on your forehead, known as your Third eye. You can spend a Bonus action to open this eye for the next 10 minutes. While this third eye is open and unobstructed, you gain a rank of Mastery to the Search skill action and Passive perception, but it is unseemly causing all creatures unfamiliar with you, that sees you to react with caution, reducing their Attitude with you to Unfriendly.
### Tsuchigumo Features
#### Spiders Thread
1st Level Clan Feature
There is a reason the Tsuchigumo are feared. It’s not their third eye or unique physiology. It’s the patience. You do not chase your prey; you lie in wait before taking the shot. You achieve this through use of your clans special Web Anchors. Special chakra infused silk you produce, anchoring it to surfaces to create a near invisible network of silk platforms, serving as both a detection system, and a firing platform for your most precise attacks.
When you take the Attack action, you can replace all attacks you would make to instead place a number of Web Anchors equal to the number of attacks you would have made. Each Web Anchor occupies a 10-foot cube attached to any surface you can see within 60 feet. You can maintain a maximum of 4 Web Anchors simultaneously, increasing to 5 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level. Placing a new anchor beyond your maximum dismisses the oldest one. A Web Anchor lasts for 1 minute in combat or 1 hour outside of combat before dissolving. The Web Anchor, while covering a surface is hidden well due to its translucence and thin profile, represented with a Stealth DC equal to your highest Jutsu save DC. A creature is unaware of the Web Anchor so long as their Passive perception or Search skill action result is lower than the Web Anchors Stealth DC. Web Anchors can be targeted for attacks or damaged by effects that would cross its area. Web Anchors have 10 AC, 15 HP, and immunity to Bludgeoning damage. Once a Web Anchor has reached 0 hit points, it is dispelled.
Beginning at 7th level, if you would only make one attack as part of the Attack action, you can place two Web Anchors instead of one when replacing that attack.
While you have Web Anchors active, if a hostile creature enters the space of one of your anchors, while also within the maximum range of a held ranged weapon, you become aware of their presence and can target them for attacks, even if they would normally be unseen or invisible, even though full cover, though attacks through full cover at made at disadvantage. When you make a ranged weapon or Taijutsu attack against a creature occupying the space of your web anchor, you treat their AC as 2 lower than its current value, as the uncertainty from your attack is erased.
#### Silk Weaves
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Tsuchigumo clan were once famous tailors and seamstresses before being conscripted by the Sound village to be assassins and spymasters. This ancient tradition informs their ability to use their special silk to achieve things normally impossible by the average shinobi, known as Silk Weaves, special techniques that allow you to create a unique silk thread weave that enables your Web Anchors to have far more use than being a simple pressure plate system. When you complete a rest, you can select 2 Silk Weaves to benefit from until you complete your next rest. You can prepare an additional Silk Weave at 7th and 15th levels. If a Silk Weave requires a saving throw it uses your highest jutsu save DC. You can only use one Silk Weave that requires you to dispel it per turn, unless otherwise specified.
Entangling Web
Once per turn, when a hostile creature enters the space of a Web Anchor, the silk instantly constricts, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Grappled in place by the webs until the beginning of their next turn. Beginning at 11th level, a creature that fails their saving throw is instead Restrained in place, remaking their saving throws at the end of each of their turns, ending the Restrained condition on a success.
Razor Web
Once per turn, when a hostile creature enters the space of a Web Anchor, the silk begins to pull tug and grind against the triggering creature, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Bleed. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th level and 3 ranks at 15th level.
Trap Silk
Once per turn, as part of setting a Web Anchor you can select one weapon with a Bulk of 1 or an explosive tool and set a trap for creatures that would trigger them based on the item used.
Weapon. If you use a weapon, you are disarmed of it as it is set in place with your Web Anchor. If a creature crosses the area of your Web Anchor, you can dispel it triggering a lethal trap. The triggering creature and all other creatures within 5 feet of the Web Anchor becomes the target of this Silk Weave. Make a ranged attack, comparing the result vs the AC of all target creatures, dealing the [Weapons Damage] on a hit. This is treated as a weapon attack for effects and features that trigger from it. Increase the damage dealt to twice the [Weapons Damage] at 7th level and three times the [Weapons Damage] at 15th level.
Explosive Tool. If you use an explosive tool, one charge is spent as it is placed with your Web Anchor. If a creature crosses the area of your Web Anchor, you can dispel it triggering a lethal trap, forcing the triggering creature and all other creatures within 5 feet of the Web Anchor to make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage, suffering the effects of the explosive tool.
Guiding Weave
Your Web Anchors act as guiding posts for ranged attacks made with a Web Weapon. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack using your Web Weapon, you can choose to target a Web Anchor. If you do, you can then draw a 60-foot long, 5-foot-wide straight line from the Web Anchor in a direction of your choice. All creatures this line crosses must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapons Damage] on a failure, or half as much on a success. This increases to twice your [Weapons Damage] at 11th level.
Unsuspecting Prey
When a hostile creatures steps onto a space occupied by your Web Anchor, you can spend your Reaction, to either take the Attack Action, making a weapon attack targeting them or Casting a Tsuchigumo clan Hijutsu that makes an attack targeting them.
These attacks have a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This increases to +2 at 7th level and +3 at 15th level.
Guiding Threads
Your Web Anchors become platforms your allies can use to coordinate with you on. While an allied creature other than yourself is standing on your Web Anchor, when they make a ranged attack, they gain a +1 bonus to their attack result. This increases to +2 at 11th level.
Wider Web
You spread your webs wider to affect a wider area. Increase the size of your Web Anchor to a 15-foot Cube. This increases to a 20-Foot Cube at 11th level.
Lifeline
Your Web Anchors lets you know when danger is coming for your allies, before they are even aware. When a willing allied creature that you can see, who is within 30 feet of a Web Anchor takes damage, you can spend your reaction to launch a silk line to them, and pull them 30 feet, ending this movement on the Web Anchor. If the triggering attack was from a melee attack, this reaction occurs before the attack is made, potentially causing the triggering attack to miss, if the ally leaves the attackers reach.
Golden Silk
While standing on your Web Anchor, when you take damage from a melee attack, your webs cover you, absorbing some of the impact. You gain 4 DR vs these attacks, and immunity to chakra damage. This increases to 6 DR at 7th level and 8 DR at 15th level.
Disorienting Thread
While you have at least two Web Anchors placed no more than 30 feet apart from one another, if a hostile creature would move into the space of one, you can dispel that Web Anchor, to force them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are pulled up to 30 feet, into a space covered by the other Web Anchor and falls prone.
This movement can trigger other Silk Weave effects that rely on moving into a space occupied by a Web Anchor.
Silk Tag
Rather than waiting for a creature to step on one of your Web Anchors, you force them to carry it with them. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack or deal [Weapon Damage] to them as a result of a Hijutsu you cast, you can mark them with Silk Tag. Creatures marked with this tag are treated as always occupying a space covered by your Web Anchor. This tag lasts until the end of your next turn before dissolving.
#### Master Silk Weaver
7th Level Clan Feature
The Tsuchigumo were not always warrior. Your people were craftsmen, tailors and seamstresses. That tradition was never lost, but repurposed. By spending 10 minutes working with your natural Silk, you can construct a traversable structure of your design, filling a 20-foot cube, such as a bridge, rope, ladder platform or something similar. This structure lasts for 1 hour before dissolving. When you construct this structure, you designate any number of creatures that you know who will or might use it. The structure can only support medium or smaller creatures, and any creatures that makes contact with the structure that you did not plan to use it, causes the structure to immediately collapse. Once you create a structure in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest of any type.
Alternatively, over the course of a short or long rest, you can weave a wearable silk garment indistinguishable from high quality clothing. This clothing lasts for up to 24 hours or until in contact with water before dissolving. Non-Hostile creatures that are unfamiliar with the wearer that interacts with them improve their attitude with the wearer by 1 rank due to being impressed by the quality of the clothing. This attitude improvement lasts until a circumstance would logically dispel it.

#### Web Walker
11th Level Clan Feature
Your body has reached a threshold that most of your clan never reach. Your silk glands beneath your skin multiply and grows. Your senses extend beyond what your eye and ears can provide.
As a Bonus action, you awaken your Arachnid state for the next minute. Once you exit this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a short rest.
[BOX]
| #### Arachnid / Battle Amp / You become as close to an arachnid as you’ve ever been. For the duration you gain the following benefits; / Six Arms. Two additional sets of silk construct arms erupt from your torso. Once per turn, at no action cost to you, you can place one Web Anchor. Additionally, with your extra arms, you can wield up to two additional web weapons in your other arms, or cast jutsu with the Hand sign (HS) component even when your normal hands are occupied. The weapon in your normal arms are treated as your Primary Weapons. You can only benefit from the weapon seals found on your Primary Weapon. / Silk Domain. Select two Silk Weaves you don’t have prepared. You can use these weaves while in this state. / Spider Sense. Your perception of threats becomes almost instantaneous. Creatures cannot gain advantage on attacks against you as a result of them being hidden or unseen by you. Additionally, once per turn, if a creature 10 or more feet away from you would miss you with an attack while you have a ranged weapon equipped, you can make a single ranged weapon attack against them. This attack cannot be made at disadvantage |
[/BOX]
#### King of the Brood
15th Level Clan Feature
You have formed a permanent and lifelong contract with the Brood Mother, an ancient and powerful arachnid from the Spider tribe, offering only your finest silk. This contract is not with the tribe but with this specific sage creature.
As an Action, you can call upon the Brood Mother, summoning it into a space that can hold it within 10 feet of you. Once summoned, you can command it as a Bonus Action on your turns as you would following Commanding A Summon section under the Summoning Jutsu chapter of Jiraiya’s Jutsu Compendium.
It uses your highest Jutsu attack bonus and Save DC to calculate its attacks and ability save DCs.
Once the Brood Mother is reduced to 0 hit points, it bursts into a cloud of fine web fibers, being dispelled, teleporting back to its home domain to rest and recover. When the Brood Mother is dispelled or dismissed, it cannot be summoned again by you, until you complete a long rest.
