### C-Rank:
#### Spider Art: Web Slingshot
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: C-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 90 Feet Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM, M, W (Any Melee) Cost: 7 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu Description: You release two thick cords of silk, binding them to a nearby surface as you drag your body against it until it can’t handle the strain, before letting yourself go, and being launched in a straight line like a missile in a direction of your choice, up to 90 feet, landing in a space that can hold you, otherwise falling prone.
This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks, and if you would cross a creature as part of this movement, you can come crashing down on them, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw and ending your movement within 5 feet of them. On a failure, they fall prone and you deal your [Weapon Damage] (or [Unarmed Damage]) + 1d12.
Alternatively, when you cast this jutsu, you can target one willing allied creature within 5 feet of you, having them benefit from this jutsu as if they cast it.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the range of this jutsu by +30 feet.
#### Spider Art: Web Flower
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: C-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 60 feet Duration: 1 round
Components: HS, CM Cost: 9 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu Description: You spit several small nets of webbing from your mouth at up to 3 targets. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack against up to three targets you can see in range. On a hit, the affected creature has their movement speed reduced by 10 feet for each successful attack until the end of your next turn.
If a target is hit by 2 or more these attacks, they must make a Dexterity saving throw, having their hands bounds, being unable to cast jutsu that require Hand Signs (HS) until the end of your next turn.
If a target is hit by 3 of these attacks, on a failure of their Dexterity saving throw, they are also Blinded and Slowed until the end of your next turn.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of attacks you make by +1.
#### Spider Web Wall
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: C-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Components: HS, CM Cost: 8 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Barrier Description: You anchor webbing between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) that are capable of bearing the tension. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 10 feet tall and 1 foot thick and can be shaped to follow the design of available surfaces. Creatures treat other creatures on opposite sides as lightly obscuring.
If a creature attempts to pass through the wall, they must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they become Restrained within the walls space for the duration. A Restrained creature can spend their Action to make a Strength saving throw, escaping on a success.
The Wall has an AC equal to your jutsu save DC, and each 10-foot section has 20 hit points, being able to destroyed independently. The wall has immunity to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage, and vulnerability to fire damage.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the hit points of each wall section by +15. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, the wall becomes heavily obscurement for creatures on opposite sides. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, its duration becomes 1 Hour and no longer requires concentration.
### B-Rank:
#### Spider Art: Silk Burial
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 60 Feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 Hour.
Components: CM Cost: 14 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Efficient Description: You can only cast this jutsu while at least one creature is standing on an active Web Anchor. You pull on the threads you set long ago, and cause one Web Anchor to collapse on itself. All creatures standing on the chosen Web Anchor when this jutsu is cast is forced to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are encased in a silk Cocoon for the duration.
An encased creature is Incapacitated, Blinded and Deafened, but well encased in their cocoon. The Cocoon has an AC equal to your jutsu save DC, 40 hit points, 10 DR immunity to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage and cannot be moved except by you. The sealed creature can spend its Action on its turn, even while Incapacitated, to make their Strength saving throw to escape on a success. If the cocoon is reduced to 0 hit points, the encased creature is able to escape. Any remaining damage targeting the cocoon does not transfer to the encased creature.
While a creature is encased, once per turn, on your turn, you can constrict the cocoon, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning damage directly to the encases creature. A creature that dies within the cocoon is perfectly preserved.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the cocoons hit points by +10. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, it increases its DR by +4.
#### Spider Art: Killing Thread
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 60 Feet (30-Foot Cube) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Components: HS, CM Cost: 12 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu Description: You launch dozens of near invisible cutting threads of silk, anchoring them between everything that can hold them, across a wide area. Select a point you can see within range, as you manifest a 30-foot cube of lacerating silk threads originating from this point for the duration.
This area is treated as difficult terrain, and if it crosses an area occupied by your Web Anchor, the entire area is also treated as your Web Anchor.
The first time each turn a creature moves through this jutsu’s area, they must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d8 slashing damage and fall prone on a failure, or half as much damage on a success on a success.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
### A-Rank:
#### Spider Art: Rain of Spiders
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: A-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Special (60-foot cylinder) Duration: 1 Minute
Components: HS, CM, CS Cost: Special (24 Chakra) Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu Description: You can only cast this jutsu while the Brood Mother and its Broodling’s are active. You draw a seal across your body in golden silk before drawing blood and pressing it into the ground release a pulse of arachnid pheromones. All active Broodling’s begins to hear you, listening to you and your directives.
For the duration all active Broodling’s no longer attack autonomously, and instead act as part of you commanding the Brood Mother, following separate commands you give, each Broodling acting independently if you dictate. Additionally, your Brood Mother and Broodling’s gain the Web Rain special ability. When you use this ability, both the Brood Mother and Broodling’s act on this single command at the same time.
Web Rain. All currently active Broodling’s move their full movement towards a single creature, and then the Brood Mother makes 2 Web String attacks targeting the same creature. For every Broodling that ends their movement within 5 feet of the target creature, they each make a Bite attack. If a creature is Bleeding or Weakened, the Broodling’s deal +4 damage to the target creature.
# Minor Land Clans
## Non-Clan
Miles punches his training log for the thousandth time today, punching the core of the tree at this point. His teacher walks onto the training field telling Miles to get some rest, it won’t come easier without sleep. Miles turns towards his teacher and begins to focus as chakra begins to swirl around his body. His teacher sees what he’s doing “Miles! Stop! You gonna~”. He stops mid-sentence as he notices that Miles has done it. He has unlocked the 3rd Inner gate. Potential is limitless when you're not bound by preconceived notions of success and expectations.
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 1 excerpt.
### Limitless Potential
Those who are a part of no bloodline or large recognized family are known as Non-Clanners or Non-Clan for short. They are the most numerous of the Naruto World and are the primary people who end up creating new clans and families for generations to come. They show the most potential and have the largest room for growth. They don’t have many limitations in regards to what’s expected of them so they have the freedom to try new things and build an identity unique to themselves.
### Non-Clan Traits
Ability Score Increase: +2 to any Ability Score, +1 to any other Ability Score (or +1 to any 3 Ability Scores.).
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Pick any 3 Skills to gain proficiency in.
Self-Taught Skills: Select two skills you have proficiency in, you gain 1 Rank of Mastery in those skills.
Though Blood, Sweat and Tears: Reduce the Ryo cost to learn and create Jutsu to 0. Also, reduce the Downtime cost to learn and create jutsu by an amount equal to the rank of the jutsu. (D-Rank: -1, C-Rank: -2, B-Rank: -3, A-Rank: -4, S-Rank: -5)
Unrelenting Focus: Select one Feat that you qualify for. You gain an additional Feat choice at 7th and 15th levels.
### Non-Clan Features
#### Limitless Potential
1st Level Clan Feature
You were born with no special family name. No bloodline. No Hijutsu. No Kekkei Genkai. You were born with nothing, but the unending drive for greatness beyond those who were born with it all. You wake up every day with one goal in mind. To surpass everyone else. You accomplish this in two distinct ways, your Drive and your Style.
Drive
Your grit and tenacity in combat is called your Drive, a measure of you building momentum, focus and experience through an encounter. You begin each combat with 0 Drive, and can accumulate up to 1 + Your Proficiency bonus at any given time, resetting to 0 when combat ends.
You gain 1 Drive, when you deal damage to, or take damage from a hostile creature. You can only gain Drive, in either way, once each, until the start of your next turn.
Feature cannot grant you Drive more than once before the start of each of your next turns, unless otherwise specified.
As you build Drive, over the course of combat, you gain passive bonuses based on that accumulated value, can spend it on effects and abilities that call for it. You cannot gain Drive as part of the same action or feature that you spend Drive on.
Momentum Shift – 2+ Drive: Once per turn, when you deal or take damage, you can move up to half your speed, without provoking opportunity attacks and can spend 1 Drive to either; Use a skill-based action, Use the Help action or make one unarmed or weapon attack against a creature in range (Pick one).
Drive Dice – 4+ Drive: Once per turn, you can spend 2 Drive to add a d4 to provide a bonus or penalty to any attack roll, damage roll, or Ability or skill check made by an ally or hostile creature within 30 feet of you. This die is added before the roll resolves. Once you add a bonus or penalty dice to a creatures result, you cannot do so again, for that creature, until the end of your next turn. The power of this penalty increases to a d6 at 11th level.
Apex Drive – 6+ Drive: Your unlock your styles Apex effect, for the remainder of combat.
Style
At character creation, select one of the following Styles.. This Style determines how you generate Drive and what unique abilities you have to spend your Drive on. Each Style grants you a way to generate Drive, a unique special ability and your Apex Drive.  This choice cannot be changed later.
Blazing Style. Embodied by those who fights with unmatched aggression and focus (Ex. Rock Lee, Might Guy, Zabuza). Attacks you make gain Pierce 4.
Drive Charge: You can gain 2 Drive on a critical hit.
Blazing Surge: As a bonus action, you can spend 2 Drive, converting it into a single charge of an expendable resource your class has (Genjutsu Specialist: Actualization Die, Hunter-Nin: Combat Exploit forgoing Lethal Attack die, Medical-Nin: Domain Charges, etc.).
Apex Drive: When you unlock this effect, select one hostile creature, and select one Damage type or condition. Damage you deal ignores resistance of the chosen damage type. The target creature cannot make saving throws to resist the chosen condition at advantage.
Adamant Style. Embodied by those who endure what others cannot (Sakura, Tsunade). For every Drive you have at the beginning of each of your turns, you gain +2 Temporary hit points. If you have temporary hit points granted by another effect when this feature would activate, you instead gain half of the listed amount, adding it to your current temporary hit point value
Drive Charge: You can gain 2 Drive when you reduce a triggering damage source by half or more.
Enduring Surge: As a Bonus Action, you can spend 2 Drive, selecting one creature you can see within 30 feet of you, until the end of your next turn, the first time each turn you take damage from this creature, reduce the number of damage dice rolled by 1. This increases to 2 at 7th and 3 15th levels.
Apex Drive: You refuse to fall in battle, you must endure. Each time you would fail a saving throw, you can spend 1 Drive to gain a rank of Mastery to the result. You can do this twice per failure.
Guiding Star Style. Embodied by those whose strength multiplies through the bonds they share with their allies (Iruka, Shizune, Sai). All allied creatures, excluding yourself, within 15 feet of you gain a +2 bonus to their damage rolls as your presence sharpen their focus. This increases to +4 at 11th level.
Drive Charge You can gain 2 Drive when you support an allied creature, other than yourself by increasing or restoring any dice-based result (Attack, Damage, Save, etc.), any statistic they have (DR, HP, Chakra, etc.) or reducing incoming damage they take. Other supportive effects can trigger this at GM’s discretion such as interposing an attack or interrupting a harmful jutsu.
Guiding Surge: As a bonus action, you can spend 2 Drive, selecting one allied creature. That creature can reroll the next 2 dice rolls they make. Once a creature benefits from this surge, they cannot do so again until they complete a short rest. This increases to 3 dice rolls at 11th level.
Apex Drive: You can use the Help Action targeting any allied creature, as a Bonus action, so long as they are within 60 feet of you. Additionally, when a creature benefits from this Help action, you gain temporary chakra points equal to half your level. You can only temporary chakra in this way, once per creature assisted, per short rest.
Shogi Style. Embodied by those who win battles through preparation, positioning and anticipation before a fight begins. (Temari, Hayate, Jiraiya). Ninja tools you used such as Explosive Tools, Medical Tools, Toolkits, Poisons or Scrolls can be used as a Bonus Action, if their normal use requires an Action.
Drive Charge: You can gain 2 Drive when a hostile creature gains a Condition.
Tactical Surge: As a bonus action, you can spend 2 Drive, to summon any one; Weapon, Explosive Tool, Trap, Toolkit, Communication Tool, Blank Keycard or Data Scroll of a rank you can access normally. These Ninja tools can be used once before breaking or expiring or 1 hour has passed, whichever occurs first.
Apex Drive: You always overprepare and overdeliver. Once per creature, per rest, when you cast a Jutsu you know, that you have not previously cast this combat, you can shock your opponent with the gravity of the technique. If they attempt to spend their Reaction in response to the Jutsu, its effects or as part of making or failing a saving throw, you can spend your Reaction, causing them to lose their Reaction.
#### Wayfarer
1st Level Clan Feature
You have to work harder to move in combat than your peers. You don’t have inherent special movement abilities like the Namikaze, Jiton or Hoshigaki. You weren’t born special. You had to work for yours. This is expressed in the following mobility options. You select one, selecting an additional option at 11th levels.
Surface Step
Your ability to adhere to a surface with chakra is exceptionally refined. When Wall or Water Walking, you no longer spend additional movement per foot traveled, allowing you to move at your full speed on walls, ceilings and across water. Additionally, you no longer make saving throws and checks to resist being knocked prone, pushed or pulled at disadvantage while Wall or Water Walking.
Deep Diver
Your Chakra control extends to your respiratory system. Double the length of time you can hold your breath both in and out of combat. Additionally, you gain a Swim speed equal to your movement speed.
Quick Shift
Your footwork has been refined to handle most hostile surfaces. Terrain that deals damage to you as you move through it is less effective against you. Reduce the damage you take from such terrain by 5. If you have DR, you can choose to instead apply your DR to the damage of this terrain.
Off Center Assault
While Wall Walking, if you make a melee attack against a creature that is not Wall Walking on the same surface, you overwhelm them with an assault from an angle they aren’t used to fending off. These attacks deal an additional 1d6 damage on a hit.
Silent Cross
While Wall Walking, Water Walking, Swimming or Burrowing, your movement is silent, making no sound. Creatures attempting to perceive you using sound make their checks at disadvantage. You are invisible to creatures using Tremor sense while using one of the listed special movements.
Flow State
When entering any form of special movement, you do not spend the normal 10 feet of movement to activate said special movement, allowing you to move between different special forms of movement with ease compared to other shinobi who are slowed down with each transition.
Chakra Suppressed Steps
While using Wall or Water Walking, you cannot be seen by Chakra Sight passively. A creature can only see you with Chakra Sight if they are performing the Search skill action and beating your Passive Stealth or Stealth DC, whichever is higher.
Living Shadow
Once per turn, on your turn, while in dim light or darkness, you can spend 10 feet of your movement to attempt the Hide skill action. Additionally, when you are Sneaking you can move up to your full speed.
#### Nindo
3rd Level Clan Feature
You are not someone who gives in easily. You have created a short saying to yourself, something you repeat to yourself when you are in a tight spot and when your backs against the wall. This saying is your Nindo, your Ninja way, and you repeat it when things get tough. You select one Nindo phrase reflavoring it to fit your shinobi, gaining its effects. You expand your horizons at 7th and 15th level, being inspired by your mentors, allies and clients, gaining an additional Nindo, at the select levels.
Never Back Down
This Nindo is one of tenacity. When an you gain a Physical or Mental Condition, you did not have ranks of already from a hostile effect, you gain 1 Drive. If you spend 1 Drive on your turn, you gain advantage on the first attack roll and saving throw you make before the beginning of your next turn.
Never Give up
This Nindo is one of perseverance. When you Clash with a hostile creature, you gain 2 Drive and a rank of Mastery to this Clash check.
Additionally, once per long rest, when you roll a Death saving throw, you can spend 2 Drive as part of rolling a success, you treat it as if you had succeeded twice.
Never Abandon A Friend
This Nindo is one of compassion. When an allied creature that you can reach within half of your movement speed takes damage, you can spend your reaction and 2 Drive to move up to half your speed towards them, redirect the damage to yourself, and if possible cast a Jutsu with a casting time of Reaction, when you take damage as part of this reaction.
Additionally, if an allied creature is Dying and you attempt to stabilize them, you make the check at advantage. On a success, they regain hit points equal to your level. You can heal a dying creature in this way once per long rest, per creature.
Never lose a Fight
This Nindo is one of power. When you lose a clash with a hostile creature, you can choose to spend 2 Drive. When you do, you treat this clash as if it were a draw.
Additionally, when you roll initiative fighting a hostile creature whose level is 2 or higher than your own, you gain 2 Will of Fire. If you have not used these Will of Fire before the end of combat, you lose them.
Never Fail
This Nindo is one of resilience. Once per turn, when you fail a saving throw that would deal damage to you, you can spend 2 Drive to remake the failed saving throw. If you spend 5 Drive, you can instead choose to automatically succeed, suffering no damage or effects that would be applied on a success.
Never Give In
This Nindo is one of resolve. When an ally is reduced to 0 hit points that you can see, you can spend 3 Drive. When you do, at the end of your next turn, you immediately take an additional turn. You gain 3 ranks of Exhaustion at the end of that additional turn.
Always Finish What I Start
This Nindo is one of conviction. Once per turn, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain 2 Drive, even if you gained Drive already this turn and can move up to half your speed towards another hostile creature. If you end this movement with that creature within your weapons range, you can make one weapon attack targeting them, dealing 2d6 bonus damage on a hit.
Always Move First
This Nindo is one of preparation. When you roll initiative, mark each hostile creature whose result is lower than yours until the end of your next turn. The first time you deal damage to a marked creature as a result of an attack, you can treat the attack as a critical hit, causing the creature to lose their mark.
Always Protect What Matters
This Nindo is one of purpose. When an allied creature within 30 feet is hit by a critical attack or fails a saving throw, you can spend your reaction to cast a D-Rank jutsu with a casting time of 1 Action, targeting the assailing creature, forcing a Clash.
Always Save Who I can
This Nindo is one of healing. When you cast a Jutsu or use a feature that restores an allied creatures, excluding yourself, hit points, you can spend 2 Drive to mark them as Saved, for the next minute. A Saved creature that gains ranks of a condition from a hostile effect, reduced the ranks they would gain by 1, losing the Saved mark.
Always Fix What is Broken
This Nindo is one of restoration. When you cast a jutsu or use a feature that removed a Condition from an allied creature you can spend 2 Drive to mark them as Fixed for the next minute. A Fixed creature is treated as they have resistance to the condition originally removed by you.
Always Go Beyond
This Nindo is one of evolution. The first time you fall below half your maximum hit or chakra points, you can choose to enter your Ultra Focus state. Once you enter this state, you cannot re-enter it until you complete a short rest.
[BOX]
| #### Ultra Focus / Fortitude Amp / Your back is against the wall and you need to focus, going beyond what your limits suggest; / Uncapped Strength. You gain a +2 bonus to damage you deal. This increases to +4 at 11th level. / Broken Limits. Once per turn on your turn, you can spend 3 Drive, spending your Bonus Action, to gain an Action. / Always Push Forward. You gain advantage on saving throws and checks to resist being Grappled, Restrained, Stunned, Staggered having your speed reduced by hostile effects. / Stress. At the end of each of your turns, make a Constitution ability check vs a DC 20. On a success, you persist in this state and it doesn’t end. On a failure, this state ends. |
[/BOX]
#### Chosen Path
3rd Level Clan Feature
Every shinobi arrives at a crossroad. The one that makes them choose a path of focus. The ones born into clans never have to make this choice. It was made for them as a result of their bloodline. But you aren’t one of them, you’ve speed unspoken time watching learning and determining which discipline is the one you will follow. Select one of the following Paths. This decision cannot be changed later.
Path of Ninshou
You’ve decided to focus on chakra molding and Ninjutsu.
Chakra Imprint. As a Bonus action on your turn, you can imprint a target creature within 60 feet of you with your chakra, until the end of your next turn. An imprinted creature, cannot make saving throws against jutsu you cast at advantage.
Chakra Anchor. When you deal damage to a creature, you can spend 2 Drive to restrain their presence. Until the end of your next turn, the affected creature cannot teleport or be moved by jutsu or feature based effects that does not spend their movement.
Path of the Fist
You’ve decided to focus on hardening your body, fists and feet.
Unrelenting Strikes. You unarmed attacks gain the Deadly 2 weapon property.
Combat Rhythm. When you deal damage to a creature with a Taijutsu you cast that doesn’t have either the Combo or Finisher keywords, you can spend 2 Drive to give the jutsu the Combo keyword.
Path of the Magician
You’ve decided to focus on breaking the minds of your foes.
Cold Illusion. Once per turn, when you score a hit with an attack against a creature, you can conjure an illusory doppelganger of yourself in any unoccupied space within 15 feet of you, has 10 AC, 1 Hit Point and lasts until the beginning of your next turn. While active and within 15 feet of you, the first time a hostile creature targets you, they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your Genjutsu save DC. On a failure, they target the doppelganger instead.
Illusory Tools. As part of casting a Genjutsu, you can spend 2 Drive to conjure one illusory Explosive Tool or ranged weapon, throwing it at the same target, either making an attack if a weapon, or following the rules of the chosen tool if it forces a saving throw. If the tool deals damage, the damage becomes psychic damage.
Path of the Blade
You’ve decided that a sharp or sturdy weapon is your best tool.
Twisting Turn. Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] to a hostile creature, you can make one additional attack using a Kunai, Shuriken or Senbon. If you score a hit with this attack, you force the target creature to make a Dexterity saving throw vs your Taijutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain a rank of Bruised until the end of your next turn.
Chain Break. As part of Casting a Bukijutsu with the Chain keyword, by spending 2 Drive, you can select which chain rank you want to use. Once you use this ability, you cannot benefit from the chain effect of a Bukijutsu you cast, until the end of your next turn. You can still sustain a chain as normal.
Universal Path
You’ve decided that dedicating yourself to a strict path is foolish. You choose to be flexible instead of rigid.
Self-Mastery. For every jutsu you cast beyond the first one cast on a turn, with a casting discipline keyword different from the previous jutsu cast this same turn, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage dealt, stacking up to three times.
Open Form. As part of Casting a Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can spend 2 Drive. When you do, you can spend either your Bonus Action or Reaction to gain an additional Action, which can only be used to cast one of the remaining casting discipline jutsu. If you do, you can spend an additional 2 Drive, to spend the remaining Bonus action or Reaction to gain an additional Action to cast one of the remaining casting discipline jutsu that you have not cast this turn. These castings must target different creatures, unless there is a Solo Adversary in combat, in which case these castings must target that creature.
#### One of Us
7th Level Clan Feature
You carry no clan name, no family crest and no inherited title that speaks before you do. To the merchants, farmers and laborers you are one of them, even if you wear a headband. When engaging in a social encounter with a creature that doesn’t carry a clan name or is of noble heritage, they have a softer attitude towards you because you feel relatable. Their Attitude towards you increases by +1, unless they are familiar with you or have a personal reason not see you as relatable.
Additionally, when you spend at least 10 minutes engaging with common folk in a settlement, outpost or populated area, you can tap into the whispers of these people, learning one of the following, GM Choice.
The name and whereabouts of one Criminal, Underground or Black-market contact in the area.
One rumor, secret or piece of information about a local clan, noble or authority figure that the common folk are aware of, but never speak openly about.
The current mood, tension or political situation among the common people, such as fear, unrest, or brewing conflict that authority figures are unaware of.
#### Righteous Growth
11th Level Clan Feature
You have grown. Through your choices, decisions, faults and failures. You have survived countless fights, and have learned from them the righteous way to forge your own path. You develop another way to build Drive, select one between Teamwork and Mobility. Regardless of this choice, you also gain 2 additional ways to spend your Drive.
Build Drive
Teamwork. Once per turn, when an allied creature provides you a boost to a roll you make, cleanse you of a condition, restores your hit points or chakra point, or uses an effect that provides you advantage or any other form of assistance in combat, you gain 2 Drive. Other supportive effects can trigger this at GM’s discretion such as them interposing an attack or interrupting a harmful jutsu.
Mobility. Once per turn, when you transition to using a form of special movement such as Wall or Water Walking, Swimming, Climbing or Burrowing, before making an attack or casting a jutsu on the same turn, you gain 1 Drive.
Spend Drive
Battle Insight. You can study a hostile creature you can see within 60 feet of you, using your accumulated battle experience to gather information normally invisible to you. By spending 1 Drive, and a Bonus action, you gain one of the following pieces of information.
One random Damage or Condition immunity, resistance or vulnerability they have.
Their DR.
Their Highest Saving throw, and its bonus.
Their highest Jutsu attack Bonus and Save DC.
One special action or ability they have.
Recover. You can spend Drive in multiples of 2, up to your remaining. For every 2 Drive spent this way, you remove 1 rank of any Physical, Sensory or Mental condition currently affecting you.
#### One Who Endures
15th Level Clan Feature
You’ve spent your whole life being compared to those with legacies, and told you were behind. But you’ve spent that time building yourself from nothing, to reach the peak of a world that expected nothing of you. You have become the one who endures.
Beginning at 15th level, whenever you would gain Drive from any Non-Clan feature, you gain +1 additional drive. Additionally, you gain immunity to the Demoralized and Shaken conditions as you can no longer be perturbed by anything other than disappointing yourself.
## Hoshi Clan
The leaf ninja stops in his tracks as a masked figure blocks the path forward. The leaf ninja pauses, mistaking the potential of their opponent. The figure then forms a strange hand sign as waves of energy saturate the air and a brightly colored wreath of chakra manifests behind them. As if looking at the distant sun, the chakra donned by this mysterious ninja sends flares of light the leaf ninja must squint through. "Incredible chakra!?" the leaf ninja tensely describes. The aura reaches its height as it takes shape to form a large tail of feathers. The tension is cut by another approaching who urges, "Wait! Stand down! This one is on our side ".
— Makuzoyashi Hanami,
The Miracle Bindings, Ch. 2, excerpt.
### Star Training
Member of the Hoshi clan are members of a rather small family of survivors from the reign of the Star Meteor. Your family were one of the few survivors of the initial training phases before it was destroyed during the Star Guard Crisis. Your family has sense left the land of Bears and settled down in one of the surrounding elemental lands giving you an opportunity to bring honor and pride back to Hoshigakure.
### Hoshi Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Int
Speed: 30 feet
Skill Proficiency: Chakra Control, Ninshou
Hoshi Techniques: The Hoshi Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
[BOX]
| Star Sickness / Max Ranks: 5, [Persist], [Elemental] / A creature suffering Star Sickness is suffering the radiation of overusing the meteors chakra. / A Star Sickened creature suffers a -2 penalty to all damage rolls they for each rank they have. / A Star Sickened creature makes Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws at disadvantage. / A Star Sickened creatures with 3 or more ranks of this condition cannot regain hit points except from short or long rests. / A Star Sickened creatures with 5 ranks of this condition cannot regain hit points except by Long Rests. / If a Star Sickened creature is part of the Hoshi Clan, then ranks of this condition cannot be reduced by Non-Hoshi Clan features, Jutsu or effects if the creature afflicted. / A Star Sickened creature reduces this condition by 2 ranks at the conclusion of a Long Rest. |
[/BOX]
Hijutsu Flexibility: Hoshi Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
[BOX]
| #### Kujaku Mode / Fortitude Amp / Your body manifests 8 fluttering tail feathers made of Star Chakra; / Cosmic Plumage. You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your maximum Star Chakra. If you begin your turn without these temporary hit points, you regain them. / Meteoric Speed. You gain a +10 bonus to your speed. This increases to +20 at 11th level. / Star Power. At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain Temporary Star Chakra equal to half of your maximum Star Chakra. / Star Sickness Boon(s) / Star Sickness (1+ Rank): When you take Chakra damage, you siphon some of the attacks chakra, turning it into Temporary Star Chakra, gaining an amount equal to half the chakra damage they rolled. / Star Sickness (2+ Ranks): Hoshi clan Hijutsu you cast cannot be dispelled except by effects at least 1 rank higher than it. / Star Sickness (3+ Ranks): Increase damage you deal with Hoshi Clan Hijutsu by 1d6 force damage. This increases to 2d6 at 7th level and 3d6 at 15th level. / Star Sickness (4+ Ranks): You gain an additional Reaction each round, which can only be used to cast a Hoshi Hijutsu or use a Hoshi clan feature. / Star Sickness (5 Ranks): Hoshi Hijutsu and Kujaku abilities that inflicts ranks of Weakened or Bruised, now instead inflicts ranks of Star Sickness on hostile creatures. |
[/BOX]
### Hoshi Features
#### Star Chakra
1st Level Clan Feature
The meteorite that helped found Hoshigakure did not simply fall from the sky, it warped the realities of all who found themselves in its orbit. Your bloodline has absorbed and metabolized this meteoric chakra granting you access to Star Chakra, a powerful and volatile alien chakra. You have a maximum pool of Star Chakra equal to 1 + your Proficiency bonus. You regain Star Chakra in one of two ways;
When you complete a short or long rest.
As a Bonus Action on your turn, drawing out as much Star Chakra as you desire. Regain a number of Star Chakra up to your maximum.
Star Chakra can be spent for features and jutsu that call for it. If you cast a jutsu using Star Chakra, it gains its Irradiated effect. Also, all temporary chakra you gain is converted into Temporary Star Chakra.
Temporary Star Chakra works like normal Temporary Chakra, but only for Hoshi clan features, abilities and Jutsu that spend Star Chakra. Temporary Star Chakra can stack unlike Temporary Chakra, but is always lost at the end of your following turn.
This Star Chakra while powerful, doesn’t come without risk, being hazardous to its users, inducing a mysterious sickness for overuse.
When you begin your turn, and have, since the beginning of your previous turn, spent or drawn out 4 or more Star Chakra, you gain 1 rank of Star Sickness. Beginning at 7th level, this penalty triggers if you spend 5 or more Star Chakra. Beginning at 15th level, this penalty triggers if you spend 6 or more Star Chakra.
#### Kujaku Peacock Plume
1st Level Clan Feature
The first and most prominent ability Hoshi clansmen unlock, the ability to materialize their Star Chakra in the shape of a beautiful peacock plumage.
As a Bonus action, you can activate Kujaku Mode for the next minute, or until you dismiss it on your turn at no action cost. Once you use this mode, you cannot use it again until you complete a short rest.
While in this mode, you suppress the penalties and negative effects of Star Sickness for the duration.
#### Celestial Body
3rd Level Clan Feature
You families deep connection to the original meteor has allowed you to be birthed with a stronger than normal physique and a slightly more toxic chakra network. You begin with resistance to Chakra damage and immunity to effects that increase the chakra cost of jutsu you cast or maintain concentration on. In addition to this, you also have other traits unique to your Star village heritage, simply called Celestial Traits. You begin with one of these traits, gaining an additional trait at 7th and 15th levels.
Celestial Traits that forces a saving throw, uses your highest jutsu save DC.
Meteoric Reflection
When a hostile creature within 30 feet deals damage to you as a result of a Ninjutsu they cast, you can spend your reaction and multiples of 2 Star Chakra to reflect some if back. When their damage is rolled, select a number of damage die, starting from the highest die rolled for every 2 Star Chakra spent, removing it from their damage total, and adding it to the Reflection total. The triggering creature takes force damage equal to the removed damage die + 2d12.
Radiation Barrier
When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a melee attack, your Star Chakra lashes out attempting to irradiate everything in your immediate area. As a reaction, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra, forcing the triggering creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature takes 2d6 poison damage and 1 rank of Weakened for every 2 Star Chakra spent.
Celestial Pulse
When a hostile creature forces you to make a saving throw to resist a Genjutsu they cast that you are aware of, your Star Chakra lashes out attempting to disrupt the intrusion of chakra. As a reaction, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra, as part of this saving throw. For every 2 Star Chakra spent, you gain a rank of Mastery to that saving throw results.
Star Threads
As a Bonus action, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra targeting one willing allied creature within 30 feet of you for every 2 Star Chakra spent. Each creature targeted has a thin thread of star chakra attached to them for the next minute or until they end their movement more than 60 feet away from you, or they gain full cover against you.
For the duration, they gain resistance to chakra damage, and make saving throws to resist effects that raise the chakra cost of jutsu they cast at advantage.
Irradiated Imprint
As part of casting a Hoshi Hijutsu that targets or affects a hostile creature, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra for every creature that makes a saving throw against the jutsu cast. You mark each creature that makes this saving throw, regardless if they pass or fail the save. They remain marked until the end of your next turn.
If a marked creature ends their next turn within 20 feet of you, they suffer potent radiation poisoning, taking 2d6 poison damage + an additional 2d6 poison damage, for every other marked creature that ends their turn within 20 feet of you.
Meteoric Pressure
If a hostile creature moves within 20 feet of you, you can spend your Reaction and 4 Star Chakra to force all creatures within 20 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are overwhelmed by the radiating potency of your chakra, having their movement reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn and they gain 2 rank of Weakened and are Bruised.
Cosmic Siphon
When a hostile creature within 30 feet of you casts a Jutsu that have both the Hand Sign (HS) and Chakra Molding (CM) components, that you can see, you can spend your reaction to irradiate their chakra, before siphoning it back into yourself. As a reaction, spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra. For every 2 Star Chakra spent, they increase the chakra cost of the jutsu they cast by +4, and you roll 1d6, recording the die result. You gain Temporary Star Chakra equal to the result.
#### Meteoric Dowsing
7th Level Clan Feature
The meteorite that birthed your clans power left behind a legacy of destruction, both of your enemies, and yourself. But you’ve learned to point and aim that destruction at things normally resilient to direct harm.
By spending 10 minutes in contact with a creature suffering from a Curse, or an object, structure or creature marked with a Complex Seal, you can feed your Star Chakra into it, weakening either, reducing the DC needed to help dispel them by 5. If you can spend at least 1 hour doing this, you can instead dispel a Complex Seal, and heavily weaken the Curse, causing it to be suppressed for the next 24 hours.
#### Meteoric Attunement
11th Level Clan Feature
You have lived with Star Chakra long enough for it to no longer function like a foreign energy source. It is part of you now, regardless of the potential harm.
Beginning at 11th level, twice per Full-Rest, when you complete a Short or Long Rest, you can reduce your Star Sickness by 1 rank.
Additionally, your Star Chakra has developed into its own network of chakra that acts as a passive sensory system for you. You gain the following benefits:
You gain the Sense Chakra special action, modified by your Star Chakra.
You make the Identify Genjutsu check at advantage.
You are always aware of creatures within 30 feet of you that are concentrating on Jutsu or casting a jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component, except through walls or barriers.
Sense Chakra. You can make a Perception check using Intelligence vs the Chakra control DC of all creatures within 30 feet of you. On a success, you gain the benefit of the Chakra Sensing special sense against them for the duration until they either have 0 chakra or they make and succeed their Suppress Chakra skill action.
#### Irradiated Apex
15th Level Clan Feature
You have pushed further than any Hoshi has before. Your use of Star Chakra grants you the chance, for one brilliant catastrophic moment, to become the Star your clan looks to for guidance.
When you spend 6 or more Star Chakra between the beginning of your most recent turn and the beginning of your next turn, you enter your Kujaku Sanseiijin (Brilliant Peacock Star Formation) state until the end of your next turn. You cannot extend the duration of this state if you are already in it, meaning even if you spend an additional 6 or more Star Chakra while in this state, it still ends at the predefined time.
[BOX]
| #### Kujaku Sanseijin / Fortitude Amp / Your chakra made tail feathers are more beautiful than you could imagine. / Brilliant Plumage. You gain the benefits of Kujaku Mode for the duration. / Stars Momentum. You gain the Star Momentum special action once per activation of this state. You can use this special action to cast or use any Hoshi Clan Hijutsu or Celestial Trait, that costs an Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. / Irradiated Reflexes. All Hoshi clan Hijutsu you cast for the duration, gain their Irradiated Effect, without spending additional Star Chakra. / Star Control. Star Chakra you spend while in this state, does not count towards gaining Star Sickness. |
[/BOX]

## Shikigami Clan
A Jonin woman is flying through the clouds with wings made of paper over her target fortress. She touches her neck and begins to speak through a radio device. “I spotted them. Do I begin the assault?” she speaks and awaits a response. “No, do not engage. If you engage you will be alone!” a voice echo’s through her receiver. “I only asked for formalities darling. You never really had a choice in the matter.” She responds coldly before she flies down and begins to weave handseals as shuriken and kunai made of paper begin to fire downwards exploding on impact with the building.
—Zozo Yamanaka
At Worlds End, Ch. 18 excerpt.
### A Work of Art
The Shikigami Clan is not a clan bound by blood as much as it is a clan bound by ideology. This Shikigami clan has no surname, and do not share any connecting tissue outside of the passed down secrets of Papercraft. This family works more like a coven of members more so than a bloodline, with senior and elder members teaching their children and bringing in those from outside the clan into the fold.
### Shikigami Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Dex
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Crafting, Sleight of Hand
Tool Proficiencies: Trappers Kit
Shikigami Techniques: The Shikigami Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Shikigami Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Paper Craft: At the conclusion of any Short or Long rest, you can craft two Ninja Tools with the word Tag in its name (Ex. Explosive Tag, Flash Tag, Sealing Tag etc.) of D-Rank. This increases to C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level.
### Shikigami Features
#### Blank Canvas
1st Level Clan Feature
You know how to make something as simple as paper both beautiful, and dangerous.
While in combat, as a Bonus Action, you can call upon this paper, making your body appear to be formed entirely of Thousands of layers of paper, entering into your Paper Veil battle state, lasting until the end of combat. This Paper Veil battle state is refined around your Canvas Type. Select one Canvas Type, this choice cannot be changed later. You gain an additional selection at 7th and 15th levels. You can select the same Canvas Type additional times, further cementing your form of paper craft which is signified by the Craft I and Craft II additional effects listed with each Canvas Type. Alternatively, you can select a different Canvas Type, gaining the base version when you reach 7th or 15th levels.
Paper Veil abilities use your highest jutsu save DC, for effects that call for it.
Explosive Veil
Your Paper is laced with explosive formulas, primed to detonate on contact or command. While your Paper Veil is active, you can spend a Bonus Action to launch your paper at a target point you can see within 60 feet, filling a 10-foot cube. You can decide to either detonate on arrive, or leave as a trap hiding all of the explosive paper across the ground.
Detonate on Arrival. All creatures within the affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 3d6 fire damage. This increases to 5d6 at 7th level and 7d6 at 15th level.
Set Trap. This trap is set and remains until the end of combat and can be destroyed if a damaging area or attack would cross with or interact with this space. A hostile creature that moves within the affected area triggers it, forcing themselves and all creatures within 15 feet of the triggering space to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 4d6 fire damage. This increases to 6d6 at 7th level and 8d6 at 15th level.
Craft I: Creatures caught in the detonation range have residual tags adhere to them, which last until the start of your next turn. As a Reaction, before the beginning of your next turn, you can detonate them, forcing all tagged creatures to remake their saving throws, being Staggered on a failure.
Craft II: If this was detonated on arrival, then all affected creatures gain 2 ranks of the Burned condition. If this was detonated as a trap, then all affected creatures gain 3 ranks of the Burned condition.
Serrated Veil
Your Paper is the thinnest it could possibly be, while still having a firmness to it that could cut less careful hands. While your Paper Veil is active, you are encircled by floating origami made of this sharpened paper. The first time on a turn that a hostile creature of your choice would be within 10 feet of you, or begin their turn within 5 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 slashing damage and gaining 1 rank of Bleed on a failure or no effects on a success. This increases to 3d6 and 2 ranks at 7th level and 3d6 and 3 ranks at 15th level.
Craft I: Shikigami Clan Hijutsu that deal piercing or slashing damage deals +4 bonus damage and increase the size of your aura to 10 feet.
Craft II: Creatures that fail their saving throw is Slowed on a failed save.
Binding Veil
Your Paper is inscribed with a chakra rejecting formula that disrupts the flow of chakra of creatures it finds itself attached to. While your Paper Veil is active, you can spend your Action to select two points you can see within 60 feet of you, generating a 10-foot radius that has floating and fluttering binding tags all throughout called your Binding Field. You can have up to 2 Binding Fields at once. Creating a Binding Field beyond your limit dismisses the oldest one. Creatures that cast jutsu while within your Binding Field, increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +4. This increases to +6 at 7th and +8 at 15th level.
Craft I: As a Bonus Action, you can move your already set Binding Fields, up to 30 feet, centered on a new point from their current position.
Craft II: The Binding Field Increases in size to a 20-foot radius, centered on the chosen point.
Weaving Veil
You fold dense overlapping layers of chakra enhanced paper around your body, covering you like an extra layer of muscle, enhancing your speed and strength to match your refined chakra control. While your Paper Veil is active, you gain the benefits of the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance.
Muscle Weave. Your strikes are controlled via your chakra controlling your paper covered form.
You can benefit from a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu stance, while in this stance.
Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and a rank of Mastery to your [Unarmed Damage] rolls. This increases to two ranks at 11th level.
Unarmed attacks you make can use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility while in this stance to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage].
If do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks with this attack, instead of one.
Craft I: You gain the Spiral Weave ability, which can only be used once per turn as an Action or in place of an Unarmed attack made while you are in the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance.
Spiral Weave. Make melee attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature within 15 feet of you, as you turn your paper into a large spiraling drill, tearing into whoever is in its way. On a hit, you deal 5d6 piercing damage and force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, being Staggered on a failure.
Craft II: You gain the Execution Weave ability, which can only be used once per turn as an Action or in place of an Unarmed attack made while you are in the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance You cannot use this ability if you’ve used Spiral Weave this turn, and if you use this ability, you cannot use Spiral Weave, in the same turn.
Execution Weave. For all creatures in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line originating from you to make a Dexterity saving throw, as you turn your paper into a compressed spiraling spear, tearing through everything in its way. On a failure, affected creatures take 5d6 piercing damage are Staggered and Dazed, or half as much damage on a success.
#### Origami
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Shikigami embodies a shinobi who specializes in preparation. Every move is calculated, and every fold has a purpose. You translate this into combat by constantly designing, and building origami one-fold at a time. At the beginning of each of your turns, or the first time each turn you cast a Shikigami Hijutsu, you summon a floating Origami called a Rei. These Rei can take any shape or design of your choice. They are charged with your chakra, and once per turn, can be spent on any of the following abilities. You can maintain up to 4 Rei at any given time, and can only generate them while in combat, or as an Action while out of combat. Effects that require a saving throw use your highest jutsu save DC. Spending two or more Rei, grants you the previous benefits as well as the upgraded benefits.
Origami Turtle. When a hostile creature deals damage to an allied creature within 30 feet of you, you can spend 1 Rei to interpose the Rei, and generate a chakra barrier with 1d10 + half your level hit points. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei increase the barriers hit points by +1d10. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei increase the barriers hit points by +1d10.
Origami Snake. As a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend 1 Rei to fling a coiling origami snake inscribed with a sealing formula at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the snake wraps around them, reducing their speed by half, and they cannot move further than 30 feet away from you until the end of their next turn. They can spend their Action on their turn, to tear the snake, ending this effect immediately. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei they are also pulled Prone. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei they also have their speed reduced to 0.
Origami Bird. As a bonus action on your turn, you spend 1 Rei to place a small origami bird onto a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. This even occurs secretly unless the target creature has Chakra Sight or Chakra Sense. A creature remains marked in this way for 10 minutes and you always know this creatures location, regardless of concealment, invisibility, walls or barriers. A creature that spends 1 Action to perform the Search action can find the bird, destroying it. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei A creature marked in this way cannot make attacks at advantage against you. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei so long as they are within 120 feet of you, Shikigami Hijutsu or features with a range of at least 5 feet and doesn’t affect an area, can reach the marked creature.
Origami Rabbit. When a construct is summoned or commanded to act or move by a hostile creature, you can spend your Reaction and 1 Rei to disrupt its command, forcing the controlling creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature wastes their action commanding it. Beginning at 7th level, the creature follows your one command in place of their summoners until the end of the current turn. Beginning at 15th level, you can command them on your own turn, until the end of your turn.

| #### Origami Angel/Demon / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Living Paper.  You instead generate 2 Rei at the start of each of your turns. / Paper Shroud. You gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus at the beginning of each of your turns. / Angel Form / These benefits are only available to Shikigami with Binding Veil or Explosive Veil as their first Canvas Type. / Paper Wings. White angel like wings of paper grants you’re a 60-foot fly speed. / Veil Enhancement (Binding). Increase the number of Binding Fields you can have to 4. / Veil Enhancement (Explosive). Your Set Trap Detonations force the triggering creature to make their saving throws at disadvantage. / Demon Form / These benefits are only available to Shikigami with Serrated Veil or Weaving Veil as their first Canvas Type. / Paper Surge. Dark paper covers your body, allowing you to, once per turn as a Bonus Action, surge forward, teleporting into a space you can see within 30 feet of you. Draw a line from your previous space to your new space, recording it. If you are using Serrated Veil, each creature this line pass through or by, within 5 feet suffers the effects of your serrated aura, making their saving throw as normal. If you are using Weaving Veil, you can make one unarmed strike against each creature the line passes through or by, within 5 feet, adding +2d6 to the damage result. / Veil Enhancement (Serrated). Your aura expands, doubling in size. / Veil Enhancement (Weaving). When you take the Attack Action, increase the number of attacks you can make by +1. Also, Spiral Weave and Extinction Weave saving throws cannot be made at advantage. |
[/BOX]
7th Level Clan Feature
While technology has advanced, people still entrusted their secrets to ink and paper. Normally, your pen and paper cannot be breached by a flawed security system. Unfortunately, a Shikigami can hack a book just as well as a hacker hacks a computer or use Paper to steal state secrets.
By spending 10 minutes working with your papercraft, you can accomplish one of the following.
Paper Mask. You construct a physical disguise made of paper for yourself or a willing creature, reshaping the creatures appearance size and even shape. It lasts for 8 hours; the creature takes damage or they are submerged in water.
Paper Scout. You animate a Rei as a scout, sending it ahead. It has a fly speed of 60 feet and can pass through any gap large enough for a sheet of paper to slip through, but it has 1 hit point. You cannot control it during its recon. Whatever it see’s is inscribe on it as text until both sides of it is filled with information. This information is basic in that it only describes creatures as humanoid or animal like, simple colors, shapes and terrain. If the scout is wet or captured, it dissolves and you become aware of its destruction. You can only have one scout active at a time.
Paper Forgery. You take any copy of a document or scroll, and you can perfectly emulate its contents. A creature can only discern it’s a forgery if they can make a successful Investigation check vs your highest jutsu save DC.
#### Kami’s Salvation/ Akuma’s Damnation
11th Level Clan Feature
You’ve reached the point where your origami stops being something you use to express your ideals but instead becomes something you use to enforce your prophetic beliefs upon your fallen foe. You either present as an Angel sent by a Kami, or a Demon summoned by an Akuma.
As a Bonus Action you can become an Origami Angel/Demon for the next minute. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.
#### The Final Page
15th Level Clan Feature
You have created your ultimate expression of art and origami. Your final shape. Once per Long Rest, you can saturate every surface within a 60-foot radius, centered on you (This radius does not move with you) or a point of your choice within 120 feet of you with your first Canvas Type for 1 minute, or until you are incapacitated.
Scorched Page (Explosive Veil). Hostile creatures that begin their turns within this radius must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 fire damage and are Staggered on a failure.
Bleeding Edge (Serrated Veil). Hostile creatures that move 10 or more feet on a turn within the radius gains 1 rank of Bleed. A Hostile creature that doesn’t move on their turn takes 2d6 slashing damage at the end of their turn.
Sealed Page (Binding Veil). Hostile creatures that begins their turns concentrating on a jutsu, gain 1 rank of Sealed.
Crushed Page (Weaving Veil). [Unarmed Damage] you deal within this area, is rolled twice taking the higher roll, and are made with a rank of Mastery to their attack rolls and if you score 2 or more hits with an Unarmed attack against the same creature as part of the same Action, they are knocked Prone with no saving throw.

## Hebi Clan
Lyo draws his blade just as quickly as his enemies drew theirs. Standing in the middle of the road, he realizes he has been surrounded by about a dozen adversaries. They assault him from the shadows throwing kunai and shuriken at him with relentless efficiency. He with his sword drawn begins to parry them all with ruthless focus. Each swing of his cuts, breaks, or deflects three or more weapons launched at him. He keeps up this defense before he realizes he can’t keep it up much longer. He takes a deep breath, as the weapons begin to strike his body, bouncing off of his skin as he dashes into the darkness. The singing of blades cutting through the air ring out as the fighting slowly quiets down to nothing more than a whisper. Lyo comes staggering out of the brush with his hand up in victory, showing his client that he is a lot tougher than he looks.
—Tatsunami Aburame
The Long Road, Ch. 4 excerpt.
### The Basilisk’s Blessings
Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever, Soren
The Hebi Clan also known as the Serpent Clan, or the Viper Clan were once slaves to a conniving master in the Land of Serpents. After escaping the shackles of oppression, they would become pivotal in their lands history, until being expelled, after the 3 Clan War, migrating south through the rest of the Shinobi world, finding themselves settled in the land of Fangs.
The Hebi has the kekkei genkai called Vipers Blood. This Bloodline allows all Hebi clansmen to produce a uniquely poison compound with themselves. This poison enables a Hebi to regenerate from harm, or severely envenom a foe. The Hebi are feared swordsmen, infiltration experts and alchemists within their new home, brining with them their religious faith of the Basilisk’s blessings.
### Hebi Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Dex, +1 Con
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Survival, Animal Handling
Weapon Proficiencies: You are proficient with Katana’s, Broadswords and Odachi.  Tool Proficiencies: Poisoner’s Kit.
Hebi Clan Jutsu: The Hebi have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Hebi Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Constitution as its casting ability score.
Snake Speech: Hebi Clansmen are known for their affinity with snakes. You can communicate with and understand snakes and reptiles.
Snake Mimicry: Your heritage and history with your clans snakes has granted you enhanced senses. You have 10 feet of Tremor sense.
### Hebi Features
#### Serpents Blood
1st Level Clan Feature
The Land of Fangs most noble family of shinobi. Born to a lineage of slaves, the Hebi vowed to never fall back into being any one persons servant, except for themselves. To ensure this, they would take and breed their own special lineage of highly venomous snakes, and harvest its venom, to ingest, drink and consume to build their bodies ability to produce it themselves.
As a child of this lineage, you carry a pool venom, called Viper Blood within your body, equal to 1 + proficiency bonus. You can spend this venom on features that call for it, regaining all spent Viper Blood when you complete a rest of any type.
Alternatively, your Viper Blood can be replenished once per turn, as a Bonus Action, by consuming a charge of a Poisoners Kit¸ or once per turn, when you deal melee damage to a creature with ranks of Envenomed you regain 1 Viper Blood.
Additionally, while you have Viper Blood, your body is constantly in a state of cellular regeneration, attempting to close wounds and heal sickness. While in combat, at the beginning of each of your turns, if you have 1 or more Viper Blood, you regain hit points equal to half your level. If you ever have 3 or more combined ranks of Physical or Elemental conditions, this regeneration is disabled until you are below this threshold. If you regain hit points from this effect, while at 0 hit points, you gain 1 failed death saving throw.
#### Serpent’s Coil
[BOX]
| Virulent / [Physical], [Elemental] / Your body has been compromised by the Hebi’s Viper Blood. Good Luck. / A Virulent creature cannot regain hit or chakra points. / A Virulent creature cannot gain temporary hit points or chakra points. / A Virulent creature reduces its damage die size by 1 step. If they use a d4, it instead becomes 1 damage, per dice that would be rolled. / Creatures that are resistant or immune to poison damage or the Envenomed condition are resistant or immune to the Virulent condition. / A creature can spend its action to make a DC 15 Constitution check to remove this condition. |
[/BOX]
1st Level Clan Feature
The Hebi are prolific in their ability with a blade. Master swordsmen, their style of fighting is akin to an aggressive serpent coiling into itself and striking forward with its fangs erect. You learn the Serpent’s Coil Bukijutsu stance. This stance can only be used with weapons from the Blade Weapon Group.
As part of entering this stance and at the beginning of each of your turns while in this stance, you can spend 1 Vipers Blood to infuse your weapon with concentrated venom for the next minute. While your weapon is infused and you are in this stance, [Weapon Damage] you deal becomes poison, and it gains a rank of Mastery to their damage rolls. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.
In place of an attack made as part of your Attack Action, you can instead make a Viper Strike or a Python Strike. Alternatively, by spending 1 Viper Blood, you can use a Strike ability as part of a Hebi Clan Hijutsu you cast., applying their saving throw on a successful hit or failed saving throw.
Hebi Clan Hijutsu, gain their Serpent Coil effects.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
Viper Strike. Once per turn, make a weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage], ignoring temporary hit points a creature may have. By spending 2 Viper Blood as part of this attack, you force them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they become Virulent until the beginning of your next turn. If an affected creature has ranks of Envenomed, you can choose to reduce those ranks to 0, and inflict Virulent, for the next minute. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Viper Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.
Python Strike. Once per turn, make a weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] If the target is currently Grappled, Restrained, or has their movement speed reduced by an effect you or an allied creature applied, this attack gains a +1 bonus to its critical threat range. On a critical hit, by spending 1 Viper Blood, this attack gains the Deadly 2 property. This increases to Deadly 3 at 7th level and Deadly 4 at 15th level.
#### Venomous Technique
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Hebi Clan has spent generations cultivating their clans special breed of serpent and using its hyper potent venom to further enhance their clans station. The Hebi have developed a special organ that stores their Viper Blood. This organ with training, can be manipulated to express a series of techniques only possible for the Hebi called Venom Arts. The first of which all Hebi has is their ability to metabolize it to suppress extreme conditions they may experience.
If you end your turn with ranks of a Physical or Elemental condition, you can spend 1 Viper Blood, to make a Constitution saving throw vs a DC 15 + 1 for each Physical or Elemental condition rank you have. On a success, you remove 1 rank of an aforementioned condition.
You know one Venom Art of your choice, gaining an additional Venom Art at 7th and 15th levels. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC. If a Venom Art inflicts Virulent, it lasts until the beginning of your next turn unless otherwise stated. If an affected creature has ranks of Envenomed, you can choose to reduce those ranks to 0, and inflict Virulent, for the next minute.
Venomous Refresh
Once per turn, as a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend 2 Viper Blood forcing it to cycle through your mind, washing over your brain and nervous system. When you do, select one Mental or Sensory condition you currently have, reducing its ranks by 2, except for the Sealed condition.
Venomous Regeneration
Once per turn, as a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend multiples of 2 Viper Blood, up to a max of 10. When you do, you roll 1 Hit die for every 2 Viper Blood spent. This does not spend your rolled hit die. You regain hit points equal to the result.
Venomous Augmentation
As a Bonus action, you can spend 2 Viper Blood, to circulate it throughout your muscles, having it act as a potent stimulant. Until the end of your next turn;
Your speed is increased by +10. This is increased by +10 at 7th and 15th levels.
Strength and Dexterity Checks you make gain a rank of Mastery. This increases to two ranks at 7th and 15th level.
Suppress the effects of Physical conditions you have for the duration.
Coiling – Black Mamba
Your Vipers Blood coils around your weapon just as you strike with it, manifesting the afterimage of a black mambas black maw striking with deadly precision. While in your Serpents Coil stance, once per turn, as a Reaction to taking damage from a hostile creature within your weapons range, you can make a Mamba Strike.
Mamba Strike. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, roll your [Weapon Damage], recording the result. First, reduce the triggering damage you would take by the result. Then, the triggering creature takes the recorded [Weapon Damage] and forces them to make a Strength saving throw, being pushed 20 feet away from the Hebi on a failure. By spending 1 Viper Blood, if the triggering creature fails this saving throw, you can move up to half your speed. If you end this movement within weapon range of the them, you can make one additional weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] on a hit and inflicting them with Virulent. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Mamba Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Your Vipers Blood coils around your weapon just as you strike with it, manifesting the afterimage of a Silver Cobras opened hood coiling around your weapon, striking in unison. Cobra Strike. Make a Weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] on a hit. Then, you can move 10 feet, spending your remaining movement. If this movement puts you within range of a different hostile creature, you can repeat this attack against them. You can repeat this movement and attack string, always targeting a creature you haven’t previously attacked as part of this Cobra strike, until you run out of movement speed. Basilisk Strike. Make a Weapon attack comparing the result vs the AC of all creatures of your choice within your weapons range, in a radius around you. If the target creature(s) has ranks of Envenomed or Virulent, treat their AC as -2 lower to determine if you score a hit. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon Damage] to target creatures on a hit. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Basilisk Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.
Serpents Cloud

All creatures in range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take 3d6 poison damage and become Virulent, or half as much damage on a success. Serpent Bite. Make an unarmed attack, dealing 3d6+your modifier in Poison damage on a hit, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Envenomed on a failure. Virulent Blood
Once per turn, when you begin your turn with at least one rank of Envenomed, you can reduce one of the aforementioned conditions ranks by 1. When you do, you regain 2 Viper Blood as your body converts it into fuel for you.
Beginning at 11th level, if you have ranks of Envenomed you ignore its effect preventing you from regaining hit points and its ranks do not count against your hit point regeneration from the Serpent Blood clan feature. Virulent Infusion
As part of casting a Ninjutsu, or a Bukijutsu using a weapon from the Blade Group, you can spend 1 Viper Blood. If the jutsu does not inflict a condition, then force one affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs jutsu’s save DC, becoming Virulent on a failure.
If you spend 3 Viper Blood as part of the aforementioned jutsu disciplines casting, then you can inflict both Virulent condition and the jutsu’s original condition. Also, if the jutsu does not inflict a condition, then you can force all affected creatures to make the Constitution saving throw, gaining the Virulent condition, on a failure.

Once per turn, it costs 0 Viper Blood to use a Strike ability as part of a Hebi Clan Hijutsu you cast. |

7th Level Clan Feature
The Hebi Clan are known for their intelligence networks throughout the shinobi world, having released specially trained snakes of different breeds across the land. Their ability to communicate with them, allows them to collect information from these snakes, without ever having to interact with another human once.
By spending 10 minutes performing a sleeper serpent ritual, you release a guiding pulse, calling on snakes within a 1-mile radius to you. These snakes share with you one piece of information or rumors or hint about the area, that the snakes collected during their time here. If the terrain or area is void of snakes, none heed your call. Once you call upon serpents in this way, they cannot be called upon again, until you complete a long rest.
Alternatively, you can spend 10 minutes performing the Viper Form ritual, spending 2 Viper Blood, to perform a special transformation, temporarily shapeshifting your biology, into that of a Tiny or Small sized snake for up to 1 hour or dismissed. While transformed in this way, you’re clothing and carrying containers melds onto you with a similar, but smaller design as what you had in your humanoid state, but for a snake, and you drop all weapons and things not sealed inside of scrolls. you gain a 60-foot swim speed, can move across walls and ceilings freely, gain 10 feet of Blind Sight, and cannot be identified by creatures as being anything other than a snake. You cannot cast Jutsu or make weapon attacks. Taking damage, immediately dispels this form, unless you spend 1 Viper Blood to resist and sustain the form. Once you transform in this way you cannot do so again, until you complete a long rest.
#### Blood of the Basilisk
11th Level Clan Feature
The blood of chain breakers, survivors and those who value their freedom, over subjugation still run through your veins. You have reached the level of strength to be blessed by the Basilisk. You wish to become the embodiment of the Basilisk himself. You can embody this blessing, as scales push through painting your body, arms and necks. Your pupils narrow to vertical slits, and your hands and even weapons bleed your Viper Blood. This augmented battle state, is known as your Basilisk’s Blessing.
As a Bonus action, by spending 4 Viper Blood, to activate your Basilisk’s Blessing for the next minute, until you are incapacitated, or your dismiss it on your turn, at no action. Once you activate this state, you cannot enter it again, until you complete a short rest.
#### Ouroboros
15th Level Clan Feature
You have become the serpent that feeds on itself, to become perfection. One that completes itself, by itself. The Ouroboros. The Breaker of chains, and the infinite serpent.
When you roll initiative, your Viper Blood surges within you, breaking the very chains of fate that bind you, as you can feel the gaze of the Basilisk upon you, granting you strength. You can use any combination of two of the following abilities, once per long rest.
Venom of Inevitability. When a creature with the Virulent feature makes a roll with a D20, you can dispel their condition, to treat their roll result as a 1.
Chain Breaker. When you would begin your turn with Physical, Mental, Elemental or Sensory conditions, you can spend 1 Viper Blood, per condition, reducing its ranks to 0, except for the Grappled condition.
The Infinite Circle. When you fall to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction to force your body to refuel, granting you double, your current maximum Viper Blood until the end of initiative, and you regain hit points equal to twice your level.
Gaze of the Basilisk. When you enter your Basilisk’s Blessing state, until the end of your next turn, the first time each turn a creature targets you with an attack or jutsu, they gain 2 rank of Shaken and Demoralized but only against you or affects you would apply to them. These ranks of Shaken and Demoralized are dispelled at the end of your following turn.
Basilisks Venom. When you inflict a creature with Virulent, if you spend 2 Viper Blood, then at end of that creatures turn, they must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, the affected creature is Petrified for the next 48 Hours (2 Days). If this petrified creature would take damage, or suffer a hostile effect, the Petrification ends immediately.
