## Kuru Clan
“How Is he able to react to everything we throw at him!?” the squad captain yelled at his team as they were failing to deal with a single shinobi. The shinobi stands in the center of the forest opening. Avoiding all attacks that are sent his way. He gracefully dodges each attack with a sly grin across his face. “Kill him! He can’t dodge us all if we attack at the same time.” The captain yells out. The lone shinobi opens his eyes revealing them to be darker than the darkest black. He smiles gracefully as they all leap towards him. He quickly weaves hand seals before releasing a wave of black chakra that overtakes the assaulting shinobi. Many fall to the ground unable to move or ever breathe. The captain looks towards his fallen forces then to the shinobi. “Looks like you guys ran out of time.” The lone shinobi gloats before attacking the captain.
—Riku Tiken
The Long Road, Ch. 19 excerpt.
### The Wolf’s Curse
Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever
The Kuru Clan also known as the Shadow Clan, or the Dark Clan were seen as an influential family of Monks, prophets and fortune tellers from the Land of Wolves. After migrating south through the rest of the Shinobi world, their offspring began to pick up the ways of Ninshou and ninjutsu and has since settled in the Land of Claws.
The Kuru Clan have access to a unique Dojutsu known as the Miraigan, the Eyes of Prophecy. This Dojutsu carries the trait of limited foresight on a creature or object that they can see. They also learned how to harness the properties of Yin Chakra to a great effect allowing them to mold their chakra into almost any shape and even grant it different properties usually reserved for Nature release techniques without having to learn the appropriate Nature Release.
### Kuru Traits
[BOX]
| #### Miraigan / Will Amp / Your Miraigan grants you the following benefits / Prophetic Vision. You cannot be surprised and hostile creatures cannot gain advantage on attacks against you for being unseen or Hidden. / Déjà vu. Once per turn, when a hostile creature casts a Jutsu while within 60 feet of you, you can spend 1 Foresight, to make a  Read the Enemy or Identify Jutsu check at No reaction or action cost. / Eyes of the Wolf. Your foresight extends  into social and environmental situations.  You gain a rank of Mastery to Insight  checks and checks to Identify Jutsu  and Read the Enemy. This increases  to 2 ranks at 7th level and 3 ranks  at 15th level. |
[/BOX]
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis, +1 Str
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Martial Arts
Dark Vision: You have Darkvision up to 60 Feet.
Black Wolf Techniques: The Kuru Clan have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Kuru Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.
Yin Release Affinity: Reduce the downtime cost to learn and create Genjutsu by an amount equal to its rank (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)
### Kuru Features
#### Miraigan
1st Level Clan Feature
[Dojutsu]
The Land of Claws single revered Dojutsu. The Miraigan is the Eyes that see through Fate. The Kuru do not see the world the way others do. They see the outcomes of actions before they are made, the results of mistakes before attempted. These eyes see tomorrow and when you see it, is when it changes. When you enter initiative, you can active your Miraigan, which lasts until the end of combat. Alternatively, you can activate your Miraigan as a Bonus action, and it remains active for 10 minutes, after which, you require at least 10 minutes of non-use before you can activate it again.
While active you can call upon a series of future visions, called Foresight. You can do this a number of times equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You use your Foresight for features that call for it, such as Prophesize. You regain spent Foresight when you complete a short or long rest.
Prophesize. You can glimpse into the future of an ally or yourself, before dragging yourself back into the preset to give them the knowledge they need to change it. Once per turn, while in combat, on your turn, by spending 1 Foresight, select one willing allied creature you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature gains a Fortune which lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until spent. A creature can only hold 1 Fortune at a time and they can spend it to do one of the following. If you grant Fortune to yourself it does not expire until spent, or combat ends;
Foretold Circumstance. Add 1d4 to an attack roll, Skill or Ability check, or saving throw they make.
Foretold Event. They gain an additional Reaction, which can only be used for feature or jutsu that trigger when they take damage.
#### Black Fang
[BOX]
| Yin-Seal / [Mental], [Sensory] / You have been marked with a special sealing mark created by the Kuru. Kuru refers to the clan of the creature that inflicted this seal. / Once per turn, If a Kuru deals damage to a Yin-Sealed creature, the Kuru regains 1 Foresight. / Attacks a Yin-Sealed creature makes against a Kuru suffer a -2 penalty to their result. / Saving throws a Yin-Sealed creature forces a Kuru to make are treated as if they have a -1 penalty, only for the Kuru. / A creature immune to the Sealed condition is immune to this condition. / A creature can spend its action to make a DC 20 Ninshou check to remove this condition. |
[/BOX]
1st Level Clan Feature
The Miraigan is but one trick the Kuru are capable of using. They are also able to utilize the Black Fang stance, a stance that blends their unique fighting style with their affinity for Yin Release. You learn the Black Fang Taijutsu stance, which uses your Clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;
Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and can deal either Bludgeoning, Necrotic or Psychic as you weave martial arts with illusions and sealing into each strike.
In place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Past Strike or Future Strike. You can only use Past Strike or Future Strike once per turn each.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
Past Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, visions of past combats overlap with this one, causing them to be Confused.
Future Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, at the beginning of their next turn, they are confronted with visions of future attacks from you that bind their chakra, inflicting 1 rank of Sealed.
#### Yin Release Adept
3rd Level Clan Feature
The Kuru has spent generations training and mastering both their Miraigan’s ability to see the future and their unique ability to manifest their variant of Yin Release. This special variant of Yin Release allows them to emulate the properties of other Nature Releases without ever having to carry their affinities. If you cast a Jutsu with a Nature Release keyword, you can choose to have it lose that Nature Release keyword, and gain the Yin Release keyword as part of that Jutsu’s Casting. Otherwise, Jutsu you cast, can gain the Yin Release keyword as part of that jutsu’s casting. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC.
Yin Release. This jutsu’s damage type becomes Necrotic or Psychic. Additionally, if the jutsu could trigger any of the listed secondary effects found at the end of this section, that effect is replaced with the following; If the triggering jutsu forces a saving throw and the affected creature fails this saving throw, they are marked with a Yin-Seal until the end of your next turn. If the triggering jutsu doesn’t force a saving throw, then one of the affected creatures must make a Charisma saving throw vs the Jutsu’s save DC, being marked with a Yin-Seal until the end of your next turn on a failure.
No Nature Release: Inflicts a Condition
Earth Release: Creates difficult terrain or inflicts a Condition.
Wind Release: Swirl effect.
Fire Release: Flat damage modifier added as part of the damage calculation.
Water Release: Benefit for being near a source of Water.
Lightning Release: Overcharge effect.
Additionally, you have access to a deep pool of secret Kuru clan techniques known as Yin Arts, of which you know 1. You gain an additional selection at 7th and 15th levels.
Dual Sight
You learn to split your focus between today and tomorrow simultaneously. While your Miraigan is active, you can grant Fortune to two creature, rather than one when you use Prophesize. Though this causes you stress. You can now only use the Prophesize effect, once every other turn.
Prophetic Counter
You can now cycle between the future and the present between each step, strike and handsigns, but only while focusing on a single creature. While your Miraigan is active, you gain the Prophetic Counter ability.
Prophetic Counter. Once per turn, when a creature makes an attack targeting you and would score a hit, you can spend your Reaction and 2 Foresight to force them to remake their attack. If this would cause them to miss their attack, you can, as part of the same reaction take the Attack action targeting them.
Prophetic Weakness
You can now focus in on an enemies weaknesses and foresee their most critical openings. While your Miraigan is active, you gain the Prophetic Weakness ability
Prophetic Weakness. As a Bonus action you can spend 2 Foresight and select one creature you can see and foretell their weakness. Until the beginning of your next turn, they take +2 bonus damage from all sources. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.
Prophetic Teamwork
You can use your Miraigan to foresee the best possible way to work with your team, by viewing multiple scenarios and stitching together a plan. When an allied creature within 30 Feet of you would deal damage to a hostile creature, you can spend your Reaction and 2 Foresight to target another allied creature within 30 feet, that can target the same hostile creature. They gain the Prophetic Teamwork special action until the beginning of their next turn.
Prophetic Teamwork. This special action can only be used when it is not your turn. You can use any feature, jutsu or Attack that takes an Action, targeting a hostile creature that has taken damage this turn from an allied creature.
Yin Release – Veil of mystery
You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to share your visions with your foe, but only the ones you want to share. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, you can spend 1 Foresight, targeting them to conjure a Misfortune which can only be used against them once before the end of your next turn. You can only maintain 1 Misfortune at a time. You can spend Misfortune to achieve one of the following;
Foretold Despair. subtract 1d4 from an attack roll, Skill check or saving throw they make.
Foretold Failure. To nullify any one jutsu based bonus, benefit or effect that applies to them.
Yin Release – Chains of Causality
You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to bind a vision of the future to your foe, making it their truth, their reality. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, each time they make a Weapon attack or cast a jutsu, they suffer a -1 penalty to their AC for attacks you make against them, as each of these activities have been foreseen and it brings you closer to the destined strike you know to be true.
Beginning at 11th level, if your attack result would be 10 or higher than the AC of a Yin Sealed target, you treat that attack as a Critical hit.
Yin Release – Uncertain Future
You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to obfuscate the assumptions and plans they just had, blinding them to their own desires. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, and they cast a jutsu or spends their Action, Bonus Action or Reaction while within 60 feet of a Kuru that can see them, that Kuru can spend their Reaction and spend 2 Foresight, forcing the Yin-Sealed creature to make a Charisma saving throw vs the Kuru’s highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, the Yin-Sealed creature must perform an alternative Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or Jutsu with the same casting time, or they lose the Action they spent as the ability to perform that action is temporarily sealed.
Black Fang – Yin Palm Strike
You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike with claws like a wolves jaw. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Yin Palm Strike.
Yin Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, breaking their spiritual center, but marking them with a Yin-Seal.
Black Fang – Future Denial
You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at the temple of your foe. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Denial Palm Strike.
Denial Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a saving throw, using their associated jutsu modifier of the target discipline. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, fragmenting their memories. Select one casting discipline between Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu and Bukijutsu; and one rank between E-Rank, D-Rank, C-Rank, B-Rank and A-Rank, for the next minute they cannot cast jutsu of the select discipline and rank. A creature affected by this remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.
Black Fang – Theft of Time
You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at where your foe believes they should be in time, replacing them with yourself and vice versa. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of an attack of opportunity, you can instead make a Time Theft Strike.
Time Theft Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you use your Yin chakra affinity to rip their belief that they belong, and delay it. You switch places with them in initiative at the end of their current turn or next turn, whichever occurs first. If this initiative movement would cause you to miss taking a turn, you instead immediately take your turn, and initiative continues selecting the creature that would have gone normally. If this initiative movement would cause you to take an additional turn this round, you skip that turn in initiative. Hostile creatures that would miss their turn due to this feature, act at the end of the initiative round. A hostile creature that would gain an additional turn as a result of this swap loses that turn instead.
#### Visions of what will be

| #### Black Okami / Battle Amp / You have inherited the will of Kuroi, acting as a vessel for his drive of retribution. / Okami’s Resilience. Your Miraigan processes many possible visions of the future. Each one you are victorious. You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws you do not have proficiency in. / Master of Prophecy. If you use the Foretold Event ability by spending a Fortune, you can use your Reaction for any Kuru clan ability or Jutsu, with the requirement of a Reaction. / Yin-Soaked Soul.  Attacks made while in Black Fang stance carry concentrated Yin Release Chakra. Your Past Strike, Future Strike and all special Strikes learned as Yin-Arts no longer require a successful hit to force their saving throw. Now, even on a miss the target makes their saving throws, but at advantage. / Fang of Kuroi. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a Yin-Sealed creature, you can Dispel their Yin-Seal, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they face a fabricated moment of a false future they desire, becoming Stunned on a failure, until the end of their next turn. A creature stunned in this way, cannot be stunned again by this effect, until you complete a rest. / Omen of Shiroi. When you do, you can spend your Reaction, to cast one Taijutsu with the Finisher keyword, targeting them, gaining their Finisher effect, as if you cast a Taijutsu with the Combo Keyword. |

7th Level Clan Feature
The Miraigan was born out of the search for truth, but was used to facilitate a war. A war whose scars still affect the Kuru to this day. The Kuru have learned to not ask the future what to do, but to instead ask what not to do.
While your Miraigan is active outside of combat, you can spend Foresight to briefly glimpse into the future to avoid mistakes and pitfalls your future self has already fallen for. For every 1 Foresight you spend, the GM can provide 1 hint relevant to your current situation, in the form of a short 1-to-2-word warning. These hints are never to tell you what to do, but to warn you against doing something, since your Miraigan shows you visions of failures, to help guide you to a successful future.
#### Okami of Midnight
11th Level Clan Feature
The clan of Monks, warriors and revolutionaries all exist at the same time within the past of the Kuru, but what is lost is the blessings of Kuroi, the first Alpha. You hope to embody their blessings, their pride and their forgotten memory, by inheriting his will, learning the Black Okami Form.
As a Bonus action, while you have both the Miraigan active and are in the Black Fang stance, you can spend 4 Foresight, to enter the Black Okami Form. Entering this form causes your Yin Chakra to tattoo itself across your skin, in tribalistic patterns as your eyes gain black markings around them, making your gaze more intense, like that of a wolf. You can remain in this form for up to 1 minute, you become incapacitated or you are no longer in your Black Fang stance or your Miraigan isn’t active. Once you use this form, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.
#### Eye of Prophecy
15th Level Clan Feature
Each time you blink, your Miraigan peers into the sea of possible futures. You are never certain what will happen, but you make certain to prevent the worst from every occurring.
When you roll initiative, and activate your Miraigan as part of it, it peers into 5 possible timelines. Roll the following dice and record each result separately: 1d20, 1d12, 1d8, 1d6, 1d4.
These results are called your Prophetic Pool for the duration of combat. You can use these results to replace die rolls made by creatures you can see, ally or hostile, when they roll a die or dice of the same size.
If a creature rolls multiple dice of the same size as part of the same effect, you can replace one of their die results with a recorded result from your Prophetic Pool as normal, but by spending 1 Foresight for every additional die you wish to replace with your Prophetic Pools result. Each replacement uses the same value.
Once you used your Prophetic Pool to replace a result, the used die size is exhausted until you next roll initiative.

## Ryu Clan
Tye dashes into the enemy fortress full of rage and his blood boiling. “GIVE HER BACK!” he screams as his eyes glow with an emerald green hue. He swipes his hand towards an enemy guard, as a wave of Chakra leaps from it chopping them in half with a blade of Wind. The enemies quickly try to seal the doors within the fortress but find it difficult as the angry boy weaves hand seals and exhales a gale of slicing Wind that blows the layered doors apart. He continues further in, before he is confronted by the man he lost to prior. “You throw away the kindness I showed you before boy. You are a fool.” He barks. But Tye doesn’t budge, as Chakra begins to coat his body with enough potency to be visible to the naked eye. The man is caught off guard with the sudden change, but Tye doesn’t hesitate as he rushes in ready to tear this man in half.
—Nina Heroshi
The Long Road, Ch. 25 excerpt.
### Blood of the Dragon
Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever
The Ryu Clan also known as the Dragon Clan were seen as a barbaric tribe of warriors, mercenaries and conquerors from the Land of Dragons. After the Three Clan War, the Land of Dragons would revolt, leading to a near genocide of the Ryu clan, causing their remnant to scatter and escape extinction. A group of these clansmen went south, learning the ways of Ninshou and has since settle in the Land of Mountains.
The Ryu has the unique bloodline simply called Blood of the Dragon or Ryuki, Draconic Chakra. This Bloodline allows all Clansmen to manifest a nature transformation at birth, but unlike normal nature transformations, this transformation is more savage, brutal, violent. Children cry fire, scream thunder and whine storms. Not enough to cause harm, but enough to show that this clan has a strong connection to nature transformations. This Kekkei Genkai also has a negative trait, that manifests in the younger members of the clan, being that their anger and rage is unmatched.
### Ryu Traits
Recommended Ability Score Increase (Select one):
Primal Dragon: +2 Int, +1 Con
Empyreal Dragon: +2 Str, +1 Con
Omen Dragon: +2 Int, +1 Str
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Martial Arts, Chakra Control
Dragon Kings Techniques: The Ryu Clan have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list.
Hijutsu Flexibility: Ryu Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
Draconic Power: Ryu Hijutsu you cast cannot have their cost increased by hostile effects or conditions.
### Ryu Features
#### Wrath of the Dragon
1st Level Clan Feature
Born with the blood of dragons running through your veins you have a natural affinity to one of 5 chakra transformations. Beginning at 1st level, Choose between Earth, Wind, Fire, Water or Lightning Release. You can learn and cast jutsu with the chosen release and all of your Ryu Clan jutsu gains the chosen keyword and deals the same damage as the chosen nature releases damage type unless otherwise stated.
This inherent connection the elements is possible through your clans unique bloodline heritage, Draconic Chakra. You have a number of Draconic Chakra equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can spend this Draconic Chakra for features and abilities that call for it, such as unleashing your Dragon’s Rage. You can regain 1 Draconic Chakra once per turn, when you inflict a hostile creature with your chosen nature releases associated condition. You regain all spent Draconic Chakra when you complete a rest of any type.
Also, as a Bonus Action you can spend 2 Draconic Chakra to enter your Dragon’s Rage. Your eyes shift colors and chakra like scales form over your skin. Both your scales and eyes are all a color that matches your Draconic Chakra (Brown = Earth, Emerald = Wind, Red = Fire, Blue = Water, Gold = Lightning). You can maintain your Dragon’s Rage for one minute. You can dismiss it at no action on your turn. If you have 3 or more ranks of Sealed, your Dragon’s Rage state forcibly ends.
Your Dragon’s Rage grows with you as you grow in level, beginning at 7th level, you can spend 4 Draconic Chakra or an additional 2 Draconic Chakra if you are already in the Dragon’s Rage state, to become Ascended. Beginning at 15th level, you can spend 6 Draconic Chakra or an additional 2 Draconic Chakra if you are already in your Ascended Dragon’s Rage state, to become Awakened.

Your [Unarmed Damage] damage type becomes your chosen nature releases damage type. / Wyrm Surge. Non Hijutsu you cast with your chosen nature release gains the Wyrm Surge Keyword as part of their casting. Jutsu with this keyword will always inflict 1 rank of their associated condition on a failed save or if the attack is a critical hit, unless the jutsu already inflicts the associated condition on a failure. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at15th level.  (Earth Release:  Shaken, Wind Release: Bleed, Fire Release: Burned, Water Release: Chilled, Lightning Release: Shocked). / Ascended (7th Level +) / Superior Release. #### Ryūken
1st Level Clan Feature
The Ryu clan has never fought with a tempered goal, or with modesty or with sportsmanship in mind. Their style of fighting was always desperate, ruthless and even a little underhanded. Their style embodies the ferocity of a starving dragon. You learn the Ryūken Taijutsu stance, which uses your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance you gain the following benefits;
Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes a d6 and can deal Slashing or Piercing damage as you treat each hand as a claw or dragon fang.
In place of an attack made as part of your Attack Action, you can instead make a Rending Strike or a Starving Strike. Alternatively, by spending 1 Draconic Chakra, you can use a Strike ability as part of a Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast., applying their saving throw on a successful hit or failed saving throw.
Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
Rending Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage], and forcing the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, their AC is reduced by 1, as you rend their defenses, until the beginning of your next turn. This increases to a 2 AC reduction at 7th level and a 3 AC reduction at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.
Starving Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] as Chakra damage, and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, you forcefully drain them of chakra, using your Draconic Chakra to tear it from them, like flesh on the bone. You gain 2 Temporary chakra, until the end of the current turn. This increases to 4 Temporary chakra at 7th level and 6 temporary chakra at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.
#### Tyrants Dominion
3rd Level Clan Feature
Your strength, unrivaled. Your savagery, unmatched. You fight better. You strike harder. You move faster. Everything that the suns light touches is yours. Your clan believed this in their past and part of you even believes it now. You express this in a series of Wyrm Arts. Special technique the Ryu clan demands its members master, to be prepared for the next clan war. You begin knowing two of these arts. You gain an additional one at 7th and 15th level. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC.
Sovereigns Ascent
As a bonus action, by spending 1 Draconic Chakra while you are standing on the ground, you can strike the ground with enough force to send you airborne, covered in Draconic Chakra. You gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed until the end of your next turn as your slowed descent can be confused for flight.
Sovereigns Brutality
Combat for you feeds something deep inside you. Something primal. Instinctual. Conflict drives you, and that drive ignites your passion for battle like an engine. At the beginning of your turn, if you have taken damage since the end of your last turn, your brutality is magnified. Attacks you make against creatures with ranks of Elemental or Physical conditions, gain a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This increases by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.
Sovereigns Coil
As a reaction to taking damage from a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra to roar, releasing a shockwave of Draconic Chakra, cracking the ground and shattering glass. This force is enough to stave off the force of jutsu. You trigger a Clash vs the triggering jutsu, using your Chakra control.
Sovereigns Momentum
As an Action, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra to move forward in a 30-foot line, creating a vacuum of force, while covered in Draconic Chakra, passing through all creatures in your path. Make an unarmed attack, comparing the result vs the AC of all hostile creatures you passed through dealing your [Unarmed Damage] as normal. This unarmed attack can use your Rending Strike, Starving Strike or any Strike ability granted by a Wyrm Art.
Ryūken – Cleaving Strike
Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons tail shredding through the ground and air. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Cleaving Strike.
Cleaving Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, reduce their DR by 4, until the end of your next turn. This penalty increases to 6 at 7th and 8 at 15th levels and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.
Ryūken – Consuming Strike
Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons maw biting and gouging at its prey. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Consuming Strike.
Consuming Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature has one jutsu based effect of D-Rank or lower they are benefiting from dispelled as your Draconic Chakra eats away at it. The rank of jutsu this affects increases to C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.
Ryūken – Rebelling Strike
Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons claw ripping and tearing at their assailant. Once per turn, as a Reaction to taking damage from a hostile creature within your unarmed attack range, you can make a Rebelling Strike.
Rebelling Strike. Make two unarmed attacks against the triggering creature, each dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit. If you hit at least once, you force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are pushed 20 feet back, fall prone and are Bruised and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.
Tyrants Focus
Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Focus ability.
Tyrants Focus. You gain immunity to effects that would force you to treat allied creatures as hostile, or force you to target allied creatures with harmful effects. Additionally, you cannot be Charmed by a hostile creature while in combat.
Tyrants Ferocity
Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Ferocity ability.
Tyrants Ferocity. When you score a critical hit against a creature with a jutsu based attack you make, you can make one Rending Strike, Starving Strike or Strike ability granted by a Wyrm Art against the same creature.
Tyrants Hunger
Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Hunger ability.
Tyrants Hunger. When you take damage from a jutsu with the associated nature release you chose as part of the Wrath of the Dragon clan feature, you can spend your reaction to consume some of it, like eating fire, lighting or stone, reducing the damage you take by 1 damage die and regaining Draconic Chakra equal to the rank of the triggering jutsu (D-Rank/C-Rank: 2, B-Rank/A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 6). Increase the damage you reduce by an additional damage die at 7th and 15th levels.
#### Wyrm Lords Ambition
7th Level Clan Feature
While the Ryu clan lost many things in the Three Clan War and its following exile. Its ambition for dominion over even the skies, has remained. By spending 1 minute focusing your Chakra outward, and spending 2 Draconic Chakra, you can extend your Draconic chakra to all willing allied creatures within 10 feet of you. Each creature gains draconic wings made of chakra that grants them 30 feet of flight for the next 10 minutes all linked to you. Once you use this feature to grant yourself or other creature flight, you cannot do so again until you complete a short or long rest.
If initiative is rolled while allied creatures are benefiting from this flight, at the beginning of their turns, they can choose to maintain or dismiss the wings. If they maintain it, they must continue to concentrate on them as if they are concentrating on an A-Rank jutsu. If they dismiss it, they float down slowly towards the ground.
Additionally, you learn to lean into the weight of your name. The stories commoners would speak of your families conquests would scare children and adults alike. When in a social encounter with a Non-combatant creature, such as a merchant, civilian, or minor official, revealing your clan heritage is enough to make one minor request without requiring a skill check, as they comply out of fear of what could happen if they don’t.
Any further requests require checks and skill-based actions as normal.
#### Dragon Kings Legacy
11th Level Clan Feature
The Ryu who stand today are descendants of the survivors of the Three Clan war. Those who survived the bloodiest 10-day conflict in the Northern Bestial Nations history. Your genes remember this blood feud and you have tapped into the methods of survival your ancestors used to make it through their conflict.
Lineage of Survival. You gain resistance to the condition your chosen nature release inflicts and if you begin your turn with ranks of Envenomed, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra, to reduce the associated ranks by 1.
Unbreakable Wyrm. All Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast that require concentration, gains the Stable keyword for their duration.
Bloodline of Violence.  Once per turn, when you cast a Ryu Clan Hijutsu and gain its Dragon Rage effect, you regain 1 Draconic Chakra.
#### Defiance of Fate
15th Level Clan Feature
The Dragon seed in your soul has sprouted, awakening one of the Dragons of legend within you whose name has long since been lost to time. It has been nurtured by your trials, tribulations, struggles, failures and successes. Now that it lives within you, it refuses to allow fate to determine your destiny. You gain the following benefits;
Untamable. While in your Dragon’s Rage, you must now have 5 ranks of Sealed to have it forcefully ended.
Dragon Kings Decree. When initiative is rolled, you can spend multiples of 5 Draconic Chakra to issue a fate defying declaration, which lasts until the end of combat. Select the Decrees you want to evoke;
Attacks you make and damage you deal cannot be intercepted by Barriers or other creatures.
Once per combat, when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you defy fate and remain at 1 Hit point and enter your Awakened, Dragon’s Rage state at no additional Draconic Chakra cost, removing all current conditions you have as part of its activation.
Effects that would change or replace your dice roll result instead always allows you to reroll, taking the higher result.

#### Conqueror’s Art: Dragon Aegis

This barrier has 2d8 + 4 Temporary Hit points until the end of the current turn. These Temporary Hit points are in addition to any other Temporary hit points granted by Ryu Clan Hijutsu.
Dragons Rage. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, you gain resistance to your chosen nature releases inferior damage type. (Ex. Superior>Inferior) (Earth>Water>Fire>Wind>Lightning>Earth).
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and your Temporary hit points by 1d8.

Components: CM, M (or W (Blade Group)) Cost: 4 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu Description: You swipe your hand releasing a massive surge of Draconic chakra serrating everything in range. Make a melee Ninjutsu attack comparing the result vs the AC of all creatures in range. On a hit, affected creatures take [Unarmed Damage] (Or [Weapon Damage]) + 2d8 damage.
If this attack result is 5 or more over the AC of the affected creature, they must make a Strength saving throw to resist having their guard shattered, making the next attack targeting them, before the beginning of your next turn be made at advantage.
Dragons Rage. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, if an affected creature would cast a jutsu with the Barrier keyword, that barriers hit points, DR or AC bonus is reduced by half.       At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the size of the cone by 5 feet and the damage by 1d8 damage.
#### Conqueror’s Art: Monarchs Roar
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self (20-foot radius) Duration: Instant
Components: HS, CM Cost: 5 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu Description: With a guttural, chakra infused exhalation, you release the fury of the dragon coiled within. Chakra surges from within, shattering the air in a concussive, bestial roar, shattering the wills of those who would dare oppose you. Hostile creatures in range must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Success: The affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effect.
Failure: Affected creatures gain 1 rank of Demoralized and Shaken.
Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they gain 2 ranks of each.
Dragons Rage. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, allied creatures in range gain a +1 bonus to the next dice roll they make before the beginning of your next turn.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the size of the shockwave by 5 feet. If this jutsu is Cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Demoralized, Shaken and the bonus allied creatures gain by +1. If this jutsu is Cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Demoralized, Shaken and the bonus allied creatures gain by +1.
#### Conqueror’s Art: Fang of Ruin
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: 5 Feet Duration: Instant
Components: CM, M (or W (Blade Group)) Cost: 4 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Clash Description: You mold chakra until your arms look to be either side of a dragon’s maw that are slammed together on a foe. Make two melee Taijutsu attacks against a single creature, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] (Or [Weapon Damage]) +2d6 Chakra damage as you are able to rip a portion of the enemy’s chakra from their bodies.
Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, you instead open your arms wide and then slam both of your hands together crushing all creatures in a 15-foot cone together. Each creature in a 15-foot cone originating from you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure they take your [Unarmed Damage] (Or [Weapon Damage]) + 2d6 Chakra damage and their defenses are sundered, increasing damage they take from other sources by +2, until the beginning of your next turn.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the Chakra damage they take by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher you can make 2 additional attacks targeting a different creature or if in your Dragon Rage State increase the size of the cone by +15-feet and the damage they take from other sources by +4. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank if in your Dragon Rage State increase the size of the cone by +30-feet and the damage they take from other sources by +6.

All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, creatures take 3d10 damage and gain 1 rank of Weakened or half as much damage on a success.
Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, creatures that fail their saving throw by 5 or more take 5d10 damage instead.

#### Conqueror’s Art: Wyrmcaller’s Pulse
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: C-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self (30-Foot radius) Duration: Concentration, Up to 1 Minute
Components: HS, CM Cost: 8 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu Description: You amplify the bodies of your allies with your draconic chakra, compelling them to fight harder, while also diverting attention to yourself.
All creatures of your choice, excluding yourself within this jutsu’s radius is affected by this jutsu in either a Wyrmling or Prey like fashion. Wyrmling’s are often your allies or non-hostile creatures. While Prey are your foes or hostile creatures.
Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, for every creature, hostile or allied, that are affected by this jutsu, you gain +4 Temporary hit points..
Wyrmling’s gain a +1 bonus to their AC and 14 temporary hit points.
Prey must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid being compelled to strike you.
Critical Success: The affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effect.
Success: The affected creature has disadvantage on the next attack they make before the end of their next turn against creatures other than you.
Failure: Affected creatures gain disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you for the duration.
Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they also gain 2 ranks of your chosen nature releases condition. (Earth Release:  Shaken, Wind Release: Bleed, Fire Release: Burned, Water Release: Chilled, Lightning Release: Shocked).

#### Conqueror’s Art: Tyrant’s Warcry

Components: HS, CM Cost: 9 Chakra Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu Description: You bellow a resonant roar that shakes your allies of their hesitation and emboldens their aggression. All creatures of your choice are Emboldened for the duration.
An Emboldened creature gains the following;
+1d6 bonus to their damage rolls
Once per turn, on a successful attack, they may move 10 feet as part of the attack, not triggering attack of opportunities.
Resistance to the Demoralized, Dazed and Shaken conditions.
Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, this jutsu’s casting time becomes a Bonus Action.

#### Conqueror’s Art: Sovereign Verdict
Classification: Hijutsu Rank: A-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action. Range: Self (20-Foot Radius) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Components: CM, M Cost: 25 Chakra
Keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu
Description: You swirl your chakra-laced claws around you in a tightening spiral with the intent of rending a foes potential clear from their being, disrupting their flow of chakra and shattering their body.

Make a melee Ninjutsu attack, comparing the result vs the AC of all hostile creatures within 20 feet of you, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage]) + 6d6 damage as you rend them.
Next, damaged creatures must make a Charisma saving throw as you attempt to rend them of a core aspect of themselves. # Clan Feats
### Bloodline, Latent
Category: Clan, Rare
Prerequisite: You must take your first instance of this feat between levels 1 and 4. If you are level 5+, you cannot take this feat for the first time.
You have the blood of a famous clan, granting you fleeting usage of their secret techniques. You gain the following benefits:
Select any one clan except your current clan or Non-Clan.
You gain 10 Bloodline Points, which can be spent to purchase bloodline abilities from the chosen clan. You can find the listed abilities below. You retain any unspent points.
You can take this feat no more than twice.
You cannot take this feat a second time until you are level 12+. When you do, you gain additional bloodline points for the same clan you originally selected with this feat.
### Aburame
#### Hive Minded
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Aburame Clan, Level 8+
Your insects treat you and your body as a hive, it's queen, and its army. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you would make a check to maintain concentration on an Aburame clan Jutsu, you may instead make an Intelligence (Chakra Control) check.
The Bug Host clan features bonus die is increased to a d6.
When you would make an Intelligence or Charisma saving throw to resist the effects of a Genjutsu, you may use the bonus provided by your Bug Host feature for these saving throws.
#### Insect Nest Integrity
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Aburame Clan
You learn to utilize the hive mind integrity of your insects to cast and maintain Ninjutsu, you gain the following benefits:
Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You reduce the cost to maintain Aburame clan jutsu by an amount equal to its rank. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)
You learn one additional Aburame clan jutsu that you qualify for.
You can learn and create Aburame clan jutsu in half the time.
#### Symbiotic Insects
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Aburame Clan, Level 4+
You provide more than just a home for your insects to thrive, and they provide more than just combat utility. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain 60 feet of Darkvision as insects who thrive in total darkness impart on to you their extrasensory abilities.
You can go for 1 week without food or Water as the insects inside your body pass on their survival capabilities. After 1 week without appropriate levels of food or Water, you gain 1 rank of exhaustion for every extra day you go without.
When you would complete a short rest, your insects transpose their energy onto you. You roll a number of additional d4’s equal to half of your Proficiency bonus, adding the result to your Chakra points regained.
### Akimichi
#### Food Born Hardiness
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Akimichi
You learn to store more calories in your fat, you gain the following benefits:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a Maximum of 20.
Increase your Calorie count by your character level.
Increase your calorie count by an additional +1 calories every level thereafter.
#### Fat Conversion
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Akimichi Clan, Level 8+
You have learned to convert your Calories to provide additional benefits. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
As a bonus action on your turn, you can spend 5 Calories and 2 Chakra die. When you do, you regain a number of chakra equal to the result of the spent Chakra die + your Constitution ability score. You can do this once per long rest.
Akimichi clan Jutsu you cast using Calories, have their calorie cost reduced by 1.
#### Iron Gut
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Akimichi Clan, Level 4+
You have undergone rigorous training to condition your body to absorb nutrition from anything. You gain the following benefits;
When you would eat a consumable, such as a Blood Pill, Military Ration Pill, or any other ingestible consumable item, you regain 1d4 calories. You can regain calories this way twice per short rest.
You have resistance to the Poisoned and Weakened Condition rolling advantage on all saving throws and checks made to resist such conditions.
Poison damage you take from the Envenomed condition is reduced by 1 step (D6>D4).
You gain advantage on skill checks and Saving throws to resist environmental Hazards & Conditions.
### Bakuton
#### Augmented Explosives
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Bakuton Clan, Level 4+
The destructive potential of your explosions have increased significantly. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Constitution or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain +2 additional shrapnel die.
When you would spend a Shrapnel Die, you instead add twice the result.
#### Art is an Explosion!
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Bakuton Clan, Level 8+
You have learned to feed into both forms of art. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Constitution or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain the second clan Style that you did not pick at 1st level, gaining access to all of that Styles Hijutsu.
Your shrapnel die becomes a d10.
#### Detonator’s Gambit
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Bakuton Clan, Level 12+
When something explodes, you just can’t contain yourself. You find that all explosions push you ever closer to ecstasy. You gain the following Benefits;
When you roll a Shrapnel die, you treat 1’s as 2.
You gain +2 additional shrapnel die.
Whenever you roll the maximum damage on a Shrapnel Die or a Bakuton clan Hijutsu damage die add +3 Force damage to the total damage dealt.
When you would cast Explosion Release: Tower of the Sun, you instead do leave behind a corpse. If you are revived after casting this jutsu, you are unable to cast that ever again.
### Chinoike Clan
#### Blood Medicine
Category: Clan Prerequisite: Chinoike Clan To improve your manipulation of blood, you decide to take some time to study in the medical industry. You gain the following benefits;
You gain the ability to learn jutsu with the Medical keyword.
All Chinoike Clan Hijutsu you know gain the Medical keyword.
Medical jutsu you cast can benefit from your Sanguine Prowess feature and Ketsuryūgan bonus action ability.
Twice per long rest, when you heal a creature with a jutsu with the medical keyword, you can automatically remove all ranks of bleeding from them.
#### Sanguine Adept
Category: Clan Prerequisite: Chinoike Clan, Level 8+ You become more efficient with your blood techniques, whilst simultaneously learning new ways to mold blood; You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by +1, to a maximum of 20.
When you damage yourself for your Sanguine Prowess feature, you lose 2 hit points, instead of 1d4.
You can now use corpses as a sufficient source of water. When you do, you also simultaneously gain the benefits of your Sanguine Prowess feature, without needing to use your own blood. The amount of times this can be done with a corpse depends on its size. (Tiny-0 uses, Small-1, Medium-3, Large-6, Huge-10, Gargantuan-20)
You gain new options for your Sanguine Prowess feature;
Impose a -1d4 penalty against creatures who would attempt to counter, dispel, negate, or clash your jutsu
Deal an additonal amount of chakra damage to one affected creature equal to the amount of damage die used by the jutsu (ex. Dealing 6d10 cold damage also deals 6 chakra damage).
Reduce the movment speed of all affected creaures by -10 feet, to a minimum of 5 feet, until the end of your next turn.
#### Efficient Ketsuryūgan
Category: Clan Prerequisite: Chinoike Clan, Level 8+ Your Ketsuryūgan improves in efficiency and speed due to your dedication to your clan's bloodwork. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by +1, to a maximum of 20.
While your Ketsuryūgan is active, you cannot be Dazzled or Concussed.

### Iburi Clan
#### Weaponized Fumes
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Iburi Clan
You have become so adept at manipulating smoke that you are able to formulate the particles necessary in the air to create a weapon without spending much, if any, chakra. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Intelligence score by +1, up to the maximum of 20.
You gain a special natural weapon known as Smoke Shot. This weapon counts a ranged weapon and cannot have seals. This weapon uses your Ninjutsu attack bonus and has a range of (30/60). On a hit, you deal 1dX fire damage, where X is equal to double your Intelligence modifier (Min. 1d4 / Max. 1d12).
Select a damage type between Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing. Your Smoke Shot weapon's damage now counts as the damage type you chose for the purpose of casting Bukijutsu that require a ranged weapon of a specific damage type.
#### Ash and Dust
Category: Clan Prerequisite: Iburi Clan, Level 8+ The flames you generate leave behind a myriad of ash and dust within their wake. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Intelligence score by +1, up to the maximum of 20.
When you succeed in a clash with an Iburi Clan jutsu, the losing creature becomes blinded until the end of their next turn.
When you are within 15 feet of a source of fire, as an action you can siphon the smoke from the flames to refuel your energy, like adding kindling to a fire. You expend and roll a number of Chakra Die equal to half your proficiency bonus, gaining back chakra equal to the result. If the fire you use this ability on does not come from a jutsu based source, you add your Intelligence and Constitution modifier to the result. The fire is immediately extinguished. You cannot use this ability if the fire exists on a hostile creature, and can absorb smoke this way once per long rest.
If you have the Smoke Shot natural weapon, it gains an additional die of damage, and its range becomes (60/120).
#### Rebellious Cinders
Category: Clan Prerequisite: Iburi Clan, Level 12+ The destructive nature of your Will-O-Wisp improves, allowing you to broaden the type of jutsu that can benefit from this ability. You gain the following benefits;
You can now use your Will-O-Wisp feature on Fire Release jutsu that require a saving throw. If the jutsu targets creatures, you may target an additional creature. If the jutsu affects creatures within a certain radius, you may increase the radius of creature's affected by 5 feet.
When you would use your Will-O-Wisp feature on a Fire Release jutsu that requires an attack roll, the radius of creatures affected increases by 5 feet and you can now choose which creatures are affected.
Creatures that fail the saving throw against your Will-O-Wisp feature now take the full damage that the original target would've taken.
If you have the Smoke Shot natural weapon, the weapon becomes able to trigger your Will-O-Wisp clan feature.

Prerequisite: Ryu Clan, Level 4+
You have learned to tap into the blood of the dragons that run through your veins, controlling it like you would any normal chakra flowing through you. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can use Intelligence in place of Strength for unarmed attacks and damage, using your Dragon Claws damage die.
While you are wielding a Katana, you can spend 1 Chakra die. When you do, for the next minute your Katana becomes bathed in Draconic chakra, increasing its damage die by +1.
Ryu clan Hijutsu you cast, that initiate a clash, you always roll at Advantage.
#### True Dragons Blood
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Ryu Clan, Level 8+
The power of the Dragon’s rage within you has bubbled forth manifesting in ways other Ryu Clan members could only dream of. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Select a Second nature release from the Blood of the Dragon clan feature. Ryu Hijutsu now deal half of your original nature releases damage and half of your new dragon’s damage. If the damage value is odd, your original damage type will always deal the most damage between the split.
All Ryu clan jutsu and your Dragon Claws damage deals an additional die of damage, while you are benefiting from Dragons Rage clan feature. (If they deal damage)
When you activate Dragons Rage, you may roll a Chakra die, gaining three times result as both Temporary Hit and Chakra points for the duration of your Dragons Rage. Temporary hit points gained in this way can be added to Ryu Clan Hijutsu that grant Temporary hit points.
### Sarutobi
#### Beacon of Fire
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Sarutobi Clan, Level 8+
Your presence on the battlefield is felt by all, and your sheer willpower to push through a tough situation helps other find confidence within themselves as well. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you would spend Focus Points, all allied within 30 feet of you, gain a +X bonus to their next attack roll, saving throw or skill check before the end of their next turn, where X equals the number of Focus Points spent in a single instance.
By spending an additional +1 Focus Point when you activate an ability granted by your Inheritors of the Will of Fire clan feature, you may select one ally within 30 feet of you. They gain the same bonus or effect until the end of their next turn.
As a reaction, you can spend 2 Focus Points to reroll any saving throw or skill check, against any 1 condition you are currently suffering from.
#### Combination Master
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Sarutobi Clan, Level 8+
Through hard work, training, and sheer luck, you are able to imitate a Kekkei Genkai using your natural born Nature Affinities. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You may learn or create jutsu with both nature Release Keywords granted by your Advanced Nature Transformation clan feature. Select one clan, whose Hijutsu have both nature releases you have as a result of your Advanced Nature Transformation clan feature. You can learn their Hijutsu, but they lose the Hijutsu keyword for you only. Jutsu learned in this way can only be learned through spending downtime.
You can spend 2 Focus Points to forcefully combine Nature Releases. A jutsu you cast with only 1 Nature Release, gains another nature release that you can cast, dealing an additional 3 damage die worth of damage of the second nature Releases damage type.
#### Elemental Flux
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Sarutobi Clan, Level 12+
Your mastery of the elements expands beyond that of even other Sarutobi clan members. Having now learnt or mastered up to 3 elements, your arsenal of jutsu far wider. You gain the following Benefits;
Select one nature release you do not have. You gain the chosen nature release and it gains the benefits of your Advanced Chakra Control clan feature.
You learn 1 additional D-Rank, C-Rank and B-Rank jutsu with the same nature release chosen by this feature. These jutsu do not count against your jutsu known limitation. Beginning at 16th level, you learn 1 additional A-Rank jutsu following the same limitations.
#### Guardians of Will
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Sarutobi Clan, Level 4+
You have enhanced your jutsu to further protect the will of Fire. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Strength, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Once per turn, when you would deal damage with a Jutsu, you may add a bonus to your damage roll equal to your Proficiency, if you do not already.
Jutsu you cast that are gaining the benefit of your Advanced Chakra Control clan feature, ignore resistance.
#### Host of Flames
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Sarutobi Clan, Level 4+
The Fire inside you begins to grow, even affecting those around you, making your will infectious. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Strength, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can spend 2 Focus Points to automatically upcast a jutsu without spending Chakra if able.
You can spend 4 Focus Points to regain a number of hit points equal to 4d10+ Your level.
You can spend 5 Focus Points to automatically succeed a saving throw.
### Senju
#### Hashirama’s Legacy
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Senju Clan, Level 4+
The blood of the First Hokage, runs through your veins, providing you unmatched vitality. You cannot take this feat if you have another Legacy Senju clan feat. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Whenever you would regain hit points as a result of spending Hit die, targeting yourself with jutsu, features or Items that restore hit points, or using the Mitotic Regeneration clan feature, you regain additional hit points equal to your Constitution modifier once per casting, item use or feature activation up to twice per rest.
Increase your Hit Point total by your level. Whenever you would gain a level here after increase your hit point total by +1.
Constructs, Structures and creatures summoned or made by your Senju clan Hijutsu gain a +1 bonus to their AC and +10 bonus hit points.
#### Personified Leadership
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Senju Clan, level 8+
Your lineage has always been leaders for their own and previous generations. People follow you for both your heritage and your strength. Your ancestors would be proud. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Strength or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
As an action on your turn, you can embolden all allied creatures who can see or hear you within 30 feet. Make a Strength or Charisma check vs a DC 15. On a success you embolden all allies around you with the will of the Senju. Each allied creature of your choice within range gains 2 Senju Cells which they can use in any way listed under the Mitotic Regeneration clan feature, using your level and constitution modifier to determine die sizes and benefits. A creature can only gain the benefit of this feature twice per long rest.
As an action on your turn, you can inspire all allied creatures who can see or hear you within 30 feet. Make a Strength or Charisma check vs a DC 17. On a success all allied creatures (excluding yourself) of your choice within range gains 1 additional bonus action or an additional reaction until the end of their next turns. A creature can be in spired in this way once per long rest.
When you would make a Saving throw against a jutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword or a creature attempting to seal or teleport you in any way, you can choose to switch the saving throw to a Strength save. You can switch saves in this way twice per long rest.
#### Progenitor of Will
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Senju Clan, level 8+
You have a will that isn’t formed through training, events or circumstances. This will be born as a result of your lineage. Your will is passed down from generation to generation. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you would cast a Senju Hijutsu using your Constitution as your Ninjutsu ability modifier, you add it to your damage rolls.
You cannot have your memories of your allied creatures altered or manipulated in any way. A creature who would attempt to do so finds it impossible to alter them by any means.
You cannot be forced to harm or betray your allies as the result of a Jutsu that would normally cause you to act against your will. If a creature would forcefully command or control you to act against your will, in an attempt to betray or harm any creature you consider an ally, you are able to ignore those commands and automatically prevent yourself from acting towards such a goal, regardless of the rank of jutsu cast.
#### Tobirama’s Legacy
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Senju Clan, level 4+
The blood of the Second Hokage, runs through your veins, providing you unmatched Wisdom. You cannot take this feat if you have another Legacy Senju clan feat. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you would deal Earth damage with your Wood Release clan feature, you can choose to instead deal Cold Damage.
Select a number of Ninjutsu with the Water release keyword that you know, equal to your Proficiency Bonus, that does not have the Hijutsu keyword. Those Jutsu gains the Hijutsu keyword and counts as a Senju Hijutsu for the purpose of triggering Senju Clan Features. You can switch these jutsu when you would complete a long rest.
#### Tsunade’s Legacy
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Senju Clan, Level 4+
The blood of the Fifth Hokage, runs through your veins, providing you unmatched fortitude and intellect. You cannot take this feat if you have another Legacy Senju clan feat. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Strength or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can learn and create jutsu with the Medical keyword that does not deal damage.
You have found alternative uses for your Senju Cells. You can spend them in the following alternative ways. creature in the following ways based on the action spent;
As an action, by spending 2 Senju Cells, you remove 1 rank of any Physical or Elemental condition a willing creature other than yourself that you touch is afflicted by.
As an action, you can spend any number of cells you have on a willing creature other than yourself that you touch. For every 2 Senju Cells you spend, the creature regains 1d6 + Your Ninjutsu ability modifier hit points.

#### Folding Petals
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Shikigami Clan, Level 12+

Paper based ninja tools listed within your Papercraft Clan feature, has their save DC increase by 1, and deal an additional die of damage.

#### Legacy of Heroes
Category: Clan

You may substitute your unarmed attacks and unarmed damage (including with Taijutsu) with the weapon attack bonus and weapon’s damage of a Quarterstaff. #### Chi Expert
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Shi Hou Clan, Level 4+
You have become more accustomed to the techniques of Inner Chi, causing your body and will to adapt.
Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by +1, up to the maximum of 20.
You gain additional Inner Chi equal to your half character level, rounded up. You gain an additional +1 Inner Chi every 2 levels after you gain this feat.
Once per long rest as full turn action you may convert chakra in your body into Inner Chi. You may spend any amount of chakra and gain Inner Chi equal to the amount of chakra spent, this cannot surpass your Inner Chi maximum.
#### Master of Transformations
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Shi Hou Clan, Level 4+
You have become fluent in your ability to pull from the power of Sage Beasts and can utilize more of them at once. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by +1, up to the maximum of 20.
You gain 1 additional 72 Transformation that you qualify for at each tier (Simple, Advanced, Mythic).
You can take this feat more than once, up to two times total.
#### Chi Master
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Shi Hou Clan, Level 8+, Chi Expert Feat
You have completely mastered your Chi, becoming a true successor to the legacy of the first Sage of the Monkey Domain. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score by +1, up to the maximum of 20.
When jutsu you cast gains the benefits from your Inner Chi clan feature it instead gains an additional 2 damage die (This can only occur once per casting) or a +2 to attack rolls until the end of the current turn.

Once per short rest, when you deal damage with a jutsu cast only using Inner Chi, you can instead deal the maximum possible damage. Afterwards, you must succeed a Constitution ability check (DC: 12 + rank of the jutsu cast (D-Rank: 2, C-Rank: 4, B-Rank: 6….)) or else become Stunned until the start of your next turn as you have overexerted your muscles.
#### Ten Thousand Hairs
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Shi Hou Clan, Level 12+
After studying more about your ancestral heritage, you are one of the few members of your clan to unlock this special technique; creating afterimages from strands of hair.
When you would target a creature with a Taijutsu that deals damage, you can spend additional Inner Chi equal to that jutsu's rank, (D=2, C=4, B=6, A=8, S=10) and a hair will fly from your body, briefly creating an afterimage of yourself to perform the jutsu again. When the jutsu is cast this way, all damage done is halved, the jutsu doesn't benefit from any additional jutsu used to increase this jutsu's damage or chance to hit and cannot inflict any conditions. Afterimages also cannot cast Taijutsu that would cause it to die or to gain a negative condition on itself (such as Exhaustion).
A jutsu can benefit from this feature up to once per casting.
#### Seiten Taisei
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Shi Hou Clan, Level 16+
You can temporarily enter a perfect mindset, and truly reach the level of the great Heavenly Sage. You gain the following benefits;
Once per long rest, as an action, you can spend 5 Inner Chi and enter this heavenly state. While transformed you cannot cast nor concentrate on ninjutsu or genjutsu, and at the start of each of your turns you must spend 1 Inner Chi to maintain the transformation. You gain the following benefits;
All Taijutsu (and Bukijutsu, if you have the Legacy of Heroes feat) you cast gain the benefit from both effects of your Inner Chi feature. If the jutsu possess multiple attack rolls, each attack benefits from the additional damage dice.
You add 1d10 to all strength and dexterity skill checks you make.
You can use 72 Earthly Transformations as part of taking the attack action.
Reduce the cost of all 72 Earthly Transformations by half. Simple Transformations cost 0 Inner Chi to activate.

You gain proficiency in Perception, or expertise if you are already proficient.
Your Passive Perception when using sound is increased by +5.
#### Blessing of the Sage Bat
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Vesper Clan, Level 8+
Your body becomes able to mend wounds, seemingly on its own. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Constitution by +1, to a maximum of 20.
Your bodies natural ability to heal over time has become greatly accelerated. As a bonus action, you may spend up to 3 hit die. Roll each hit die spent, and gain the result as hit points.
When you would lose concentration of the Vampyr jutsu as the result of damage, you may spend 5 chakra to automatically succeed the concentration check.
Twice per long rest, while you are in Darkness or are under Moonlight, you may turn invisible for 1 minute or until you deal damage, cast a jutsu that would break stealth, or take damage.
### Yamanaka
[BOX]
| #### Psycho Mind Flux / Classification: Hijutsu Rank: Special (Starting Rank D-Rank) Casting Time: Action Range: 120 Feet Duration: Instant / Components: HS, CM, CS Cost: Special Keywords: Genjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Tactile Description: You combine the two unique Yamanaka clan jutsu into this new one, Psycho Mind Flux. Select one creature you can see within range; it must make a Charisma saving throw. / Critical Success: No further effects. / Success: Targets take 4d8 psychic damage. / Failure: Target take 5d8 psychic damage and must make one weapon attack against one of its closest allied creatures. / Critical Failure: Same as failure, but instead of a weapon attack, the target must cast a damaging jutsu at the highest rank possible against its closest allied creature. / At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the damage by 4d8 and the number of creatures you can target by +1. |
[/BOX]
#### Mental Boons
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yamanaka Clan
You've learned to adapt your mental acuity to keep your opponent’s guessing, you gain the following benefits:
Increase your Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You may use your Charisma instead of Wisdom as your Genjutsu ability modifier.
You gain a Yamanaka Boon that you qualify for.
You can learn and create Yamanaka Hijutsu in half the time.
#### Thought Breaker
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yamanaka Clan, Mind Body Disturbance, Level 8+
You’ve learned how to break the thoughts and minds of those who are the target of your psychological combat. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Mind Body Disturbance’s damage die is increased to a d10.
Creatures who fail Mind Body Disturbances’ saving throw also gains 1 rank of Concussed.
When a creature would critically fail a Genjutsu you cast on them, they lose concentration on all jutsu they are concentrating on.
#### Psycho Mind Flux
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yamanaka Clan, Mind Body Transfer, Mind Body Disturbance, Level 16+
You’ve learned how to combine the two most prolific jutsu in your clans history, manifesting a unique capability with both. You gain the following Benefits;
When you would cast Mind Body Transfer or Mind Body Disturbance, you may cast the other as a part of the same action, but they must be cast at the same rank. You can cast them both in this way twice per long rest.
When you would cast both Mind Body Transfer and Mind Body Disturbance in the same action, you must combine them both into a new jutsu known as Psycho Mind Flux. The new jutsu cast is cast at the same rank as the previous two jutsu, and its cost is the combined cost of them both.
### Yamada Clan
#### Asayama Pills (Changed)
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yamada Clan, Level 4+
You’re as comfortable rooting around the insides of a corpse as you are creating them, you gain the following benefits:
You gain expertise in the Medicine skill.
By spending 10 minutes, you can expend one use of a Medicine Kit in order to create Asayama Pills out of the corpse of a creature, these pills function as Greater Blood Pills or Greater Chakra Pills. You may also harvest Greater Military Ration Pills, but you gain 1 less pill. Pills created this way increase the resource they provide by half your proficiency bonus when consumed. You can gain a number of pills from a corpse depending on its size (Small = 1, Medium =2, Large = 3, Huge = 4, Gargantuan = 5). These pills last for 48 hours before their effects become half as potent (half the result when using these pills). After a week, these pills completely decay, having no effect when consumed.
#### Emotional Nirvana (Changed)
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yamada Clan, Level 8+
You have refined your control over your emotions. You gain the following benefits:
Increase your Wisdom score by +1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain an additional number of Balance Die equal to your Wisdom modifier (Min. 1).
When you would roll for initiative and have no Balance Die remaining, you regain 2 Balance Die.
When you roll a 1 or 2 on a Balance Die you may reroll it taking the second result. You can benefit from this feature no more than twice per round.
#### Yamada Asaemon
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yamada Clan, Level 12+
Your swordsman skills have reached their absolute peak, you have been granted the name Asaemon. You gain the following benefits:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by +1, to a maximum of 20.
Once per turn, when dealing damage with a Katana or Odachi, you may roll the damage twice and take whichever result.
When you use Single-Swing Style I or Single-Swing Style II to make one attack instead of multiple, you may spend 5 chakra or 1 Balance die to treat it as if you made one additional attack with the feature or jutsu.
### Yoton
#### Earthen Blood
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yoton Clan, Level 4+
Earthen chakra runs through your veins, as you learn to balance the hardened nature release within. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Intelligence or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Select one damage type from the following; Wind, Earth or Water. Your Calcified Skin clan feature now applied to the selected damage type. You cannot change this once selected.
Yoton clan jutsu you cast has their range increased by 10 feet. If the jutsu affects a cube, radius, sphere or cylinder, then increase its size by 10 feet.
You are immune to Environmental conditions and hazardous traps related to Fire or Heat.
#### Blazing Blood
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yoton Clan, Level 8+
Blazing chakra runs through your blood, making you far more powerful than anyone else could even fathom. You gain the following benefits;
Increase your Intelligence or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Yoton clan Hijutsu you cast deals additional damage equal to your Constitution modifier, once per casting.
When you would make a Strength or Constitution saving throw, you may add your Intelligence modifier. You can do this twice per long rest.
#### Molten Blood
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yoton Clan, Level 12+
Molten chakra has begun to bubble up and reinforce both your strengths and defenses. People can’t stand being near you for long periods of time in combat or risk sustaining more damage just from being near. You gain the following benefits;
Increase the DC to remove the Molten condition to 23.
A creature submerging themselves in water cannot end the Molten condition.
You can use up to three qualities on a single jutsu with the Lava Release clan feature.
You no longer need to spend chakra to maintain concentration on Lava Release: Lava Chakra Mode.
### Yuki
#### Chilling Realization
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yuki Clan, Level 8+
You move so swiftly you seem to be gliding on Ice. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
While on Water, Ice or Snow, you ignore the difficult terrain or movement penalty it impairs and instead gain a +15 bonus to your movement speed.
When you would make a Dexterity Saving throw, you gain a +2 bonus to the save so long as you are standing on ice, snow, or water.
#### Freezing Façade
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yuki Clan
You become accustomed to the cold and all that comes with it. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Intelligence or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can use your Intelligence for Stealth, Deception and Persuasion checks.
You ignore any perception-based penalties a cold environment would inflict.
You ignore difficult terrain created by jutsu with the Water Release or Wind Release keywords.
When you would make a saving throw against a jutsu with the Water Release or Wind Release keywords and fail, you can spend 1 Chakra die to remake the save. You can do this twice per long rest.
#### Frigid Frost
Category: Clan
Prerequisite: Yuki Clan, Level 4+
You exert so much Ice release chakra when you cast your clan jutsu that it becomes impossible to dodge and must instead be resisted. You gain the following Benefits;
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Yuki clan Hijutsu you cast with a range of Self (Range), can have their size increased by 10 feet when cast.
Yuki clan Hijutsu you cast that would force a creature to make a Dexterity saving throw, you can choose to instead make them make a Strength saving throw.
Creatures who fail a Strength saving throw against a Yuki clan Hijutsu you cast, become bruised.
